// ---------------------------------------------------------------- JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001
// LIGHT AND DARK. Every colour that sits on a surface goes through one of three calls:
// _lzFg (text and icons), _lzBg (cards, sheets, fields, the canvas), _lzLine (borders and the
// gold hairline). In light mode they return the colour untouched - the dashboard you know.
// In dark mode (mission control) surfaces become plum-black glass, dark text becomes ivory,
// and gold, plum buttons and accents stay. The mode is 'system' | 'light' | 'dark' in
// SharedPreferences lazo_theme, shared by the couple and vendor dashboards.
bool _lzDark = false;
String _lzThemePref = 'system';
const Color _lzSurface = Color(0xFF1E1023); // dark card glass
const Color _lzCanvas = Color(0xFF140A17); // dark canvas
const Color _lzText = Color(0xFFF3ECE5);
const Color _lzMuted = Color(0xFFB7AABF);

Color _lzFg(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final int v = c.value & 0x00FFFFFF;
  if (v == 0x241E2B || v == 0x000000 || v == 0x141414) return _lzText.withOpacity(c.opacity);
  if (v == 0x6B5F72 || v == 0x8A7D90 || v == 0x8A7F90 || v == 0x5C5262) return _lzMuted.withOpacity(c.opacity);
  if (v == 0x52284F || v == 0x3D1C3B || v == 0x4A2147 || v == 0x6A3A66) return const Color(0xFFE2C6DE).withOpacity(c.opacity);
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness >= 0.5) return c;
  return h.withLightness(0.74).withSaturation(h.saturation.clamp(0.0, 0.55)).toColor();
}

Color _lzBg(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final int v = c.value & 0x00FFFFFF;
  final double a = c.opacity;
  if (v == 0xFAF6F0) return (a > .97 ? _lzCanvas : _lzSurface).withOpacity(a);
  if (v == 0xFFFDF9 || v == 0xFFFFFF || v == 0xFFFDF8) return _lzSurface.withOpacity(a);
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness <= 0.75) return c;
  // a tinted light surface (pale gold, pale red, pale green ...) keeps a whisper of its hue
  return Color.lerp(_lzSurface, h.withLightness(0.5).toColor(), 0.12)!.withOpacity(a);
}

Color _lzLine(Color c) {
  if (!_lzDark) return c;
  final HSLColor h = HSLColor.fromColor(c);
  if (h.lightness <= 0.75) return c;
  if ((c.value & 0x00FFFFFF) == 0xFFFFFF) return Colors.white.withOpacity(c.opacity * .14);
  return const Color(0xFFD9B77C).withOpacity(.26 * c.opacity);
}

Color? _lzFgN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzFg(c);
Color? _lzBgN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzBg(c);
Color? _lzLineN(Color? c) => c == null ? null : _lzLine(c);

bool _lzResolveDark(BuildContext context) {
  if (_lzThemePref == 'dark') return true;
  if (_lzThemePref == 'light') return false;
  return MediaQuery.platformBrightnessOf(context) == Brightness.dark;
}

// JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001: the Appearance control - three segments, gold on the chosen one.
Widget _lzThemePicker(void Function(String) onPick) {
  Widget seg(String v, IconData icon, String label) {
    final bool on = _lzThemePref == v;
    return Expanded(
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => onPick(v),
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          height: 40,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: on ? const Color(0xFFD9B77C) : Colors.transparent,
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          ),
          child: Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: <Widget>[
            Icon(icon, size: 16, color: on ? const Color(0xFF3D1C3B) : _lzFg(const Color(0xFF6B5F72))),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            Text(label,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,
                    fontWeight: on ? FontWeight.w800 : FontWeight.w600,
                    color: on ? const Color(0xFF3D1C3B) : _lzFg(const Color(0xFF6B5F72)))),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  return Container(
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
    decoration: BoxDecoration(
      color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0)).withOpacity(_lzDark ? 1 : .9),
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(const Color(0xFFE6D6B8))),
    ),
    child: Row(children: <Widget>[
      seg('light', Icons.light_mode_rounded, 'Light'),
      seg('dark', Icons.dark_mode_rounded, 'Dark'),
      seg('system', Icons.brightness_auto_rounded, 'Auto'),
    ]),
  );
}

  // v159: TOWNS + EVERY METRO. The list above is the offline fallback; the real one is the site's, rebuilt every
  // night, so a new metro or town shows up here without a FlutterFlow paste.
  static List<Map<String, String>> kTowns = <Map<String, String>>[];
  static bool _placesLoaded = false;
  static Future<void>? _placesLoading;

  static Future<void> _loadPlaces() {
    if (_placesLoaded) return Future<void>.value();
    return _placesLoading ??= _fetchPlaces();
  }

  static Future<void> _fetchPlaces() async {
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse('https://meetlazo.com/assets/places.json'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (r.statusCode != 200) return;
      final dynamic j = jsonDecode(utf8.decode(r.bodyBytes));
      if (j is! Map) return;
      final List<Map<String, String>> ms = <Map<String, String>>[];
      for (final dynamic m in (j['metros'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
        if (m is! Map) continue;
        final String id = (m['id'] ?? '').toString();
        if (id.isEmpty) continue;
        ms.add(<String, String>{
          'id': id,
          'label': (m['label'] ?? id).toString(),
          'state': (m['state'] ?? '').toString(),
        });
        final dynamic lat = m['lat'];
        final dynamic lng = m['lng'];
        if (lat is num && lng is num) {
          kMetroLatLng[id] = <double>[lat.toDouble(), lng.toDouble()];
        }
      }
      if (ms.length >= 20) {
        ms.sort((Map<String, String> a, Map<String, String> b) =>
            (a['label'] ?? '').compareTo(b['label'] ?? ''));
        kMetros = ms;
      }
      final List<Map<String, String>> ts = <Map<String, String>>[];
      for (final dynamic t in (j['towns'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
        if (t is! Map) continue;
        final String n = (t['n'] ?? '').toString();
        final String m = (t['m'] ?? '').toString();
        if (n.isEmpty || m.isEmpty) continue;
        ts.add(<String, String>{'n': n, 's': (t['s'] ?? '').toString(), 'm': m});
      }
      kTowns = ts;
      _placesLoaded = true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO places: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      _placesLoading = null;
    }
  }

  // One picker for "where": type a town or a city. A town answers with its Lazo metro, because vendors live in
  // metros; the town comes back too so the couple's own town is kept. Returns {metro, town} or null.
  Future<Map<String, String>?> _pickPlace(
      {String title = 'Where’s the wedding?'}) async {
    await _loadPlaces();
    if (!mounted) return null;
    final TextEditingController q = TextEditingController();
    final Map<String, String>? out = await _lzSheet<Map<String, String>>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setP) {
          final String s = q.text.trim().toLowerCase();
          final List<Map<String, String>> rows = <Map<String, String>>[];
          final Set<String> seen = <String>{};
          if (s.length >= 2) {
            for (final Map<String, String> t in kTowns) {
              if (rows.length >= 40) break;
              final String n = (t['n'] ?? '').toLowerCase();
              if (n.startsWith(s) && seen.add('${t['n']}|${t['s']}')) {
                rows.add(<String, String>{
                  'metro': t['m'] ?? '',
                  'town': t['n'] ?? '',
                  'title': '${t['n']}, ${t['s']}',
                  'sub': '${_metroLabel(t['m'] ?? '')} area',
                });
              }
            }
          }
          for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros) {
            final String l = (m['label'] ?? '').toLowerCase();
            if (s.isEmpty || l.contains(s)) {
              rows.add(<String, String>{
                'metro': m['id'] ?? '',
                'town': '',
                'title': m['label'] ?? '',
                'sub': (m['state'] ?? '').isEmpty ? 'Lazo city' : 'Lazo city · ${m['state']}',
              });
            }
          }
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                20, 18, 20, 12 + MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text(title,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plumDeep),
                        fontSize: 20,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text('Type your town or the nearest city.',
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13)),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: q,
                  autofocus: true,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                  onChanged: (String _) => setP(() {}),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Town or city', hint: 'Worcester'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 380,
                  child: rows.isEmpty
                      ? Center(
                          child: Text(
                              'No Lazo city near “${q.text.trim()}” yet.\nTry the nearest larger city.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13)))
                      : ListView.builder(
                          itemCount: rows.length,
                          itemBuilder: (BuildContext c, int i) {
                            final Map<String, String> r = rows[i];
                            return ListTile(
                              dense: true,
                              leading: Icon(
                                  (r['town'] ?? '').isEmpty
                                      ? Icons.location_city_rounded
                                      : Icons.place_rounded,
                                  color: gold,
                                  size: 20),
                              title: Text(r['title'] ?? '',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                                      fontSize: 15,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                              subtitle: Text(r['sub'] ?? '',
                                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12.5)),
                              onTap: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, <String, String>{
                                'metro': r['metro'] ?? '',
                                'town': r['town'] ?? '',
                              }),
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
    q.dispose();
    return out;
  }

  // ---------------- v131: FOLDABLE CARDS ----------------
  // The big cards on the hub fold to a one-line row that still carries the
  // headline, so a folded card keeps earning its row. What is folded lives on
  // the couple doc (layout.collapsed) and follows them across devices. The
  // hero, the desk tiles and the June bar are structure and never fold.
  Set<String> _folded = <String>{};
  String _foldsSynced = '';

  void _syncFolds(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> lay = d['layout'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(d['layout'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<String> l = ((lay['collapsed'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        .map((dynamic e) => e.toString())
        .toList()
      ..sort();
    final String sig = l.join(',');
    if (sig == _foldsSynced) return;
    _foldsSynced = sig;
    _folded = l.toSet();
  }

  Future<void> _toggleFold(String k) async {
    setState(() {
      if (!_folded.remove(k)) _folded.add(k);
      _foldsSynced = (_folded.toList()..sort()).join(',');
    });
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'layout': <String, dynamic>{'collapsed': _folded.toList()}
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO fold: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _foldBtn(String k, {bool onDark = false}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    return Tooltip(
      message: folded ? 'Unfold' : 'Fold',
      child: _Press(
        scale: .88,
        tick: _Tick.select,
        onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
        child: Container(
          width: 26,
          height: 26,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
            color: _lzBg(onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.14) : plum.withOpacity(.05)),
            border:
                Border.all(color: _lzLine(onDark ? ivory.withOpacity(.3) : goldLine)),
          ),
          child: Icon(
              folded ? Icons.expand_more_rounded : Icons.expand_less_rounded,
              size: 16,
              color: _lzFg(onDark ? ivory : muted)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The card, or its folded row. `gap` matches the spacing the card carries
  // beneath itself.
  Widget _fold(String k, String title, String? summary, Widget card,
      {double gap = 0}) {
    final bool folded = _folded.contains(k);
    Widget child;
    if (!folded) {
      child = card;
    } else if (summary == null) {
      child = const SizedBox.shrink();
    } else {
      child = Padding(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: gap),
        child: _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          tick: _Tick.select,
          onTap: () => _toggleFold(k),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 11, 12, 11),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              Text(title, style: _serif(size: 20, height: 1)),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(summary,
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              _foldBtn(k),
            ]),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    return AnimatedSize(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 320),
      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
      child: KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<bool>(folded), child: child),
    );
  }

  // The one line the folded weather card keeps.
  String? _weatherFoldSummary(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return 'Tell June your city';
    }
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime day =
        ts is Timestamp ? ts.toDate() : DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(day, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(day)}|$metro'];
    if (w == null) return 'Reading the sky\u2026';
    return '${w['hi']}\u00b0 \u00b7 ${_wmoLabel(w['code'] as int)} \u00b7 ${_metroLabel(metro)}';
  }

  // ---------------- v98: SWITCHING FROM ANOTHER PLANNING SITE ----------------
  // Nothing here touches the other site. Guests come from the CSV those sites
  // export; the website, budget and vendors go through June; the registry is
  // linked, never moved. Every import previews before it saves.

  bool _showImportCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (couple['importDismissedAt'] != null || couple['importedAt'] != null)
      return false;
    final dynamic c = couple['createdAt'] ?? couple['setupDoneAt'];
    if (c is Timestamp && DateTime.now().difference(c.toDate()).inDays > 21)
      return false;
    return true;
  }

  // ---------------- v158: BRING YOUR WEDDING TO LAZO (JC-LAZO-POPUP-1014) ----------------
  // One popup, one place at a time. Pick where you are coming from (the steps
  // name that site's own menus), then a tile per thing to bring. Each import
  // happens inside the popup: June reads it while you watch, you check and fix
  // what she found (vendors are an editable list: name, what they do, amount),
  // and it ends on a "done" card. Tiles remember what came across this visit.
  static const List<List<String>> _kImportFrom = <List<String>>[
    <String>['knot', 'The Knot'],
    <String>['zola', 'Zola'],
    <String>['weddingwire', 'WeddingWire'],
    <String>['joy', 'Joy'],
    <String>['other', 'Somewhere else'],
  ];

  String _importFromGuess(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic acq = couple['acq'];
    final String s =
        (acq is Map ? (acq['source'] ?? acq['from'] ?? '') : '').toString().toLowerCase();
    if (s.contains('knot')) return 'knot';
    if (s.contains('zola')) return 'zola';
    if (s.contains('wire')) return 'weddingwire';
    if (s.contains('joy')) return 'joy';
    return '';
  }

  /// The site's own display date when June found one, else the ISO date as "March 27, 2027".
  String _importNiceDate(Map<String, dynamic> site) {
    final String shown = (site['dateDisplay'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (shown.isNotEmpty) return shown;
    final String iso = (site['dateIso'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(iso);
    if (d == null) return iso;
    const List<String> mo = <String>['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July',
      'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];
    return '${mo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';
  }

  String _importFromName(String src) {
    for (final List<String> e in _kImportFrom) {
      if (e[0] == src) return e[1];
    }
    return 'the other site';
  }

  List<String> _guestExportSteps(String src) {
    switch (src) {
      case 'knot':
        return <String>['On The Knot, open Guest List.', 'Choose Manage (or the three-dot menu), then Export. A CSV downloads.'];
      case 'zola':
        return <String>['On Zola, open Guest List.', 'Choose Manage, then Export guest list. A CSV downloads.'];
      case 'weddingwire':
        return <String>['On WeddingWire, open Guests.', 'Choose Export, then CSV.'];
      case 'joy':
        return <String>['On Joy, open your guest list.', 'Export it as a CSV file.'];
      default:
        return <String>['Export your guest list as a spreadsheet (CSV).', 'Any columns work. A name column is enough.'];
    }
  }

  String _siteHint(String src) {
    switch (src) {
      case 'knot':
        return 'theknot.com/us/your-names';
      case 'zola':
        return 'zola.com/wedding/your-names';
      case 'weddingwire':
        return 'weddingwire.com/web/your-names';
      case 'joy':
        return 'withjoy.com/your-names';
      default:
        return 'Your website link, or paste the page text';
    }
  }

  Future<void> _importSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    bool open = true;
    String src = _importFromGuess(couple);
    String view = 'home'; // home | guests | vendors | website | budget | done
    final Map<String, String> done = <String, String>{};
    bool busy = false;
    String busyLabel = '';
    String err = '';
    String doneTitle = '', doneBody = '';
    // guests
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> gRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    String gFile = '';
    // vendors
    String vMode = 'type';
    final TextEditingController vText = TextEditingController();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> vRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    Map<String, String> vBooked = <String, String>{}; // category -> vendor already booked there
    // website
    final TextEditingController wText = TextEditingController();
    Map<String, dynamic> wSite = <String, dynamic>{};
    List<dynamic> wRegs = <dynamic>[];
    final Set<String> wKeep = <String>{};
    // budget
    String bMode = '';
    final TextEditingController bText = TextEditingController();
    Map<String, Map<String, num>> bCats = <String, Map<String, num>>{};
    double bTotal = 0;

    const List<List<String>> siteFields = <List<String>>[
      <String>['names', 'Names'],
      <String>['dateIso', 'Date'],
      <String>['venueName', 'Venue'],
      <String>['venueAddress', 'Address'],
      <String>['ceremonyTime', 'Ceremony'],
      <String>['cocktailTime', 'Cocktail hour'],
      <String>['receptionTime', 'Reception'],
      <String>['dressCode', 'Dress code'],
      <String>['hotelBlock', 'Hotel block'],
      <String>['transport', 'Getting there'],
      <String>['parking', 'Parking'],
      <String>['travelNotes', 'Travel'],
      <String>['story', 'Your story'],
    ];

    Map<String, dynamic> vRow(String name, String cat, String amt, String lazoId) =>
        <String, dynamic>{
          'name': TextEditingController(text: name),
          'amount': TextEditingController(text: amt),
          'category': cat,
          'lazoVendorId': lazoId,
        };

    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      builder: (BuildContext sheetCtx) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter set) {
        void up(VoidCallback f) {
          if (open) set(f);
        }

        void finish(String key, String summary, String title, String body) {
          up(() {
            done[key] = summary;
            doneTitle = title;
            doneBody = body;
            busy = false;
            err = '';
            view = 'done';
          });
        }

        Widget fromChips() => Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
              for (final List<String> e in _kImportFrom)
                _Press(
                  scale: .97,
                  onTap: () => up(() => src = e[0]),
                  child: AnimatedContainer(
                    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: src == e[0] ? plumDeep : _lzBg(cardBg),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: src == e[0] ? plumDeep : _lzLine(goldLine))),
                    child: Text(e[1],
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                            color: src == e[0] ? gold : _lzFg(plum))),
                  ),
                ),
            ]);

        Widget errBox() => err.isEmpty
            ? const SizedBox.shrink()
            : Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 12),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFBEAEA)),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
                  child: Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(Icons.error_outline_rounded, size: 18, color: Color(0xFFB3261E)),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Text(err,
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: _lzFg(ink), height: 1.4))),
                  ]),
                ),
              );

        Widget stepList(List<String> steps) => Column(children: <Widget>[
              for (int i = 0; i < steps.length; i++)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                  child: Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[

                                color: gold, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                    const SizedBox(width: 12),
                    Expanded(
                        child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: Text(steps[i],
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: _lzFg(ink), height: 1.45)),
                    )),
                  ]),
                ),
            ]);

        Widget bigPick(IconData ic, String title, String sub, VoidCallback onTap) => _Press(
              scale: .985,
              onTap: busy ? null : onTap,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18, vertical: 22),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75), width: 1.4)),
                child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(ic, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 30),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(title,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: _lzFg(plum))),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(sub,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.35)),
                ]),
              ),
            );

        Widget stat(String n, String label) => Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14, horizontal: 10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                  Text(n, style: _serif(size: 28)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                  Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                ]),
              ),
            );

        Widget rowCard({required Widget child}) => Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 10, 12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
              child: child,
            );

        // ---------- actions ----------
        Future<void> pickGuests() async {
          final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
              type: FileType.custom,
              allowedExtensions: <String>['csv', 'txt', 'tsv'],
              withData: true);
          if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty || res.files.first.bytes == null) return;
          String bad = '';
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> g =
              _parseGuestFile(res.files.first.bytes!, (String m) => bad = m);
          up(() {
            gRows = g;
            gFile = res.files.first.name;
            err = bad;
          });
        }

        Future<void> saveGuests() async {
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            final int added = await _saveImportedGuests(gRows);
            final int skipped = gRows.length - added;
            finish(
                'guests',
                '$added added',
                added == 0 ? 'Everyone was already here' : '$added guest${added == 1 ? '' : 's'} added',
                skipped > 0
                    ? '$skipped already on your list ${skipped == 1 ? 'was' : 'were'} left as they were.'
                    : 'Find them under Guests, with their parties, meals and RSVPs.');
          } catch (e) {
            up(() {
              busy = false;
              err = 'Couldn’t save the guests. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        Future<void> readVendors() async {
          if (vText.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            busyLabel = 'June is reading your list and looking for each vendor on Lazo…';
            err = '';
          });
          String why = '';
          final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _juneImport(<String, dynamic>{
            'kind': 'vendors',
            'input': vText.text.trim(),
            'metroId': (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString()
          }, onError: (String m) => why = m);
          final List<dynamic> vs = r != null && r['vendors'] is List ? r['vendors'] as List : <dynamic>[];
          // who is already booked, so the review can say what an import would replace
          final Map<String, String> booked = <String, String>{};
          try {
            final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pq = await _planRef.get();
            for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in pq.docs) {
              final String n = (d.data()['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if ((d.data()['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' && n.isNotEmpty) booked[d.id] = n;
            }
          } catch (_) {}
          up(() {
            busy = false;
            vBooked = booked;
            if (r == null) {
              err = why.isEmpty ? 'June couldn’t read that. Try again in a moment.' : why;
              return;
            }
            if (vs.isEmpty) {
              err = 'June couldn’t find vendors in that. Put each one on its own line.';
              return;
            }
            vRows.clear();
            for (final dynamic e in vs) {
              if (e is! Map) continue;
              final String cat = (e['category'] ?? '').toString();
              vRows.add(vRow(
                  (e['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                  kCategories.any((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] == cat) ? cat : '',
                  e['amount'] is num && (e['amount'] as num) > 0
                      ? (e['amount'] as num).round().toString()
                      : '',
                  (e['lazoVendorId'] ?? '').toString()));
            }
          });
        }

        List<Map<String, dynamic>> readyVendors() => vRows
            .where((Map<String, dynamic> r) =>
                (r['name'] as TextEditingController).text.trim().isNotEmpty &&
                (r['category'] as String).isNotEmpty)
            .toList();

        Future<void> saveVendors() async {
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> ready = readyVendors();
          if (ready.isEmpty) return;
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
            for (final Map<String, dynamic> r in ready) {
              final num? amt = num.tryParse(
                  (r['amount'] as TextEditingController).text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.]'), ''));
              b.set(
                  _planRef.doc(r['category'] as String),
                  <String, dynamic>{
                    'status': 'booked',
                    'vendorName': (r['name'] as TextEditingController).text.trim(),
                    if ((r['lazoVendorId'] as String).isNotEmpty) 'vendorId': r['lazoVendorId'],
                    if (amt != null && amt > 0) 'budgetActual': amt,
                    'bookedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                    'source': 'import',
                  },
                  SetOptions(merge: true));
            }
            await b.commit();
            await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
                SetOptions(merge: true));
            _logActivity(
                'added ${ready.length} booked vendor${ready.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from ${_importFromName(src)}.',
                open: 'vendors');
            finish(
                'vendors',
                '${ready.length} on your team',
                '${ready.length} vendor${ready.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} on your team',
                'They’re marked booked, with the amounts you gave. Message the ones on Lazo straight from Vendor team.');
          } catch (e) {
            up(() {
              busy = false;
              err = 'Couldn’t save your vendors. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        Future<void> readSite() async {
          if (wText.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            busyLabel = 'June is reading your website…';
            err = '';
          });
          String why = '';
          final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _juneImport(
              <String, dynamic>{'kind': 'website', 'input': wText.text.trim()},
              onError: (String m) => why = m);
          up(() {
            busy = false;
            if (r == null) {
              err = why.isEmpty ? 'June couldn’t read that. Try again in a moment.' : why;
              return;
            }
            wSite = r['site'] is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(r['site'] as Map) : <String, dynamic>{};
            wRegs = r['registryLinks'] is List ? r['registryLinks'] as List : <dynamic>[];
            wKeep.clear();
            for (final List<String> f in siteFields) {
              if ((wSite[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty) wKeep.add(f[0]);
            }
            if (wRegs.isNotEmpty) wKeep.add('registries');
            if (wKeep.isEmpty) {
              err = 'June couldn’t find wedding details there. If the site has a password, paste the page text instead of the link.';
            }
          });
        }

        Future<void> saveSite() async {
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            final Map<String, dynamic> keep = <String, dynamic>{
              for (final String k in wKeep)
                if (k != 'registries') k: wSite[k],
            };
            if (wKeep.contains('dateIso') && (wSite['dateDisplay'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
              keep['dateDisplay'] = wSite['dateDisplay'];
            }
            final bool live = await _saveImportedSite(
                keep, wKeep.contains('registries') ? wRegs : const <dynamic>[], couple);
            final int n = wKeep.length;
            finish(
                'website',
                '$n detail${n == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                live ? 'Your Lazo website is updated' : 'Your website is ready to design',
                live
                    ? 'The details you kept are on your site now. Photos you’ll add yourself - they’re yours, and we can’t copy them from another site.'
                    : 'Open Website and pick a design - it’s filled in with what you kept.');
          } catch (e) {
            up(() {
              busy = false;
              err = 'Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        Future<void> readBudget(Map<String, dynamic> args) async {
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            busyLabel = 'June is reading your budget…';
            err = '';
          });
          String why = '';
          final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _juneImport(args, onError: (String m) => why = m);
          up(() {
            busy = false;
            if (r == null) {
              err = why.isEmpty ? 'June couldn’t read that. Try again in a moment.' : why;
              return;
            }
            final List<dynamic> lines = r['lines'] is List ? r['lines'] as List : <dynamic>[];
            bCats = <String, Map<String, num>>{};
            bTotal = 0;
            for (final dynamic e in lines) {
              if (e is! Map) continue;
              final String slug = (e['category'] ?? '').toString();
              if (!kCategories.any((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] == slug)) continue;
              final num planned = e['planned'] is num ? e['planned'] as num : 0;
              final num paid = e['paid'] is num ? e['paid'] as num : 0;
              final Map<String, num> cur =
                  bCats.putIfAbsent(slug, () => <String, num>{'planned': 0, 'paid': 0});
              cur['planned'] = (cur['planned'] ?? 0) + planned;
              cur['paid'] = (cur['paid'] ?? 0) + paid;
              bTotal += planned;
            }
            if (bCats.isEmpty) {
              err = lines.isEmpty
                  ? 'June couldn’t find budget lines there.'
                  : 'June found lines but couldn’t match them to vendor categories. Try naming each line by vendor type (Photographer, Florist…).';
            }
          });
        }

        Future<void> pickBudgetFile() async {
          final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
              type: FileType.custom,
              allowedExtensions: <String>['csv', 'txt', 'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp'],
              withData: true);
          if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty || res.files.first.bytes == null) return;
          final String ext = (res.files.first.extension ?? '').toLowerCase();
          final Map<String, dynamic> args = <String, dynamic>{'kind': 'budget'};
          if (ext == 'csv' || ext == 'txt') {
            args['input'] = utf8.decode(res.files.first.bytes!, allowMalformed: true);
          } else {
            if (res.files.first.bytes!.lengthInBytes > 4500 * 1024) {
              up(() => err = 'That image is too large. A screenshot of the budget page works best.');
              return;
            }
            args['imageBase64'] = base64Encode(res.files.first.bytes!);
            args['imageType'] =
                ext == 'png' ? 'image/png' : (ext == 'webp' ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg');
          }
          await readBudget(args);
        }

        Future<void> saveBudget() async {
          up(() {
            busy = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            await _saveImportedBudget(bCats, bTotal);
            finish('budget', '${bCats.length} lines', 'Budget imported',
                '${bCats.length} line${bCats.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}, ${_railMoney(bTotal)} planned. Real local prices sit beside each one in Budget.');
          } catch (e) {
            up(() {
              busy = false;
              err = 'Couldn’t save the budget. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        void back() => up(() {
              view = 'home';
              err = '';
              busy = false;
            });

        // ---------- views ----------
        Widget tile(String key, IconData ic, String title, String sub, VoidCallback onTap) {
          final String? d = done[key];
          return _Press(
            scale: .985,
            onTap: onTap,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 14, 12, 14),

                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                  border: Border.all(color: d != null ? vGreen.withOpacity(.55) : _lzLine(goldLine))),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                    width: 40,
                    height: 40,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: d != null ? vGreen.withOpacity(.12) : plumDeep,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
                    child: Icon(d != null ? Icons.check_rounded : ic,
                        color: d != null ? vGreen : gold, size: 20)),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                    Text(title,
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: _lzFg(plum))),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(d ?? sub,
                        maxLines: 2,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            color: d != null ? vGreen : _lzFg(muted),
                            fontWeight: d != null ? FontWeight.w600 : FontWeight.w400,
                            height: 1.35)),
                  ]),
                ),
                Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
              ]),
            ),
          );
        }

        if (view == 'done') {
          return _lzFrame(ctx, title: '', children: <Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Center(
              child: TweenAnimationBuilder<double>(
                tween: Tween<double>(begin: .6, end: 1),
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 420),
                curve: Curves.easeOutBack,
                builder: (BuildContext c, double v, Widget? ch) => Transform.scale(scale: v, child: ch),
                child: Container(
                    width: 74,
                    height: 74,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.12), shape: BoxShape.circle),
                    child: const Icon(Icons.check_rounded, color: vGreen, size: 40)),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),

  /// Reads a guest-list export (Knot, Zola, WeddingWire, Joy or any CSV).
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseGuestFile(Uint8List bytes, void Function(String) onErr) {
    String text = String.fromCharCodes(bytes);
    try {
      text = utf8.decode(bytes, allowMalformed: true);
    } catch (_) {}
    if (text.contains('\t') && !text.contains(',')) text = text.replaceAll('\t', ',');
    final List<List<String>> rows = _parseCsv(text);
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      onErr('That file has no guest rows.');
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    }
    final List<String> h = rows.first;
    final int iFirst = _colIndex(h, <String>['firstname', 'first']);
    final int iLast = _colIndex(h, <String>['lastname', 'last', 'surname']);
    final int iName = _colIndex(h, <String>['guestname', 'fullname', 'name', 'guest']);
    final int iEmail = _colIndex(h, <String>['email', 'emailaddress']);
    final int iPhone = _colIndex(h, <String>['phone', 'mobile', 'cell']);
    final int iParty = _colIndex(h, <String>['partyname', 'party', 'household', 'group', 'family']);
    final int iRsvp = _colIndex(h, <String>['rsvpstatus', 'rsvp', 'attending', 'response', 'status']);
    final int iMeal = _colIndex(h, <String>['meal', 'mealchoice', 'entree', 'dinner']);
    final int iPlus = _colIndex(h, <String>['plusones', 'plusone', 'additionalguests', 'guests', 'partysize']);
    final int iAddr = _colIndex(h, <String>['address', 'street', 'mailingaddress']);
    if (iName < 0 && iFirst < 0) {
      onErr('Couldn’t find a name column. Check the file has headers like First Name and Last Name.');
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    }
    String cell(List<String> r, int i) => (i >= 0 && i < r.length) ? r[i].trim() : '';
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> guests = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final List<String> r in rows.skip(1)) {
      // v139: Knot and Zola exports carry First / Last; a column that only
      // CONTAINS "name" (First Name) used to win and drop every surname
      String name = (iFirst >= 0 || iLast >= 0) ? ('${cell(r, iFirst)} ${cell(r, iLast)}').trim() : '';
      if (name.isEmpty && iName >= 0) name = cell(r, iName);
      if (name.isEmpty) continue;
      final String rsvpRaw = cell(r, iRsvp).toLowerCase();
      final String rsvp = rsvpRaw.contains('accept') ||
              rsvpRaw == 'yes' ||
              rsvpRaw.contains('attending') && !rsvpRaw.contains('not')
          ? 'yes'
          : (rsvpRaw.contains('decline') || rsvpRaw == 'no' || rsvpRaw.contains('not attending')
              ? 'no'
              : 'pending');
      int plus = 0;
      final String pRaw = cell(r, iPlus).toLowerCase();
      if (pRaw.isNotEmpty) {
        final int? n = int.tryParse(pRaw.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9]'), ''));
        if (n != null)
          plus = iPlus >= 0 && h[iPlus].toLowerCase().contains('size') ? (n - 1).clamp(0, 20) : n.clamp(0, 20);
        else if (pRaw == 'yes' || pRaw == 'true') plus = 1;
      }
      guests.add(<String, dynamic>{
        'name': name,
        'email': cell(r, iEmail),
        'phone': cell(r, iPhone),
        'party': cell(r, iParty),
        'rsvp': rsvp,
        'meal': cell(r, iMeal),
        'plusOnes': plus,
        'address': cell(r, iAddr),
        'source': 'import',
      });
    }
    if (guests.isEmpty) onErr('No guests found in that file.');
    return guests;
  }

  /// Adds guests not already on the list (by name). Returns how many were added.
  Future<int> _saveImportedGuests(List<Map<String, dynamic>> guests) async {
    final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> existing = await _coupleRef.collection('guests').get();
    final Set<String> have = existing.docs
        .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['name'] ?? '').toString().trim().toLowerCase())
        .toSet();
    int added = 0;
    WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    int inBatch = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> g in guests) {
      final String key = g['name'].toString().toLowerCase();
      if (have.contains(key)) continue;
      have.add(key); // v139: no dupes within the file
      b.set(_coupleRef.collection('guests').doc(),
          <String, dynamic>{...g, 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()});
      added++;
      inBatch++;
      if (inBatch >= 400) {
        await b.commit();
        b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
        inBatch = 0;
      }
    }
    if (inBatch > 0) await b.commit();
    await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    if (added > 0) _logActivity('imported $added guest${added == 1 ? '' : 's'} to the list.', open: 'guests');
    return added;
  }

  /// Saves the website details the couple kept. True when a live Lazo site was updated.
  Future<bool> _saveImportedSite(
      Map<String, dynamic> site, List<dynamic> regs, Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> clean = <String, dynamic>{
      for (final MapEntry<String, dynamic> e in site.entries)
        if ((e.value ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty) e.key: e.value.toString().trim(),
    };
    final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('weddingSites')
        .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
        .limit(1)
        .get();
    if (clean.isNotEmpty) {
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        await q.docs.first.reference
            .set(<String, dynamic>{...clean, 'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } else {
        await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'siteDraft': clean}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> cp = <String, dynamic>{'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()};
    if ((clean['names'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty && (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty)
      cp['names'] = clean['names'];
    if ((clean['dateIso'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty && couple['weddingDate'] == null) {
      final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(clean['dateIso'].toString());
      if (d != null) cp['weddingDate'] = Timestamp.fromDate(d);
    }
    await _coupleRef.set(cp, SetOptions(merge: true));
    if (regs.isNotEmpty) {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cur = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
        for (final dynamic e in (c.data()?['registryLinks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
          if (e is Map) Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)
      ];
      for (final dynamic e in regs) {
        if (e is! Map) continue;
        final String url = (e['url'] ?? '').toString();
        if (!_urlOk(url) || cur.any((Map<String, dynamic> l) => l['url'] == url)) continue;
        final List<String>? st = _storeFor(url);
        cur.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'label': (e['label'] ?? (st == null ? 'Registry' : st[1])).toString(),
          'url': url,
          'store': st == null ? '' : st[1]
        });
      }
      await _saveRegistry(cur);
    }
    return q.docs.isNotEmpty;
  }

  Future<void> _saveImportedBudget(Map<String, Map<String, num>> byCat, double total) async {
    // an import never lowers what is already recorded as spent (paid invoices, typed amounts)
    final Map<String, num> spent = <String, num>{};
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pq = await _planRef.get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in pq.docs) {
        if (d.data()['budgetActual'] is num) spent[d.id] = d.data()['budgetActual'] as num;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    for (final MapEntry<String, Map<String, num>> en in byCat.entries) {
      final num paid = en.value['paid'] ?? 0;
      b.set(
          _planRef.doc(en.key),
          <String, dynamic>{
            'budgetPlanned': en.value['planned'],
            if (paid > 0 && paid > (spent[en.key] ?? 0)) 'budgetActual': paid
          },
          SetOptions(merge: true));
    }
    await b.commit();
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
    final num curTotal = c.data()?['budgetTotal'] is num ? c.data()!['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
      if (curTotal <= 0 && total > 0) 'budgetTotal': total,
      'importedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  // -- CSV: a small RFC-4180 reader (quotes, commas in quotes, CRLF) --
  List<List<String>> _parseCsv(String text) {
    final List<List<String>> rows = <List<String>>[];
    List<String> row = <String>[];
    final StringBuffer cell = StringBuffer();
    bool inQ = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
      final String ch = text[i];
      if (inQ) {
        if (ch == '"') {
          if (i + 1 < text.length && text[i + 1] == '"') {
            cell.write('"');
            i++;
          } else {
            inQ = false;
          }
        } else {
          cell.write(ch);
        }
      } else if (ch == '"') {
        inQ = true;
      } else if (ch == ',') {
        row.add(cell.toString());
        cell.clear();
      } else if (ch == '\n' || ch == '\r') {
        if (ch == '\r' && i + 1 < text.length && text[i + 1] == '\n') i++;
        row.add(cell.toString());
        cell.clear();
        if (row.any((String c) => c.trim().isNotEmpty)) rows.add(row);
        row = <String>[];
      } else {
        cell.write(ch);
      }
    }
    row.add(cell.toString());
    if (row.any((String c) => c.trim().isNotEmpty)) rows.add(row);
    return rows;
  }

  int _colIndex(List<String> headers, List<String> wants) {
    for (final String w in wants) {
      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
        final String h =
            headers[i].toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
        if (h == w) return i;
      }
    }
    for (final String w in wants) {
      for (int i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
        final String h =
            headers[i].toLowerCase().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]'), '');
        if (h.contains(w)) return i;
      }
    }
    return -1;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _juneImport(Map<String, dynamic> args,
      {void Function(String)? onError}) async {
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneImport',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 90)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r = await fn.call(args);
      return Map<String, dynamic>.from(r.data as Map);
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      // a server-side failure arrives as 'internal' / 'unavailable' with a bare code for a message
      final bool raw = const <String>['internal', 'unknown', 'unavailable', 'deadline-exceeded'].contains(e.code) ||
          (e.message ?? '').trim().length < 16;
      final String m = raw
          ? 'June couldn\u2019t read that right now. Try again in a moment.'
          : (e.message ?? 'June couldn\u2019t read that.');
      if (onError != null) onError(m); else _toast(m);
    } catch (e) {
      if (onError != null) onError('June couldn\u2019t read that. Check your connection and try again.');
      else _toast('June couldn\u2019t read that: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }


  // ---------------- v97: SAVED VENDORS ----------------
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _savedList(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final dynamic e
        in (couple['savedVendors'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
      if (e is Map) out.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e));
    }
    return out;
  }

  bool _isSaved(Map<String, dynamic> couple, String placeId) =>
      _savedList(couple)
          .any((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == placeId);

  Future<void> _toggleSave(Map<String, dynamic> v, {bool quiet = false}) async {
    final String pid = (v['placeId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (pid.isEmpty) return;
    final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
    final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _savedList(couple);
    final bool already =
        list.any((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == pid);
    if (already) {
      list.removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['placeId'] == pid);
    } else {
      final List<dynamic> cats =
          v['categories'] is List ? v['categories'] as List : const <dynamic>[];
      list.insert(0, <String, dynamic>{
        'placeId': pid,
        'name': (v['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        'category': cats.isEmpty ? '' : cats.first.toString(),
        'metroId': (v['metroId'] ?? '').toString(),
        'image': (v['coverUrl'] ??
                ((v['gallery'] is List && (v['gallery'] as List).isNotEmpty)
                    ? (v['gallery'] as List).first
                    : (v['logoUrl'] ?? '')))
            .toString(),
        'startingPrice': (v['startingPrice'] ?? '').toString(),
        'verified': v['verified'] == true,
        'savedAt': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      });
    }
    await _coupleRef.set(
        <String, dynamic>{'savedVendors': list.take(60).toList()},
        SetOptions(merge: true));
    if (!quiet)
      _toast(already
          ? 'Removed from saved.'
          : 'Saved. It\u2019s on your home under Saved vendors.');
  }

  // A "Save" heart on a public vendor page sends ?save=<vendorId>; the auth
  // flow stashes it across signup.
  Future<void> _openPendingSave() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String id = '';
    try {
      id = (Uri.base.queryParameters['save'] ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (id.isEmpty) id = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_save') ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (id.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_save');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(id).get();
      final Map<String, dynamic>? vd = vs.data();
      if (vd == null) return;
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = Map<String, dynamic>.from(vd);
      v['placeId'] = vs.id;
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      if (_isSaved(c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{}, vs.id)) return;
      await _toggleSave(v, quiet: true);
      _toast(
          '${v['name'] ?? 'That vendor'} is saved - it\u2019s on your home.');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending save: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }
