  // v144: the meetlazo.com/welcome/<hook>/ landing pages (the Meta ad funnels)
  // send ?from=welcome-<page>&intent=<yes|website|budget|import>&names=&date=
  // &metro=&design=&source=&guests= (+ utm_*). Names, date and city land on the
  // couple doc when it has none, first-touch attribution is kept once on
  // couples.acq, and the intent opens the screen the ad promised. URL first;
  // else the JSON the auth flow stashed in SharedPreferences
  // 'lazo_pending_welcome' (goNamed drops the query string).
  Future<void> _openPendingWelcome() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    Map<String, String> p = <String, String>{};
    try {
      final Map<String, String> q = Uri.base.queryParameters;
      final bool ours = (q['from'] ?? '').startsWith('welcome') ||
          (q['intent'] ?? '').isNotEmpty ||
          (q['names'] ?? '').isNotEmpty ||
          (q['date'] ?? '').isNotEmpty;
      if (ours) p = Map<String, String>.from(q);
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (p.isEmpty) {
        final String raw = prefs.getString('lazo_pending_welcome') ?? '';
        if (raw.isNotEmpty) {
          final dynamic j = jsonDecode(raw);
          if (j is Map) {
            p = j.map((dynamic k, dynamic v) =>
                MapEntry<String, String>(k.toString(), (v ?? '').toString()));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (p.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_welcome');
    } catch (_) {}
    final String from = (p['from'] ?? '').trim();
    final String intent = (p['intent'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String names = (p['names'] ?? '').trim();
    final String dateS = (p['date'] ?? '').trim();
    final String metro =
        (p['metro'] ?? p['metroId'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String design =
        (p['design'] ?? p['template'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    final String source = (p['source'] ?? '').trim();
    final int? guests = int.tryParse((p['guests'] ?? '').trim());
    try {
      // let _loadCoupleId land first so a partner's shared plan is the target
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
      if (!mounted) return;
      await _loadPlaces(); // v159: a welcome-page metro outside the old 45 is real too
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      final Map<String, dynamic> up = <String, dynamic>{};
      if (names.isNotEmpty &&
          names.length <= 80 &&
          (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty) {
        up['names'] = names;
      }
      if (dateS.isNotEmpty && couple['weddingDate'] == null) {
        final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(dateS);
        if (d != null && d.year >= 2024 && d.year <= 2040) {
          up['weddingDate'] = Timestamp.fromDate(d);
        }
      }
      if (metro.isNotEmpty &&
          (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty &&
          kMetros.any((Map<String, String> m) => m['id'] == metro)) {
        up['metroId'] = metro;
      }
      if (guests != null &&
          guests > 0 &&
          guests <= 2000 &&
          couple['guestEstimate'] == null) {
        up['guestEstimate'] = guests;
      }
      if (couple['acq'] == null && (from.isNotEmpty || intent.isNotEmpty)) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> acq = <String, dynamic>{
          'from': from,
          'intent': intent,
          if (source.isNotEmpty) 'source': source,
          'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        };
        for (final String k in <String>[
          'utm_source',
          'utm_medium',
          'utm_campaign',
          'utm_content',
          'utm_term',
          'fbclid'
        ]) {
          final String v = (p[k] ?? '').trim();
          if (v.isNotEmpty) acq[k] = v.length > 200 ? v.substring(0, 200) : v;
        }
        up['acq'] = acq;
      }
      if (up.isNotEmpty) {
        up['updatedAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
        await _coupleRef.set(up, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> merged = <String, dynamic>{...couple, ...up};
      // give the shell a frame to mount, like the other handlers
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
      if (!mounted) return;
      switch (intent) {
        case 'website':
          if (design.isNotEmpty) {
            try {
              await prefs?.setString('lazo_pending_template', design);
            } catch (_) {}
            await _openPendingTemplate(); // v96 path: opens the editor on it
          } else {
            setState(() => _view = _View.website);
          }
          break;
        case 'budget':
          Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan =
              <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
          try {
            final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> ps = await _planRef.get();
            plan = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
              for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                  in ps.docs)
                d.id: d.data()
            };
          } catch (_) {}
          if (!mounted) return;
          await _budgetSheet(merged, plan);
          break;
        case 'import':
          await _importSheet(merged);
          break;
        default:
          final bool missing = (merged['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty ||
              merged['weddingDate'] == null ||
              (merged['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty;
          if (missing) {
            await _setupSheet(merged);
          } else if (up.isNotEmpty) {
            _toast('Welcome. Your date and city are in - here’s your plan.');
          }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending welcome: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // v96: they chose a design on meetlazo.com/wedding-websites ("Use Sage").
  // The auth flow stashes it; if they have no site yet, open the editor on
  // that design so the first thing they see is the site they came for.
  Future<void> _openPendingTemplate() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String tpl = '';
    String pal = '';
    try {
      tpl = (Uri.base.queryParameters['template'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
      pal = (Uri.base.queryParameters['palette'] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (tpl.isEmpty)
        tpl = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_template') ?? '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
      if (pal.isEmpty)
        pal = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_palette') ?? '')
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
    } catch (_) {}
    if (tpl.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_template');
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_palette');
    } catch (_) {}
    const List<String> known = <String>[
      'sage',
      'noir',
      'dune',
      'fete',
      'tide',
      'flora',
      'atelier',
      'verona',
      'shore',
      'summit',
      'ranch',
      'starlit',
      'frost',
      'harvest',
      'aquarelle',
      'prism',
      'meadow',
      'gilded',
      'marigold',
      'papel',
      'peony'
    ];
    if (!known.contains(tpl)) return;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty)
        return; // they already have a site; don't override it
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> couple = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 700));
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        _pendingTemplate = tpl;
        _pendingPalette = pal;
        _view = _View.website;
      });
      final String defNames = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      _editWebsite(couple, null, defNames);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending template: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // v93: the reason they signed up was a vendor. Open that conversation
  // before they have to find it again. The auth flow stashes ?vendor= in a
  // preference because goNamed drops the query string; a direct hit with
  // ?vendor= on this page works too.
  Future<void> _openPendingVendor() async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    String vendorId = '';
    try {
      vendorId = (Uri.base.queryParameters['vendor'] ?? '').trim();
    } catch (_) {}
    SharedPreferences? prefs;
    try {
      prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      if (vendorId.isEmpty) {
        vendorId = (prefs.getString('lazo_pending_vendor') ?? '').trim();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await prefs?.remove('lazo_pending_vendor');
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .get();
      final Map<String, dynamic>? vd = vs.data();
      if (vd == null || !mounted) return;
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = Map<String, dynamic>.from(vd);
      v['placeId'] = vs.id;
      // Give the shell a frame to mount, then open the composer.
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));
      if (!mounted) return;
      _sendInquiry(v);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO pending vendor: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _loadCoupleId() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> u =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final String cu = (u.data()?['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString();
      if (cu.isNotEmpty && cu != _uid && mounted) {
        setState(() => _coupleIdCache = cu);
        _ensureCoupleChime(cu);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO coupleId: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // ---------------- v91: SHARED LIVE STREAMS ----------------
  // One Firestore listener per query, the same Stream object every build, and
  // the latest snapshot replayed to late subscribers - so a card that scrolls
  // back into view never draws an empty frame.
  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveQuery(
      String key, Query<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveQ[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(() => build().snapshots());
      _liveQ[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _liveDoc(
      String key, DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> Function() build) {
    _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? l = _liveD[key];
    if (l == null) {
      l = _Live<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          () => build().snapshots());
      _liveD[key] = l;
    }
    return l.stream;
  }

  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqStream() {
    return _liveQuery(
        'inq:$_cid',
        () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('inquiries')
            .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid));
  }

  QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _inqLatest() =>
      _liveQ['inq:$_cid']?.latest;

  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqList(
      AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
    return (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'flagged')
        .toList();
  }

  // ---------------- v91: TYPE + SMALL HELPERS ----------------
  Widget _glyphSwitch(Widget child) => AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 160),
        switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
        switchOutCurve: Curves.easeIn,
        transitionBuilder: (Widget w, Animation<double> a) => ScaleTransition(
            scale: Tween<double>(begin: .7, end: 1).animate(a),
            child: FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: w)),
        child: child,
      );

  TextStyle _serif(
      {double size = 24,
      FontWeight weight = FontWeight.w600,
      Color? color,
      double height = 1.05}) {
    // v130: display sizes tighten as they grow; body stays at 0.
    final double track = size >= 26 ? -0.015 * size : 0;
    try {
      return GoogleFonts.cormorantGaramond(
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: (color ?? _lzFg(plum)),
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track,
          fontFeatures: const <FontFeature>[FontFeature.liningFigures()]);
    } catch (_) {
      return TextStyle(
          fontFamily: 'serif',
          fontSize: size,
          fontWeight: weight,
          color: (color ?? _lzFg(plum)),
          height: height,
          letterSpacing: track);
    }
  }

  // v130: screens slide in from the right and leave the way they came. The
  // hub - the thing underneath - only fades. A key that ends in ':root'
  // marks "underneath".
  Widget _viewSwitch(Widget child) {
    final bool reduced = _reducedMotion(context);
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 260),
      reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: reduced ? 140 : 200),
      switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
      switchOutCurve: Curves.easeInCubic,
      layoutBuilder: (Widget? current, List<Widget> previous) => Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: <Widget>[...previous, if (current != null) current],
      ),
      transitionBuilder: (Widget c, Animation<double> a) {
        final Key? k = c.key;
        final bool root = k is ValueKey<String> && k.value.endsWith(':root');
        final Widget faded = FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: c);
        if (reduced || root) return faded;
        return SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(.04, 0), end: Offset.zero)
              .animate(a),
          child: faded,
        );
      },
      child: child,
    );
  }

  Widget _screenKeyed(Widget screen) => KeyedSubtree(
      key: ValueKey<String>(
          _view == _View.hub ? 'hub:root' : 'view:${_view.name}'),
      child: screen);

  static const List<String> _kMo = <String>[
    'Jan',
    'Feb',
    'Mar',
    'Apr',
    'May',
    'Jun',
    'Jul',
    'Aug',
    'Sep',
    'Oct',
    'Nov',
    'Dec'
  ];
  static const List<String> _kMoLong = <String>[
    'January',
    'February',
    'March',
    'April',
    'May',
    'June',
    'July',
    'August',
    'September',
    'October',
    'November',
    'December'
  ];

  String _shortDate(DateTime d) => '${_kMo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  String _longDate(DateTime d) =>
      '${_kMoLong[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';

  String _initials(String name) {
    final List<String> parts = name
        .replaceAll('&', ' ')
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty && w.toLowerCase() != 'and')
        .toList();
    if (parts.isEmpty) return 'L';
    if (parts.length == 1) return parts.first[0].toUpperCase();
    return (parts[0][0] + parts[1][0]).toUpperCase();
  }

  String _ago(dynamic ts) {
    if (ts is! Timestamp) return '';
    final Duration d = DateTime.now().difference(ts.toDate());
    if (d.inMinutes < 1) return 'now';
    if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
    if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
    if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
    return _shortDate(ts.toDate());
  }

  String _catLabel(String slug) {
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      if (c['slug'] == slug) return c['label'] ?? slug;
    }
    return slug;
  }

  String _metroLabel(String id) {
    for (final Map<String, String> m in kMetros) {
      if (m['id'] == id) return m['label'] ?? id;
    }
    return '';
  }

  // The month a category usually needs to be booked by, for this couple.
  DateTime? _dueFor(String slug, DateTime? wedding) {
    if (wedding == null) return null;
    final int lead = kLeadMonths[slug] ?? 6;
    return DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month - lead, 1);
  }

  Widget _pill(String label, Color c, {bool solid = false}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 3),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(solid ? c : c.withOpacity(.14)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(c.withOpacity(solid ? 1 : .5))),
      ),
      child: Text(label,
          style: TextStyle(
              color: _lzFg(solid ? ivory : (c == gold ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F) : c)),
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
    );
  }

  // ================= POPUPS (JC-LAZO-POPUP-1014) =================
  // One frame for every popup in the dashboard. Phones get a bottom sheet with a
  // grab handle over a plum veil. Wide screens (760 px and up) get a centred card
  // that rises and fades in, instead of a sheet stretched along the bottom of a
  // monitor. Every showModalBottomSheet / showDialog in this widget goes through
  // _lzSheet / _lzDialog, so a popup built before this still gets the new frame.
  // New and rebuilt popups also use _lzFrame (header, scrolling body, footer that
  // stays put), _lzActions, _lzConfirm, _lzBusy and _lzNote.
  static const double _lzWideAt = 760;

  Color get _lzVeil =>
      _lzDark ? Colors.black.withOpacity(.6) : plumDeep.withOpacity(.42);

  Widget _lzRise(Animation<double> a, Widget child, {Color? veil}) {
    final CurvedAnimation c = CurvedAnimation(
        parent: a, curve: Curves.easeOutCubic, reverseCurve: Curves.easeInCubic);
    return Stack(children: <Widget>[
      Positioned.fill(
          child: IgnorePointer(
              child: FadeTransition(
                  opacity: c, child: ColoredBox(color: veil ?? _lzVeil)))),
      FadeTransition(
        opacity: c,
        child: SlideTransition(
          position: Tween<Offset>(
                  begin: const Offset(0, .035), end: Offset.zero)
              .animate(c),
          child: ScaleTransition(
              scale: Tween<double>(begin: .975, end: 1).animate(c),
              child: child),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Future<T?> _lzSheet<T>({
    required BuildContext context,
    required WidgetBuilder builder,
    Color? backgroundColor,
    ShapeBorder? shape,
    bool isScrollControlled = true,
    BoxConstraints? constraints,
    bool isDismissible = true,
    Color? barrierColor,
  }) {
    final Size size = MediaQuery.of(context).size;
    final Color bg = backgroundColor ?? _lzBg(ivory);
    final bool clear = bg.opacity == 0;
    _lzBeforeOpen();
    if (size.width >= _lzWideAt) {
      final double wantW = constraints?.maxWidth ?? 620;
      final double maxW = wantW > 760 ? 760 : wantW;
      return _lzTrack<T>(showGeneralDialog<T>(
        context: context,
        barrierDismissible: isDismissible,
        barrierLabel: 'Close',
        barrierColor: Colors.transparent,
        transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 280),
        pageBuilder: (BuildContext ctx, Animation<double> a1,
                Animation<double> a2) =>
            SafeArea(
          child: Center(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(
                    maxWidth: maxW, maxHeight: size.height * .88),
                child: Material(
                  color: clear ? Colors.transparent : bg,
                  elevation: clear ? 0 : 22,
                  shadowColor: plumDeep.withOpacity(.4),
                  shape: clear
                      ? null
                      : RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                          side: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                  clipBehavior: clear ? Clip.none : Clip.antiAlias,
                  child: builder(ctx),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        transitionBuilder: (BuildContext ctx, Animation<double> a1,
                Animation<double> a2, Widget child) =>
            _lzRise(a1, child),
      ));
    }
    return _lzTrack<T>(showModalBottomSheet<T>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: isScrollControlled,
      isDismissible: isDismissible,
      useSafeArea: true,
      backgroundColor: bg,
      barrierColor: barrierColor ?? _lzVeil,
      elevation: 0,
      constraints: constraints,
      shape: shape ??
          const RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => clear
          ? builder(ctx)
          : Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 9, bottom: 3),
                child: Container(
                    width: 38,
                    height: 4.5,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _lzLine(goldLine).withOpacity(.95),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3))),
              ),
              Flexible(child: builder(ctx)),
            ]),
    ));
  }

  // While a popup is open, toasts are drawn on the root overlay so they show ON the popup (a SnackBar
  // paints under modal routes: an "Undo" behind a sheet could not be reached and surfaced minutes later).
  int _lzOpen = 0;
  OverlayEntry? _lzToastEntry;
  Timer? _lzToastTimer;

  void _lzBeforeOpen() {
    // a popup takes the focus with it; closing it must not hand the keyboard (and the scroll) to a field
    FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus?.unfocus();
    if (mounted) ScaffoldMessenger.maybeOf(context)?.hideCurrentSnackBar();
  }

  Future<T?> _lzTrack<T>(Future<T?> shown) {
    _lzOpen++;
    return shown.whenComplete(() {
      if (_lzOpen > 0) _lzOpen--;
    });
  }

  void _lzToastDrop() {
    _lzToastTimer?.cancel();
    final OverlayEntry? e = _lzToastEntry;
    _lzToastEntry = null;
    if (e != null && e.mounted) e.remove();
  }

  /// Shows [message] above any open popup. False when no popup is open (the caller uses its SnackBar).
  bool _lzToastOver(String message,
      {String? action, Future<void> Function()? onAction, Duration duration = const Duration(seconds: 4)}) {
    if (_lzOpen <= 0 || !mounted) return false;
    final OverlayState? ov = Overlay.maybeOf(context, rootOverlay: true);
    if (ov == null) return false;
    _lzToastDrop();
    final OverlayEntry e = OverlayEntry(
      builder: (BuildContext c) => Positioned(
        left: 16,
        right: 16,
        bottom: 20 + MediaQuery.of(c).viewInsets.bottom + MediaQuery.of(c).padding.bottom,
        child: Center(
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
            child: Material(
              color: plumDeep,
              elevation: 14,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              child: Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, action == null ? 14 : 6, action == null ? 16 : 6, action == null ? 14 : 6),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text(message,
                          style: const TextStyle(color: ivory, fontSize: 14, height: 1.35))),
                  if (action != null)
                    TextButton(
                        style: TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: gold),
                        onPressed: () async {
                          _lzToastDrop();
                          if (onAction != null) await onAction();
                        },
                        child: Text(action, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    // inserted after the current frame: a toast raised while a popup is closing must not touch the tree mid-layout
    _lzToastEntry = e;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (_lzToastEntry == e && !e.mounted) ov.insert(e);
    });
    _lzToastTimer = Timer(duration, () {
      if (_lzToastEntry == e) _lzToastDrop();
    });
    return true;
  }

  /// A Cloud Function error as a sentence a person can read. A server-side failure arrives as a bare
  /// code ("internal", "unavailable") for a message; those get [fallback].
  String _lzFnMsg(Object e, String fallback) {
    if (e is FirebaseException) {
      const List<String> raw = <String>['internal', 'unknown', 'unavailable', 'deadline-exceeded', 'cancelled', 'resource-exhausted'];
      final String m = (e.message ?? '').trim();
      if (raw.contains(e.code) || m.length < 16 || m.toLowerCase() == e.code.toLowerCase()) return fallback;
      return m;
    }
    return fallback;
  }

  Future<T?> _lzDialog<T>({
    required BuildContext context,
    required WidgetBuilder builder,
    bool barrierDismissible = true,
    Color? barrierColor,
  }) {
    _lzBeforeOpen();
    return _lzTrack<T>(showGeneralDialog<T>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: barrierDismissible,
      barrierLabel: 'Close',
      barrierColor: Colors.transparent,
      transitionDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
      pageBuilder: (BuildContext ctx, Animation<double> a1,
              Animation<double> a2) =>
          Theme(
        data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
          dialogTheme: DialogThemeData(
            backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
            surfaceTintColor: Colors.transparent,
            elevation: 22,
            shadowColor: plumDeep.withOpacity(.4),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                side: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
            titleTextStyle: _serif(size: 24),
            contentTextStyle:
                TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14, height: 1.5),
            actionsPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 4, 18, 16),
          ),
          filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: gold,
                  foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                  minimumSize: const Size(0, 44),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
                  textStyle: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)))),
          textButtonTheme: TextButtonThemeData(
              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: _lzFg(muted),
                  minimumSize: const Size(0, 44),
                  textStyle: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))),
        ),
        child: Builder(builder: builder),
      ),
      transitionBuilder: (BuildContext ctx, Animation<double> a1,
              Animation<double> a2, Widget child) =>
          _lzRise(a1, child, veil: barrierColor),
    ));
  }

  /// The standard popup layout: an icon, a serif title and one line under it,
  /// a close button, a body that scrolls, and a footer that never scrolls away.
  /// Sits inside _lzSheet; lifts above the keyboard on phones.
  Widget _lzFrame(
    BuildContext ctx, {
    IconData? icon,
    required String title,
    String? subtitle,
    required List<Widget> children,
    Widget? footer,
    Widget? headerExtra,
    VoidCallback? onBack,
    EdgeInsets bodyPadding = const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 4, 22, 22),
    bool fill = false,
  }) {
    final Widget body = SingleChildScrollView(
      padding: bodyPadding,
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: children),
    );
    return AnimatedPadding(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
      padding:
          EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom),
      child: Column(mainAxisSize: fill ? MainAxisSize.max : MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            // A popup with no title (a "done" card) gets only a close button, no empty header strip.
            if (title.isEmpty && icon == null && onBack == null)
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 4, 10, 0),
                  child: IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).maybePop())),
                ),
              )
            else
            Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(onBack != null ? 8 : 22, 14, 10, 12),
              child: Row(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    if (onBack != null)
                      IconButton(
                          tooltip: 'Back',
                          icon: Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded,
                              color: _lzFg(plum)),
                          onPressed: _h(onBack)),
                    if (icon != null) ...<Widget>[
                      Container(
                          width: 42,
                          height: 42,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: plumDeep,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13)),
                          child: Icon(icon, color: gold, size: 21)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 13),
                    ],
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(title, style: _serif(size: 25, height: 1.1)),
                            if (subtitle != null && subtitle.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                              const SizedBox(height: 4),
                              Text(subtitle,
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      color: _lzFg(muted),
                                      height: 1.4)),
                            ],
                          ]),
                    ),
                    IconButton(
                        tooltip: 'Close',
                        icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx).maybePop())),
                  ]),
            ),
            if (headerExtra != null)
              Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 0, 22, 10),
                  child: headerExtra),
            if (title.isNotEmpty || icon != null || onBack != null)
              Divider(height: 1, thickness: 1, color: _lzLine(goldLine).withOpacity(.7)),
            if (fill) Expanded(child: body) else Flexible(child: body),
            if (footer != null)
              Container(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _lzBg(ivory),
                    border: Border(
                        top: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine).withOpacity(.7)))),
                padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                    18, 12, 18, 12 + MediaQuery.of(ctx).padding.bottom * .5),
                child: footer,
              ),
          ]),
    );
  }

  /// The footer row: a quiet way out on the left, one clear action on the right.
  Widget _lzActions({
    String? secondary,
    VoidCallback? onSecondary,
    required String primary,
    VoidCallback? onPrimary,
    bool busy = false,
    bool danger = false,
    IconData? icon,
  }) {
    // OverflowBar: one row while it fits; on a narrow phone the two buttons stack (main button on top)
    // instead of overflowing.
    return OverflowBar(
        alignment: secondary == null ? MainAxisAlignment.end : MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        overflowAlignment: OverflowBarAlignment.end,
        overflowDirection: VerticalDirection.up,
        spacing: 8,
        overflowSpacing: 4,
        children: <Widget>[
      if (secondary != null)
        TextButton(
            style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: _lzFg(muted),
                minimumSize: const Size(0, 46),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14)),
            onPressed: busy ? null : _h(onSecondary),
            child: Text(secondary,
                style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))),
      FilledButton.icon(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: danger ? const Color(0xFFB3261E) : gold,
            foregroundColor: danger ? Colors.white : plumDeep,
            disabledBackgroundColor:
                (danger ? const Color(0xFFB3261E) : gold).withOpacity(.45),
            disabledForegroundColor:
                (danger ? Colors.white : plumDeep).withOpacity(.7),
            minimumSize: const Size(0, 46),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13))),
        onPressed: busy || onPrimary == null ? null : _h(onPrimary, _Tick.medium),
        icon: busy
            ? SizedBox(
                width: 16,
                height: 16,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                    strokeWidth: 2,
                    color: danger ? Colors.white : plumDeep))
            : Icon(icon ?? Icons.arrow_forward_rounded, size: 18),
        label: Text(primary,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  /// A yes/no question in the same frame. Returns true only on the main button.
  Future<bool> _lzConfirm(String title, String body,
      {String confirm = 'Continue',
      String cancel = 'Not now',
      bool danger = false,
      IconData? icon}) async {
    if (!mounted) return false;
    final bool? ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => _lzFrame(ctx,
          icon: icon ?? (danger ? Icons.warning_amber_rounded : null),
          title: title,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(body,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14.5, color: _lzFg(ink), height: 1.5)),
          ],
          footer: _lzActions(
              secondary: cancel,
              onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              primary: confirm,
              danger: danger,
              icon: danger ? Icons.delete_outline_rounded : Icons.check_rounded,
              onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true))),
    );
    return ok == true;
  }

  void _toast(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_lzToastOver(message)) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: plumDeep,
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(message, style: const TextStyle(color: ivory)),
    ));
  }

  // JC-LAZO-VIEWSWITCH-0917-001: the two dashboards each bounce the other
  // role on load, so a manual view switch leaves a short-lived flag that the
  // receiving guard consumes once. Kept in SharedPreferences because the two
  // widgets are separate files and cannot share a static; the two-minute
  // window means a stale flag can never strand a vendor on the couple side.
  static const String _kViewSwitchKey = 'lazo_view_switch_at';

  Future<void> _markViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await p.setInt(_kViewSwitchKey, DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<bool> _consumeViewSwitch() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final int t = p.getInt(_kViewSwitchKey) ?? 0;
      if (t <= 0) {
        return false;
      }
      await p.remove(_kViewSwitchKey);
      return DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - t < 120000;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _guardRole() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    // v146: a vendor on the couple side is in preview mode, with the bar and
    // the way back always on screen - nothing to bounce.
    if (_previewVendor != null) {
      return;
    }
    if (await _consumeViewSwitch()) {
      return; // v130: they asked to be here
    }
    try {
      final snap =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final data = snap.data();
      if (data == null) {
        return;
      }
      final String role = data['role'] == null ? '' : data['role'].toString();
      if (role == 'vendor') {
        // v146: late discovery (seeding hadn't resolved yet): stay, in preview.
        if (_previewVendor == null) {
          final Map<String, dynamic>? pv = await _loadPreviewVendor();
          if (mounted) setState(() => _previewVendor = pv ?? <String, dynamic>{'name': 'Your business'});
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO role guard error: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  void _celebrate() {
    final rnd = math.Random();
    const colors = [
      Color(0xFFD9B77C),
      Color(0xFFC9A45C),
      Color(0xFFE8CFA0),
      Color(0xFF52284F),
      Color(0xFF6A3A66),
      Color(0xFFFAF6F0),
      Color(0xFFE8B4B8),
    ];
    final pieces = <_ConfettiPiece>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
      final bool ribbon = rnd.nextDouble() > 0.62;
      pieces.add(_ConfettiPiece(
        x: rnd.nextDouble(),
        startY: -0.08 - rnd.nextDouble() * 0.30,
        speed: 0.85 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.55,
        size: ribbon ? 5 + rnd.nextDouble() * 4 : 7 + rnd.nextDouble() * 6,
        swayAmp: 0.015 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.045,
        swayFreq: 1.6 + rnd.nextDouble() * 2.6,
        phase: rnd.nextDouble() * math.pi * 2,
        rotSpeed: (rnd.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 7,
        color: colors[rnd.nextInt(colors.length)],
        delay: rnd.nextDouble() * 0.34,
        span: 0.58 + rnd.nextDouble() * 0.42,
        ribbon: ribbon,
      ));
    }
    // v130: reduced motion skips the confetti; the banner and toast stay.
    if (_reducedMotion(context)) return;
    setState(() {
      _confetti = pieces;
      _confettiOn = true;
    });
    _confettiC.forward(from: 0);
  }

  void _toastC(String message) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_lzToastOver(message)) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),

  // Agency, with forgiveness: the two delete buttons in this widget are
  // unlabelled x icons with no confirm step. A dialog on every tap would train
  // people to dismiss it, so the delete stays instant and becomes reversible.
  void _toastUndo(String message, Future<void> Function() undo) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (_lzToastOver(message, action: 'Undo', duration: const Duration(seconds: 6), onAction: () async {
      try {
        await undo();
      } catch (_) {
        _toastC('Could not undo that.');
      }
    })) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(
        backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        duration: const Duration(seconds: 6),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
        content: Text(message,
            style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
        action: SnackBarAction(
          label: 'Undo',
          textColor: _lzFg(plum),
          onPressed: () async {
            try {
              await undo();
            } catch (_) {
              _toastC('Could not undo that.');
            }
          },
        ),
      ));
  }

  Future<void> _juneLoadHistory() async {
    if (_juneLoaded || _uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    _juneLoaded = true;
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> qs = await _coupleRef
          .collection('june')
          .orderBy('at', descending: true)
          .limit(30)
          .get();
      final List<Map<String, String>> hist = qs.docs.reversed
          .map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
              <String, String>{
                'role': (d.data()['role'] ?? 'user') as String,
                'content': (d.data()['content'] ?? '') as String,
              })
          .where((Map<String, String> mm) => (mm['content'] ?? '').isNotEmpty)
          .toList();
      if (hist.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _juneMsgs
            ..clear()
            ..addAll(hist);
        });
        _juneScrollDown();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  String _juneNavIntent(String text) {
    final String t = text.toLowerCase().trim();
    final RegExp lead = RegExp(
        r'^(open|go to|take me to|send me to|show me|bring up|navigate to|switch to|jump to)\s+(the |my |our )?');
    if (!lead.hasMatch(t)) return '';
    final String rest = t
        .replaceFirst(lead, '')
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'\b(tab|page|screen|section)\b'), '')
        .trim();
    for (final List<String> p in kJunePlaces) {
      for (final String alias in p[2].split('|')) {
        if (rest == alias ||
            rest.startsWith('$alias ') ||
            rest.endsWith(' $alias') ||
            rest == p[1].toLowerCase()) {
          return p[0];
        }
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  void _juneGo(String key) {
    switch (key) {
      case 'home':
        setState(() => _view = _View.hub);
        break;
      case 'vendors':
        setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
        break;
      case 'browse':
        _openBrowse();
        break;
      case 'messages':
        setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
        break;
      case 'dayof':
        setState(() => _view = _View.dayof);
        break;
      case 'guests':
        setState(() => _view = _View.guests);
        break;
      case 'seating':
        _openSeating();
        break;
      case 'music':
        _openMusic();
        break;
      case 'website':
        setState(() => _view = _View.website);
        break;
      case 'registry':
        setState(() => _view = _View.registry);
        break;
      case 'shopping':
        setState(() => _view = _View.shopping);
        break;
      case 'board':
        setState(() => _view = _View.board);
        break;
      case 'account':
        setState(() => _view = _View.account);
        break;
    }
  }

  String _junePlaceLabel(String key) {
    for (final List<String> p in kJunePlaces) {
      if (p[0] == key) return p[1];
    }
    return '';
  }

  Future<void> _juneSend() async {
    final String text = _juneC.text.trim();
    if (text.isEmpty || _juneBusy) {
      return;
    }
    // v113: "open music" doesn't need a model - it needs a page.
    final String go = _juneNavIntent(text);
    if (go.isNotEmpty) {
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': text});
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{
          'role': 'assistant',
          'content': 'Opening ${_junePlaceLabel(go)}. [[open:$go]]'
        });
        _juneC.clear();
      });
      _juneScrollDown();
      Future<void>.delayed(
          const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () => _juneGo(go));
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': text});
      _juneC.clear();
      _juneBusy = true;
    });
    _juneScrollDown();
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn =
          FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable('juneChat');
      final List<Map<String, String>> wire = <Map<String, String>>[
        <String, String>{'role': 'user', 'content': kJuneAppMap},
        <String, String>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'Understood.'},
        ..._juneMsgs,
      ];
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> res =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'messages': wire});
      final String reply = ((res.data as Map)['reply'] ?? '') as String;
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{'role': 'assistant', 'content': reply});
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }
      setState(() {
        _juneMsgs.add(<String, String>{
          'role': 'assistant',
          'content': 'I lost my train of thought - try me again in a moment?'
        });
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _juneBusy = false);
        _juneScrollDown();
      }
    }
  }

  // v113: light markdown (bold, bullets) and [[open:key]] buttons.
  Widget _juneRich(String raw, bool me) {
    final RegExp tok = RegExp(r'\[\[open:([a-z]+)\]\]');
    final List<String> opens =
        tok.allMatches(raw).map((RegExpMatch m) => m.group(1)!).toList();
    String text = raw.replaceAll(tok, '').trim();
    text = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^#{1,6}\s*', multiLine: true), '');
    text = text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^\s*[-*]\s+', multiLine: true), '\u2022 ');
    final List<TextSpan> spans = <TextSpan>[];
    final RegExp bold = RegExp(r'\*\*(.+?)\*\*');
    int i = 0;
    for (final RegExpMatch m in bold.allMatches(text)) {
      if (m.start > i) spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(i, m.start)));
      spans.add(TextSpan(
          text: m.group(1),
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)));
      i = m.end;
    }
    if (i < text.length) spans.add(TextSpan(text: text.substring(i)));
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        if (text.isNotEmpty)
          Text.rich(TextSpan(children: spans),
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 14, height: 1.45, color: _lzFg(me ? ivory : ink))),
        for (final String k in opens)
          if (_junePlaceLabel(k).isNotEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
              child: FilledButton.icon(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold,
                    foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                    elevation: 0,
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    minimumSize: Size.zero,
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                onPressed: _h(() => _juneGo(k)),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded, size: 15),
                label: Text('Open ${_junePlaceLabel(k)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _juneScrollDown() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (_juneScroll.hasClients) {
        _juneScroll.animateTo(
          _juneScroll.position.maxScrollExtent,
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 250),
          curve: Curves.easeOut,
        );
      }
    });
  }

  List<String> _siteGal = <String>[];
  bool _siteGalBusy = false;

  // v136: PHOTOS, PLACED. A slot is {url, x, y, zoom}: x/y (0..1) is the
  // point of the picture that stays in view, zoom (1..3) scales around it.
  // The site applies exactly this (object-position + transform-origin), so
  // the sheet below shows what guests will see.
  Map<String, dynamic>? _siteHero;
  Map<String, dynamic>? _siteStory;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _siteGalFocus = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];

  Map<String, dynamic>? _slotFrom(dynamic v) {
    if (v is! Map) {
      return null;
    }
    final String url = (v['url'] ?? '').toString();
    double d(dynamic x, double def, double lo, double hi) =>
        x is num ? x.toDouble().clamp(lo, hi).toDouble() : def;
    return <String, dynamic>{
      if (url.isNotEmpty) 'url': url,
      'x': d(v['x'], .5, 0, 1),
      'y': d(v['y'], .5, 0, 1),
      'zoom': d(v['zoom'], 1, 1, 3),
    };
  }

  // the picture's real size, so a drag moves the focus point by exactly the
  // distance the finger travelled
  Future<Size?> _imgSize(String url) {
    final Completer<Size?> c = Completer<Size?>();
    final ImageStream st =
        NetworkImage(url).resolve(const ImageConfiguration());
    late ImageStreamListener l;
    l = ImageStreamListener((ImageInfo i, bool sync) {
      if (!c.isCompleted) {
        c.complete(Size(i.image.width.toDouble(), i.image.height.toDouble()));
      }
      st.removeListener(l);
    }, onError: (Object e, StackTrace? st2) {
      if (!c.isCompleted) {
        c.complete(null);
      }
      st.removeListener(l);
    });
    st.addListener(l);
    return c.future
        .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 8), onTimeout: () => null);
  }

  // the picture as the site shows it: cover-fit, the focus point aligned,
  // scaled around that same point
  Widget _placed(Map<String, dynamic> p, {int resize = 1400}) {
    final double x = ((p['x'] as num?) ?? .5).toDouble();
    final double y = ((p['y'] as num?) ?? .5).toDouble();
    final double z = ((p['zoom'] as num?) ?? 1).toDouble();
    final Alignment a = Alignment(x * 2 - 1, y * 2 - 1);
    return ClipRect(
      child: Transform.scale(
        scale: z,
        alignment: a,
        child: Image(
          image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage((p['url'] ?? '').toString()),
              width: resize),
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          alignment: a,
          width: double.infinity,
          height: double.infinity,
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
              const ColoredBox(
                  color: plumDeep,
                  child: Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined, color: ivory)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<String?> _uploadSlotPhoto(String slot) async {
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        withData: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
        return null;
      }
      final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
      final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
      if (bytes == null) {
        return null;
      }
      if (bytes.length > 12 * 1024 * 1024) {
        _toastC('That photo is over 12 MB — pick a smaller one.');
        return null;
      }
      final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
          ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.')).toLowerCase()
          : '.jpg';
      final String ctype = ext == '.png'
          ? 'image/png'
          : ext == '.webp'
              ? 'image/webp'
              : 'image/jpeg';
      _toastC('Uploading photo…');
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(
          'couples/$_uid/site/$slot-${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext');
      await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
      return await ref.getDownloadURL();
    } catch (e) {
      _toastC(e.toString().contains('unauthorized') ||
              e.toString().contains('permission')
          ? 'Photo upload isn’t permitted yet — storage rules need the couples/site path.'
          : 'Could not upload photo — try again.');
      return null;
    }
  }

  // The sheet: drag the picture until what matters is in view, zoom around
  // that point, check it in each frame the site will show. Returns the new
  // {url, x, y, zoom}; {'choose': true} to pick a different photo;
  // {'remove': true} to take it off; null when cancelled.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _positionSheet({
    required Map<String, dynamic> photo,
    required String title,
    required String hint,
    required List<List<dynamic>> frames, // [label, width/height]
    bool canChoose = true,
    bool canRemove = true,
  }) async {
    final String url = (photo['url'] ?? '').toString();
    double fx = ((photo['x'] as num?) ?? .5).toDouble();
    double fy = ((photo['y'] as num?) ?? .5).toDouble();
    double fz =
        ((photo['zoom'] as num?) ?? 1).toDouble().clamp(1.0, 3.0).toDouble();
    int frame = 0;
    Size? nat;
    _imgSize(url).then((Size? v) => nat = v);
    if (!mounted) {
      return null;
    }
    return _lzSheet<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          final double aspect = (frames[frame][1] as num).toDouble();
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                20, 10, 12, 20 +MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                      child: Text(title,
                          style: _serif(
                              size: 24, weight: FontWeight.w600, color: _lzFg(plum))),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx2).maybePop())),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(hint,
                    style:  TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4)),
                if (frames.length > 1) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 8,
                    children: frames.asMap().entries.map(
                        (MapEntry<int, List<dynamic>> e) {
                      final bool sel = e.key == frame;
                      return ChoiceChip(
                        label: Text(e.value[0] as String,
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(sel ? plum : ivory),
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        selected: sel,
                        selectedColor: gold,
                        backgroundColor: plum,
                        showCheckmark: false,
                        onSelected: (bool v) {
                          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                          setD(() => frame = e.key);
                        },
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
                  double w = cons.maxWidth;
                  double h = w / aspect;
                  final double maxH =
                      MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size.height * .42;
                  if (h > maxH) {
                    h = maxH;
                    w = h * aspect;
                  }
                  return Center(
                    child: ClipRRect(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                      child: GestureDetector(
                        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                        onPanUpdate: (DragUpdateDetails d) {
                          // how far the picture can slide inside the frame at
                          // this zoom; the finger moves it that far, so the
                          // focus point moves the opposite way in proportion
                          double px, py;
                          final Size? n = nat;
                          if (n != null && n.width > 0 && n.height > 0) {
                            final double sc =
                                math.max(w / n.width, h / n.height);
                            px = n.width * sc * fz - w;
                            py = n.height * sc * fz - h;
                          } else {
                            px = w * fz * .6;
                            py = h * fz * .6;
                          }
                          setD(() {
                            if (px > 2) {
                              fx = (fx - d.delta.dx / px).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
                            }
                            if (py > 2) {
                              fy = (fy - d.delta.dy / py).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
                            }
                          });
                        },
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: w,
                          height: h,
                          child: Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                            const ColoredBox(color: plumDeep),
                            _placed(<String, dynamic>{
                              'url': url,
                              'x': fx,
                              'y': fy,
                              'zoom': fz
                            }),
                            Positioned(
                              left: 14,
                              bottom: 12,
                              child: Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 9, vertical: 5),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.55),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                                child: Row(
                                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                    children: <Widget>[
                                      const Icon(Icons.open_with_rounded,
                                          color: ivory, size: 14),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                      Text('Drag to move',
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                              color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                                              fontSize: 12,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                    ]),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ]),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                   Icon(Icons.zoom_out_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 18),
                  Expanded(
                    child: SliderTheme(
                      data: SliderTheme.of(ctx2).copyWith(
                          activeTrackColor: gold,
                          inactiveTrackColor: gold.withOpacity(.25),
                          thumbColor: plum,
                          overlayColor: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                          trackHeight: 3),
                      child: Slider(
                        value: fz,
                        min: 1,
                        max: 3,
                        onChanged: (double v) => setD(() => fz = v),
                        onChangeEnd: (double v) =>
                            HapticFeedback.selectionClick(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                   Icon(Icons.zoom_in_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 18),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 2,
                  runSpacing: 2,
                  crossAxisAlignment: WrapCrossAlignment.center,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    TextButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _h(() => setD(() {
                            fx = .5;
                            fy = .5;
                            fz = 1;
                          })),
                      icon:  Icon(Icons.center_focus_strong_rounded,
                          color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                      label:
                           Text('Center', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum))),
                    ),
                    if (canChoose)
                      TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(
                            ctx2, <String, dynamic>{'choose': true})),
                        icon:  Icon(Icons.photo_camera_rounded,
                            color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                        label:  Text('Different photo',
                            style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum))),
                      ),
                    if (canRemove)
                      TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(
                            ctx2, <String, dynamic>{'remove': true})),
                        icon:  Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                            color: _lzFg(rose), size: 18),
                        label:  Text('Remove',
                            style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(rose))),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12))),
                    onPressed: _h(
                        () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, <String, dynamic>{
                              'url': url,
                              'x': fx,
                              'y': fy,
                              'zoom': double.parse(fz.toStringAsFixed(2)),
                            }),
                        _Tick.medium),
                    child: const Text('Use this',
                        style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // pick (if there is nothing yet) then position; loops through "Different
  // photo" until the couple settles on one
  Future<void> _slotFlow({
    required StateSetter setD,
    required String slot,
    required Map<String, dynamic>? current,
    Map<String, dynamic>? fallback,
    required String title,
    required String hint,
    required List<List<dynamic>> frames,
    required void Function(Map<String, dynamic>?) apply,
  }) async {
    Map<String, dynamic>? p = current ?? fallback;
    if (p == null || (p['url'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty) {
      final String? u = await _uploadSlotPhoto(slot);
      if (u == null) {
        return;
      }
      p = <String, dynamic>{'url': u, 'x': .5, 'y': .5, 'zoom': 1.0};
    }
    while (true) {
      final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _positionSheet(
          photo: p!,
          title: title,
          hint: hint,
          frames: frames,
          canRemove: current != null);
      if (r == null) {
        return;
      }
      if (r['choose'] == true) {
        final String? u = await _uploadSlotPhoto(slot);
        if (u != null) {
          p = <String, dynamic>{'url': u, 'x': .5, 'y': .5, 'zoom': 1.0};
        }
        continue;
      }
      if (r['remove'] == true) {
        setD(() => apply(null));
        _toastC('Photo removed — publish to update the site.');
        return;
      }
      setD(() => apply(r));
      return;
    }
  }

  static const List<List<dynamic>> _heroFrames = <List<dynamic>>[
    <dynamic>['Desktop', 1.7],
    <dynamic>['Phone', .58],

  Future<void> _galPosition(StateSetter setD, int i) async {
    if (i < 0 || i >= _siteGal.length) {
      return;
    }
    while (_siteGalFocus.length < _siteGal.length) {
      _siteGalFocus.add(<String, dynamic>{'x': .5, 'y': .5, 'zoom': 1.0});
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> cur = <String, dynamic>{
      'url': _siteGal[i],
      ..._siteGalFocus[i]
    };
    final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await _positionSheet(
        photo: cur,
        title: 'Position this photo',
        hint: i == 0
            ? 'The first photo leads the gallery as a tall tile on desktop.'
            : 'Gallery tiles are landscape on desktop and full-width on phones.',
        frames: i == 0
            ? const <List<dynamic>>[
                <dynamic>['Desktop', .75],
                <dynamic>['Phone', 1.33]
              ]
            : const <List<dynamic>>[
                <dynamic>['Tile', 1.33]
              ],
        canChoose: false,
        canRemove: false);
    if (r == null || r['url'] == null) {
      return;
    }
    setD(() => _siteGalFocus[i] = <String, dynamic>{
          'x': r['x'],
          'y': r['y'],
          'zoom': r['zoom']
        });
  }

  // ---- v138: signed calls to the worker (the partner's Firebase ID token) ----
  Future<Map<String, String>> _authHeaders() async {
    final String? t = await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.getIdToken();
    return <String, String>{
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      if (t != null && t.isNotEmpty) 'authorization': 'Bearer $t',
    };
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _workerPost(
      String url, Map<String, dynamic> body) async {
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .post(Uri.parse(url),
              headers: await _authHeaders(), body: jsonEncode(body))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 90));
      final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
      if (j is Map) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(j)..['_status'] = r.statusCode;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return <String, dynamic>{'ok': false, 'error': 'network'};
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> _workerGet(String url) async {
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse(url), headers: await _authHeaders())
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 30));
      final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
      if (j is Map) {
        return Map<String, dynamic>.from(j);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return <String, dynamic>{'ok': false};
  }

  Future<void> _dayBeforeSheet(String slug, Map<String, dynamic> w) async {
    final TextEditingController noteC = TextEditingController(
        text: (w['dayBeforeNote'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
            ? (w['dayBeforeNote'] ?? '').toString()
            : 'We can’t wait to see you tomorrow. Here’s everything you need for the day.');
    bool busy = false;
    bool testing = false;
    bool ok = true;
    bool open = true;
    String status = w['dayBeforeSentAt'] != null
        ? 'Sent once already, to ${w['dayBeforeSentTo'] ?? 'your'} guests.'
        : '';
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> send(bool test) async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              testing = test;
            });
            final Map<String, dynamic> r = await _workerPost(
                'https://meetlazo.com/api/w/$slug/day-before', <String, dynamic>{
              'test': test,
              'note': noteC.text.trim(),
              'replyTo': FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email ?? '',
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('weddingSites')
                  .doc(slug)
                  .set(<String, dynamic>{'dayBeforeNote': noteC.text.trim()},
                      SetOptions(merge: true));
            } catch (_) {}
            up(() {
              busy = false;
              ok = r['ok'] == true;
              status = ok
                  ? (test
                      ? 'Test sent to ${FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email ?? 'you'}.'
                      : 'Sent to ${r['sent']} guest${r['sent'] == 1 ? '' : 's'}${(r['failed'] ?? 0) != 0 ? ' (${r['failed']} didn’t go through)' : ''}.')
                  : (r['message'] ?? 'Couldn’t send - ${r['error'] ?? 'try again'}.')
                      .toString();
            });
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.mark_email_unread_outlined,
              title: 'The day-before note',
              subtitle: 'One email to every guest who’s coming. Replies come to you.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                    controller: noteC,
                    autofocus: false,
                    enabled: !busy,
                    minLines: 2,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    maxLength: 600,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('A line from the two of you')),
                _lzSection('What else is in it'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<dynamic> e in <List<dynamic>>[
                    <dynamic>[Icons.schedule_rounded, 'The day, hour by hour'],
                    <dynamic>[Icons.place_outlined, 'Venue and map'],
                    <dynamic>[Icons.local_parking_rounded, 'Parking'],
                    <dynamic>[Icons.wb_sunny_outlined, 'The forecast'],
                    <dynamic>[Icons.event_seat_outlined, 'Their table, if seat finder is on'],
                  ])
                    _pcA_chip(e[0] as IconData, e[1] as String),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (busy)
                  _lzBusy(testing ? 'Sending a test to you…' : 'Sending to your guests…')
                else if (status.isNotEmpty)
                  _pcA_status(status, ok),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Send a test to me',
                  onSecondary: () => send(true),
                  primary: 'Send to everyone',
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: () async {
                    final bool sure = await _lzConfirm('Send to everyone?',
                        'Every guest who’s coming and left an email gets it now.',
                        confirm: 'Send it', cancel: 'Not yet', icon: Icons.send_rounded);
                    if (sure) {
                      await send(false);
                    }
                  }));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
  }

  // a tappable choice card: icon, title, one line; gold border when picked
  Widget _pcA_pick(IconData icon, String title, String sub, bool sel, VoidCallback? onTap) =>
      _Press(
        scale: .985,
        onTap: onTap,
        child: AnimatedContainer(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 13, 12, 13),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: sel ? plumDeep : _lzBg(cardBg),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(
