  // the photos guests sent while the hold is on: approve or decline each
  Future<void> _pendingPhotosSheet(String slug) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> j = await _workerGet(
        'https://meetlazo.com/api/w/$slug/photos?pending=1&t=${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}');
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = ((j['photos'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[])
        .whereType<Map>()
        .map((Map e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))
        .toList();
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    bool open = true;
    bool busyAll = false;
    final Set<String> working = <String>{};
    String err = j['photos'] is List
        ? ''
        : 'Couldn\u2019t load the photos waiting. Check your connection, then close this and try again.';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> act(List<String> ids, bool decline) async {
            up(() {
              working.addAll(ids);
              err = '';
            });
            final Map<String, dynamic> r = await _workerPost(
                'https://meetlazo.com/api/w/$slug/photos/approve',
                <String, dynamic>{'ids': ids, 'decline': decline});
            if (r['ok'] == true) {
              _gpFuture = null;
              up(() {
                working.removeAll(ids);
                list.removeWhere(
                    (Map<String, dynamic> p) => ids.contains(p['id']));
              });
            } else {
              up(() {
                working.removeAll(ids);
                err = 'Couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          Widget tileBtn(IconData ic, Color bg, Color fg, String tip, VoidCallback? onTap) =>
              Tooltip(
                message: tip,
                child: _Press(
                  onTap: onTap,
                  child: Container(
                      width: 34,
                      height: 34,
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(color: bg, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                      child: Icon(ic, color: fg, size: 19)),
                ),
              );

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.photo_library_outlined,
              title: 'Waiting for approval',
              subtitle: list.isEmpty
                  ? 'While the hold is on, guest photos land here first.'
                  : '${list.length} photo${list.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from guests. Tap a photo to see it full size.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (list.isEmpty && err.isEmpty)
                  _pcA_empty(Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded,
                      'Nothing waiting. You’re all caught up.')
                else
                  GridView.builder(
                    shrinkWrap: true,
                    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent(
                        maxCrossAxisExtent: 170,
                        mainAxisSpacing: 10,
                        crossAxisSpacing: 10),
                    itemCount: list.length,
                    itemBuilder: (BuildContext gc, int i) {
                      final Map<String, dynamic> p = list[i];
                      final String u = (p['url'] ?? '').toString();
                      final String id = (p['id'] ?? '').toString();
                      final String who = (p['name'] ?? '').toString();
                      final bool w8 = busyAll || working.contains(id);
                      return ClipRRect(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                        child: Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                          GestureDetector(
                            onTap: () => _openLink(u),
                            child: Image.network(u,
                                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                errorBuilder: (BuildContext c5, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                                    Container(
                                        color: gold.withOpacity(.08),
                                        child: Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                                            color: _lzFg(muted)))),
                          ),
                          Positioned(
                            left: 0,
                            right: 0,
                            bottom: 0,
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(8, 18, 6, 6),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                                      begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                      colors: <Color>[
                                    plumDeep.withOpacity(0),
                                    plumDeep.withOpacity(.8),
                                  ])),
                              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                                Expanded(
                                  child: Text(who.isEmpty ? 'A guest' : who,
                                      maxLines: 1,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: ivory,
                                          fontSize: 11.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                ),
                                if (w8)
                                  const Padding(
                                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                                    child: SizedBox(
                                        width: 18,
                                        height: 18,
                                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                            strokeWidth: 2, color: gold)),
                                  )
                                else ...<Widget>[
                                  tileBtn(Icons.close_rounded, Colors.white.withOpacity(.18),
                                      ivory, 'Decline', () => act(<String>[id], true)),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                  tileBtn(Icons.check_rounded, gold, plumDeep,
                                      'Put it on the wall', () => act(<String>[id], false)),
                                ],
                              ]),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ]),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _pcA_status(err, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: list.isEmpty
                  ? _lzActions(
                      primary: 'Done',
                      icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                      onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2))
                  : _lzActions(
                      secondary: 'Close',
                      onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                      primary: list.length == 1 ? 'Approve it' : 'Approve all ${list.length}',
                      icon: Icons.done_all_rounded,
                      busy: busyAll,
                      onPrimary: () async {
                        up(() => busyAll = true);
                        await act(
                            list
                                .map((Map<String, dynamic> p) => (p['id'] ?? '').toString())
                                .toList(),
                            false);
                        up(() => busyAll = false);
                      }));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
  }

  // ---- v137: the site, live ----
  static const List<String> _tlVendorWords = <String>[
    'photographer', 'videographer', 'dj arriv', 'band arriv', 'florist',
    'caterer', 'planner', 'load', 'setup', 'set-up', 'set up', 'vendor', 'deliver',
    'breakdown', 'strike', 'pickup', 'pick-up', 'tear', 'sound check',
    'getting ready', 'hair', 'makeup', 'make-up', 'first look', 'photos with'
  ];

  // the Day-of moments a guest should see: the ceremony and everything a
  // guest is part of; not the vendor calls, the load-in or getting ready
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _guestTimeline() async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> evq =
          await _dayofRef.orderBy('time').get();
      final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs =
          <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[...evq.docs];
      _tlSortDocs(evs);
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        final String label = (m['label'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        final String time = (m['time'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (label.isEmpty || time.isEmpty) {
          continue;
        }
        final String low = label.toLowerCase();
        final bool anchor = m['anchor'] == true;
        if (!anchor && _tlVendorWords.any((String w) => low.contains(w))) {
          continue;
        }
        out.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'time': time,
          'label': label,
          'note': (m['note'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'dur': (m['dur'] is num) ? (m['dur'] as num).toInt() : 0,
        });
        if (out.length >= 40) {
          break;
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return out;
  }

  // v138: one event of the weekend. Returns the map, {'_delete': true}, or null.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _eventEditor(
      BuildContext ctx, Map<String, dynamic>? cur) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> c = cur ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['name'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController dateC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['dateIso'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController timeC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['time'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController venC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['venueName'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController addrC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['venueAddress'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['note'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController dressC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['dress'] ?? '').toString());
    bool ask = c['rsvp'] == true;
    final String? act = await _lzSheet<String>(
      context: ctx,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext dc) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext dc2, StateSetter setE) {
          final bool valid = nameC.text.trim().isNotEmpty;
          return _lzFrame(dc2,
              icon: Icons.celebration_outlined,
              title: cur == null ? 'Add an event' : 'Edit event',
              subtitle: 'It shows on your website with the rest of the weekend.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                    controller: nameC,
                    autofocus: cur == null,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    onChanged: (_) => setE(() {}),
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Event', hint: 'Welcome dinner')),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                        controller: dateC,
                        readOnly: true,
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: _lightDeco('Date', hint: 'Tap to pick'),
                        onTap: () async {
                          final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                              context: dc2,
                              initialDate: DateTime.tryParse(dateC.text) ??
                                  DateTime.now(),
                              firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                              lastDate: DateTime(2040));
                          if (d != null) {
                            setE(() => dateC.text =
                                '${d.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}');
                          }
                        }),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: TextField(
                        controller: timeC,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.datetime,
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: _lightDeco('Time', hint: '6:30 PM')),
                  ),
                ]),
                _lzSection('Where'),
                TextField(
                    controller: venC,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Place')),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                TextField(
                    controller: addrC,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.streetAddress,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Address')),
                _lzSection('For guests'),
                TextField(
                    controller: dressC,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Dress (optional)')),
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                TextField(
                    controller: noteC,
                    minLines: 1,
                    maxLines: 3,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('A line for guests (optional)')),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                SwitchListTile(
                  dense: true,
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  activeColor: Colors.white,
                  activeTrackColor: vGreen,
                  inactiveThumbColor: Colors.white,
                  inactiveTrackColor: muted.withOpacity(.4),
                  title: Text('Ask on the RSVP who’s joining',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: _lzFg(ink))),
                  value: ask,
                  onChanged: _hb((bool v) => setE(() => ask = v)),
                ),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: cur != null ? 'Remove event' : 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () async {
                    if (cur == null) {
                      Navigator.pop(dc2, null);

                    }
                    final bool sure = await _lzConfirm('Remove this event?',
                        '${nameC.text.trim().isEmpty ? 'It' : nameC.text.trim()} comes off your website.',

                  onPrimary: valid ? () => Navigator.pop(dc2, 'save') : null));
        },
      ),
    );
    if (act == 'delete') {
      return <String, dynamic>{'_delete': true};
    }
    if (act != 'save' || nameC.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    return <String, dynamic>{
      'name': nameC.text.trim(),
      'dateIso': dateC.text.trim(),
      'time': timeC.text.trim(),
      'venueName': venC.text.trim(),
      'venueAddress': addrC.text.trim(),
      'note': noteC.text.trim(),
      'dress': dressC.text.trim(),
      'rsvp': ask,
    };

  Future<void> _mirrorSeating(String slug, bool on) async {
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref = FirebaseFirestore
        .instance
        .collection('weddingSites')
        .doc(slug)
        .collection('seating')
        .doc('main');
    if (!on) {
      try {
        await ref.delete();
      } catch (_) {}
      return;
    }
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> gs = await _guestsRef.get();
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in gs.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
        final String n = (g['name'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (n.isEmpty || (g['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'no') {
          continue;
        }
        rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'n': n,
          'p': (g['party'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          't': (g['tableName'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          's': g['seat'] is num ? (g['seat'] as num).toInt() : -1,
        });
      }
      // v138: the room, so the site can draw the guest's table on a map
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> tables = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      Map<String, dynamic> canvas = <String, dynamic>{'w': 1600, 'h': 1000};
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> lay =
            await _coupleRef.collection('seating').doc('main').get();
        final Map<String, dynamic> ld = lay.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        if (ld['canvas'] is Map) {
          canvas = Map<String, dynamic>.from(ld['canvas'] as Map);
        }
        for (final dynamic t in (ld['tables'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
          if (t is! Map) {
            continue;
          }
          tables.add(<String, dynamic>{
            'n': (t['name'] ?? '').toString(),
            'x': t['x'] is num ? (t['x'] as num).toDouble() : 0,
            'y': t['y'] is num ? (t['y'] as num).toDouble() : 0,
            'sh': (t['shape'] ?? 'round').toString(),
            'r': t['rotation'] is num ? (t['rotation'] as num).toDouble() : 0,
            's': t['seats'] is num ? (t['seats'] as num).toInt() : 8,
          });
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      await ref.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'guests': rows,
        'tables': tables,
        'canvas': canvas,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<int> _mirrorPlaylist(String slug) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> songs = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> rq =
          await _coupleRef.collection('musicRequests').get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in rq.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        if ((m['status'] ?? '') == 'declined') {
          continue;
        }
        final String song = (m['song'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (song.isEmpty) {
          continue;
        }
        songs.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'song': song,
          'artist': (m['artist'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'guest': (m['guest'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'note': (m['note'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'must': m['status'] == 'must',
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> rs = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .doc(slug)
          .collection('rsvps')
          .get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in rs.docs) {
        final String song = (d.data()['song'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (song.isEmpty) {
          continue;
        }
        songs.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'song': song,
          'artist': '',
          'guest': (d.data()['name'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'note': '',
          'must': false,
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> gs = await _guestsRef.get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in gs.docs) {
        final String song = (d.data()['song'] ?? '').toString().trim();
        if (song.isEmpty) {
          continue;
        }
        songs.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'song': song,
          'artist': '',
          'guest': (d.data()['name'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
          'note': '',
          'must': false,
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .doc(slug)
          .collection('playlist')
          .doc('main')
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'songs': songs.take(300).toList(),
        'updatedAt': DateTime.now().toUtc().toIso8601String(),
      });
    } catch (_) {}
    return songs.length;
  }

  Future<String> _siteSlug() async {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        return q.docs.first.id;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return '';
  }

  // a link that opens the site with this guest's RSVP form already filled in
  Future<void> _personalLink(String guestId, Map<String, dynamic> g) async {
    final String slug = await _siteSlug();
    if (slug.isEmpty) {
      _toastC('Create your wedding website first — it’s under Website.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> site = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .doc(slug)
          .get();
      final List<String> meals = List<String>.from(
          (site.data()?['mealOptions'] as List?)
                  ?.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()) ??
              const <String>[]);
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .doc(slug)
          .collection('invites')
          .doc(guestId)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'name': (g['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        'party': (g['party'] ?? '').toString(),
        'plusOnes': ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt(),
        'meals': meals,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      final String link = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/$slug/?i=$guestId';
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: link));
      _toastC('Personal link copied — their RSVP arrives already matched ✓');
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Could not make the link — try again.');
    }
  }

  Widget _thankYouLine(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) {
    int yes = 0, done = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
      if ((g['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'yes') {
        yes++;
        if (g['thankYouAt'] != null) {
          done++;
        }
      }
    }
    if (yes == 0) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 10),
      child: Text('✉ Thank-you notes: $done of $yes sent',
          style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 12.5,
              color: _lzFg(done == yes ? vGreen : muted),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
    );
  }

  Widget _liveLinksCard(String slug, Map<String, dynamic> w) {
    Widget row(IconData ic, String title, String sub, String url,

  // ---- v136: photos from the guests (read through the worker's API) ----
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _gpFuture;
  String _gpFutureSlug = '';

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _guestPhotosFetch(String slug) async {
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse(
              'https://meetlazo.com/api/w/$slug/photos?t=${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12));
      if (r.statusCode != 200) {
        return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      }
      final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
      final List<dynamic> ph =
          (j is Map ? j['photos'] as List? : null) ?? const <dynamic>[];
      return ph
          .whereType<Map>()
          .map((Map e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e))
          .toList();
    } catch (_) {
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    }
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _guestPhotos(String slug,
      {bool fresh = false}) {
    if (fresh || _gpFuture == null || _gpFutureSlug != slug) {
      _gpFutureSlug = slug;
      _gpFuture = _guestPhotosFetch(slug);
    }
    return _gpFuture!;
  }

  Future<void> _guestPhotosSheet(String slug) async {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = await _guestPhotos(slug, fresh: true);
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    bool open = true;
    bool refreshing = false;
    String note = '';
    bool noteOk = true;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> remove(Map<String, dynamic> p) async {
            final bool sure = await _lzConfirm('Remove this photo?',
                'It comes off the wall for everyone and the file is deleted. This can’t be undone.',
                confirm: 'Remove photo', cancel: 'Keep it', danger: true);
            if (!sure) {
              return;
            }
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('weddingSites')
                  .doc(slug)
                  .update(<String, dynamic>{
                'guestPhotosRemoved': FieldValue.arrayUnion(<dynamic>[p['id']]),
              });
              up(() {
                list.removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> x) => x['id'] == p['id']);
                note = 'Removed. It’s off the wall within a minute.';
                noteOk = true;
              });
              _gpFuture = Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>.value(
                  List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(list));
              // the worker deletes the file on its next listing
              Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
                _guestPhotosFetch(slug);
              });
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                note = 'Couldn’t remove that photo. Check your connection and try again.';
                noteOk = false;
              });
            }
          }

          Widget tool(IconData ic, String label, VoidCallback? onTap, {bool spin = false}) =>
              _Press(
                scale: .97,
                onTap: onTap,
                child: Opacity(
                  opacity: onTap == null ? .45 : 1,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                    child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                      if (spin)
                        const SizedBox(
                            width: 15,
                            height: 15,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: gold))
                      else
                        Icon(ic, size: 16, color: _lzFg(plum)),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Text(label,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: _lzFg(plum))),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ),
              );

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.photo_camera_back_outlined,
              title: 'Photos from your guests',
              subtitle: list.isEmpty
                  ? 'From the wedding day, guests add photos from their phones on your site.'
                  : '${list.length} photo${list.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}. Tap one to open it, hold to remove it.',
              headerExtra: Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                tool(Icons.pending_actions_rounded, 'Waiting for approval',
                    () => _pendingPhotosSheet(slug)),
                tool(Icons.refresh_rounded, 'Refresh', refreshing
                    ? null
                    : () async {
                        up(() => refreshing = true);
                        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> l =
                            await _guestPhotos(slug, fresh: true);
                        up(() {
                          list = l;
                          refreshing = false;
                        });
                      }, spin: refreshing),
                tool(Icons.link_rounded, 'Copy all links', list.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : () async {
                        await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(
                            text: list
                                .map((Map<String, dynamic> p) => (p['url'] ?? '').toString())
                                .join('\n')));
                        up(() {
                          note = 'All ${list.length} links copied. Paste them anywhere.';
                          noteOk = true;
                        });
                      }),
                tool(Icons.download_rounded, 'Download all (zip)', list.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : () => _openLink('https://meetlazo.com/w/$slug/photos/download')),
              ]),
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (note.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  _pcA_status(note, noteOk),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ],
                if (list.isEmpty)
                  _pcA_empty(Icons.photo_library_outlined,
                      'Nothing shared yet. Guests’ photos show up here as they add them.')
                else
                  GridView.builder(
                    shrinkWrap: true,
                    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    gridDelegate: const SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent(
                        maxCrossAxisExtent: 130, mainAxisSpacing: 8, crossAxisSpacing: 8),
                    itemCount: list.length,
                    itemBuilder: (BuildContext gc, int i) {
                      final Map<String, dynamic> p = list[i];
                      final String u = (p['url'] ?? '').toString();
                      return GestureDetector(
                        onTap: () => _openLink(u),
                        onLongPress: () => remove(p),
                        child: ClipRRect(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          child: Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                            Image.network(
                              'https://wsrv.nl/?url=${Uri.encodeComponent(u)}&w=300&q=70',
                              fit: BoxFit.cover,
                              errorBuilder: (BuildContext c5, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                                  Container(
                                      color: gold.withOpacity(.08),
                                      child: Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined,
                                          color: _lzFg(muted))),
                            ),
                            if ((p['name'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                              Positioned(
                                left: 0,
                                right: 0,
                                bottom: 0,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(6, 12, 6, 4),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      gradient: LinearGradient(
                                          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                                          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                          colors: <Color>[
                                        plumDeep.withOpacity(0),
                                        plumDeep.withOpacity(.75),
                                      ])),
                                  child: Text((p['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      maxLines: 1,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: ivory,
                                          fontSize: 10.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                ),
                              ),
                            Positioned(
                              top: 4,
                              right: 4,
                              child: Tooltip(
                                message: 'Remove',
                                child: _Press(
                                  tick: _Tick.select,
                                  onTap: () => remove(p),
                                  child: Container(
                                    width: 24,
                                    height: 24,
                                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                        color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.85),
                                        shape: BoxShape.circle),
                                    child: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                        color: ivory, size: 14),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ]),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Close',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'See the wall',
                  icon: Icons.open_in_new_rounded,
                  onPrimary: () =>
                      _openLink('https://meetlazo.com/w/$slug/?photos=1#photos')));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
  }

  Future<void> _uploadSitePhotos(StateSetter setD) async {
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        withData: true,
        allowMultiple: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
        return;
      }
      setD(() => _siteGalBusy = true);
      for (final PlatformFile f in res.files) {
        if (_siteGal.length >= 24) {
          break;
        }
        final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
        if (bytes == null || bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
          continue;
        }
        final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
            ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.')).toLowerCase()
            : '.jpg';
        final String ctype = ext == '.png'
            ? 'image/png'
            : ext == '.webp'
                ? 'image/webp'
                : 'image/jpeg';
        final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(
            'couples/$_uid/site/g${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext');
        await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
        final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
        _siteGal.add(url);
        setD(() {});
      }
      setD(() => _siteGalBusy = false);
      _toastC('Photos added \u2713');
    } catch (e) {
      setD(() => _siteGalBusy = false);
      _toastC(e.toString().contains('unauthorized') ||
              e.toString().contains('permission')
          ? 'Photo upload isn\u2019t permitted yet \u2014 storage rules need the couples/site path.'
          : 'Upload failed: ${e.toString().length > 80 ? e.toString().substring(0, 80) : e}');
    }
  }

  // v133: the song row in the website editor - the first dance from the
  // Music page, with the switch that lets it play when guests arrive.
  Widget _songRow(
      Map<String, dynamic>? fd, bool on, ValueChanged<bool> onChanged) {
    final bool has = fd != null && (fd['title'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty;
    final String art = has ? (fd['art'] ?? '').toString() : '';
    Widget fallback() => Container(
        color: plumDeep,
        child: const Icon(Icons.music_note_rounded, color: gold, size: 20));
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 8, 10),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.35)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
          child: SizedBox(
            width: 40,
            height: 40,
            child: art.startsWith('http')
                ? Image.network(art,
                    fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                        fallback())
                : fallback(),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text(has ? fd['title'].toString() : 'No song picked yet',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style:  TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(ink),
                        fontSize: 13.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                Text(
                    has
                        ? '${fd['artist']} \u00b7 plays softly when guests arrive'
                        : 'Pick your first dance on the Music page and it can play here.',
                    maxLines: 2,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
              ]),
        ),
        _lazoSwitch(
          value: has && on,
          onChanged: has ? _hb(onChanged) : null,
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // v140: every section registers a key so the jump bar can scroll to it
  final Map<String, GlobalKey> _wbKeys = <String, GlobalKey>{};
  bool _wbJumpArmed = false;

  Widget _wbJumpBar(StateSetter setD) {
    if (_wbKeys.isEmpty) {
      if (!_wbJumpArmed) {
        _wbJumpArmed = true;
        WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          try {
            setD(() {});
          } catch (_) {}
        });
      }
      return const SizedBox(height: 4);
    }
    return SizedBox(
      height: 36,
      child: ListView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        children: _wbKeys.entries.map((MapEntry<String, GlobalKey> e) {
          final String label = e.key.contains(' \u00b7 ')
              ? e.key.split(' \u00b7 ').first
              : e.key;
          // v143: an opaque pill, not an ActionChip (M3 tinted the translucent
          // gold over the theme surface and the pills came out dark grey)
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
            child: Material(
              color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFF7F0E1)),
              shape: StadiumBorder(side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.7))),
              clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
              child: InkWell(
                onTap: () {
                  HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                  final BuildContext? c = e.value.currentContext;
                  if (c != null) {
                    Scrollable.ensureVisible(c,
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
                        alignment: 0.02,
                        curve: Curves.easeOutCubic);
                  }
                },
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                  child: Text(
                      label[0] + label.substring(1).toLowerCase(),
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(plum),
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  // A short list of cards with an editor per item, like the weekend's events.
  List<Widget> _plusList({
    required BuildContext ctx,
    required StateSetter setD,
    required List<Map<String, dynamic>> items,
    required IconData icon,
    required String Function(Map<String, dynamic>) title,
    required String Function(Map<String, dynamic>) sub,
    required Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> Function(Map<String, dynamic>?) edit,
    required String addLabel,
    String Function(Map<String, dynamic>)? photo,
    int max = 12,
    Widget? extra,
  }) {
    return <Widget>[
      ...items.asMap().entries.map((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> en) {
        final String ph = photo == null ? '' : photo(en.value);
        final String st = sub(en.value);
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
          child: _Press(
            tick: _Tick.select,
            onTap: () async {
              final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await edit(en.value);
              if (r == null) {
                return;
              }
              setD(() {
                if (r['_delete'] == true) {
                  items.removeAt(en.key);
                } else {
                  items[en.key] = r;
                }
              });
            },
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                if (ph.isNotEmpty)
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    child: Image.network(ph,
                        width: 34,
                        height: 34,
                        fit: BoxFit.cover,
                        errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e,
                                StackTrace? s) =>
                            Icon(icon, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18)),
                  )
                else
                  Icon(icon, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text(title(en.value),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(plum),
                                fontSize: 13.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        if (st.isNotEmpty)
                          Text(st,
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style:
                                  TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                      ]),
                ),
                Icon(Icons.edit_outlined, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 16),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
      }),
      Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
        if (items.length < max)
          OutlinedButton.icon(
            style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8))),
            onPressed: _h(() async {
              final Map<String, dynamic>? r = await edit(null);
              if (r != null && r['_delete'] != true) {
                setD(() => items.add(r));
              }
            }),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 16),
            label: Text(addLabel),
          ),
        if (extra != null) extra,
      ]),
    ];
  }

  // One item. Returns the map, {'_delete': true}, or null when cancelled.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _plusEditor(BuildContext ctx, String title,
      List<List<String>> fields, Map<String, dynamic>? cur,
      {String slot = 'item', List<String> sides = const <String>[]}) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> c = cur ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final Map<String, TextEditingController> tc =
        <String, TextEditingController>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields)
        if (<String>['text', 'multi', 'url', 'num'].contains(f[3]))
          f[0]: TextEditingController(
              text: c[f[0]] == null ? '' : c[f[0]].toString())
    };
    String photoUrl = (c['photo'] ?? '').toString();
    String side = (c['side'] ?? '').toString();
    final Map<String, bool> flags = <String, bool>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields)
        if (f[3] == 'bool') f[0]: cur == null ? true : c[f[0]] != false
    };
    bool busy = false;
    final String firstKey = fields.any((List<String> f) => f[0] == 'title')
        ? 'title'
        : (fields.isEmpty ? '' : fields.first[0]);
    final String? act = await _lzSheet<String>(
      context: ctx,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext dc) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext dc2, StateSetter setE) {
          final bool valid = (tc[firstKey]?.text.trim() ?? '').isNotEmpty;
          return _lzFrame(dc2,
              icon: cur == null ? Icons.add_rounded : Icons.edit_outlined,
              title: title,
              subtitle: cur == null
                  ? 'It shows on your website once you save.'
                  : 'Changes show on your website once you save.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                for (final List<String> f in fields) ...<Widget>[
                  if (tc.containsKey(f[0]))
                    TextField(
                        controller: tc[f[0]],
                        autofocus: cur == null && f[0] == firstKey,
                        minLines: 1,
                        maxLines: f[3] == 'multi' ? 4 : 1,
                        onChanged: f[0] == firstKey ? (_) => setE(() {}) : null,
                        keyboardType: f[3] == 'num'
                            ? const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true)
                            : f[3] == 'url'
                                ? TextInputType.url
                                : f[3] == 'multi'
                                    ? TextInputType.multiline
                                    : TextInputType.text,
                        textCapitalization: f[3] == 'url' || f[3] == 'num'
                            ? TextCapitalization.none
                            : TextCapitalization.sentences,
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                        decoration: _lightDeco(f[1],
                            hint: f[2].isEmpty ? null : f[2])),
                  if (f[3] == 'side') ...<Widget>[
                    Text(f[1].isEmpty ? 'Whose side' : f[1],
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                      for (final List<String> o in <List<String>>[
                        <String>['a', sides.isNotEmpty ? sides[0] : 'First side'],
                        <String>['b', sides.length > 1 ? sides[1] : 'Second side'],
                        <String>['', 'Both / neither'],
                      ])
                        _Press(
                          scale: .97,
                          onTap: () => setE(() => side = o[0]),
                          child: AnimatedContainer(
                            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 9),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: side == o[0] ? plumDeep : _lzBg(cardBg),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                                border: Border.all(
                                    color: side == o[0] ? plumDeep : _lzLine(goldLine))),
                            child: Text(o[1],
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 13,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                    color: side == o[0] ? gold : _lzFg(plum))),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ]),
                  ],
                  if (f[3] == 'photo')
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        ClipRRect(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                          child: SizedBox(
                            width: 56,
                            height: 56,
                            child: photoUrl.isNotEmpty
                                ? Image.network(photoUrl, fit: BoxFit.cover)
                                : ColoredBox(
                                    color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFF6EEDF)),
                                    child: Icon(Icons.image_outlined, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: busy
                              ? Text('Uploading…',
                                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: _lzFg(muted)))
                              : TextButton.icon(
                                  style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                      foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum)),
                                  onPressed: _h(() async {
                                    setE(() => busy = true);
                                    final String? u = await _uploadSlotPhoto(slot);
                                    setE(() {
                                      busy = false;
                                      if (u != null) {
                                        photoUrl = u;
                                      }
                                    });
                                  }),
                                  icon: const Icon(Icons.add_a_photo_outlined, size: 17),
                                  label: Text(
                                      photoUrl.isEmpty ? 'Add a photo' : 'Change photo',
                                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                ),
                        ),
                        if (busy)
                          const SizedBox(
                              width: 18,
                              height: 18,
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: gold))
                        else if (photoUrl.isNotEmpty)
                          IconButton(
                              tooltip: 'Take the photo off',
                              onPressed: _h(() => setE(() => photoUrl = '')),
                              icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 19)),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  if (f[3] == 'bool')
                    SwitchListTile(
                      dense: true,
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      activeColor: Colors.white,
                      activeTrackColor: vGreen,
                      inactiveThumbColor: Colors.white,
                      inactiveTrackColor: muted.withOpacity(.4),
                      title: Text(f[1],
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: _lzFg(ink))),
                      value: flags[f[0]] ?? true,
                      onChanged: (bool v) => setE(() => flags[f[0]] = v),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: cur != null ? 'Remove' : 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () async {
                    if (cur == null) {
                      Navigator.pop(dc2, null);
                      return;
                    }
                    final bool sure = await _lzConfirm('Remove this?',
                        'It comes off your website.',
                        confirm: 'Remove it', cancel: 'Keep it', danger: true);
                    if (sure && dc2.mounted) {
                      Navigator.pop(dc2, 'delete');
                    }
                  },
                  primary: 'Save',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  onPrimary: busy || !valid ? null : () => Navigator.pop(dc2, 'save')));
        },
      ),
    );
    if (act == 'delete') {
      return <String, dynamic>{'_delete': true};
    }
    final String first = tc[firstKey]?.text.trim() ?? '';
    if (act != 'save' || first.isEmpty) {
      return null;
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> out = <String, dynamic>{};
    for (final List<String> f in fields) {
      switch (f[3]) {
        case 'photo':
          out[f[0]] = photoUrl;
          break;
        case 'side':
          out[f[0]] = side;
          break;
        case 'bool':
          out[f[0]] = flags[f[0]] ?? true;
          break;
        case 'num':
          final String t = tc[f[0]]!.text.trim();
          out[f[0]] = t.isEmpty ? null : num.tryParse(t.replaceAll(',', ''));
          break;
        case 'url':
          String u = tc[f[0]]!.text.trim();
          if (u.isNotEmpty && !u.startsWith('http')) {
            u = 'https://$u';
          }
          out[f[0]] = u.startsWith('https://') ? u : '';
          break;
        default:
          out[f[0]] = tc[f[0]]!.text.trim();
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Hashtag ideas from their names and year: easy to spell, no symbols.
  List<String> _tagIdeasFor(String a, String b, String iso) {
    String w(String s) => s
        .trim()
        .split(RegExp(r'\s+'))
        .first
        .replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]'), '');
    final String x = w(a), y = w(b);
    if (x.isEmpty || y.isEmpty) {
      return <String>[];
    }
    final String yy = iso.length >= 4 ? iso.substring(0, 4) : '';
    return <String>[
      '${x}And$y',
      if (yy.isNotEmpty) '$x$y$yy',
      '${y}Says${x}Yes',
    ];
  }

  // Hotels and airports near the venue (meetlazo.com/api/stay).
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _staySuggest(String slug) async {
    if (slug.isEmpty) {
      _toastC('Publish your site once, then Lazo can look up hotels near the venue.');
      return null;
    }
    try {
      _toastC('Looking near the venue…');
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse(
              'https://meetlazo.com/api/stay?slug=${Uri.encodeComponent(slug)}'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
      final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
      return j is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(j) : null;
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Couldn’t reach the hotel lookup — try again.');
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Five questions, then June drafts. Returns {draft, meta} or null.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _juneSiteDraft(BuildContext ctx) async {
    final List<List<String>> qs = <List<String>>[
      <String>['met', 'How did you meet?', 'Where, when, who said what first'],
      <String>['proposal', 'The proposal', 'Where and how it happened'],
      <String>['moments', 'Dates that matter (optional)', 'First trip, moving in, the dog'],
      <String>['vibe', 'The feel you want', 'Garden, candlelit, relaxed but dressy'],
      <String>['notes', 'Anything guests should know (optional)', 'Outdoor ceremony, kids welcome, parking'],
    ];
    final Map<String, TextEditingController> c = <String, TextEditingController>{
      for (final List<String> q in qs) q[0]: TextEditingController()
    };
    bool open = true;
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    final Map<String, dynamic>? out = await _lzSheet<Map<String, dynamic>>(
      context: ctx,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 580),
      isDismissible: true,
      builder: (BuildContext dc) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext dc2, StateSetter setE) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setE(f);
          }

          final bool enough = c['met']!.text.trim().isNotEmpty ||
              c['proposal']!.text.trim().isNotEmpty;

          Future<void> write() async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              final String? t = await FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.getIdToken();
              if (t == null) {
                up(() {
                  busy = false;
                  err = 'Sign in again, then ask June.';
                });
                return;
              }
              final httpc.Response r = await httpc
                  .post(Uri.parse('https://june.meetlazo.com/api/site/draft'),
                      headers: <String, String>{
                        'authorization': 'Bearer $t',
                        'content-type': 'application/json',
                      },
                      body: jsonEncode(<String, dynamic>{
                        'answers': <String, String>{
                          for (final MapEntry<String, TextEditingController> e
                              in c.entries)
                            e.key: e.value.text.trim()
                        }
                      }))
                  .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 120));
              final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
              if (r.statusCode != 200 || j is! Map || j['draft'] is! Map) {
                up(() {
                  busy = false;
                  err = j is Map && j['error'] != null
                      ? 'June couldn’t finish: ${j['error'].toString().length > 80 ? j['error'].toString().substring(0, 80) : j['error']}'
                      : 'June couldn’t finish. Try again in a moment.';
                });
                return;
              }
              if (open && dc2.mounted) {
                Navigator.pop(dc2, Map<String, dynamic>.from(j));
              }
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'June couldn’t finish. Try again in a moment.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(dc2,
              icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
              title: 'Build it with June',
              subtitle: 'A few lines each is plenty. June only writes what you tell her.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                for (int i = 0; i < qs.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                  TextField(
                      controller: c[qs[i][0]],
                      autofocus: i == 0,
                      enabled: !busy,
                      maxLines: qs[i][0] == 'vibe' ? 1 : 3,
                      minLines: 1,
                      onChanged: i < 2 ? (_) => up(() {}) : null,
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                      decoration: _lightDeco(qs[i][1], hint: qs[i][2])),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                ],
                _lzNote(Icons.edit_note_rounded,
                    'She fills only the fields you’ve left empty, and you read it all before it goes live.'),
                if (busy) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _lzBusy('June is writing your site. This takes about twenty seconds.'),
                ],
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _pcA_status(err, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(dc2),
                  primary: enough ? 'Write it' : 'Tell June how you met',
                  icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: enough ? write : null));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
    return out;
  }

  Widget _wbTime(BuildContext ctx, TextEditingController c, String label,
      TimeOfDay fallback) {
    return TextField(
      controller: c,
      readOnly: true,
      style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
      decoration: _lightDeco(label, hint: 'Tap to set').copyWith(
        suffixIcon: c.text.isEmpty
            ?  Icon(Icons.schedule_rounded, size: 18, color: _lzFg(muted))
            : IconButton(
                icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 16, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                onPressed: _h(() => c.clear()),
              ),
      ),
      onTap: () async {
        final TimeOfDay? t = await showTimePicker(
          context: ctx,
          initialTime: fallback,
        );
        if (t != null) {
          final int h12 = t.hourOfPeriod == 0 ? 12 : t.hourOfPeriod;
          c.text =
              '$h12:${t.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${t.period == DayPeriod.am ? 'AM' : 'PM'}';
        }
      },
    );
  }

  String _slugFor(String names) {
    String sl = names.toLowerCase().trim();
    sl = sl.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^a-z0-9]+'), '-');
    sl = sl.replaceAll(RegExp(r'-+'), '-');
    sl = sl.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^-+|-+$'), ''); // v139: was matching "-$"
    return sl.isEmpty ? 'our-wedding' : sl;
  }

  Future<void> _importRsvp(
      String slug, String id, Map<String, dynamic> r) async {
    final String nm = (r['name'] ?? '') as String;
    if (nm.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    // v137: a personal link carries the guest's id, so the reply lands on
    // the right row even when they typed the household name
    final String inv = (r['invite'] ?? '').toString();
    String matchId = '';
    if (inv.isNotEmpty) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> gd =
            await _guestsRef.doc(inv).get();
        if (gd.exists) {
          matchId = inv;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? ex = matchId.isNotEmpty
        ? null
        : await _guestsRef.where('name', isEqualTo: nm).limit(1).get();
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = <String, dynamic>{
      if (matchId.isEmpty) 'name': nm,
      'rsvp': (r['attending'] ?? 'yes') == 'yes' ? 'yes' : 'no',
      // v139: a blank reply no longer wipes what the couple typed
      if ((r['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
        'meal': (r['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
      if (r['plusOnes'] is num && (r['plusOnes'] as num) > 0)
        'plusOnes': (r['plusOnes'] as num).toInt(),
      if ((r['song'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
        'song': (r['song'] ?? '').toString().trim(),
      if (r['events'] is List)
        'events': List<String>.from(
            (r['events'] as List).map((dynamic e) => e.toString())),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    };
    if (matchId.isNotEmpty) {
      await _guestsRef.doc(matchId).set(data, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } else if (ex != null && ex.docs.isNotEmpty) {
      await _guestsRef.doc(ex.docs.first.id).set(data, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } else {
      data['group'] = 'friends';
      data['side'] = 'both';
      data['party'] = '';
      data['email'] = '';
      data['address'] = '';
      data['createdAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
      await _guestsRef.add(data);
    }
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('weddingSites')
        .doc(slug)
        .collection('rsvps')
        .doc(id)
        .delete();
  }

  Future<void> _editGuest([String? id, Map<String, dynamic>? cur]) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> c = cur ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['name'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController partyC =
        TextEditingController(text: (c['party'] ?? '') as String);
    final TextEditingController emailC =

                    scale: .97,

                              color: val == o[0] ? plumDeep : _lzLine(goldLine))),

                          style: TextStyle(

                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,

              ]);

          Future<void> remove() async {
            // v139: ask first, and take the personal-link doc with it
            final bool sure = await _lzConfirm(
                'Remove ${nameC.text.trim().isEmpty ? 'this guest' : nameC.text.trim()}?',
                'They come off the list, the seating chart and the site’s seat finder.',
                confirm: 'Remove guest',
                cancel: 'Keep',
                danger: true);

              return;

                await FirebaseFirestore.instance

                    .doc(id)

                    controller: nameC,
                    autofocus: id == null,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,

                      <String>['no', 'Declined'],

                  const SizedBox(width: 10),

                    width: 84,
                    child: TextField(
                        controller: plusC,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.number,

                        decoration: _lightDeco('+1s')),
