  // v146: a vendor looking at the couple side. Reads users/{uid} once; a
  // vendor-role login resolves to their listing (users.vendorId, else the
  // listing they claimed). Null for couples.
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> _loadPreviewVendor() async {
    if (_uid == null) return null;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> us =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> u = us.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      if ((u['role'] ?? '').toString() != 'vendor') return null;
      String vid = (u['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
      Map<String, dynamic>? v;
      if (vid.isNotEmpty) {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs =
            await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vid).get();
        v = vs.data();
      }
      if (v == null) {
        final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
            .instance
            .collection('vendors')
            .where('claimedBy', isEqualTo: _uid)
            .limit(1)
            .get();
        if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) {
          vid = q.docs.first.id;
          v = q.docs.first.data();
        }
      }
      _previewVendorId = vid;
      return v ?? <String, dynamic>{'name': 'Your business'};
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO preview vendor: ' + e.toString());
      return null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _ensureSeeded() async {
    if (_uid == null || _seeding) return;
    _seeding = true;
    try {
      // v146: know who this is before writing anything
      if (!_roleChecked) {
        final Map<String, dynamic>? pv = await _loadPreviewVendor();
        _roleChecked = true;
        if (mounted) setState(() => _previewVendor = pv);
      }
      final snap = await _planRef.limit(1).get();
      if (snap.docs.isEmpty) {
        final batch = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
        final Map<String, dynamic>? pv = _previewVendor;
        final String mine = pv == null ? '' : _vendorCat(pv);
        for (final c in kCategories) {
          final bool own = pv != null && c['slug'] == mine;
          batch.set(_planRef.doc(c['slug']), {
            'status': own ? 'booked' : 'needed',
            'vendorName': own ? (pv['name'] ?? '').toString() : '',
            'vendorId': own && _previewVendorId.isNotEmpty ? _previewVendorId : null,
            'budgetPlanned': null,
            'budgetActual': null,
            if (pv != null) 'preview': true,
            'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          });
        }
        if (pv == null) {
          batch.set(_coupleRef, {'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()},
              SetOptions(merge: true));
        } else {
          // a stand-in couple so the vendor sees the product as a couple does;
          // preview: true keeps it out of analytics, June and every email
          batch.set(
              _coupleRef,
              {
                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'preview': true,
                'names': 'Jordan & Sam',
                'weddingDate': Timestamp.fromDate(
                    DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 183))),
                if ((pv['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                  'metroId': (pv['metroId'] ?? '').toString(),
                'guestEstimate': 120,
              },
              SetOptions(merge: true));
        }
        await batch.commit();
      }
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      _seeding = false;
    }
  }

  // v127: where the cover photo sits inside the hero. couples.photoFocus is
  // {x, y} in 0..1 (0.5/0.5 = centred); BoxFit.cover crops from that point,
  // so a couple can slide their faces into view instead of losing them.
  Alignment _photoAlign(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic f = couple['photoFocus'];
    double x = .5, y = .5;
    if (f is Map) {
      if (f['x'] is num) x = (f['x'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
      if (f['y'] is num) y = (f['y'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
    }
    return Alignment(x * 2 - 1, y * 2 - 1);
  }

  Future<void> _adjustPhotoSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final String photo = (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    if (photo.isEmpty) {
      await _changePhoto();
      return;
    }
    double fx = .5, fy = .5;
    final dynamic f = couple['photoFocus'];
    if (f is Map) {
      if (f['x'] is num) fx = (f['x'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
      if (f['y'] is num) fy = (f['y'] as num).toDouble().clamp(0, 1).toDouble();
    }
    bool saving = false;
    String err = '';
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                20, 10, 12, 20 + MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                      child: Text('Position your photo',
                          style: _serif(
                              size: 24, weight: FontWeight.w600, color: _lzFg(plum))),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Close',
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.of(ctx2).maybePop())),
                ]),
                Text(
                    'Drag it until the two of you sit where you want. This is how it crops on your home screen.',
                    style:
                        TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4)),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
                  final double w = cons.maxWidth;
                  final double h = w < 520 ? w * .78 : w * .42;
                  return ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                    child: GestureDetector(
                      behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                      onPanUpdate: (DragUpdateDetails d) {
                        // dragging the picture right shows more of its left
                        // side, i.e. the focus point moves left.
                        setD(() {
                          fx = (fx - d.delta.dx / w).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
                          fy = (fy - d.delta.dy / h).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
                        });
                      },
                      child: SizedBox(
                        width: w,
                        height: h,
                        child: Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                          const ColoredBox(color: plumDeep),
                          Image(
                            image:
                                ResizeImage(NetworkImage(photo), width: 1400),
                            fit: BoxFit.cover,
                            alignment: Alignment(fx * 2 - 1, fy * 2 - 1),
                          ),
                          // the same scrim the hero paints, so the preview
                          // is honest about how dark the bottom gets
                          const DecoratedBox(
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              gradient: LinearGradient(
                                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                                colors: <Color>[
                                  Color(0x333D1C3B),
                                  Color(0xC63D1C3B),
                                  Color(0xF23D1C3B)
                                ],
                                stops: <double>[0, .55, 1],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                          Positioned(
                            left: 14,
                            bottom: 12,
                            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                              const Icon(Icons.open_with_rounded,
                                  color: ivory, size: 14),
                              const SizedBox(width: 6),
                              Text('Drag to move',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: ivory.withOpacity(.85),
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _h(() => setD(() {
                          fx = .5;
                          fy = .5;
                        })),
                    icon:  Icon(Icons.center_focus_strong_rounded,
                        color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                    label:  Text('Center', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum))),
                  ),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _h(() async {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                      await _changePhoto();
                    }),
                    icon:  Icon(Icons.photo_camera_rounded,
                        color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                    label:  Text('Different photo',
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum))),
                  ),
                ]),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  _pcA_status(err, false),
                ],
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                  child: _lzActions(
                      secondary: 'Cancel',
                      onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                      primary: 'Save position',
                      icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                      busy: saving,
                      onPrimary: () async {
                        setD(() {
                          saving = true;
                          err = '';
                        });
                        try {
                          await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
                            'photoFocus': <String, double>{'x': fx, 'y': fy}
                          }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                          if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
                          _toastC('Photo position saved.');
                        } catch (_) {
                          if (ctx2.mounted) {
                            setD(() {
                              saving = false;
                              err = 'Couldn\u2019t save. Check your connection and try again.';
                            });
                          }
                        }
                      }),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _changePhoto() async {
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        withData: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) return;
      final Uint8List? bytes = res.files.first.bytes;
      if (bytes == null) return;
      _toastC('Uploading photo\u2026');
      final ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref('couples/$_uid/couple.jpg');
      await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: 'image/jpeg'));
      final url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
      final String busted = url +
          (url.contains('?') ? '&' : '?') +
          'v=${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}';
      await _coupleRef.set({'photoUrl': busted}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      _toastC('Photo updated \u2713');
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Could not upload photo \u2014 try again.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _cycleStatus(String slug, String current) async {
    final next = kStatuses[(kStatuses.indexOf(current) + 1) % kStatuses.length];
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'status': next,
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  String _money(num v) {
    final String s = v.round().toString();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) {
        b.write(',');
      }
      b.write(s[i]);
    }
    return '\$$b';
  }

  Widget _budgetCard(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    final num? total = couple['budgetTotal'] as num?;
    num spent = 0;
    num planned = 0;
    final List<List<dynamic>> byCat = <List<dynamic>>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> p =
          plan[c['slug']] ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
      final num s = _spentOf(p); // v140: typed or paid on Lazo
      final num pl = (p['status'] ?? '') == 'skipped' ? 0 : ((p['budgetPlanned'] as num?) ?? 0);
      spent += s;
      planned += pl;
      if (s > 0) {
        byCat.add(<dynamic>[c['label'], s]);
      }
    }
    byCat.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
        (b[1] as num).compareTo(a[1] as num));

    if (total == null || total <= 0) {
      return _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
        radius: 24,
        tint: .6,
        borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          Container(
            width: 44,
            height: 44,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              gradient: LinearGradient(
                  colors: <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.3), gold.withOpacity(.12)]),
              shape: BoxShape.circle,
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55)),
            ),
            child:  Icon(Icons.savings_rounded, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 21),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
           Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text('Set your wedding budget',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 15.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                Text('Lazo tracks spending as you book your team.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          FilledButton(
            style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
            onPressed: _h(() => _setBudgetSheet(null)),
            child: const Text('Set it',
                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ),
        ]),
      );
    }

    final double frac = (spent / total).clamp(0.0, 1.5).toDouble();
    final bool over = spent > total;
    final Color barColor = over
        ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
        : frac > .75
            ? const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)
            : vGreen;
    final num remaining = total - spent;

    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
      radius: 24,
      tint: .6,
      borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
             Expanded(
              child: Text('Wedding budget',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 17, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
            _Press(
              onTap: () => _setBudgetSheet(total),
              child:  Padding(
                padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                child: Icon(Icons.edit_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 17),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(_money(spent),
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(over ? const Color(0xFFB3413A) : plum),
                      fontSize: 30,
                      height: 1,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 3),
                child: Text('of ${_money(total)}',
                    style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 13.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          // v65: the bar must be bounded. A FractionallySizedBox with no
          // heightFactor expands to its max constraint - inside a Stack that
          // meant a full-screen wash of colour.
          SizedBox(
            height: 10,
            child: ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              child: Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                Container(color: plum.withOpacity(.1)),
                Align(
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  child: FractionallySizedBox(
                    alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                    widthFactor: frac.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                    heightFactor: 1.0,
                    child: DecoratedBox(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        gradient: LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[
                          barColor.withOpacity(.75),
                          barColor
                        ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
              over
                  ? 'Over budget by ${_money(spent - total)} \u2014 worth a look together.'
                  : '${_money(remaining)} still to spend' +
                      (planned > spent
                          ? ' \u00b7 ${_money(planned)} planned across categories'
                          : ''),
              style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 12.5,
                  color: _lzFg(over ? const Color(0xFFB3413A) : muted),
                  fontWeight: over ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w400)),
          // v135: allocation - every planned category as a share of the total.
          ...(() {
            final List<Widget> out = <Widget>[];
            final List<List<dynamic>> rows = <List<dynamic>>[];
            Timestamp? latestAt;
            String latestLine = '';
            for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
              final Map<String, dynamic> p =
                  plan[c['slug']] ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
              final num pl = (p['status'] ?? '') == 'skipped' ? 0 : ((p['budgetPlanned'] as num?) ?? 0);
              final num sp = _spentOf(p); // v140
              if (pl > 0 || sp > 0) rows.add(<dynamic>[c['label'], pl, sp]);
              final dynamic ua = p['updatedAt'];
              if (ua is Timestamp &&
                  (latestAt == null || ua.compareTo(latestAt!) > 0) &&
                  (pl > 0 || sp > 0)) {
                latestAt = ua;
                final String by = (p['updatedBy'] ?? '').toString();
                latestLine =
                    '${c['label']} updated${by.isEmpty ? '' : ' by $by'} \u00b7 ${_ago(ua)}';
              }
            }
            if (rows.isEmpty) return out;
            rows.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
                ((b[1] as num) > 0 ? b[1] as num : b[2] as num)
                    .compareTo((a[1] as num) > 0 ? a[1] as num : a[2] as num));
            final num allocated = rows.fold<num>(
                0, (num acc, List<dynamic> r) => acc + (r[1] as num));
            final bool overAlloc = allocated > total;
            out.add(const SizedBox(height: 14));
            out.add(Row(children: <Widget>[
               Expanded(
                child: Text('ALLOCATION',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10.5,
                        letterSpacing: 2,
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
              Text(
                  '${_money(allocated)} planned \u00b7 ${(allocated / total * 100).round()}%',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      color: _lzFg(overAlloc ? const Color(0xFFB3413A) : muted),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ]));
            out.add(const SizedBox(height: 6));
            for (final List<dynamic> r in rows.take(8)) {
              final num pl = r[1] as num;
              final num sp = r[2] as num;
              final double share = (pl / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
              final double spentShare = (sp / total).clamp(0.0, 1.0).toDouble();
              out.add(_Press(
                onTap: () {
                  // v139: the card lives in a sheet - close it first
                  Navigator.of(context).maybePop();
                  setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
                },
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 7),
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(
                              child: Text(r[0].toString(),
                                  style:  TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                                      fontSize: 12.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))),
                          Text(
                              '${pl > 0 ? (pl / total * 100).round() : 0}% \u00b7 ${_money(pl > 0 ? pl : sp)}${sp > 0 && pl > 0 ? ' \u00b7 ${_money(sp)} spent' : ''}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  color: _lzFg(sp > pl && pl > 0
                                      ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
                                      : muted))),
                        ]),
                        const SizedBox(height: 4),
                        SizedBox(
                          height: 6,
                          child: ClipRRect(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                            child:
                                Stack(fit: StackFit.expand, children: <Widget>[
                              Container(color: plum.withOpacity(.08)),
                              Align(
                                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                  child: FractionallySizedBox(
                                      widthFactor: share,
                                      heightFactor: 1,
                                      child: Container(
                                          color: gold.withOpacity(.75)))),
                              Align(
                                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                                  child: FractionallySizedBox(
                                      widthFactor: spentShare,
                                      heightFactor: 1,
                                      child: Container(
                                          color: _lzBg(sp > pl && pl > 0
                                              ? const Color(0xFFB3413A)
                                              : plum)))),
                            ]),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ]),
                ),
              ));
            }
            if (rows.length > 8) {
              out.add(Text('and ${rows.length - 8} more',
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))));
            }
            if (latestLine.isNotEmpty) {
              out.add(Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                   Icon(Icons.history_rounded, size: 13, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text(latestLine,
                          style:
                               TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted)))),
                ]),
              ));
            }
            return out;
          })(),
          if (byCat.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Wrap(
              spacing: 8,
              runSpacing: 8,
              children: byCat
                  .take(4)
                  .map((List<dynamic> e) => _Press(
                        onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 11, vertical: 6),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _lzBg(Colors.white.withOpacity(.7)),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                          ),
                          child: Text('${e[0]} ${_money(e[1] as num)}',
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plum),
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      ))
                  .toList(),
            ),
          ],
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          _Press(
            onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors),
            child:  Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
              child: Text('Track spending per vendor \u2192',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editVendor(
      String slug, String label, Map<String, dynamic> current) async {
    final nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: (current['vendorName'] ?? '') as String);
    final planC = TextEditingController(
        text: current['budgetPlanned'] == null
            ? ''
            : (current['budgetPlanned'] as num).toStringAsFixed(0));
    final spentC = TextEditingController(
        text: current['budgetActual'] == null
            ? ''
            : (current['budgetActual'] as num).toStringAsFixed(0));
    final ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      builder: (ctx) => _lzFrame(ctx,
          icon: Icons.storefront_outlined,
          title: 'Your $label',
          subtitle: 'Who you booked, and what it costs.',
          children: <Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            TextField(
                controller: nameC,
                autofocus: nameC.text.isEmpty,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Vendor name')),
            _lzSection('Money'),
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                    controller: planC,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Budget', prefix: '\$ ')),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: TextField(
                    controller: spentC,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    onSubmitted: (_) => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Spent', prefix: '\$ ')),
              ),
            ]),
          ],
          footer: _lzActions(
              secondary: 'Cancel',
              onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              primary: 'Save',
              icon: Icons.check_rounded,
              onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true))),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'vendorName': nameC.text.trim(),
      'budgetPlanned': double.tryParse(planC.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.]'), '')),
      'budgetActual': double.tryParse(spentC.text.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.]'), '')),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      'updatedBy': _bdMe()[1], // v135: the last-change line on the budget card
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  Future<void> _setWeddingDate(DateTime? current) async {
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: current ?? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 270)),
      // v139: after the wedding the picker asserted (initial before first)
      firstDate: (current != null && current.isBefore(DateTime.now()))
          ? current
          : DateTime.now(),
      lastDate: DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 4)),
    );
    if (picked == null) return;
    await _coupleRef.set(
        {'weddingDate': Timestamp.fromDate(picked)}, SetOptions(merge: true));
  }

  void _openBrowse({String? category, String? metro}) {
    setState(() {
      if (category != null) _browseCat = category;
      if (metro != null) _browseMetro = metro;
      _view = _View.browse;
    });
    if (category != null) {
      _autoResearch(category);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _autoResearch(String slug) async {
    // Browsing a category IS researching it - the list listens, she doesn't file.
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d =
          await _planRef.doc(slug).get();
      final String st = (d.data()?['status'] ?? 'needed') as String;
      if (st == 'needed' || st.isEmpty) {
        await _planRef.doc(slug).set(<String, dynamic>{
          'status': 'researching',
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // v139: the vendor's own category (their doc carries `categories`), so an
  // inquiry from name search, Saved or a deep link marks the right row
  String _vendorCat(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final Set<String> known =
        kCategories.map((Map<String, String> c) => c['slug'] ?? '').toSet();
    final dynamic cs = v['categories'];
    if (cs is List) {
      if (cs.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).contains(_browseCat)) {
        return _browseCat;
      }
      for (final dynamic e in cs) {
        if (known.contains(e.toString())) {
          return e.toString();
        }
      }
    }
    final String one = (v['category'] ?? '').toString();
    if (known.contains(one)) {
      return one;
    }
    return _browseCat;
  }

  Future<void> _sendInquiry(Map<String, dynamic> v) async {
    final placeId = (v['placeId'] as String?) ?? '';
    final vendorName = (v['name'] as String?) ?? 'this vendor';
    if (placeId.isEmpty || _uid == null) return;
    // v146: a vendor looking around must never create a real inquiry
    if (_previewVendor != null) {
      _toast(
          'Preview mode: messaging vendors is off here. This is what a couple would see when they reach out to $vendorName.');
      return;
    }
    final String inqCat = _vendorCat(v);
    final coupleSnap = await _coupleRef.get();
    final couple = coupleSnap.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    if (!mounted) return;
    final msgC = TextEditingController(
        text:
            'Hi! We found you on Lazo and would love to hear about your availability and packages.');
    final ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    bool open = true;
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    final ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> send() async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            // v160: the first message gets the safety check before the thread exists
            final Map<String, dynamic> pre =
                await _safetyFirstCheck(placeId, msgC.text.trim());
            if (pre['held'] == true) {
              up(() => busy = false);
              await _safetyNudge(null, pre);
              return;
            }
            try {
              final Map<String, dynamic>? refBy = _pendingReferral != null &&
                      _pendingReferral!['vendorId'] == placeId
                  ? <String, dynamic>{
                      'vendorId': _pendingReferral!['fromVendorId'],
                      'name': _pendingReferral!['fromVendorName']
                    }
                  : null;
              _pendingReferral = null;
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').add({
                'coupleUid': _cid,
                'vendorId': placeId,
                'vendorName': vendorName,
                'message': msgC.text.trim(),
                'status': 'new',
                if (refBy != null) 'referredBy': refBy,
                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'structuredIntent': {
                  'weddingDate': ts is Timestamp
                      ? ts.toDate().toIso8601String().split('T').first
                      : 'Date TBD',
                  'metroId': _browseMetro,
                  'category': inqCat,
                },
              });
              // The list listens: inquiring marks the category researching, with who
              try {
                final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pd =
                    await _planRef.doc(inqCat).get();
                final String pst = (pd.data()?['status'] ?? 'needed') as String;
                if (pst != 'booked' && pst != 'skipped') {
                  await _planRef.doc(inqCat).set(<String, dynamic>{
                    'status': 'researching',
                    'vendorName': vendorName,
                    'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                  }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                }
              } catch (_) {}
              if (open && ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'Couldn’t send. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.mail_outline_rounded,
              title: 'Contact $vendorName',
              subtitle: 'They reply in your Lazo messages.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  _pcA_chip(
                      Icons.event_outlined,
                      ts is Timestamp
                          ? _pcA_date(ts.toDate())
                          : 'Date to be decided'),
                  if (inqCat.isNotEmpty)
                    _pcA_chip(Icons.sell_outlined, _catLabel(inqCat)),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: msgC,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  minLines: 3,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14, height: 1.45),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Your message'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _lzNote(Icons.verified_rounded,
                    'Sent as a verified couple with your date attached. Never sold, never shared.'),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _pcA_status(err, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                  primary: 'Send',
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: msgC.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : send));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
    if (ok != true) return;
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool vUnclaimed = ((v['claimedBy'] ?? '') as String? ?? '').isEmpty;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      duration: Duration(seconds: vUnclaimed ? 6 : 4),
      behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14)),
      content: Text(
          vUnclaimed
              ? 'Sent. $vendorName hasn’t joined Lazo yet, so we’re letting them know a couple’s waiting. Their phone and website are on their card meanwhile.'
              : 'Sent to $vendorName.',
          style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
    ));
    _maybeAskPush();
  }

  // "Sat, Jun 13, 2027" without pulling in intl here
  String _pcA_date(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'
    ];
    const List<String> wd = <String>['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
    return '${wd[d.weekday - 1]}, ${mo[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}, ${d.year}';
  }

  // ---------------- v101: THE NOTIFICATION ASK ----------------
  // The OS prompt is one-shot: a No on first launch can never be taken back
  // from inside the app. So we never ask on landing, when nothing has
  // happened yet and there is no reason to say yes. We ask here, seconds
  // after she has messaged a vendor and genuinely wants to know when they
  // write back - and we ask ourselves first, so a No costs us nothing and
  // the next inquiry can ask again.
  // ---------------- v102: PUSH REGISTRATION, IN THE WIDGET ----------------
  // FlutterFlow only registers a token at startup, so granting permission
  // mid-session used to leave the device with no token until the next cold
  // launch. We do it here instead: ask, then fetch the token and write it in
  // FlutterFlow's own shape so its sender finds it.
  static const String kVapidKey =
      'BL9OflCUn1UyDwhFzdWQfsm_4yG5x7urzYbWGNvGhCbQgmsh5cNx-FX-VRRd4Q8dQpuWz04UG47Spu9VBj6CYdo';

  String get _pushDeviceType => kIsWeb
      ? 'web'
      : (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS ? 'ios' : 'android');

  Future<void> _writePushToken(String token) async {
    final String? uid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid;
    if (uid == null || token.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('users')
          .doc(uid)
          .collection('fcm_tokens')
          .doc(token)
          .set(<String, dynamic>{
        'fcm_token': token,
        'device_type': _pushDeviceType,
        'created_at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push token write: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  // Returns true only when permission was granted AND a token was written.
  Future<bool> _registerPush() async {
    try {
      final FirebaseMessaging fm = FirebaseMessaging.instance;
      final NotificationSettings st =
          await fm.requestPermission(alert: true, badge: true, sound: true);
      if (st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.authorized &&
          st.authorizationStatus != AuthorizationStatus.provisional) {
        return false;
      }
      String? token;
      if (kIsWeb) {
        token = await fm.getToken(vapidKey: kVapidKey);
      } else {
        // iOS hands back the APNs token a beat after the grant; asking for
        // the FCM token before it lands throws.
        if (defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.iOS) {
          for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            final String? apns = await fm.getAPNSToken();
            if (apns != null && apns.isNotEmpty) break;
            await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));
          }
        }
        token = await fm.getToken();
      }
      if (token == null || token.isEmpty) return false;
      await _writePushToken(token);
      fm.onTokenRefresh.listen(_writePushToken);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push register: ' + e.toString());
      return false;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _maybeAskPush({bool force = false}) async {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    if (!force) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = c.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        // v139: per partner (pushAsk.{uid}); the plan-wide fields only count
        // for the creator, so a joining partner's devices register too
        Map<String, dynamic> mine = <String, dynamic>{};
        if (d['pushAsk'] is Map && (d['pushAsk'] as Map)[_uid] is Map) {
          mine = Map<String, dynamic>.from((d['pushAsk'] as Map)[_uid] as Map);
        } else if (_uid == _cid) {
          mine = <String, dynamic>{
            'answer': d['pushAskAnswer'],
            'at': d['pushAskedAt']
          };
        }
        if ((mine['answer'] ?? '') == 'yes') return;
        final dynamic asked = mine['at'];
        if (asked is Timestamp &&
            DateTime.now().difference(asked.toDate()).inDays < 30) return;
      } catch (_) {
        return;
      }
    }
    // Let the "Sent" confirmation land and be read before anything else
    // appears on top of it.
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 1400));
    if (!mounted) return;
    final bool? yes = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      isScrollControlled: true,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => _lzFrame(ctx,
          icon: Icons.notifications_active_rounded,
          title: 'A heads up when they write back?',
          subtitle: 'Most vendors reply within a day or two.',
          children: <Widget>[
            const SizedBox(height: 14),
            for (final List<dynamic> r in <List<dynamic>>[
              <dynamic>[Icons.mark_chat_unread_outlined, 'When a vendor replies', true],
              <dynamic>[Icons.campaign_outlined, 'Marketing', false],
              <dynamic>[Icons.alarm_off_rounded, 'Reminders or nudges', false],
            ])
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(r[0] as IconData, size: 19, color: _lzFg(plum)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text(r[1] as String,
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14.5, color: _lzFg(ink)))),
                  Icon(
                      (r[2] as bool) ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.block_rounded,
                      size: 19,
                      color: (r[2] as bool) ? vGreen : _lzFg(muted)),
                ]),
              ),
          ],
          footer: _lzActions(
              secondary: 'Not now',
              onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              primary: 'Yes, let me know',
              icon: Icons.notifications_active_rounded,
              onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true))),
    );
    if (yes != true) {
      await _stampPushAsk('no');
      return;
    }
    final bool ok = await _registerPush();
    // 'blocked' means they said yes to us and the OS said no - asking again
    // can't help, only a trip to system settings can.
    await _stampPushAsk(ok ? 'yes' : 'blocked');
    if (ok) {
      _toast('Done - we’ll let you know.');
    } else {
      _toast('Notifications are off for Lazo on this device. Turn them on in your settings, then try again from Account.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _stampPushAsk(String answer) async {
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'pushAskedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'pushAskAnswer': answer,
        'pushAsk': <String, dynamic>{
          _uid!: <String, dynamic>{
            'answer': answer,
            'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
          }
        },
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO push ask stamp: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _linkBooking(Map<String, dynamic> inq, String inquiryId) async {
    final intent =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((inq['structuredIntent'] as Map?) ?? {});
    final slug = (intent['category'] as String?) ?? kCategories.first['slug']!;
    await _planRef.doc(slug).set({
      'status': 'booked',
      'vendorName': (inq['vendorName'] as String?) ?? '',
      'vendorId': (inq['vendorId'] as String?),
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    await _coupleRef.set({
      'linkedInquiries': FieldValue.arrayUnion([inquiryId]),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _celebrate();
  }

  // ---------------- v94: REGISTRY ----------------
  // A universal registry: links to wherever the registries live. Lazo never
  // hosts or marks one up. The site mirrors the list the moment it changes.
  static const List<List<String>> _kStores = <List<String>>[
    // host fragment, display name, brand color
    <String>['zola.com', 'Zola', '0xFF1A1A1A'],
    <String>['amazon.', 'Amazon', '0xFFFF9900'],
    <String>['target.com', 'Target', '0xFFCC0000'],
    <String>['crateandbarrel.com', 'Crate & Barrel', '0xFF222222'],
    <String>['williams-sonoma.com', 'Williams Sonoma', '0xFF2B2B2B'],
    <String>['potterybarn.com', 'Pottery Barn', '0xFF3B3B3B'],
    <String>['westelm.com', 'West Elm', '0xFF333333'],
    <String>['macys.com', "Macy's", '0xFFC8102E'],
    <String>['bloomingdales.com', "Bloomingdale's", '0xFF000000'],
    <String>['honeyfund.com', 'Honeyfund', '0xFFE8A33D'],
    <String>['theknot.com', 'The Knot', '0xFF0A5C5C'],
    <String>['myregistry.com', 'MyRegistry', '0xFF7A3F9C'],
    <String>['etsy.com', 'Etsy', '0xFFF1641E'],
    <String>['wayfair.com', 'Wayfair', '0xFF7B189F'],
    <String>['venmo.com', 'Venmo', '0xFF008CFF'],
    <String>['paypal.', 'PayPal', '0xFF003087'],
    <String>['cash.app', 'Cash App', '0xFF00D632'],
    <String>['airbnb.', 'Airbnb', '0xFFFF5A5F'],
    <String>['thingsremembered', 'Things Remembered', '0xFF8A6A2F'],
  ];

  // The store's own icon, fetched through our worker (meetlazo.com/icon/<host>,
  // which relays Google's favicon endpoint with the CORS header Flutter web
  // needs) - we never draw or alter a brand mark ourselves. Falls back to a
  // letter on a brand-colored tile if the icon can't be fetched.
  Widget _storeMark(String url, String fallbackLetter, Color color,
      {double size = 36}) {
    final String host = (Uri.tryParse(url)?.host ?? '').toLowerCase();
    final Widget letter = Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(color), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size * .28)),
      child: Center(
          child: Text(fallbackLetter,
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                  fontSize: size * .42))),
    );
    if (host.isEmpty) return letter;
    return ClipRRect(
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size * .28),
      child: Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(size * .14),
        child: Image.network(
          'https://meetlazo.com/icon/$host',
          width: size,
          height: size,
          fit: BoxFit.contain,
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? st) => letter,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<String>? _storeFor(String url) {
    final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(url);
    final String host = (u?.host ?? url).toLowerCase();
    for (final List<String> st in _kStores) {
      if (host.contains(st[0])) return st;
    }
    return null;
  }

  bool _urlOk(String url) {
    final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(url);
    return u != null &&
        (u.scheme == 'https' || u.scheme == 'http') &&
        u.host.contains('.');
  }

  // The wedding site shows the same list; keep it identical without waiting
  // for the next website save.
  Future<void> _syncRegistryToSite(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> links, String note) async {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isEmpty) return;
      await q.docs.first.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'registryLinks': links,
        'registryNote': note,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO registry sync: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveRegistry(List<Map<String, dynamic>> links,
      {String? note}) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> patch = <String, dynamic>{
      'registryLinks': links
    };
    if (note != null) patch['registryNote'] = note;
    await _coupleRef.set(patch, SetOptions(merge: true));
    String n = note ?? '';
    if (note == null) {
      try {
        final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c = await _coupleRef.get();
        n = (c.data()?['registryNote'] ?? '').toString();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
    await _syncRegistryToSite(links, n);
  }

  Future<void> _addRegistryLink(List<Map<String, dynamic>> current,
      {String presetHost = '', String presetLabel = '', int editIndex = -1}) async {
    // v139: a tapped store icon prefills; editIndex >= 0 edits that row
    final Map<String, dynamic> ed =
        editIndex >= 0 && editIndex < current.length
            ? current[editIndex]
            : <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController labelC = TextEditingController(
        text: (ed['label'] ?? presetLabel).toString());
    final TextEditingController urlC = TextEditingController(
        text: (ed['url'] ?? (presetHost.isEmpty ? '' : 'https://$presetHost/'))
            .toString());
    String detected = '';
    {
      final String u0 = urlC.text.trim();
      final List<String>? st0 = u0.isEmpty ? null : _storeFor(u0);
      if (st0 != null) detected = st0[1];
    }
    String error = '';
    bool busy = false;
    bool open = true;
    final bool? ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> save() async {
            String url = urlC.text.trim();
            if (url.isEmpty) {
              up(() => error = 'Paste the registry link first.');
              return;
            }
            if (!url.startsWith('http')) url = 'https://$url';
            if (!_urlOk(url)) {
              up(() => error = 'That doesn’t look like a web address.');
              return;
            }
            if (current.asMap().entries.any((MapEntry<int, Map<String, dynamic>> e) =>
                e.key != editIndex &&
                (e.value['url'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() ==
                    url.toLowerCase())) {
              up(() => error = 'That link is already on your list.');
              return;
            }
            urlC.text = url;
            final List<String>? st = _storeFor(url);
            final String label = labelC.text.trim().isNotEmpty
                ? labelC.text.trim()
                : (st == null
                    ? (Uri.tryParse(url)?.host ?? 'Registry').replaceFirst('www.', '')
                    : st[1]);
            final Map<String, dynamic> row = <String, dynamic>{
              'label': label,
              'url': url,
              'store': st == null ? '' : st[1]
            };
            final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next =
                List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
            if (editIndex >= 0 && editIndex < next.length) {
              next[editIndex] = row; // v139: edit in place
            } else {
              next.add(row);
            }
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              error = '';
            });
            try {
              await _saveRegistry(next);
              if (open && ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                error = 'Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.card_giftcard_rounded,
              title: editIndex >= 0 ? 'Edit registry' : 'Add a registry',
              subtitle: 'Paste the link guests would use. Any store, any fund.',
              children: <Widget>[
                _lzSection('Start from a store'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<String> p in const <List<String>>[
                    <String>['Zola', 'https://www.zola.com/registry/'],
                    <String>['Amazon', 'https://www.amazon.com/wedding/'],
                    <String>['Target', 'https://www.target.com/gift-registry/'],
                    <String>['Honeymoon fund', 'https://www.honeyfund.com/'],
                    <String>['Venmo', 'https://venmo.com/u/'],
                  ])
                    _Press(
                      scale: .97,
                      onTap: busy
                          ? null
                          : () => up(() {
                                urlC.text = p[1];
                                labelC.text = p[0];
                                detected = p[0];
                                error = '';
                              }),
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(6, 6, 13, 6),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: detected == p[0] ? plumDeep : _lzBg(cardBg),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                            border: Border.all(
                                color: detected == p[0] ? plumDeep : _lzLine(goldLine))),
                        child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                          _storeMark(p[1], p[0][0], plum, size: 22),
                          const SizedBox(width: 7),
                          Text(p[0],
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                  color: detected == p[0] ? gold : _lzFg(plum))),
                        ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: urlC,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                  autofocus: urlC.text.isEmpty,
                  autocorrect: false,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                  onChanged: (String v) {
                    final String u = v.trim().startsWith('http')
                        ? v.trim()
                        : 'https://${v.trim()}';
                    final List<String>? st = _storeFor(u);
                    up(() {
                      detected = st == null ? '' : st[1];
                      if (st != null && labelC.text.trim().isEmpty)
                        labelC.text = st[1];
                      error = '';
                    });
                  },
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Registry link',
                          hint: 'https://www.zola.com/registry/yournames')
                      .copyWith(
                    suffixIcon: detected.isEmpty
                        ? null
                        : Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 10, top: 14),
                            child: Text(detected,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(vGreen),
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: labelC,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                  onSubmitted: (_) {
                    if (!busy) save();
                  },
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Shown to guests as (optional)',
                      hint: 'Amazon, Our honeymoon fund…'),
                ),
                if (error.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _pcA_status(error, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                  primary: editIndex >= 0 ? 'Save' : 'Add registry',
                  icon: editIndex >= 0 ? Icons.check_rounded : Icons.add_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: urlC.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : save));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
    if (ok != true) return;
    _toast(editIndex >= 0
        ? 'Saved. Your website shows it now.'
        : 'Added. Your website shows it now.');
  }

  Future<void> _removeRegistryLink(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> current, Map<String, dynamic> link) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> restore =
        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next = current
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> l) => l['url'] != link['url'])
        .toList();
    await _saveRegistry(next);
    final String label =
        (link['label'] ?? link['store'] ?? 'Registry link').toString();
    _toastUndo('Removed $label.', () => _saveRegistry(restore));
  }

  Future<void> _moveRegistryLink(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> current, int from, int to) async {
    if (to < 0 || to >= current.length) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next =
        List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(current);
    final Map<String, dynamic> item = next.removeAt(from);
    next.insert(to, item);
    await _saveRegistry(next);
  }

  Future<void> _editRegistryNote(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, List<Map<String, dynamic>> links) async {
    final TextEditingController c =
        TextEditingController(text: (couple['registryNote'] ?? '').toString());
    bool open = true;
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    final bool? ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 540),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> save() async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await _saveRegistry(links, note: c.text.trim());
              if (open && ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.edit_note_rounded,

              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),

                  controller: c,
                  minLines: 3,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  autofocus: true,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5, height: 1.45),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('',
                      hint:
                          'Your presence is the gift. If you’d like to give something, these are the places we’d love…'),

                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                  primary: 'Save note',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: save));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
    if (ok == true) _toast('Saved. Your website shows it now.');
  }

  Future<void> _copyRegistryLink() async {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isEmpty) {
        _toast('Make your wedding website first - the registry lives on it.');
        return;
      }
      final String url = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/${q.docs.first.id}/#registry';
      await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
      _toast('Copied. That link goes on the invitation.');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not copy: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _openLink(String url) async {
    final uri = Uri.tryParse(url);
    if (uri != null && await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
      await launchUrl(uri,
          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication, webOnlyWindowName: '_blank');
    }
  }

      content: Text('$what is coming soon \u2014 you\u2019ll be first to know.',
          style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> _editDisplayName() async {
    final u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u == null) return;
    final c = TextEditingController(text: u.displayName ?? '');
    final ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 460),
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          final bool valid = c.text.trim().isNotEmpty;
          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.badge_outlined,
              title: 'Your name',
              subtitle: 'How vendors and your partner see you on Lazo.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                TextField(
                  controller: c,
                  autofocus: true,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                  onChanged: (_) => setD(() {}),
                  onSubmitted: (_) {
                    if (valid) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
                  },
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Display name'),
                ),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                  primary: 'Save',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  onPrimary: valid ? () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, true) : null));
        },
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true || c.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
    await u.updateDisplayName(c.text.trim());
    await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('users')
        .doc(u.uid)
        .set({'display_name': c.text.trim()}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  // What the seating chart holds, read live from the same docs it writes.
  Widget _seatingCard(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> guests) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc(
          'seat:$_cid', () => _coupleRef.collection('seating').doc('main')),
      initialData: _liveD['seat:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final int tables =
            d['tables'] is List ? (d['tables'] as List).length : 0;
        int seated = 0;
        int coming = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> g in guests) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = g.data();
          if ((m['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'no') continue;
          coming++;
          if ((m['table'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty) seated++;
        }
        final bool started = tables > 0;
        final String headline =
            started ? '$seated of $coming seated' : 'Lay out your reception';
        final String sub = started
            ? '$tables table${tables == 1 ? '' : 's'} on the floor plan'
                '${coming - seated > 0 ? ' \u00b7 ${coming - seated} still to seat' : ' \u00b7 everyone has a seat'}'
            : 'Drop in tables, the dance floor and the bar, then drag guests to their seats. Send it to your planner when it\u2019s ready.';
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
          child: _Press(
            scale: .985,
            dim: .92,
            onTap: _openSeating,
            child: _glass(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              radius: 20,
              tint: .6,
              borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Container(
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    gradient:
                        const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.table_restaurant_rounded,
                      color: gold, size: 22),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text('Seating chart', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                        Text(headline,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(ink),
                                fontSize: 14,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        Text(sub,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.35)),
                      ]),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                FilledButton(
                  style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: gold,
                      foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                      elevation: 0,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),

                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),

                          fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

              ]),

          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // v107: what the Music page holds, read live from the doc it writes.
  Widget _musicCard() {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc(
          'music:$_cid', () => _coupleRef.collection('music').doc('main')),
      initialData: _liveD['music:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final int moments =
            d['moments'] is Map ? (d['moments'] as Map).length : 0;
        final int must =
            d['mustPlay'] is List ? (d['mustPlay'] as List).length : 0;
        final int dont =
            d['doNotPlay'] is List ? (d['doNotPlay'] as List).length : 0;
        final bool started = moments > 0 || must > 0 || dont > 0;
        final Map<String, dynamic> sent = d['sentTo'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(d['sentTo'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{};
        final String headline = started
            ? '$moments of 11 moments set \u00b7 $must must-play${must == 1 ? '' : 's'}${dont > 0 ? ' \u00b7 $dont do-not-play${dont == 1 ? '' : 's'}' : ''}'
            : 'Pick the first dance';
        final String sub = started
            ? (sent['at'] is Timestamp
                ? 'Sent to ${(sent['vendorName'] ?? 'your DJ').toString()} \u00b7 ${_shortDate((sent['at'] as Timestamp).toDate())}'
                : 'Not sent to your DJ yet')
            : 'Search any song, hear the preview, and file it - the moments, your must-plays, the do-not-play list. Then send the whole plan to your DJ.';
        return _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          onTap: _openMusic,
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
            radius: 22,
            borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                width: 44,
                height: 44,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient:
                      const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                ),
                child:
                    const Icon(Icons.music_note_rounded, color: gold, size: 22),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text('Music', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                      Text(headline,
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(ink),
                              fontSize: 14,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      Text(sub,
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.35)),
                    ]),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              FilledButton(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold,
                    foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                    elevation: 0,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                    shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                onPressed: _h(_openMusic),
                child: Text(started ? 'Open' : 'Start',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // sunset for golden-hour portraits. Never a fake forecast for a day a year
  // away. Cached per session; re-fetched when the date or city changes.

  static const List<String> kKeyDateIdeas = <String>[
    'Engagement session',
    'Rehearsal dinner',

    'Bridal shower',
