  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _keyDates(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (couple['keyDates'] is! List) return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final dynamic e in couple['keyDates'] as List) {
      if (e is Map &&
          e['date'] is Timestamp &&
          (e['label'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        out.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e));
      }
    }
    out.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>
        (a['date'] as Timestamp).compareTo(b['date'] as Timestamp));
    return out;
  }

  Future<void> _addKeyDate(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    DateTime? picked;
    String? chosen;
    bool open = true;
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    final bool? ok = await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 540),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          final bool valid = c.text.trim().isNotEmpty && picked != null;

          Future<void> save() async {
            final DateTime p = picked!;
            final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _keyDates(couple)
              ..add(<String, dynamic>{
                'label': c.text.trim(),
                'date': Timestamp.fromDate(DateTime(p.year, p.month, p.day, 12))
              });
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await _coupleRef
                  .set(<String, dynamic>{'keyDates': list}, SetOptions(merge: true));
              if (open && ctx.mounted) Navigator.of(ctx).pop(true);
            } catch (e) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'Couldn’t save that date. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          Future<void> pickDay() async {
            final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
            final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
              context: ctx,
              initialDate: picked ?? now,
              firstDate: DateTime(now.year - 1),
              lastDate: DateTime(now.year + 3),
            );
            if (d != null) up(() => picked = d);
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx,
              icon: Icons.event_available_rounded,
              title: 'Add a date',
              subtitle: 'Shoots, tastings, fittings - the days around the big one.',
              children: <Widget>[
                _lzSection('Ideas'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final String i in kKeyDateIdeas)
                    _Press(
                      scale: .97,
                      onTap: busy
                          ? null
                          : () => up(() {
                                chosen = i;
                                c.text = i;
                              }),
                      child: AnimatedContainer(
                        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 180),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: chosen == i ? plumDeep : _lzBg(cardBg),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(30),
                            border: Border.all(
                                color: chosen == i ? plumDeep : _lzLine(goldLine))),
                        child: Text(i,
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                color: chosen == i ? gold : _lzFg(plum))),
                      ),
                    ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: c,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  onChanged: (_) => up(() => chosen = null),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('What is it?',
                      hint: 'Engagement session at the lake'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _pcA_pick(
                    Icons.event_rounded,
                    picked == null ? 'Pick the day' : _longDate(picked!),
                    picked == null ? 'Tap to open the calendar' : 'Tap to change it',
                    picked != null,
                    busy ? null : pickDay),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _pcA_status(err, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(false),
                  primary: c.text.trim().isEmpty
                      ? 'Name the date'
                      : (picked == null ? 'Pick the day' : 'Add date'),
                  icon: picked == null && c.text.trim().isNotEmpty ? Icons.event_rounded : Icons.add_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: valid
                      ? save
                      : (c.text.trim().isNotEmpty && picked == null ? pickDay : null)));
        },
      ),
    );
    open = false;
    if (ok != true || picked == null) return;
    if (mounted) setState(() => _wxSel = _ymd(picked!));
  }

  Future<void> _removeKeyDate(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, dynamic> kd) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> list = _keyDates(couple)
      ..removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> e) =>
          e['label'] == kd['label'] &&
          (e['date'] as Timestamp).seconds ==
              (kd['date'] as Timestamp).seconds);
    try {
      await _coupleRef
          .set(<String, dynamic>{'keyDates': list}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      setState(() => _wxSel = '');
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not remove it: $e');
    }
  }

  static String _wmoLabel(int code) {
    if (code == 0) return 'Clear';
    if (code == 1) return 'Mostly sunny';
    if (code == 2) return 'Partly cloudy';
    if (code == 3) return 'Overcast';
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return 'Foggy';
    if (code >= 51 && code <= 57) return 'Drizzle';
    if (code >= 61 && code <= 67) return 'Rain';
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 77) return 'Snow';
    if (code >= 80 && code <= 82) return 'Showers';
    if (code >= 85 && code <= 86) return 'Snow showers';
    if (code >= 95) return 'Thunderstorms';
    return 'Mixed';
  }

  static IconData _wmoIcon(int code) {
    if (code == 0 || code == 1) return Icons.wb_sunny_rounded;
    if (code == 2) return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
    if (code == 3) return Icons.cloud_rounded;
    if (code == 45 || code == 48) return Icons.foggy;
    if (code >= 71 && code <= 86 && code != 80 && code != 81 && code != 82)
      return Icons.ac_unit_rounded;
    if (code >= 95) return Icons.thunderstorm_rounded;
    if (code >= 51) return Icons.water_drop_rounded;
    return Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded;
  }

  String _ymd(DateTime d) =>
      '${d.year}-${d.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${d.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

  final Map<String, int> _wxFailAt = <String, int>{}; // v139

  Future<void> _loadWeather(DateTime wedding, String metro) async {
    final String key = '${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro';
    if (_wxCache.containsKey(key) || _wxLoading.contains(key)) return;
    // v139: after a failure, wait ten minutes instead of refetching on
    // every build
    final int? failed = _wxFailAt[key];
    if (failed != null &&
        DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch - failed < 600000) return;
    final List<double>? ll = kMetroLatLng[metro];
    if (ll == null) return;
    _wxLoading.add(key);
    _wxErr = '';
    Map<String, dynamic>? _wx;
    try {
      final DateTime today = DateTime(
          DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
      final int daysOut = DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month, wedding.day)
          .difference(today)
          .inDays;
      if (daysOut >= 0 && daysOut <= 15) {
        final Uri u = Uri.parse(
            'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
            '&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max,wind_speed_10m_max,sunset,sunrise'
            '&hourly=temperature_2m,weather_code,precipitation_probability,is_day'
            '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&wind_speed_unit=mph&timezone=auto&start_date=${_ymd(wedding)}&end_date=${_ymd(wedding)}');
        final httpc.Response r =
            await httpc.get(u).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
        final Map<String, dynamic> j =
            jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final Map<String, dynamic> d =
            Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
        _wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'forecast',
          'hi': ((d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'lo': ((d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first as num).round(),
          'code': ((d['weather_code'] as List).first as num).toInt(),
          'rainPct': _numAt(d['precipitation_probability_max']).round(),
          'wind': _numAt(d['wind_speed_10m_max']).round(),
          'sunset': (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString(),
          'hours': _SkyCard.hoursFrom(j, daysOut), // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-001
          'daysOut': daysOut,
        };
      } else {
        // The same date, the last five years, in parallel.
        final int endYear = today.year -
            (wedding.month > today.month ||
                    (wedding.month == today.month && wedding.day > today.day)
                ? 1
                : 0);
        final List<Future<httpc.Response>> reqs = <Future<httpc.Response>>[];
        final List<int> years = <int>[];
        for (int y = endYear; y > endYear - 5; y--) {
          years.add(y);
          final String ds =
              '$y-${wedding.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${wedding.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
          reqs.add(httpc
              .get(Uri.parse(
                  'https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=${ll[0]}&longitude=${ll[1]}'
                  '&start_date=$ds&end_date=$ds&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_sum,sunset,sunshine_duration,daylight_duration'
                  '&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&timezone=auto'))
              .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 12)));
        }
        final List<httpc.Response> rs = await Future.wait(reqs);
        double hi = 0, lo = 0;
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> yearsRows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[]; // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-001
        int n = 0, rainy = 0;
        final Map<int, int> codes = <int, int>{};
        String sunset = '';
        for (final httpc.Response r in rs) {
          if (r.statusCode != 200) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> j =
              jsonDecode(r.body) as Map<String, dynamic>;
          if (j['daily'] is! Map) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> d =
              Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['daily'] as Map);
          final dynamic h = (d['temperature_2m_max'] as List).first;
          final dynamic l = (d['temperature_2m_min'] as List).first;
          if (h is! num || l is! num) continue;
          hi += h;
          lo += l;
          n++;
          final dynamic p = (d['precipitation_sum'] as List).first;
          if (p is num && p >= 1.0)
            rainy++; // under 1 mm is a trace, not a rainy day
          final int c = _SkyCard.dayCode(d); // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-002
          codes[c] = (codes[c] ?? 0) + 1;
          yearsRows.add(<String, dynamic>{
            'y': (d['time'] is List && (d['time'] as List).isNotEmpty) ? (d['time'] as List).first.toString().substring(0, 4) : '',
            'hi': h.round(),
            'lo': l.round(),
            'code': c,
            'rain': p is num && p >= 1.0,
          });
          if (sunset.isEmpty &&
              d['sunset'] is List &&
              (d['sunset'] as List).isNotEmpty) {
            sunset = (d['sunset'] as List).first.toString();
          }
        }
        if (n == 0) throw Exception('no history');
        int code = 1;
        int best = -1;
        codes.forEach((int c, int k) {
          if (k > best) {
            best = k;
            code = c;
          }
        });
        _wx = <String, dynamic>{
          'mode': 'typical',
          'yearsRows': yearsRows,
          'hi': (hi / n).round(),
          'lo': (lo / n).round(),
          'code': code,
          'rainYears': rainy,
          'years': n,
          'sunset': sunset,
          'daysOut': daysOut,
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO weather: ' + e.toString());
      _wxErr = 'Weather is unavailable right now.';
      _wx = null;
      _wxFailAt[key] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    }
    _wxLoading.remove(key);
    if (_wx != null) _wxCache[key] = _wx;
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  static num _numAt(dynamic list) {
    if (list is List && list.isNotEmpty && list.first is num)
      return list.first as num;
    return 0;
  }

  String _sunsetClock(String iso) {
    // Open-Meteo returns local ISO like 2027-07-02T19:41; show 7:41 PM.
    final int t = iso.indexOf('T');
    if (t < 0 || iso.length < t + 6) return '';
    final int h = int.tryParse(iso.substring(t + 1, t + 3)) ?? 0;
    final String m = iso.substring(t + 4, t + 6);
    final int h12 = h % 12 == 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
    return '$h12:$m ${h < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}';
  }

  String _weatherTip(Map<String, dynamic> w, {bool wedding = true}) {
    final int hi = w['hi'] as int;
    final int code = w['code'] as int;
    final bool wet = w['mode'] == 'forecast'
        ? (w['rainPct'] as int) >= 40
        : (w['rainYears'] as int) >= 2;
    if (!wedding) {
      if (wet)
        return 'Keep a backup day in mind - photographers reschedule for rain all the time.';
      if (hi >= 95)
        return 'Go early or go late - midday heat shows in faces and flowers.';
      if (hi <= 40)
        return 'Cold - layers that photograph well, and a warm car nearby.';
      if (code <= 1)
        return 'Clear - the hour before sunset is the one to book.';
      return 'Soft light if it stays cloudy - flattering, and no squinting.';
    }
    if (wet) return 'Ask your venue about the rain plan now, not the week of.';
    if (hi >= 95)
      return 'Shade, water and a short ceremony - guests remember the heat.';
    if (hi >= 85)
      return 'Warm one. Cocktail hour in the shade, and put water where guests stand.';
    if (hi <= 45)
      return 'Cold for an outdoor ceremony - heaters, wraps, or move it inside.';
    if (code <= 1)
      return 'Clear skies - sunset portraits will be worth planning around.';
    return 'Mild and easy. Not much to plan around.';
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v117: phone polish - desk FAB, weather on the home, folded team
  // ===================================================================
  bool _teamExpanded = false;

  // A gold disc that reads as a made object rather than a coloured circle.
  // Three layers, because that is what the eye is actually reading:
  //
  //   BEZEL   a 1.2 rim that is near-white where the light hits and bronze
  //           where it turns away. A single flat border is the difference
  //           between a machined disc and a sticker - this is the layer that
  //           does most of the work.
  //   FACE    a four-stop ramp, champagne through gold into bronze, running
  //           the same direction as the light on the bezel.
  //   SPECULAR a soft hotspot up and left, where the highlight actually lands.
  //
  // The shadow is warm, not grey: gold spilling onto the plum underneath,
  // with a tight black contact line so it still touches the page.
  Widget _goldDisc({
    required double size,
    required IconData icon,
    required double iconSize,
    bool glow = true,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        gradient: const LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: <Color>[
            Color(0xFFFFF6E2),
            Color(0xFFE3C286),
            Color(0xFF9A7842),
          ],
          stops: <double>[0, .5, 1],
        ),
        boxShadow: glow
            ? <BoxShadow>[
                // Warm halo - the disc lighting the plum around it.
                BoxShadow(
                    color: gold.withOpacity(.30),
                    blurRadius: 28,
                    spreadRadius: -4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 8)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.34),
                    blurRadius: 22,
                    spreadRadius: -6,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22),

  // v131: the desk button, reworked on Apple's fluid-interface rules.
  //
  // DEPTH is two shadows, not one. A single wide blur reads as a sticker
  // printed on the page; real objects cast a tight contact shadow directly
  // under them AND a wider ambient one. The pair is what says 'above'.
  //
  // THE PRESS no longer fades the button out. Physical things do not go
  // translucent when you push them - they move, and the shadow tightens as
  // they get closer to the surface. Scale carries the whole gesture.
  //
  // THE HAPTIC moved to touch-down, onto the same frame as the scale. Fired
  // on release it was confirming something the finger had already finished.
  Widget _deskFab() {
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: _MovableFab(
      prefKey: 'lazo_fab_couple',
      size: 58,
      defaultBottom: 86, // v129: always above the Ask June bar (never shown on June)
      child: Material(
        key: _kTourFab,
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: _Press(
          scale: .90,
          dim: 1, // no opacity change - see above
          tickOnDown: true,
          onTap: _deskSheet,
          child: _goldDisc(
            size: 58,
            icon: Icons.grid_view_rounded,
            iconSize: 25,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ));
  }

  Future<void> _deskSheet() async {
    // [label, icon, what it does, which screen it lands on]
    // The fourth entry is what lets a tile know it is the screen you are
    // already on. Seating and Music leave the dashboard for their own pages,
    // so they have no view to match and never light up.
    final List<List<dynamic>> items = <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>[
        'Home',
        Icons.home_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.hub),
        _View.hub
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Vendor team',
        Icons.checklist_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors),
        _View.vendors
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Browse',
        Icons.storefront_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.browse),
        _View.browse
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Messages',
        Icons.chat_bubble_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.messages),
        _View.messages
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'June',
        Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.june),
        _View.june
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Day-of',
        Icons.event_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof),
        _View.dayof
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Guests',
        Icons.group_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests),
        _View.guests
      ],
      <dynamic>['Seating', Icons.table_restaurant_rounded, _openSeating, null],
      <dynamic>['Music', Icons.music_note_rounded, _openMusic, null],
      <dynamic>[
        'Website',
        Icons.language_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
        _View.website
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Registry',
        Icons.card_giftcard_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.registry),
        _View.registry
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Shopping',
        Icons.shopping_bag_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.shopping),
        _View.shopping
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Dream board',
        Icons.auto_awesome_mosaic_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.board),
        _View.board
      ],
      <dynamic>[
        'Account',
        Icons.person_rounded,
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.account),
        _View.account
      ],
    ];
    // SPATIAL CONSISTENCY. The desk used to slide up from the bottom edge with
    // no relationship to the button that summoned it - tap a circle in the
    // corner, watch a full-width panel arrive from somewhere else. Now it
    // grows out of that corner and shrinks back into it, so the button and
    // the panel read as one object opening rather than two unrelated ones.
    //
    // The curve is critically damped, no overshoot: a tap carries no momentum,
    // and bounce belongs to gestures that were thrown. easeIn on the way out
    // mirrors easeOut on the way in, so the return retraces the path.
    //
    // Reduced motion keeps the plain slide - the vestibular problem is the
    // zoom, not the transition.
    final bool calm = _reducedMotion(context);
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: AnimatedBuilder(
          // The route's OWN animation, not one of ours.
          //
          // Supplying a transitionAnimationController here and disposing it
          // after the await crashed the app: showModalBottomSheet's Future
          // completes when the route is popped, which is BEFORE the exit
          // animation has run, so the dispose tore the controller down
          // mid-flight and the next tick threw. Borrowing the route's
          // animation gives the same motion with no lifecycle to get wrong.
          animation: ModalRoute.of(ctx)?.animation ?? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation,
          builder: (BuildContext actx, Widget? panel) {
            if (calm) return panel!;
            final Animation<double> a =
                ModalRoute.of(actx)?.animation ?? kAlwaysCompleteAnimation;
            final double t = (a.status == AnimationStatus.reverse
                    ? Curves.easeInCubic
                    : Curves.easeOutCubic)
                .transform(a.value.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
            return Transform.scale(
              scale: .88 + .12 * t,
              // Roughly where the button sits: hard right, on the floor.
              alignment: const Alignment(.8, 1),
              child: panel,
            );
          },
          child: Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 0, 10, 10),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 12, 16, 16),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              // Lit from above, like everything else here: one flat fill gave
              // the tiles nothing to sit in.
              gradient: const LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF3B1C3D), Color(0xFF291228)],
              ),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
              boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                // A bigger surface reads as a thicker one: wider, softer, and
                // sitting further off the page than the button that opened it.
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.38),
                    blurRadius: 40,
                    spreadRadius: -4,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 18)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.26),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 3)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: <Widget>[
                // the clear sheet gets no handle from _lzSheet, so the desk
                // keeps its own - on phones only, where it can be swiped away
                if (MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.width < _lzWideAt)
                Container(
                    width: 44,
                    height: 4,
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: gold.withOpacity(.45),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99))),
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                  child: Text('YOUR PLANNING DESK',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: gold.withOpacity(.9),
                          fontSize: 10.5,
                          letterSpacing: 2.2,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                GridView.count(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  crossAxisCount: 4,
                  mainAxisSpacing: 10,
                  crossAxisSpacing: 10,
                  childAspectRatio: .92,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final List<dynamic> it in items)
                      _deskSheetTile(ctx, it),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // One tile on the planning desk.
  //
  // The gold state is the point: a launcher whose first job is telling you
  // where you are had twelve identical squares and told you nothing. The tile
  // for the screen behind the sheet is lit, so the desk always answers 'here'
  // before you pick 'there'.
  //
  // Read at build time and never updated - correct, because tapping any tile
  // closes the sheet.
  Widget _deskSheetTile(BuildContext sheetCtx, List<dynamic> it) {
    final bool here = it.length > 3 && it[3] != null && it[3] == _view;
    const Color lit = Color(0xFFF7E3B4);
    return _Press(
      scale: .94,
      dim: 1,
      tickOnDown: true,
      onTap: () {
        Navigator.pop(sheetCtx);
        (it[2] as VoidCallback)();
      },
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          // Top-lit face, same as the panel and the discs.
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            colors: here
                ? <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.34), gold.withOpacity(.14)]
                : <Color>[_lzBg(ivory).withOpacity(.13), _lzBg(ivory).withOpacity(.05)],
          ),
          border: Border.all(
              color: _lzLine(here ? gold.withOpacity(.9) : ivory.withOpacity(.16)),
              width: here ? 1.3 : 1),
          boxShadow: here
              ? <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: gold.withOpacity(.26),
                      blurRadius: 16,
                      spreadRadius: -2),
                ]
              : <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22),
                      blurRadius: 8,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 3)),
                ],
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            Icon(it[1] as IconData, color: _lzFg(here ? lit : gold), size: 23),
            const SizedBox(height: 7),
            Padding(

              child: Text(it[0] as String,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: TextStyle(
