                      fontSize: 11,
                      height: 1.15,
                      letterSpacing: .2,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The sky on the home. Reads the same cache the Day-of weather card fills.
  Widget _weatherHubWidget(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    // Always present. Without a date it shows today in their city; without a
    // city it asks for one (the setup sheet writes couples.metroId).
    if (metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _setupSheet(couple),
        child: Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            gradient: const LinearGradient(
                begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF4A2B4C), plumDeep]),
          ),
          foregroundDecoration: BoxDecoration(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.55))),
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 16),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text('WEATHER ON YOUR DAY',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory.withOpacity(.7),
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            letterSpacing: 1.8,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    const Text('Tell June your city',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 16,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                        'She\u2019ll show the real forecast as your date nears, and what that day is usually like there until then.',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory.withOpacity(.75),
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            height: 1.4)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Icon(Icons.wb_sunny_rounded, color: gold.withOpacity(.9), size: 46),
          ]),
        ),
      );
    }
    final DateTime wedding = ts is Timestamp
        ? ts.toDate()
        : DateTime(
            DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
    final bool hasDate = ts is Timestamp;
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(wedding, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro'];
    final String city = _metroLabel(metro);
    final int code = w == null ? -1 : (w['code'] as int);
    final bool fc = w != null && w['mode'] == 'forecast';
    // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-001: drawn the way Apple draws its weather widget
    // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-002: what a couple plans around - rain, golden hour, sunset - as tiles, when the
    // real forecast starts, and June's planning tip as the footer line
    final String sunsetIso = w == null ? '' : (w['sunset'] ?? '').toString();
    final String sunset = _sunsetClock(sunsetIso);
    final DateTime? sunsetAt = DateTime.tryParse(sunsetIso);
    final String golden = sunsetAt == null
        ? ''
        : _sunsetClock(
            sunsetAt.subtract(const Duration(hours: 1)).toIso8601String());
    final DateTime today0 = DateTime(
        DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
    final DateTime day0 = DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month, wedding.day);
    final String when;
    if (!hasDate) {
      when = 'Today · set your date to see your day';
    } else if (fc) {
      when = 'Forecast · ${_shortDate(wedding)}';
    } else if (day0.isAfter(today0)) {
      when =
          'Typical for ${_shortDate(wedding)} · forecast from ${_shortDate(day0.subtract(const Duration(days: 15)))}';
    } else {
      when = 'Your day · ${_shortDate(wedding)}';
    }
    final List<List<String>> stats = <List<String>>[
      if (w != null && fc) <String>['Rain', '${w['rainPct']}%'],
      if (w != null && !fc)
        <String>[
          'Rainy years',
          (w['rainYears'] == 0 ? 'None' : '${w['rainYears']}') +
              ' of ${w['years']}'
        ],
      if (golden.isNotEmpty) <String>['Golden hour', golden],
      if (sunset.isNotEmpty) <String>['Sunset', sunset],
    ];
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof),
      child: _SkyCard(
        place: city,
        when: when,
        w: w,
        status: _wxErr.isEmpty ? 'Reading the sky…' : _wxErr,
        fold: _foldBtn('weather', onDark: true),
        stats: stats,
        note: w == null || !hasDate ? '' : _weatherTip(w),
        action: 'All dates',
        radius: 22,
      ),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // vTOUR: THE FIRST-RUN TOUR (spotlight coach marks, no packages)
  // ===================================================================
  final GlobalKey _tourRootKey = GlobalKey();
  int _tourIdx = -1;
  List<_TourStep> _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
  Rect? _tourRect;
  bool _tourMeasuring = false;

  bool _tourVoice = true; // v156: June narrates the tour

  void _startTour(List<_TourStep> steps) {
    if (steps.isEmpty) return;
    JuneNative.holdLine = true;
    _tourVoice = true;
    setState(() {
      _tourSteps = steps;
      _tourIdx = 0;
      _tourRect = null;
    });
    _tourFocus();
  }

  void _tourGo(int delta) {
    final int next = _tourIdx + delta;
    if (next < 0 || next >= _tourSteps.length) {
      _endTour(completed: next >= _tourSteps.length);
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _tourIdx = next);
    _tourFocus();
  }

  Future<void> _tourFocus() async {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length) return;
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    st.before?.call();
    // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-1010-V150: a step's screen can take a few frames to build (a tab switch
    // on a slow phone) - look for the target across frames before calling
    // it absent, so Money and Profile are never skipped.
    BuildContext? tc = st.key?.currentContext;
    bool laidOut(BuildContext? c) {
      if (c == null) return false;
      final RenderObject? ro = c.findRenderObject();
      return ro is RenderBox && ro.hasSize;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 12 && st.key != null && !laidOut(tc); i++) {
      await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 40));
      if (!mounted) return;
      tc = st.key?.currentContext;
    }
    if (tc == null && st.key != null) {
      // target not on this screen - skip it
      if (mounted) _tourGo(1);
      return;
    }
    if (_tourVoice) JuneNative.say(st.say ?? '${st.title}. ${st.body}');
    if (tc != null) {
      // Scroll only when the target is actually off-screen; ensureVisible
      // resolves when its animation ends, so no fixed wait is needed.
      bool needScroll = true;
      try {
        final RenderObject? rootRo0 =
            _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
        final RenderObject? ro0 = tc.findRenderObject();
        if (rootRo0 is RenderBox && ro0 is RenderBox && ro0.hasSize) {
          final Offset o0 = ro0.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo0);
          final double h0 = rootRo0.size.height;
          needScroll = o0.dy < 70 || o0.dy + ro0.size.height > h0 - 90;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
      if (needScroll) {
        try {
          await Scrollable.ensureVisible(tc,
              alignment: .25,
              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 380),
              curve: Curves.easeInOutCubic);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }
    if (!mounted) return;
    _tourMeasuring = true;
    // measure after the frame; if the target has no size yet, try again for
    // a few frames rather than leaving the ring off the screen
    Rect? measure() {
      final RenderObject? rootRo =
          _tourRootKey.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      final RenderObject? ro = st.key?.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
      if (rootRo is RenderBox && ro is RenderBox && ro.hasSize) {
        final Offset o = ro.localToGlobal(Offset.zero, ancestor: rootRo);
        return Rect.fromLTWH(o.dx, o.dy, ro.size.width, ro.size.height)
            .inflate(6);
      }
      return null;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      await WidgetsBinding.instance.endOfFrame;
      if (!mounted) return;
      final Rect? r = measure();
      if (r != null || st.key == null || i == 9) {
        _tourMeasuring = false;
        setState(() => _tourRect = r);
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  Widget _tourOverlay() {
    if (_tourIdx < 0 || _tourIdx >= _tourSteps.length)
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final _TourStep st = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
    final Rect? r = _tourRect;
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
        final double w = cons.maxWidth, h = cons.maxHeight;
        final bool phone = w < 700;
        // card goes below the spotlight when there's room, else above
        final double cardW = phone ? w - 28 : 380;
        final bool below = r == null || r.bottom + 190 < h;
        final double top = r == null
            ? h * .35
            : (below ? r.bottom + 14 : (r.top - 14 - 180).clamp(12.0, h - 200));
        final double left = phone
            ? 14
            : (r == null
                ? (w - cardW) / 2
                : (r.left).clamp(14.0, w - cardW - 14));
        return Stack(children: <Widget>[
          Positioned.fill(
            child: GestureDetector(
              onTap: () => _tourGo(1),
              // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-1010-V150: a step with no target (the welcome card) paints the
              // dim directly - a RectTween with a null end trips an assert in
              // debug builds, and there is nothing to animate to anyway.
              child: r == null
                  ? CustomPaint(painter: _SpotlightPainter(null, plum))
                  : TweenAnimationBuilder<Rect?>(
                      // v130: re-key when the ring first appears so it doesn't
                      // grow out of the top-left corner (Rect.lerp from null).
                      key: const ValueKey<bool>(false),
                      tween: RectTween(begin: r, end: r),
                      duration: Duration(
                          milliseconds: _reducedMotion(context) ? 0 : 260),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      builder: (BuildContext bc, Rect? v, Widget? _) =>
                          CustomPaint(painter: _SpotlightPainter(v, plum)),
                    ),
            ),
          ),
          AnimatedPositioned(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 220),
            curve: Curves.easeOut,
            left: left,
            top: top,
            width: cardW,
            child: Material(
              color: Colors.transparent,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 14),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFFFDF9)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold),
                  boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                    BoxShadow(
                        color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.35),
                        blurRadius: 30,
                        offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                  ],
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                          color: gold, size: 16),
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(st.title,
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(plum),
                                fontSize: 16,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                      Tooltip(
                        message: _tourVoice ? 'Mute June' : 'Let June talk you through it',
                        child: InkWell(
                          customBorder: const CircleBorder(),
                          onTap: () {
                            setState(() => _tourVoice = !_tourVoice);
                            if (_tourVoice) {
                              final _TourStep cur = _tourSteps[_tourIdx];
                              JuneNative.say(cur.say ?? '${cur.title}. ${cur.body}');
                            } else {
                              JuneNative.stopSpeaking();
                            }
                          },
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                            child: Icon(_tourVoice ? Icons.volume_up_rounded : Icons.volume_off_rounded, size: 17, color: _tourVoice ? plum : muted),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                      Text('${_tourIdx + 1} of ${_tourSteps.length}',
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF6B5F72)),
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ]),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(st.body,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF241E2B)),
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            height: 1.45)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() => _endTour(completed: false)),
                        child:  Text('Skip',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF6B5F72)),
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      if (_tourIdx > 0)
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(-1)),
                          child:  Text('Back',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plum),
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: plum,
                            elevation: 0,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 16, vertical: 10),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _tourGo(1)),
                        child: Text(
                            _tourIdx == _tourSteps.length - 1 ? 'Done' : 'Next',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 13,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ]);
      }),
    );
  }

  // ---- couple-specific ----
  final GlobalKey _kTourSetup = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourHero = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourWeek = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourTeam = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourMessages = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourDayOf = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourJune = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourFab = GlobalKey();
  final GlobalKey _kTourRail = GlobalKey();
  bool _tourChecked = false;

  void _maybeStartCoupleTour(Map<String, dynamic> couple, bool needsSetup) {
    if (_tourChecked || _tourIdx >= 0) return;
    // The hub renders once with an empty map before the couple doc arrives -
    // deciding on that frame started the tour for everyone, every load.
    if (couple.isEmpty) return;
    // v139: per partner - a joining partner gets the tour too. A legacy
    // tourDoneAt with no tourDoneBy counts for the plan's creator only.
    final List<dynamic> doneBy =
        couple['tourDoneBy'] is List ? couple['tourDoneBy'] as List : <dynamic>[];
    final bool doneForMe = doneBy.contains(_uid) ||
        (doneBy.isEmpty && couple['tourDoneAt'] != null && _uid == _cid);
    if (doneForMe) {
      _tourChecked = true;
      return;
    }
    _tourChecked = true;
    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 900), () {
      if (mounted && _view == _View.hub)
        _startTour(_coupleTourSteps(needsSetup: needsSetup));
    });
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v156: JUNE KEEPS YOU POSTED (couples)
  // ===================================================================
  String _cwFor = '';
  final List<StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _cwSubs = <StreamSubscription<dynamic>>[];
  final Map<String, StreamSubscription<dynamic>> _cwInvSubs = <String, StreamSubscription<dynamic>>{};
  final Map<String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _cwInv = <String, List<Map<String, dynamic>>>{};
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _cwInq = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  final Set<String> _cwArmed = <String>{};
  Set<String> _cwSaid = <String>{};
  bool _cwVoice = true;
  DateTime? _cwLastSeen;
  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> _cwQueue = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  Map<String, dynamic>? _cwNotice;
  Timer? _cwNoticeT;
  Timer? _cwSeenT;
  final List<String> _cwAway = <String>[];
  Timer? _cwAwayT;
  String _cwSlug = '';
  Map<String, dynamic> _cwCouple = <String, dynamic>{};

  bool _cwFresh(dynamic v, {int minutes = 15}) => v is Timestamp && DateTime.now().difference(v.toDate()).inMinutes.abs() <= minutes;
  bool _cwSince(dynamic v) {
    final DateTime? ls = _cwLastSeen;
    return ls != null && v is Timestamp && v.toDate().isAfter(ls) && DateTime.now().difference(v.toDate()).inDays < 14;
  }

  String _cwVendor(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
    final String n = (m['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    return n.isEmpty ? 'Your vendor' : n;
  }

  String _cwDay(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> wd = <String>['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday'];
    final DateTime t = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, DateTime.now().day);
    final int n = DateTime(d.year, d.month, d.day).difference(t).inDays;
    if (n == 0) return 'today';
    if (n == 1) return 'tomorrow';
    if (n > 1 && n < 7) return 'on ${wd[d.weekday - 1]}';
    return 'on ${_kMoLong[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  }

  Future<void> _cwRemember(String key) async {
    if (key.isEmpty) return;
    _cwSaid.add(key);
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      final List<String> l = _cwSaid.toList();
      await p.setStringList('juneSaidC_$_cwFor', l.length > 400 ? l.sublist(l.length - 400) : l);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _cwMarkSeen() async {
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await p.setString('juneSeenC_$_cwFor', DateTime.now().toIso8601String());
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _cwSay(String key, String text, {String? threadId, IconData icon = Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, bool speak = true, _View? go}) {
    if (key.isNotEmpty) {
      if (_cwSaid.contains(key)) return;
      _cwRemember(key);
    }
    _cwQueue.add(<String, dynamic>{'text': text, 'thread': threadId, 'icon': icon, 'speak': speak, 'go': go});
    if (_cwNotice == null) _cwNext();
  }

  void _cwNext() {
    _cwNoticeT?.cancel();
    if (_cwQueue.isEmpty) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _cwNotice = null);
      return;
    }
    final Map<String, dynamic> n = _cwQueue.removeAt(0);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _cwNotice = n);
    if (n['speak'] == true && _cwVoice && !JuneNative.holdLine && _tourIdx < 0) JuneNative.say(n['text'] as String);
    _cwNoticeT = Timer(Duration(milliseconds: 4500 + (n['text'] as String).split(' ').length * 330), _cwNext);
  }

  void _cwAwayAdd(String key, String phrase) {
    if (_cwSaid.contains(key)) return;
    _cwRemember(key);
    _cwAway.add(phrase);
    _cwAwayKick();
  }

  void _cwAwayKick() {
    _cwAwayT?.cancel();
    _cwAwayT = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 3), () {
      if (_cwAway.isEmpty) return;
      final List<String> a = List<String>.from(_cwAway);
      _cwAway.clear();
      final String list = a.length == 1 ? a.first : a.sublist(0, a.length - 1).join(', ') + ', and ' + a.last;
      _cwSay('', 'While you were away: $list.', icon: Icons.history_rounded);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _cwWatch(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    _cwCouple = couple;
    if (_cid.isEmpty || couple.isEmpty || _cwFor == _cid) return;
    _cwFor = _cid;
    for (final StreamSubscription<dynamic> x in _cwSubs) {
      x.cancel();
    }
    _cwSubs.clear();
    try {
      final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      _cwSaid = (p.getStringList('juneSaidC_$_cid') ?? <String>[]).toSet();
      _cwVoice = p.getBool('juneAnnounce') ?? true;
      _cwLastSeen = DateTime.tryParse(p.getString('juneSeenC_$_cid') ?? '');
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!mounted || _cwFor != _cid) return;
    _cwSeenT?.cancel();
    _cwSeenT = Timer.periodic(const Duration(minutes: 1), (_) => _cwMarkSeen());

    // ---- vendor threads
    _cwSubs.add(_inqStream().listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      final bool first = !_cwArmed.contains('inq');
      int awayReplies = 0;
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in snap.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        if ((m['status'] ?? '') == 'flagged') continue;
        final Map<String, dynamic>? was = _cwInq[d.id];
        _cwInq[d.id] = <String, dynamic>{'status': m['status'], 'contract': m['contractStatus'], 'invoice': m['invoiceStatus'], 'lastAt': m['lastMessageAt'], 'vendor': _cwVendor(m), 'data': m};
        final String v = _cwVendor(m);
        // invoices for threads that have any
        if ((m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty || (m['status'] ?? '') == 'booked') _cwWatchInvoices(d.id);
        if (first) {
          if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor' && _cwSince(m['lastMessageAt'])) {
            awayReplies++;
            _cwRemember('msg:${d.id}:${(m['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp).seconds}');
          }
          if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent' && _cwSince(m['lastMessageAt'])) _cwAwayAdd('contract:${d.id}', 'a contract to sign from $v');
          continue;
        }
        if (was == null) continue;
        if ((m['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' && (was['status'] ?? '') != 'booked') {
          _cwSay('booked:${d.id}', 'You booked $v. One more off the list!', threadId: d.id, icon: Icons.celebration_rounded);
        } else if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent' && (was['contract'] ?? '') != 'sent') {
          _cwSay('contract:${d.id}', '$v sent you a contract to sign.', threadId: d.id, icon: Icons.draw_rounded);
        } else if (<String>['sent', 'due'].contains((m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString()) && (was['invoice'] ?? '') != (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '')) {
          _cwSay('invoice:${d.id}:${m['invoiceStatus']}', '$v sent you an invoice.', threadId: d.id, icon: Icons.receipt_long_rounded);
        } else if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor' && m['lastMessageAt'] is Timestamp &&
            (was['lastAt'] is! Timestamp || (m['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp).compareTo(was['lastAt'] as Timestamp) > 0) &&
            _cwFresh(m['lastMessageAt'], minutes: 5) && d.id != _openThreadId) {
          final String prev = (m['lastMessagePreview'] ?? '').toString().trim();
          final String line = prev.isEmpty ? '' : ' "${prev.length > 90 ? prev.substring(0, 87).trimRight() + '...' : prev}"';
          _cwSay('msg:${d.id}:${(m['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp).seconds}', '$v just replied.$line', threadId: d.id, icon: Icons.chat_bubble_rounded);
        }
      }
      if (first) {
        if (awayReplies > 0) {
          _cwAway.insert(0, awayReplies == 1 ? 'a vendor replied' : '$awayReplies vendors replied');
          _cwAwayKick();
        }
        _cwArmed.add('inq');
        _cwMarkSeen();
      }
    }, onError: (Object _) {}));

    // ---- RSVPs from the wedding website
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> sites = await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('weddingSites').where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid).limit(1).get();
      if (sites.docs.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
        _cwSlug = sites.docs.first.id;
        _cwSubs.add(_liveQuery('rsvp:$_cwSlug', () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('weddingSites').doc(_cwSlug).collection('rsvps')).listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
          final bool first = !_cwArmed.contains('rsvp');
          int away = 0;
          for (final DocumentChange<Map<String, dynamic>> ch in snap.docChanges) {
            if (ch.type != DocumentChangeType.added) continue;
            final Map<String, dynamic> r = ch.doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
            final String who = (r['name'] ?? 'A guest').toString().trim();
            final bool yes = (r['attending'] ?? 'yes').toString() == 'yes';
            final int plus = r['plusOnes'] is num ? (r['plusOnes'] as num).toInt() : 0;
            if (first) {
              if (_cwSince(r['createdAt'])) {
                away++;
                _cwRemember('rsvp:${ch.doc.id}');
              }
              continue;
            }
            _cwSay('rsvp:${ch.doc.id}', yes ? '$who RSVP\'d yes${plus > 0 ? ', plus $plus' : ''}!' : '$who sent their regrets.', icon: yes ? Icons.how_to_reg_rounded : Icons.person_off_rounded, go: _View.guests);
          }
          if (first) {
            if (away > 0) {
              _cwAway.add(away == 1 ? 'one new RSVP' : '$away new RSVPs');
              _cwAwayKick();
            }
            _cwArmed.add('rsvp');
            if (mounted) setState(() {});
          }
        }, onError: (Object _) {}));
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    // v157: what the other partner just did
    _cwSubs.add(_coupleRef.collection('activity').orderBy('at', descending: true).limit(10).snapshots().listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      final bool first = !_cwArmed.contains('act');
      for (final DocumentChange<Map<String, dynamic>> ch in snap.docChanges) {
        if (ch.type != DocumentChangeType.added) continue;
        final Map<String, dynamic> a = ch.doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        if ((a['by'] ?? '') == _uid) continue;
        if (first) {
          if (_cwSince(a['at'])) _cwAwayAdd('act:${ch.doc.id}', (a['text'] ?? '').toString().replaceAll(RegExp(r'\.$'), ''));
          continue;
        }
        if (!_cwFresh(a['at'], minutes: 10)) continue;
        final String open = (a['open'] ?? '').toString();
        _cwSay('act:${ch.doc.id}', (a['text'] ?? '').toString(), icon: Icons.favorite_rounded, go: open == 'guests' ? _View.guests : open == 'website' ? _View.website : open == 'vendors' ? _View.vendors : null);
      }
      _cwArmed.add('act');
    }, onError: (Object _) {}));

    Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 6), _cwDaily);
  }

  // v157: a line for the partner (and the push the server sends them)
  Future<void> _logActivity(String what, {String open = ''}) async {
    if (_cid.isEmpty || _uid == null) return;
    final String me = (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '').trim().split(RegExp(r'\s+')).first;
    final String who = me.isEmpty ? 'Your partner' : me;
    try {
      await _coupleRef.collection('activity').add(<String, dynamic>{
        'by': _uid,
        'byName': who,
        'text': '$who $what',
        'open': open,
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _cwWatchInvoices(String inqId) {
    if (_cwInvSubs.containsKey(inqId)) return;
    _cwInvSubs[inqId] = FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').doc(inqId).collection('invoices').snapshots().listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      _cwInv[inqId] = snap.docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) => <String, dynamic>{...d.data(), '_id': d.id, '_inq': inqId}).toList();
      final String v = (_cwInq[inqId]?['vendor'] ?? 'your vendor').toString();
      final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in _cwInv[inqId]!) {
        final String st = (i['status'] ?? '').toString();
        if (st == 'paid' || st == 'void' || i['demo'] == true) continue;
        final dynamic dd = i['dueDate'];
        if (dd is! Timestamp) continue;
        final int days = DateTime(dd.toDate().year, dd.toDate().month, dd.toDate().day).difference(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day)).inDays;
        if (days >= 0 && days <= 3) {
          final String amt = i['total'] is num ? _money(i['total'] as num) : '';
          _cwSay('due:${i['_id']}', 'Your ${amt.isEmpty ? '' : '$amt '}payment to $v is due ${_cwDay(dd.toDate())}.', threadId: inqId, icon: Icons.payments_rounded);
        }
      }
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }, onError: (Object _) {});
  }

  // once a day: the countdown, the next milestone, the weather
  Future<void> _cwDaily() async {
    if (!mounted || _cwFor != _cid) return;
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final String key = 'day:${_ymd(now)}';
    if (_cwSaid.contains(key) || now.hour < 5) return;
    final Map<String, dynamic> c = _cwCouple;
    final DateTime? wed = c['weddingDate'] is Timestamp ? (c['weddingDate'] as Timestamp).toDate() : null;
    final String metro = (c['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    final List<String> parts = <String>[];
    if (wed != null) {
      final int days = DateTime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day).difference(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day)).inDays;
      if (days > 1) parts.add('$days days to go.');
      if (days == 1) parts.add('Tomorrow is the day!');
      if (days == 0) parts.add('Today is the day. Congratulations!');
      final List<dynamic>? ms = _crMilestone(days);
      if (ms != null && days > 0) parts.add(ms[0] == 0 ? 'Today: ${ms[1]}.' : 'Next up, in ${ms[0]} day${ms[0] == 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${ms[1]}.');
      if (metro.isNotEmpty && days >= 0 && days <= 15) {
        await _loadWeather(wed, metro);
        final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(wed)}|$metro'];
        if (w != null && w['hi'] != null) parts.add('Your wedding-day forecast: ${_crSky(w)}, a high of ${w['hi']}${w['rainPct'] is num && (w['rainPct'] as num) >= 20 ? ', ${w['rainPct']} percent chance of rain' : ''}.');
      }
    }
    if (metro.isNotEmpty && (wed == null || DateTime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day).difference(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day)).inDays > 15)) {
      await _loadWeather(now, metro);
      final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(now)}|$metro'];
      if (w != null && w['hi'] != null) parts.add('Today it\'s ${_crSky(w)}, a high of ${w['hi']}.');
    }
    if (parts.isEmpty) return;
    _cwSay(key, parts.join(' '), icon: Icons.wb_sunny_rounded);
  }

  String _crSky(Map<String, dynamic> w) {
    final int code = (w['code'] is num) ? (w['code'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    return code == 0 ? 'clear skies' : code <= 2 ? 'sun and a few clouds' : code == 3 ? 'cloudy' : (code == 45 || code == 48) ? 'foggy' : code >= 95 ? 'stormy' : (code >= 71 && code <= 86 && code != 80 && code != 81 && code != 82) ? 'snowy' : code >= 51 ? 'rainy' : 'mixed skies';
  }

  // the usual planning milestones, by days before the wedding: [days until it, what]
  static const List<List<dynamic>> _kCrMilestones = <List<dynamic>>[
    <dynamic>[300, 'book your venue and photographer'],
    <dynamic>[240, 'send save-the-dates'],
    <dynamic>[180, 'order your attire'],
    <dynamic>[120, 'order invitations'],
    <dynamic>[56, 'mail your invitations'],
    <dynamic>[28, 'your RSVP deadline'],
    <dynamic>[14, 'give your caterer the final headcount'],
    <dynamic>[7, 'send the final timeline to your vendors'],
    <dynamic>[1, 'the rehearsal'],
  ];

  List<dynamic>? _crMilestone(int daysOut) {
    for (final List<dynamic> m in _kCrMilestones) {
      final int at = m[0] as int;
      if (daysOut >= at) return <dynamic>[daysOut - at, m[1]];
    }
    return null;
  }

  Widget _cwNoticeOverlay() {
    final Map<String, dynamic>? n = _cwNotice;
    final bool phone = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width < 700;
    return Positioned(
      top: MediaQuery.of(context).padding.top + (phone ? 10 : 18),
      left: 0,
      right: 0,
      child: IgnorePointer(
        ignoring: n == null,
        child: AnimatedSwitcher(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
          transitionBuilder: (Widget c, Animation<double> a) => FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: SlideTransition(position: Tween<Offset>(begin: const Offset(0, -.4), end: Offset.zero).animate(a), child: c)),
          child: n == null
              ? const SizedBox.shrink(key: ValueKey<String>('none'))
              : Center(
                  key: ValueKey<String>(n['text'] as String),
                  child: Container(
                    constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: phone ? MediaQuery.of(context).size.width - 20 : 560),
                    margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10),
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 6, 10),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF3D1C3B), Color(0xFF5A2D57)]),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                      border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75)),
                      boxShadow: const <BoxShadow>[BoxShadow(color: Color(0x55000000), blurRadius: 24, offset: Offset(0, 10))],
                    ),
                    child: Material(
                      color: Colors.transparent,
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Container(
                          width: 34,
                          height: 34,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle, color: gold.withOpacity(.16), border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
                          child: Icon(n['icon'] as IconData, size: 18, color: gold),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                            const Text('JUNE', style: TextStyle(color: gold, fontSize: 9.5, letterSpacing: 1.6, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 2),
                            Text(n['text'] as String, maxLines: 4, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: const TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFFAF6F0), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.35, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
                          ]),
                        ),
                        if ((n['thread'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty || n['go'] != null)
                          TextButton(
                            onPressed: () {
                              final String id = (n['thread'] ?? '').toString();
                              final _View? go = n['go'] as _View?;
                              _cwNext();
                              if (id.isNotEmpty) {
                                setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
                                final Map<String, dynamic> m = (_cwInq[id]?['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? <String, dynamic>{};
                                _openCoupleThread(id, m);
                              } else if (go != null) {
                                setState(() => _view = go);
                              }
                            },
                            child: const Text('Open', style: TextStyle(color: gold, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 13)),
                          ),
                        Tooltip(
                          message: _cwVoice ? 'Mute June\'s updates' : 'Let June read updates aloud',
                          child: IconButton(
                            visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                            icon: Icon(_cwVoice ? Icons.volume_up_rounded : Icons.volume_off_rounded, size: 18, color: _cwVoice ? gold : const Color(0xFFB9A9BC)),
                            onPressed: () async {
                              setState(() => _cwVoice = !_cwVoice);
                              if (!_cwVoice) JuneNative.stopSpeaking();
                              try {
                                final SharedPreferences p = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
                                await p.setBool('juneAnnounce', _cwVoice);
                              } catch (_) {}
                            },
                          ),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                          visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                          tooltip: 'Dismiss',
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded, size: 18, color: Color(0xFFB9A9BC)),
                          onPressed: () {
                            JuneNative.stopSpeaking();
                            _cwNext();
                          },
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v156: WIDGETS (couples)
  // ===================================================================
  static const List<List<String>> _kCrAll = <List<String>>[
    <String>['weather', 'Weather', 'Your wedding-day sky, or today'],
    <String>['countdown', 'Countdown', 'Days to go and the next milestone'],
    <String>['budget', 'Budget', 'Planned and committed against your total'],
    <String>['rsvp', 'RSVPs', 'Yes, no and still waiting'],
    <String>['team', 'Vendor team', 'Booked so far and who to book next'],
    <String>['payments', 'Payments due', 'What you owe your vendors, and when'],
    <String>['replies', 'Waiting on you', 'Vendors who wrote last'],
    <String>['website', 'Your website', 'RSVPs online and your link'],
    <String>['dayof', 'Your day', 'The first moments of your timeline'],
    <String>['shopping', 'Shopping list', 'What is left to buy'],
    <String>['notes', 'Notes', 'A private notepad for the two of you'],
  ];
  static const List<String> _kCrDefault = <String>['countdown', 'weather', 'rsvp', 'budget', 'team', 'payments', 'replies'];
  List<String> _cr = List<String>.from(_kCrDefault);
  String _crSynced = '';
  final TextEditingController _crNoteC = TextEditingController();
  bool _crNoteLoaded = false;
  Timer? _crNoteT;

  Color get _crLink => _lzDark ? gold : plum;
  Color get _crRed => _lzDark ? const Color(0xFFEE9A90) : const Color(0xFFB4534B);

  bool _crKnown(String id) => _kCrAll.any((List<String> r) => r[0] == id);
  List<String> _crTitle(String id) => _kCrAll.firstWhere((List<String> r) => r[0] == id, orElse: () => <String>[id, id, '']);

  void _crSync(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> lay = d['layout'] is Map ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(d['layout'] as Map) : <String, dynamic>{};
    if (lay['rail'] is! List) return;
    final List<String> l = (lay['rail'] as List).map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).where(_crKnown).toList();
    final String sig = l.join(',');
    if (sig == _crSynced) return;
    _crSynced = sig;
    _cr = l;
  }

  Future<void> _crSave() async {
    _crSynced = _cr.join(',');
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'layout': <String, dynamic>{'rail': _cr}}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO rail: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _crStack(Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs, DateTime? wed, int? daysOut) {
    _crSync(couple);
    final List<String> ids = _cr.where(_crKnown).toList();
    Widget body(String id) => _crBody(id, couple, plan, inqs, wed, daysOut);

    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
      ReorderableListView(
        shrinkWrap: true,
        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        buildDefaultDragHandles: false,
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        proxyDecorator: (Widget child, int i, Animation<double> a) => Material(color: Colors.transparent, elevation: 10, shadowColor: const Color(0x55000000), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20), child: child),
        onReorder: (int from, int to) {
          setState(() {
            if (to > from) to -= 1;
            final String x = ids.removeAt(from);
            ids.insert(to, x);
            _cr = List<String>.from(ids);
          });
          HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
          _crSave();
        },
        children: <Widget>[
          for (int i = 0; i < ids.length; i++)
            KeyedSubtree(
              key: ValueKey<String>('crail-${ids[i]}'),
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
                Center(
                  child: ReorderableDragStartListener(
                    index: i,
                    child: MouseRegion(
                      cursor: SystemMouseCursors.grab,
                      child: Tooltip(
                        message: 'Drag to move',
                        child: Container(width: 54, height: 14, alignment: Alignment.center, child: Container(width: 30, height: 4, decoration: BoxDecoration(color: gold.withOpacity(.55), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3)))),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                ReorderableDelayedDragStartListener(index: i, child: body(ids[i])),
              ]),
            ),
        ],
      ),
      Center(
        child: TextButton.icon(
          onPressed: () => _crSheet(),
          icon: Icon(Icons.dashboard_customize_rounded, size: 16, color: _crLink),
          label: Text(ids.isEmpty ? 'Add widgets' : 'Customize widgets', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 12.5)),
        ),
      ),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _crBody(String id, Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs, DateTime? wed, int? daysOut) {
    switch (id) {
      case 'weather':
        return Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14), child: _fold('weather', 'Weather', _weatherFoldSummary(couple), _weatherHubWidget(couple)));
      case 'countdown':
        return _crCard('Countdown', Icons.hourglass_top_rounded, _crCountdown(wed, daysOut));
      case 'budget':
        return _crCard('Budget', Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded, _crBudget(couple, plan));
      case 'rsvp':
        return _crCard('RSVPs', Icons.how_to_reg_rounded, _crRsvp(couple));
      case 'team':
        return _crCard('Vendor team', Icons.groups_rounded, _crTeam(plan));
      case 'payments':
        return _crCard('Payments due', Icons.payments_rounded, _crPayments());
      case 'replies':
        return _crCard('Waiting on you', Icons.mark_chat_unread_rounded, _crReplies(inqs));
      case 'website':
        return _crCard('Your website', Icons.language_rounded, _crWebsite());
      case 'dayof':
        return _crCard('Your day', Icons.schedule_rounded, _crDayOf());
      case 'shopping':
        return _crCard('Shopping list', Icons.shopping_bag_rounded, _crShopping());
      case 'notes':
        return _crCard('Notes', Icons.sticky_note_2_rounded, _crNotes(couple), sub: 'Just for the two of you');
    }
    return const SizedBox.shrink();
  }

  // v157: pay from the widget - the thread's card checkout, else the thread
  Future<void> _crPay(String inquiryId, String invoiceId) async {
    if (inquiryId.isEmpty || invoiceId.isEmpty) return;
    setState(() => _payingInvoiceId = invoiceId);
    try {
      final httpc.Response res = await httpc.get(Uri.parse('$_kCheckoutFn?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=$invoiceId&tip=0'), headers: <String, String>{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 25));
      final dynamic r = jsonDecode(res.body.isEmpty ? '{}' : res.body);
      final String url = r is Map ? (r['url'] ?? '').toString() : '';
      if (url.isNotEmpty) {
        await _openSigning(url);
        return;
      }
    } catch (_) {
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _payingInvoiceId = '');
    }
    // no card checkout for this vendor: the thread shows how they take payment
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
    _openCoupleThread(inquiryId, (_cwInq[inquiryId]?['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
  }

  // v157: one line per widget for the phone strip
  String _crSummary(String id, Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs, int? daysOut) {
    switch (id) {
      case 'countdown':
        return daysOut == null ? 'Set your date' : daysOut < 0 ? 'Married' : daysOut == 0 ? 'Today!' : '$daysOut days to go';
      case 'weather':
        return _weatherFoldSummary(couple) ?? 'Weather';
      case 'team':
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> need = plan.values.where((Map<String, dynamic> p) => (p['status'] ?? 'needed') != 'skipped').toList();
        return need.isEmpty ? 'Vendor team' : '${need.where((Map<String, dynamic> p) => p['status'] == 'booked').length} of ${need.length} booked';
      case 'budget':
        final num total = couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
        num committed = 0;
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
          if (p['budgetActual'] is num) committed += p['budgetActual'] as num;
        }
        return total > 0 ? '${_money(total - committed)} left' : 'Budget';
      case 'replies':
        final int w = inqs.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) => (d.data()['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor' && (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'lost').length;
        return w == 0 ? 'Nobody waiting' : '$w waiting on you';
      case 'payments':
        num t = 0;
        for (final List<Map<String, dynamic>> l in _cwInv.values) {
          for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in l) {
            if ((i['status'] ?? '') != 'paid' && (i['status'] ?? '') != 'void' && i['total'] is num && i['dueDate'] is Timestamp) t += i['total'] as num;
          }
        }
        return t > 0 ? '${_money(t)} due' : 'Nothing due';
      case 'rsvp':
        int yes = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in _liveQ['guests:$_cid']?.latest?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]) {
          final String r = (d.data()['rsvp'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
          if (d.data()['rsvp'] == true || r.startsWith('yes') || r.startsWith('attend')) yes += d.data()['count'] is num ? (d.data()['count'] as num).toInt() : 1;
        }
        return '$yes coming';
      case 'website':
        final Map<String, dynamic> sd = _liveD['site:$_cwSlug']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        return _cwSlug.isEmpty ? 'Your website' : '${(sd['viewsTotal'] is num ? (sd['viewsTotal'] as num).round() : 0)} visits';
    }
    return _crTitle(id)[1];
  }

  BuildContext? _crSheetCtx;

  Widget _crSheetHold(BuildContext c, Widget child) {
    _crSheetCtx = c;
    return child;
  }

  @override
  void setState(VoidCallback fn) {
    final _View before = _view;
    super.setState(fn);
    final BuildContext? sc = _crSheetCtx;
    if (_view != before && sc != null) {
      _crSheetCtx = null;
      Future<void>.microtask(() {
        if (sc.mounted) Navigator.of(sc).maybePop();
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _crStrip(Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs, DateTime? wed, int? daysOut) {
    final List<String> ids = _cr.where(_crKnown).toList();
    void open(String? id) {
      if (id == null) {
        _lzSheet<void>(
          context: context,
          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
          builder: (BuildContext c) => _crSheetHold(c, ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(c).size.height * .88),
            child: _lzFrame(c,
                icon: Icons.dashboard_customize_rounded,
                title: 'Your widgets',
                subtitle: 'Press and hold a widget to move it.',
                bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 16),
                children: <Widget>[_crStack(couple, plan, inqs, wed, daysOut)]),
          )),
        ).whenComplete(() => _crSheetCtx = null);
        return;
      }
      // One widget opens on its own card, which already carries its title.
      _lzSheet<void>(
        context: context,
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
        builder: (BuildContext c) => _crSheetHold(c, SafeArea(
          top: false,
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(c).size.height * .88),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 10, 16, 16),
              child: _crBody(id, couple, plan, inqs, wed, daysOut),
            ),
          ),
        )),
      ).whenComplete(() => _crSheetCtx = null);
    }

    const Map<String, IconData> icons = <String, IconData>{
      'weather': Icons.wb_sunny_rounded, 'countdown': Icons.hourglass_top_rounded, 'budget': Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded, 'rsvp': Icons.how_to_reg_rounded,
      'team': Icons.groups_rounded, 'payments': Icons.payments_rounded, 'replies': Icons.mark_chat_unread_rounded, 'website': Icons.language_rounded,
      'dayof': Icons.schedule_rounded, 'shopping': Icons.shopping_bag_rounded, 'notes': Icons.sticky_note_2_rounded,
    };
    Widget chip(String label, IconData icon, VoidCallback onTap, {bool lead = false}) => Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
          child: _Press(
            scale: .96,
            onTap: onTap,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(color: lead ? gold : _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.12)), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99), border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(lead ? 1 : .6))),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Icon(icon, size: 15, color: lead ? plumDeep : gold),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: lead ? plumDeep : ivory, fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        );
    return SizedBox(
      height: 40,
      child: ListView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal, children: <Widget>[
        chip('Widgets', Icons.dashboard_customize_rounded, () => open(null), lead: true),
        for (final String id in ids) chip(_crSummary(id, couple, plan, inqs, daysOut), icons[id] ?? Icons.widgets_rounded, () => open(id)),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // ---- v157: JUNE'S FEED (the bell)
  Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _cFeedStream() => _liveQuery('feed:$_uid',
      () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('users').doc(_uid).collection('juneFeed').orderBy('at', descending: true).limit(40));

  Widget _cFeedBell() {
    if (_uid == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _cFeedStream(),
      initialData: _liveQ['feed:$_uid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c, AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final int unread = (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]).where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) => d.data()['read'] != true).length;
        return _Press(
          scale: .92,
          onTap: _cFeedSheet,
          child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: <Widget>[
            Container(
              width: 44,
              height: 44,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle, color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.10)), border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7), width: 1.2)),
              child: Icon(unread > 0 ? Icons.notifications_active_rounded : Icons.notifications_none_rounded, color: gold, size: 20),
            ),
            if (unread > 0)
              Positioned(
                right: -2,
                top: -2,
                child: Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 5, vertical: 1),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: gold, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99), border: Border.all(color: plumDeep, width: 1.5)),
                  child: Text(unread > 9 ? '9+' : '$unread', style: const TextStyle(color: plumDeep, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ),
              ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  IconData _cFeedIcon(String k) {
    switch (k) {
      case 'message':
        return Icons.chat_bubble_rounded;
      case 'booked':
        return Icons.celebration_rounded;
      case 'contract':
        return Icons.draw_rounded;
      case 'invoice':
      case 'due':
        return Icons.payments_rounded;
      case 'rsvp':
        return Icons.how_to_reg_rounded;
      case 'partner':
        return Icons.favorite_rounded;
      case 'morning':
        return Icons.wb_sunny_rounded;
    }
    return Icons.auto_awesome_rounded;
  }

  void _cFeedSheet() {
    if (_uid == null) return;
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs = _liveQ['feed:$_uid']?.latest?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
    final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    int n = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      if (d.data()['read'] == true) continue;
      b.update(d.reference, <String, dynamic>{'read': true, 'readAt': Timestamp.now()});
      n++;
    }
    if (n > 0) b.commit().catchError((Object _) {});
    String ago(dynamic t) {
      if (t is! Timestamp) return '';
      final Duration d = DateTime.now().difference(t.toDate());
      if (d.inMinutes < 1) return 'now';
      if (d.inMinutes < 60) return '${d.inMinutes}m';
      if (d.inHours < 24) return '${d.inHours}h';
      if (d.inDays < 7) return '${d.inDays}d';
      return _shortDate(t.toDate());
    }

    _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext c) => ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(c).size.height * .8),
        child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          stream: _cFeedStream(),
          initialData: _liveQ['feed:$_uid']?.latest,
          builder: (BuildContext c2, AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
            final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ds = s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
            Widget item(Map<String, dynamic> m) {
              final String thread = (m['thread'] ?? '').toString();
              final String openTo = (m['open'] ?? '').toString();
              final bool fresh = m['readAt'] == null && m['read'] != true;
              return ListTile(
                contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                leading: Container(
                  width: 36,
                  height: 36,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(shape: BoxShape.circle, color: gold.withOpacity(.16), border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
                  child: Icon(_cFeedIcon((m['kind'] ?? '').toString()), size: 18, color: gold),
                ),
                title: Text((m['text'] ?? '').toString(), maxLines: 3, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.35, fontWeight: fresh ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w500)),
                trailing: Text(ago(m['at']), style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
                onTap: () {
                  Navigator.of(c2).pop();
                  if (thread.isNotEmpty) {
                    setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
                    _openCoupleThread(thread, (_cwInq[thread]?['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
                  } else if (openTo == 'guests') {
                    setState(() => _view = _View.guests);
                  } else if (openTo == 'website') {
                    setState(() => _view = _View.website);
                  } else if (openTo == 'vendors') {
                    setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
                  } else if (openTo == 'june') {
                    setState(() => _view = _View.june);
                  }
                },
              );
            }

            return _lzFrame(c2,
                icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                title: 'From June',
                subtitle: n > 0 ? '$n new since you last looked' : 'Vendor replies, contracts, payments and RSVPs',
                bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 12, 16),
                children: <Widget>[
                  if (ds.isEmpty)
                    _pcB_empty(Icons.notifications_none_rounded, 'Nothing yet. When a vendor replies or a guest RSVPs, it lands here and on your phone.')
                  else
                    for (int i = 0; i < ds.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                      if (i > 0) Divider(height: 1, color: _lzLine(goldLine)),
                      item(ds[i].data()),
                    ],
                ]);
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
