  void _crSheet() {
    _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext c) => StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext c2, StateSetter setS) {
        final List<String> on = _cr.where(_crKnown).toList();
        final List<String> off = _kCrAll.map((List<String> r) => r[0]).where((String id) => !on.contains(id)).toList();
        Widget row(String id, bool enabled, {int? index}) {
          final List<String> r = _crTitle(id);
          return ListTile(
            key: ValueKey<String>('crsheet-$id'),
            contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
            leading: index == null ? Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)) : ReorderableDragStartListener(index: index, child: Icon(Icons.drag_indicator_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted))),
            title: Text(r[1], style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700, fontSize: 14)),
            subtitle: Text(r[2], style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
            trailing: Switch(
              value: enabled,
              activeColor: Colors.white,
              activeTrackColor: vGreen,
              onChanged: (bool v) {
                setS(() {});
                setState(() => _cr = v ? <String>[...on, id] : on.where((String x) => x != id).toList());
                _crSave();
              },
            ),
          );
        }

        return ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(c2).size.height * .82),
          child: _lzFrame(c2,
              icon: Icons.dashboard_customize_rounded,
              title: 'Choose widgets',
              subtitle: 'Switch them on or off. Drag the handle to reorder.',
              bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 16),
              children: <Widget>[
                if (on.isEmpty) _pcB_empty(Icons.widgets_outlined, 'No widgets on yet. Switch one on below.'),
                ReorderableListView(
                  shrinkWrap: true,
                  physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                  buildDefaultDragHandles: false,
                  onReorder: (int from, int to) {
                    if (to > from) to -= 1;
                    final String x = on.removeAt(from);
                    on.insert(to, x);
                    setS(() {});
                    setState(() => _cr = List<String>.from(on));
                    _crSave();
                  },
                  children: <Widget>[for (int i = 0; i < on.length; i++) row(on[i], true, index: i)],
                ),
                if (off.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  _lzSection('More widgets'),
                  for (final String id in off) row(id, false),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(primary: 'Done', icon: Icons.check_rounded, onPrimary: () => Navigator.of(c2).pop())),
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  Widget _crStat(String big, String label) => Expanded(
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 10),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(color: _lzBg(plum.withOpacity(.04)), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14), border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
          child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
            Text(big, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 21, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, height: 1)),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(label, maxLines: 2, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11, height: 1.25)),
          ]),
        ),
      );

  Widget _crBar(String label, String right, double v, {Color? color}) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
        child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(child: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))),
            Text(right, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 5),
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(value: v.isNaN ? 0 : v.clamp(0.0, 1.0), minHeight: 9, backgroundColor: _lzBg(plum.withOpacity(.07)), valueColor: AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(color ?? gold)),
          ),
        ]),
      );

  Widget _crRow({required String title, required String sub, String right = '', Color? rightColor, VoidCallback? onTap}) => InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        onTap: onTap,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6, horizontal: 2),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                Text(title, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                if (sub.isNotEmpty) Text(sub, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
              ]),
            ),
            if (right.isNotEmpty) Text(right, style: TextStyle(color: rightColor ?? _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            if (onTap != null) Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, size: 18, color: _lzFg(muted)),
          ]),
        ),
      );

  Widget _crEmpty(String t) => Text(t, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.4));

  // ---- Countdown
  Widget _crCountdown(DateTime? wed, int? daysOut) {
    if (wed == null || daysOut == null) return _crEmpty('Set your wedding date and the countdown starts here.');
    if (daysOut < 0) return _crEmpty('Married ${-daysOut} day${daysOut == -1 ? '' : 's'}. Congratulations!');
    final List<dynamic>? ms = _crMilestone(daysOut);
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
      Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: <Widget>[
        Text('$daysOut', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 40, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, height: .95)),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4), child: Text(daysOut == 1 ? 'day to go' : 'days to go', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13))),
      ]),
      const SizedBox(height: 4),
      Text('${_kMoLong[wed.month - 1]} ${wed.day}, ${wed.year} - about ${(daysOut / 7).floor()} weeks', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
      if (ms != null) ...<Widget>[
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.flag_rounded, size: 15, color: gold),
          const SizedBox(width: 6),
          Expanded(child: Text(ms[0] == 0 ? 'Today: ${ms[1]}' : 'In ${ms[0]} day${ms[0] == 1 ? '' : 's'}: ${ms[1]}', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))),
        ]),
      ],
    ]);
  }

  // ---- Budget
  Widget _crBudget(Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    final num total = couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    num planned = 0, committed = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if (p['budgetPlanned'] is num && (p['status'] ?? '') != 'skipped') planned += p['budgetPlanned'] as num;
      if (p['budgetActual'] is num) committed += p['budgetActual'] as num;
    }
    num paid = 0;
    for (final List<Map<String, dynamic>> l in _cwInv.values) {
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in l) {
        if ((i['status'] ?? '') == 'paid' && i['total'] is num && i['demo'] != true) paid += i['total'] as num;
      }
    }
    if (total <= 0 && planned <= 0) return _crEmpty('Set a total budget and give each vendor a number, and this shows where you stand.');
    final double base = (total > 0 ? total : planned).toDouble();
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
      if (total > 0) Text('${_money(total)} total', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
      const SizedBox(height: 10),
      _crBar('Planned', '${_money(planned)}', planned / base, color: planned > base ? _crRed : gold),
      _crBar('Committed to vendors', '${_money(committed)}', committed / base, color: committed > base ? _crRed : const Color(0xFF8DA399)),
      _crBar('Paid so far', '${_money(paid)}', paid / base, color: vGreen),
      if (total > 0) Text(committed <= total ? '${_money(total - committed)} left to commit' : '${_money(committed - total)} over your total', style: TextStyle(color: committed <= total ? _lzFg(muted) : _crRed, fontSize: 12)),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- RSVPs
  Widget _crRsvp(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery('guests:$_cid', () => _guestsRef),
      initialData: _liveQ['guests:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c, AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        int yes = 0, no = 0, wait = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
          final int n = g['count'] is num ? math.max(1, (g['count'] as num).toInt()) : 1;
          final String r = (g['rsvp'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
          if (g['rsvp'] == true || r.startsWith('yes') || r.startsWith('attend') || r.startsWith('accept')) {
            yes += n;
          } else if (g['rsvp'] == false || r.startsWith('no') || r.startsWith('declin') || r.startsWith('regret')) {
            no += n;
          } else {
            wait += n;
          }
        }
        final int all = yes + no + wait;
        final int est = couple['guestEstimate'] is num ? (couple['guestEstimate'] as num).toInt() : 0;
        if (all == 0) return _crEmpty('Add your guest list and RSVPs count up here as they come in.');
        return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            _crStat('$yes', 'Coming'),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            _crStat('$wait', 'Waiting'),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            _crStat('$no', 'Can\'t make it'),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          _crBar('Answered', '${yes + no} of $all', (yes + no) / all, color: vGreen),
          if (est > 0) Text('You planned for about $est guests.', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
          Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: TextButton(onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests), child: Text('Open guests', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)))),
        ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- Vendor team
  Widget _crTeam(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    final List<MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>>> need = plan.entries.where((MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> e) => (e.value['status'] ?? 'needed') != 'skipped').toList();
    if (need.isEmpty) return _crEmpty('Tell June which vendors you need and your team fills in here.');
    final int booked = need.where((MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> e) => e.value['status'] == 'booked').length;
    const List<String> order = <String>['wedding-venues', 'wedding-planners', 'wedding-photographers', 'wedding-caterers', 'wedding-videographers', 'wedding-djs', 'wedding-bands', 'wedding-florists', 'wedding-officiants', 'hair-and-makeup', 'wedding-cakes', 'wedding-invitations', 'wedding-rentals', 'wedding-transportation', 'day-of-coordination'];
    final List<String> open = need.where((MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> e) => e.value['status'] != 'booked').map((MapEntry<String, Map<String, dynamic>> e) => e.key).toList()
      ..sort((String a, String b) => (order.indexOf(a) + 100) % 100 - (order.indexOf(b) + 100) % 100);
    String label(String slug) => slug.replaceFirst('wedding-', '').replaceAll('-', ' ').replaceAll('djs', 'DJ').replaceAllMapped(RegExp(r'^\w'), (Match m) => m[0]!.toUpperCase());
    return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
      _crBar('Booked', '$booked of ${need.length}', booked / need.length, color: vGreen),
      if (open.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
        Text('NEXT TO BOOK', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 9.5, letterSpacing: 1.3, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
          for (final String sl in open.take(4))
            Container(padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5), decoration: BoxDecoration(color: _lzBg(plum.withOpacity(.05)), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99), border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))), child: Text(label(sl), style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))),
        ]),
      ] else
        _crEmpty('Every vendor you need is booked. Lovely.'),
      Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: TextButton(onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors), child: Text('Open team', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)))),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- Payments due
  Widget _crPayments() {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> due = <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      for (final List<Map<String, dynamic>> l in _cwInv.values)
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in l)
          if ((i['status'] ?? '') != 'paid' && (i['status'] ?? '') != 'void' && i['demo'] != true && i['dueDate'] is Timestamp) i
    ]..sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) => (a['dueDate'] as Timestamp).compareTo(b['dueDate'] as Timestamp));
    if (due.isEmpty) return _crEmpty('Nothing to pay right now. Invoices from your vendors show here with their due dates.');
    return Column(children: <Widget>[
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in due.take(5))
        Builder(builder: (BuildContext _) {
          final DateTime dd = (i['dueDate'] as Timestamp).toDate();
          final int days = DateTime(dd.year, dd.month, dd.day).difference(DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day)).inDays;
          final String inq = (i['_inq'] ?? '').toString();
          return Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: _crRow(
            title: (_cwInq[inq]?['vendor'] ?? 'Your vendor').toString(),
            sub: (i['title'] ?? 'Invoice').toString(),
            right: '${i['total'] is num ? '${_money(i['total'] as num)}' : ''}  ${days < 0 ? '${-days}d late' : days == 0 ? 'today' : 'in ${days}d'}',
            rightColor: days < 0 ? _crRed : (days <= 7 ? gold : _lzFg(plum)),
            onTap: () {
              setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
              _openCoupleThread(inq, (_cwInq[inq]?['data'] as Map<String, dynamic>?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
            },
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
            FilledButton(
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep, visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact, padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12)),
              onPressed: _payingInvoiceId == (i['_id'] ?? '').toString() ? null : () => _crPay(inq, (i['_id'] ?? '').toString()),
              child: Text(_payingInvoiceId == (i['_id'] ?? '').toString() ? '...' : 'Pay', style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12.5)),
            ),
          ]);
        }),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- Waiting on you
  Widget _crReplies(List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs) {
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> w = inqs.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') != 'vendor' || (m['status'] ?? '') == 'lost' || m['blockedByCouple'] == true) return false;
      return m['lastMessageAt'] is Timestamp;
    }).toList()
      ..sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a, QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) => (a.data()['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp).compareTo(b.data()['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp));
    if (w.isEmpty) return _crEmpty('Nobody is waiting on you. Lovely.');
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    return Column(children: <Widget>[
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in w.take(5))
        Builder(builder: (BuildContext _) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          final Duration age = now.difference((m['lastMessageAt'] as Timestamp).toDate());
          final String ago = age.inHours < 1 ? 'now' : age.inHours < 24 ? '${age.inHours}h' : '${age.inDays}d';
          return _crRow(
            title: _cwVendor(m),
            sub: (m['lastMessagePreview'] ?? 'Tap to reply').toString(),
            right: ago,
            rightColor: age.inDays >= 2 ? _crRed : gold,
            onTap: () {
              setState(() => _view = _View.messages);
              _openCoupleThread(d.id, m);
            },
          );
        }),
    ]);
  }

  // ---- Your website
  Widget _crWebsite() {
    if (_cwSlug.isEmpty) {
      return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
        _crEmpty('A free website with RSVPs, your story, travel and your registry. June can write it with you.'),
        Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: TextButton(onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.website), child: Text('Build my website', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)))),
      ]);
    }
    final String url = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/$_cwSlug/';
    final int n = _liveQ['rsvp:$_cwSlug']?.latest?.docs.length ?? 0;
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc('site:$_cwSlug', () => FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('weddingSites').doc(_cwSlug)),
      initialData: _liveD['site:$_cwSlug']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c, AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sd) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> site = sd.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final int total = site['viewsTotal'] is num ? (site['viewsTotal'] as num).round() : 0;
        int week = 0;
        if (site['viewsByDay'] is Map) {
          final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
          for (int k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
            final dynamic v = (site['viewsByDay'] as Map)[_ymd(now.subtract(Duration(days: k)))];
            if (v is num) week += v.round();
          }
        }
        return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
      Row(children: <Widget>[
        _crStat('$week', 'Visits this week'),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        _crStat('$total', 'Visits in all'),
        const SizedBox(width: 8),
        _crStat('$n', 'RSVPs online'),
      ]),
      const SizedBox(height: 8),
      Text(url.replaceFirst('https://', ''), style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 12)),
      Row(children: <Widget>[
        TextButton.icon(
          onPressed: () async {
            await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: url));
            _toastC('Link copied.');
          },
          icon: const Icon(Icons.link_rounded, size: 15, color: gold),
          label: Text('Copy link', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)),
        ),
        TextButton.icon(
          onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
          icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded, size: 15, color: gold),
          label: Text('Edit', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)),
        ),
      ]),
    ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- Your day
  Widget _crDayOf() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery('dayof:$_cid', () => _dayofRef.orderBy('time')),
      initialData: _liveQ['dayof:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c, AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> ms = (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]).map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) => d.data()).where((Map<String, dynamic> m) => (m['label'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty).toList();
        if (ms.isEmpty) return _crEmpty('Your day-of timeline shows here once you build it. June can draft one around your ceremony time.');
        return Column(children: <Widget>[
          for (final Map<String, dynamic> m in ms.take(5))
            _crRow(title: (m['label'] ?? '').toString(), sub: (m['note'] ?? '').toString(), right: (m['time'] ?? '').toString()),
          Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: TextButton(onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof), child: Text(ms.length > 5 ? 'All ${ms.length} moments' : 'Open day-of', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)))),
        ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- Shopping list
  Widget _crShopping() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery('shop:$_cid', () => _shopRef.orderBy('order')),
      initialData: _liveQ['shop:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c, AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> all = (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]).map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) => d.data()).toList();
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> left = all.where((Map<String, dynamic> m) => m['bought'] != true).toList();
        if (all.isEmpty) return _crEmpty('Favors, guest book, cake knife... add what you need to buy and track it here.');
        num est = 0;
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> m in left) {
          if (m['est'] is num) est += m['est'] as num;
        }
        return Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
          _crBar('Bought', '${all.length - left.length} of ${all.length}', (all.length - left.length) / all.length, color: vGreen),
          for (final Map<String, dynamic> m in left.take(4)) _crRow(title: (m['name'] ?? '').toString(), sub: '', right: m['est'] is num && (m['est'] as num) > 0 ? '${_money(m['est'] as num)}' : ''),
          if (est > 0) Text('About ${_money(est)} still to spend', style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 12)),
          Align(alignment: Alignment.centerRight, child: TextButton(onPressed: () => setState(() => _view = _View.shopping), child: Text('Open list', style: TextStyle(color: _crLink, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800, fontSize: 12)))),
        ]);
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- Notes (the couple doc is private to the two of them)
  Widget _crNotes(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    if (!_crNoteLoaded && couple.isNotEmpty) {
      _crNoteLoaded = true;
      _crNoteC.text = (couple['deskNotes'] ?? '').toString();
    }
    return TextField(
      controller: _crNoteC,
      minLines: 4,
      maxLines: 10,
      style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4),
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        hintText: 'Song ideas, questions for the venue, who owes us a call...',
        hintStyle: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), borderSide: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12), borderSide: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
        isDense: true,
      ),
      onChanged: (String v) {
        _crNoteT?.cancel();
        _crNoteT = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 900), () async {
          try {
            await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{'deskNotes': v}, SetOptions(merge: true));
          } catch (_) {}
        });
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _endTour({required bool completed}) async {
    _tourChecked = true;
    JuneNative.holdLine = false;
    if (completed && _tourVoice) {
      JuneNative.say('That\'s the tour. I\'m right here whenever you need me. Ask me anything about the wedding, any time.');
    } else {
      JuneNative.stopSpeaking();
    }
    setState(() {
      _tourIdx = -1;
      _tourSteps = <_TourStep>[];
      _tourRect = null;
    });
    try {
      await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'tourDoneAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'tourCompleted': completed,
        'tourDoneBy': FieldValue.arrayUnion(<dynamic>[_uid]),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // v118.1: sheets sit on ivory but the app theme is built for the dark
  // canvas, so a bare OutlineInputBorder() picked up near-invisible theme
  // colors - fields looked like empty space. Explicit light-surface styling.
  InputDecoration _lightDeco(String label, {String? hint, String? prefix}) {
    return InputDecoration(
      labelText: label.isEmpty ? null : label,
      labelStyle:  TextStyle(
          color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
      floatingLabelStyle:  TextStyle(
          color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
      hintText: hint,
      hintStyle: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink.withOpacity(.35)), fontSize: 15),
      prefixText: prefix,
      prefixStyle:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
      filled: true,
      fillColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 14),
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: gold, width: 1.2)),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: gold, width: 1.2)),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.6)),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v120: THE DESK - six tiles, one line each, tap to open the screen
  // ===================================================================
  Widget _deskTiles(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut,
      bool twoUp) {
    int booked = 0, active = 0;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'skipped') continue;
      active++;
      if (st == 'booked') booked++;
    }
    int unread = 0, contracts = 0;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
      final dynamic read = m['coupleLastReadAt'];
      if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor' &&
          last is Timestamp &&
          (read is! Timestamp || last.compareTo(read) > 0)) unread++;
      if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent') contracts++;
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double committed = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')
        committed += _spentOf(p).toDouble(); // v140
    }
    final int saved =
        ((couple['savedVendors'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]).length;

    final List<Widget> tiles = <Widget>[
      KeyedSubtree(
        key: _kTourTeam,
        child: _deskTile(
          Icons.checklist_rounded,
          'Vendor team',
          booked == 0 ? '0 of $active booked' : '$booked of $active booked',
          booked == 0
              ? 'Nobody yet - that\u2019s normal'
              : (booked == active
                  ? 'All booked'
                  : 'Next: ${_nextUpLabel(plan, wedding)}'),
          () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors),
          hot: false,
        ),
      ),
      KeyedSubtree(
        key: _kTourMessages,
        child: _deskTile(
          Icons.chat_bubble_rounded,
          'Messages',
          inqs.isEmpty
              ? 'No threads yet'
              : '${inqs.length} thread${inqs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
          contracts > 0
              ? '$contracts contract${contracts == 1 ? '' : 's'} to sign'
              : unread > 0
                  ? '$unread new repl${unread == 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'}'
                  : 'Inbox is clear',
          () => setState(() => _view = _View.messages),
          hot: unread > 0 || contracts > 0,
        ),
      ),
      StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _liveQuery('dayof:$_cid', () => _dayofRef.orderBy('time')),
        initialData: _liveQ['dayof:$_cid']?.latest,
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
          final int n = sn.data?.docs.length ?? 0;
          return KeyedSubtree(
            key: _kTourDayOf,
            child: _deskTile(
              Icons.event_rounded,
              'Day-of',
              n == 0 ? 'No timeline yet' : '$n moment${n == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
              daysOut == null
                  ? 'Set your date first'
                  : (n == 0
                      ? 'Build it, share it'
                      : 'Timeline, guests, seating, music'),
              () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof),
              hot: false,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: _liveQuery(
            'site:$_cid',
            () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('weddingSites')
                .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
                .limit(1)),
        initialData: _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest,
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
          final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? doc =
              (sn.data?.docs.isNotEmpty ?? false) ? sn.data!.docs.first : null;
          return _deskTile(
            Icons.language_rounded,
            'Website',
            doc == null ? 'Not built yet' : 'meetlazo.com/w/${doc.id}',
            doc == null ? 'Free, ten minutes' : 'Story, RSVPs, registry',
            () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
            hot: false,
          );
        },
      ),
      _deskTile(
        Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
        'Budget',
        budgetTotal <= 0 ? 'Not set' : _railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble()),
        budgetTotal <= 0
            ? 'Even a rough number helps'
            : (committed <= 0
                ? 'Nothing committed yet'
                : '${_railMoney(committed)} committed'),
        () => _budgetSheet(couple, plan),
        hot: false,
      ),
      _deskTile(
        Icons.favorite_rounded,
        'Saved vendors',
        saved == 0 ? 'None saved' : '$saved saved',
        saved == 0 ? 'Tap the heart on any vendor' : 'Check their dates',
        () => saved == 0
            ? setState(() => _view = _View.browse)
            : _lzSheet<void>(
                context: context,
                backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
                isScrollControlled: true,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
                shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius:
                        BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
                builder: (BuildContext ctx) => SafeArea(
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 22),
                    child: _savedCard(couple),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
        hot: false,
      ),
    ];
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
      final int cols = cons.maxWidth >= 900 ? 3 : 2;
      final double w = (cons.maxWidth - (cols - 1) * 12) / cols;
      return Wrap(
        spacing: 12,
        runSpacing: 12,
        children: <Widget>[
          for (final Widget t in tiles) SizedBox(width: w, child: t)
        ],
      );
    });
  }

  String _nextUpLabel(
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, DateTime? wedding) {
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
          (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
        nextSlug = slug;
        nextBy = by;
      }
    }
    return nextSlug.isEmpty ? 'done' : _catLabel(nextSlug);
  }

  // v121: what the vendor told us about who they work with, shown before the
  // couple inquires - the honest version of "contact for pricing".
  Widget _worksWithLine(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> p =
        Map<String, dynamic>.from((v['prefs'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
    final List<String> bits = <String>[];
    if (p['minBudget'] is num && (p['minBudget'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('books from ${_railMoney((p['minBudget'] as num).toDouble())}');
    final num gMin = p['guestMin'] is num ? p['guestMin'] as num : 0;
    final num gMax = p['guestMax'] is num ? p['guestMax'] as num : 0;
    if (gMin > 0 || gMax > 0)
      bits.add(
          '${gMin > 0 ? gMin.round() : 'any'}\u2013${gMax > 0 ? gMax.round() : 'any'} guests');
    if (p['travelMiles'] is num && (p['travelMiles'] as num) > 0)
      bits.add('travels ${(p['travelMiles'] as num).round()} mi');
    final String note = (p['note'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (bits.isEmpty && note.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 10, 12, 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: gold.withOpacity(.14),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
               Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                  size: 15, color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F))),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      if (bits.isNotEmpty)
                        Text(
                            '${bits.first[0].toUpperCase()}${bits.first.substring(1)}${bits.length > 1 ? ' \u00b7 ' + bits.sublist(1).join(' \u00b7 ') : ''}',
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(ink),
                                fontSize: 12.5,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      if (note.isNotEmpty)
                        Text('\u201c$note\u201d',
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(muted),
                                fontSize: 12,
                                height: 1.35,
                                fontStyle: FontStyle.italic)),
                    ]),
              ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // v123: YOUR VENDOR'S TEAM (recommendations from booked pros)
  // ===================================================================
  Map<String, dynamic>? _pendingReferral;
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _recsCache =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};
  String _recsFor = '';

  // couples/{cid}/recs keyed by vendorId; cached per couple, refreshed by stream
  Map<String, dynamic>? _recFor(String categorySlug) {
    if (_recsFor != _cid) {
      _recsFor = _cid;
      _liveQuery('recs:$_cid', () => _coupleRef.collection('recs'))
          .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> s) {
        _recsCache = <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in s.docs)
            d.id: d.data()
        };
        if (mounted) setState(() {});
      });
    }
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> r in _recsCache.values) {
      if ((r['category'] ?? '') == categorySlug) return r;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _checkDateWithRec(Map<String, dynamic> rec) async {
    final String vid = (rec['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (vid.isEmpty) return;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> vs =
          await FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('vendors').doc(vid).get();
      if (!vs.exists) {
        _toastC('That vendor isn\u2019t on Lazo yet.');
        return;
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> v = <String, dynamic>{
        ...vs.data()!,
        'placeId': vs.id
      };
      _pendingReferral = <String, dynamic>{
        'vendorId': vid,
        'fromVendorId': rec['fromVendorId'],
        'fromVendorName': rec['fromVendorName']
      };
      _browseCat = (v['category'] ?? _browseCat).toString();
      await _sendInquiry(v);
    } catch (e) {
      _toastC('Could not open that vendor.');
    }
  }

  // ---- JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-LIC-001: the marriage license ----
  Map<String, dynamic>? _licData;
  bool _licLoading = false;
  String _licErr = '';

  Future<void> _loadLicenseData() async {
    if (_licData != null || _licLoading) return;
    _licLoading = true;
    try {
      final httpc.Response r = await httpc
          .get(Uri.parse('https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/data.json'))
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 10));
      if (r.statusCode == 200) {
        final dynamic j = jsonDecode(r.body);
        if (j is Map) _licData = Map<String, dynamic>.from(j);
      } else {
        _licErr = 'Could not load license details.';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _licErr = 'Could not load license details.';
      debugPrint('LAZO license data: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      _licLoading = false;
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }
  }

  String _licDate(DateTime d) {
    const List<String> m = <String>[
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${m[d.month - 1]} ${d.day}';
  }

  Widget _licenseCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final bool done = couple['licenseDone'] == true;
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (_licData == null && !_licLoading && _licErr.isEmpty) {
      _loadLicenseData();
    }
    Map<String, dynamic>? st;
    List<dynamic> offices = const <dynamic>[];
    String stateSlug = '';
    if (_licData != null && metro.isNotEmpty) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ms = _licData!['metros'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(_licData!['metros'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      final Map<String, dynamic> me = ms[metro] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(ms[metro] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      stateSlug = (me['state'] ?? '').toString();
      offices =
          me['offices'] is List ? me['offices'] as List : const <dynamic>[];
      final Map<String, dynamic> sts = _licData!['states'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(_licData!['states'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      if (sts[stateSlug] is Map)
        st = Map<String, dynamic>.from(sts[stateSlug] as Map);
    }
    DateTime? wd;
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    if (ts is Timestamp) wd = ts.toDate();
    String window = '';
    if (st != null && wd != null) {
      final int v =
          st['valid_days'] is num ? (st['valid_days'] as num).toInt() : 0;
      final int w =
          st['wait_days'] is num ? (st['wait_days'] as num).toInt() : 0;
      final DateTime latest = wd.subtract(Duration(days: w));
      if (v > 0) {
        final DateTime earliest = wd.subtract(Duration(days: v));
        window = earliest.isBefore(DateTime.now())
            ? 'Apply any time before ${_licDate(latest)}, ${latest.year}'
            : 'Apply between ${_licDate(earliest)}${earliest.year != latest.year ? ', ${earliest.year}' : ''} and ${_licDate(latest)}, ${latest.year}';
      } else {
        window = 'Apply by ${_licDate(latest)} - it does not expire';
      }
      final int daysToLatest = latest.difference(DateTime.now()).inDays;
      if (!done && daysToLatest < 0) {
        window +=
            ' · that was ${-daysToLatest} day${daysToLatest == -1 ? '' : 's'} ago';
      } else if (!done && daysToLatest <= 14) {
        window +=
            ' · ${daysToLatest == 0 ? 'today' : 'in $daysToLatest day${daysToLatest == 1 ? '' : 's'}'}';
      }
    }
    final String fee = st == null ? '' : (st['fee_text'] ?? '').toString();
    final String issuer = st == null ? '' : (st['issuer'] ?? '').toString();
    final String stateName = st == null ? '' : (st['name'] ?? '').toString();
    final String siteUrl = stateSlug.isEmpty
        ? 'https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/'
        : 'https://meetlazo.com/marriage-license/$stateSlug/';

    Future<void> toggle() async {
      try {
        await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
          'licenseDone': !done,
          'licenseDoneAt':
              done ? FieldValue.delete() : FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } catch (e) {
        _toast('Could not save that: ' + e.toString());
      }
    }

    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
      radius: 22,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Row(children: <Widget>[
             Expanded(
              child: Text('Marriage license',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
            _Press(
              tick: _Tick.select,
              onTap: toggle,
              child: Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 6),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(done ? vGreen : Colors.white),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(done ? vGreen : goldLine)),
                ),
                child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(
                      done
                          ? Icons.check_rounded
                          : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
                      size: 14,
                      color: _lzFg(done ? Colors.white : muted)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 5),
                  Text(done ? 'We have it' : 'Not yet',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(done ? Colors.white : plum),
                          fontSize: 12,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),

  Widget _weatherCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (ts is! Timestamp || metro.isEmpty || !kMetroLatLng.containsKey(metro)) {
      return _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        radius: 22,
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          const Icon(Icons.wb_sunny_rounded, color: gold, size: 22),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text('Wedding day weather', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                  Text(
                      ts is! Timestamp
                          ? 'Set your date and June will show what that day is usually like.'
                          : 'Tell June the city to see what that day is usually like there.',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12, color: muted, height: 1.35)),
                ]),
          ),
        ]),
      );
    }
    final DateTime weddingDay = ts.toDate();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> extra = _keyDates(couple);
    // Which day is on the card: the wedding, or one of their key dates.
    DateTime wedding = weddingDay;
    String title = 'Wedding day';
    Map<String, dynamic>? selKd;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> kd in extra) {
      final DateTime d = (kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate();
      if (_ymd(d) == _wxSel) {
        wedding = d;
        title = kd['label'].toString();
        selKd = kd;
      }
    }
    WidgetsBinding.instance
        .addPostFrameCallback((_) => _loadWeather(wedding, metro));
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = _wxCache['${_ymd(wedding)}|$metro'];
    final String city = _metroLabel(metro);
    final Widget chips = SizedBox(
      height: 32,
      child: ListView(scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal, children: <Widget>[
        _wxChip('Wedding day', _shortDate(weddingDay), selKd == null,
            () => setState(() => _wxSel = '')),
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> kd in extra)
          _wxChip(
              kd['label'].toString(),
              _shortDate((kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate()),
              selKd == kd,
              () => setState(
                  () => _wxSel = _ymd((kd['date'] as Timestamp).toDate()))),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
          child: ActionChip(
            avatar: const Icon(Icons.add_rounded, size: 15, color: plum),
            label: const Text('Add a date',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11.5, color: plum, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            backgroundColor: ivory,
            side: const BorderSide(color: goldLine),
            onPressed: _h(() => _addKeyDate(couple)),
          ),
        ),
      ]),
    );
    Widget body;
    if (w == null) {
      body = Row(children: <Widget>[
        const SizedBox(
            width: 18,
            height: 18,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: gold)),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Text(_wxErr.isEmpty ? 'Reading the sky over $city\u2026' : _wxErr,
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: muted)),
      ]);
    } else {
      final bool fc = w['mode'] == 'forecast';
      final int code = w['code'] as int;
      final String sunset = _sunsetClock((w['sunset'] ?? '').toString());
      final String rainLine = fc
          ? '${w['rainPct']}% chance of rain'
          : (w['rainYears'] == 0
              ? 'Dry on this date every one of the last ${w['years']} years'
              : 'Rained ${w['rainYears']} of the last ${w['years']} years on this date');
      body = Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Icon(_wmoIcon(code), color: gold, size: 44),
                  const SizedBox(width: 14),
                  // Expanded, because without it this column is handed
                  // unbounded width and asks for whatever the city line needs.
                  // 'Typically drizzle - Dallas-Fort Worth' is about 230px, and
                  // icon + gap + that + the pill is wider than the card. A
                  // short city name hid it; a hyphenated metro does not.
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          // Scales down rather than overflowing if the temps
                          // and a long pill ever fight over the same row.
                          FittedBox(
                            fit: BoxFit.scaleDown,
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            child: Row(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                                textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Text('${w['hi']}\u00b0',
                                      style: _serif(size: 38, height: 1)),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                  Text('/ ${w['lo']}\u00b0',
                                      style: _serif(
                                          size: 20, color: muted, height: 1)),
                                ]),
                          ),
                          Text(
                              '${fc ? '' : 'Typically '}${_wmoLabel(code).toLowerCase()} \u00b7 $city',
                              maxLines: 2,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: ink,
                                  fontSize: 13,
                                  height: 1.25,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  Container(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: fc
                            ? vGreen.withOpacity(.12)
                            : gold.withOpacity(.18),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        border: Border.all(
                            color: fc
                                ? vGreen.withOpacity(.5)
                                : gold.withOpacity(.6))),
                    child: Text(
                        fc
                            ? 'Forecast \u00b7 ${w['daysOut'] == 0 ? 'today' : '${w['daysOut']} day${w['daysOut'] == 1 ? '' : 's'} out'}'
                            : 'Last ${w['years']} years',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            color: fc ? vGreen : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            Wrap(spacing: 14, runSpacing: 4, children: <Widget>[
              _wxBit(Icons.water_drop_outlined, rainLine),
              if (fc) _wxBit(Icons.air_rounded, 'Wind to ${w['wind']} mph'),
              if (sunset.isNotEmpty)
                _wxBit(Icons.wb_twilight_rounded, 'Sunset $sunset'),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, color: gold, size: 14),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(
                      child: Text(_weatherTip(w, wedding: selKd == null),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: muted,
                              height: 1.35,
                              fontStyle: FontStyle.italic))),
                ]),
            if (!fc)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                child: Text(
                    'A real forecast appears here 16 days before ${_shortDate(wedding)}.',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: muted)),
              ),
          ]);
    }
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      radius: 22,
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              Text('Weather', maxLines: 1, softWrap: false, style: _serif(size: 22)),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                  child: Text('$title \u00b7 ${_longDate(wedding)}',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.right,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: muted))),
              if (selKd != null)
                IconButton(
                    tooltip: 'Remove this date',
                    // 44x44 is the floor on both platforms; compact density was 40.
                    constraints:
                        const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44),
                    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    onPressed: _h(() => _removeKeyDate(couple, selKd!)),
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                        color: muted, size: 16)),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            chips,
            const SizedBox(height: 10),
            body,
          ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _wxBit(IconData ic, String t) =>
      Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
