  // ---------------- v106: SEND TO YOUR VENDORS ----------------
  // One sheet, many artifacts. Every "send" is a message in the booked
  // vendor's inquiry thread plus a printable HTML file in
  // inquiries/{id}/attachments (text-only fallback if Storage says no), and
  // a couples/{cid}/sends/{kind} doc so the source card can say who has it
  // and since when. The artifacts are small render functions below.

  static const String pageMusic = 'Music';

  void _openMusic() {
    try {
      context.pushNamed(pageMusic);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO music nav: ' + e.toString());
      _toast('Could not open Music - try again.');
    }
  }

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _sendsRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('sends');

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _detailsRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('details');

  static String _catTag(String cat) {
    final String c = cat.toLowerCase();
    if (c.contains('plann') || c.contains('coordinat')) return 'planner';
    if (c.contains('dj') || c.contains('band') || c.contains('music')) {
      return 'dj';
    }
    if (c.contains('cater')) return 'caterer';
    if (c.contains('venue')) return 'venue';
    if (c.contains('photo')) return 'photo';
    if (c.contains('video') || c.contains('film')) return 'video';
    if (c.contains('officiant')) return 'officiant';
    if (c.contains('flor')) return 'florist';
    if (c.contains('cake') || c.contains('bak')) return 'cake';
    return '';
  }

  static String _esc(String s) => s
      .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
      .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
      .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
      .replaceAll('"', '&quot;');

  // Booked vendors, planner first, then by name. Booked = the thread says
  // booked or the contract is signed.
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> _bookedForSend() async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    try {
      QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? qs = _inqLatest();
      qs ??= await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in qs.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        final bool booked = (m['status'] ?? '').toString() == 'booked' ||
            (m['contractStatus'] ?? '').toString() == 'signed';
        if (!booked) continue;
        final Map<String, dynamic> intent = m['structuredIntent'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(m['structuredIntent'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{};
        final String cat =
            (m['vendorCategory'] ?? m['category'] ?? intent['category'] ?? '')
                .toString();
        out.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'id': d.id,
          'name': (m['vendorName'] ?? 'Your vendor').toString(),
          'vendorId': (m['vendorId'] ?? '').toString(),
          'cat': cat,
          'label': _catLabel(cat),
          'tag': _catTag(cat),
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO booked for send: ' + e.toString());
    }
    out.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
      final int pa = a['tag'] == 'planner' ? 0 : 1;
      final int pb = b['tag'] == 'planner' ? 0 : 1;
      if (pa != pb) return pa.compareTo(pb);
      return a['name'].toString().compareTo(b['name'].toString());
    });
    return out;
  }

  String _printShell(String title, String subtitle, String bodyHtml) {
    return '<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">'
        '<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">'
        '<title>${_esc(title)}</title><style>'
        'body{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#241E2B;margin:0;padding:32px;background:#fff}'
        'h1{font-weight:600;font-size:30px;margin:0 0 4px;color:#52284F}'
        '.sub{color:#6B5F72;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:22px}'
        'h2{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#52284F;margin:26px 0 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #E6D6B8;padding-bottom:4px}'
        'table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px}'
        'td,th{text-align:left;padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #F0E8D8;vertical-align:top}'
        'th{font-size:11px;color:#6B5F72;font-weight:600}'
        'p,li{font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5}'
        '.time{display:inline-block;min-width:68px;font-weight:700;color:#8A6A2F}'
        '.foot{margin-top:34px;color:#6B5F72;font-size:11px;font-family:Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}'
        '.btn{position:fixed;top:14px;right:14px;background:#52284F;color:#fff;border:0;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}'
        '@media print{.btn{display:none}body{padding:0}}'
        '</style></head><body>'
        '<button class="btn" onclick="window.print()">Print / Save as PDF</button>'
        '<h1>${_esc(title)}</h1><div class="sub">${_esc(subtitle)}</div>'
        '$bodyHtml'
        '<div class="foot">Planned on Lazo &middot; meetlazo.com</div>'
        '</body></html>';
  }

  String _coupleLabel(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String n = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (n.isNotEmpty) return n;
    return (couple['partnerName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
  }

  String _weddingDateLine(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    if (ts is Timestamp) return _longDate(ts.toDate());
    return '';
  }

  // The sheet. kind is the sends/{kind} key; tags pre-check vendors whose
  // category matches (empty list = everyone checked).
  Future<void> _sendToVendors({
    required String kind,
    required String title,
    required String fileName,
    required String page,
    required String text,
    required List<String> tags,
    String note = '',
    String preview = '',
    // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: a page and text built for one vendor
    // (their role's moments first). Null keeps one page for everyone.
    String Function(Map<String, dynamic> vendor)? pageFor,
    String Function(Map<String, dynamic> vendor)? textFor,
  }) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> booked = await _bookedForSend();
    if (!mounted) return;
    final Set<String> picked = <String>{};
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {
      if (tags.isEmpty || tags.contains(v['tag'])) {
        picked.add(v['id'].toString());
      }
    }
    if (picked.isEmpty && booked.isNotEmpty) {
      picked.add(booked.first['id'].toString());
    }
    final TextEditingController noteC = TextEditingController(text: note);
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    Future<void> emailIt() async {
      final Uri u = Uri.parse(
          'mailto:?subject=${Uri.encodeComponent(title)}&body=${Uri.encodeComponent(text)}');
      try {
        await launchUrl(u);
      } catch (_) {
        await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
        _toast('Copied - paste it into an email.');
      }
    }

    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx, StateSetter setS) {
          Future<void> send() async {
            setS(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            final List<Map<String, dynamic>> sent = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
            for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {
              if (!picked.contains(v['id'])) continue;
              final bool ok = await _sendArtifact(
                  v['id'].toString(),
                  fileName,
                  pageFor == null ? page : pageFor(v),
                  noteC.text.trim(),
                  textFor == null ? text : textFor(v),
                  title);
              if (ok) {
                sent.add(<String, dynamic>{
                  'inquiryId': v['id'],
                  'vendorName': v['name'],
                });
              }
            }
            if (sent.isEmpty) {
              if (ctx.mounted) {
                setS(() {
                  busy = false;
                  err = 'That didn\u2019t send. Check your connection and try again.';
                });
              }
              return;
            }
            try {
              await _sendsRef.doc(kind).set(<String, dynamic>{
                'kind': kind,
                'title': title,
                'to': sent,
                'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              }, SetOptions(merge: true));
            } catch (_) {}
            if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.of(ctx).pop();
            _toast(
                'Sent to ${sent.map((Map<String, dynamic> e) => e['vendorName']).join(', ')} \u2713 They can reply in your thread.');
          }

          Widget vendorRow(Map<String, dynamic> v) {
            final String id = v['id'].toString();
            final bool on = picked.contains(id);
            final String nm = v['name'].toString();
            final String initials = nm
                .split(' ')
                .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty)
                .take(2)
                .map((String w) => w[0].toUpperCase())
                .join();
            return _Press(
              tick: _Tick.select,
              onTap: () {
                if (busy) return;
                setS(() {
                  if (on) {
                    picked.remove(id);
                  } else {
                    picked.add(id);
                  }
                });
              },
              child: AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 160),
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 9, 12, 9),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(on ? Colors.white : Colors.white.withOpacity(.55)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(on ? plum : goldLine), width: on ? 1.6 : 1),
                ),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                    width: 36,
                    height: 36,
                    alignment: Alignment.center,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(color: _lzBg(on ? plum : gold.withOpacity(.25)), shape: BoxShape.circle),
                    child: Text(initials.isEmpty ? '?' : initials,
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(on ? gold : plum), fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 11),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
                      Text(nm, style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      Text(v['label'].toString(), style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                    ]),
                  ),
                  Icon(on ? Icons.check_circle_rounded : Icons.radio_button_unchecked_rounded,
                      color: _lzFg(on ? vGreen : muted.withOpacity(.6)), size: 22),
                ]),
              ),
            );
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx,
              icon: Icons.send_rounded,
              title: 'Send $title',
              subtitle: preview.isNotEmpty
                  ? preview
                  : (booked.isEmpty
                      ? 'Email it, copy it or print it.'
                      : 'It lands in each vendor\u2019s thread on Lazo.'),
              children: <Widget>[
                if (booked.isEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  _lzNote(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                      'No vendors booked on Lazo yet. Once one is, this goes straight to their thread.'),
                ] else ...<Widget>[
                  _lzSection('Who gets it', trailing: '${picked.length} of ${booked.length}'),
                  for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) vendorRow(v),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  TextField(
                    controller: noteC,
                    enabled: !busy,
                    minLines: 2,
                    maxLines: 4,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('A note to go with it (optional)'),
                  ),
                ],
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
                ],
                _lzSection(booked.isEmpty ? 'Other ways to share it' : 'Or share it yourself'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  if (booked.isNotEmpty) _pcB_chip(Icons.mail_outline_rounded, 'Email it', emailIt),
                  _pcB_chip(Icons.copy_rounded, 'Copy text', () async {
                    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text));
                    _toast('Copied \u2713');
                  }),
                  _pcB_chip(Icons.print_rounded, 'Print', () => _openHtml(page, text)),
                ]),
              ],
              footer: booked.isEmpty
                  ? _lzActions(
                      secondary: 'Close',
                      onSecondary: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                      primary: 'Email it',
                      icon: Icons.mail_outline_rounded,
                      onPrimary: emailIt)
                  : _lzActions(
                      secondary: 'Cancel',
                      onSecondary: () => Navigator.of(ctx).pop(),
                      primary: busy
                          ? 'Sending\u2026'
                          : 'Send to ${picked.length} vendor${picked.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                      icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                      busy: busy,
                      onPrimary: picked.isEmpty ? null : send));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // Printable page in a new tab (web). Same trick the seating chart uses.
  void _openHtml(String page, [String text = '']) {
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      // Phones have no new tab to print from; the text version goes to the
      // clipboard for Notes or Messages, and Email it carries it as well.
      Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: text.isEmpty ? page : text));
      _toast('Copied - paste it into Notes, Messages or an email.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final html.Blob blob = html.Blob(<String>[page], 'text/html');
      final String url = html.Url.createObjectUrlFromBlob(blob);
      html.window.open(url, '_blank');
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO print: ' + e.toString());
      _toast('Could not open the printable page.');
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _sendArtifact(String inquiryId, String fileName, String page,
      String note, String text, String title) async {
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref =
        FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('inquiries').doc(inquiryId);
    Map<String, dynamic>? att;
    try {
      final Uint8List bytes = Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode(page));
      final String safe = fileName.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
      final String path =
          'inquiries/$inquiryId/attachments/${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safe';
      final Reference r = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
      await r.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: 'text/html')).timeout(const Duration(seconds: 20));
      final String url = await r.getDownloadURL();
      att = <String, dynamic>{
        'url': url,
        'name': fileName,
        'type': 'text/html',
        'size': bytes.length,
        'path': path,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO send attach: ' + e.toString());
      att = null;
    }
    // Rules cap a message at 3,000 characters; the file has everything.
    String body = '${note.isEmpty ? 'Here\u2019s our $title.' : note}\n\n$text';
    if (body.length >= 2900) {
      body =
          body.substring(0, 2860) + '\u2026\n\n(The full $title is attached.)';
    }
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> msg = <String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'couple',
        'text': body,
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      if (att != null) msg['attachment'] = att;
      try {
        await ref.collection('messages').add(msg);
      } catch (e) {
        if (att == null) rethrow;
        msg.remove('attachment');
        await ref.collection('messages').add(msg);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _toast('Could not send: $e');
      return false;
    }
    try {
      await ref.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'lastMessageAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'lastMessageRole': 'couple',
        'lastMessagePreview': '${_tc(title)} from the couple',
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (_) {
      // onMessageWritten keeps the thread header honest if the rules say no.
    }
    return true;
  }

  // "Sent to Maria, Tony \u00b7 Sep 12" under a source card.
  Widget _sentLine(String kind) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc('send:$kind:$_cid', () => _sendsRef.doc(kind)),
      initialData: _liveD['send:$kind:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> d = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final List<dynamic> to =
            d['to'] is List ? d['to'] as List : <dynamic>[];
        if (to.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
        final String names = to
            .map((dynamic e) => e is Map ? (e['vendorName'] ?? '') : '')
            .where((dynamic e) => e.toString().isNotEmpty)
            .join(', ');
        final String when = d['at'] is Timestamp
            ? _shortDate((d['at'] as Timestamp).toDate())
            : '';
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
          child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
             Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 13),
            const SizedBox(width: 5),
            Flexible(
              child: Text(
                  'Sent to $names${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' \u00b7 $when'}',
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted))),
            ),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 1: vendor team sheet ----
  Future<void> _sendTeamSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> booked = await _bookedForSend();
    final List<Map<String, String>> rows = <Map<String, String>>[];
    final Set<String> seenCats = <String>{};
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> v in booked) {
      Map<String, dynamic> vd = <String, dynamic>{};
      final String vid = v['vendorId'].toString();
      if (vid.isNotEmpty) {
        try {
          final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> s =
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('vendors')
                  .doc(vid)
                  .get();
          vd = s.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      final String cat = v['cat'].toString();
      seenCats.add(cat);
      rows.add(<String, String>{
        'role': v['label'].toString(),
        'name': v['name'].toString(),
        'contact': (vd['contactName'] ?? vd['ownerName'] ?? '').toString(),
        'email': (vd['email'] ?? vd['contactEmail'] ?? vd['publicEmail'] ?? '')
            .toString(),
        'phone': (vd['phone'] ?? '').toString(),
        'site': (vd['website'] ?? '').toString(),
        'contract':
            ((plan[cat] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['contractUrl'] ?? '')
                    .toString()
                    .isNotEmpty
                ? 'On file'
                : 'Booked on Lazo',
      });
    }
    // Vendors booked off Lazo (typed into the plan) still belong on the sheet.
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug']!;
      final Map<String, dynamic> p = plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{};
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') != 'booked' || seenCats.contains(slug)) continue;
      final String vn = (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      rows.add(<String, String>{
        'role': c['label']!,
        'name': vn.isEmpty ? 'Booked' : vn,
        'contact': '',
        'email': '',
        'phone': '',
        'site': '',
        'contract': (p['contractUrl'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
            ? 'On file'
            : 'Booked elsewhere',
      });
    }
    if (rows.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Book a vendor or two first - the sheet lists your booked team.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln(
        'VENDOR TEAM${who.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $who'}${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    t.writeln('');
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    h.write(
        '<table><tr><th>Role</th><th>Vendor</th><th>Contact</th><th>Status</th></tr>');
    for (final Map<String, String> r in rows) {
      final List<String> bits = <String>[
        if (r['contact']!.isNotEmpty) r['contact']!,
        if (r['email']!.isNotEmpty) r['email']!,
        if (r['phone']!.isNotEmpty) r['phone']!,
        if (r['site']!.isNotEmpty) r['site']!,
      ];
      t.writeln(
          '${r['role']}: ${r['name']}${bits.isEmpty ? '' : ' - ${bits.join(' \u00b7 ')}'}');
      h.write(
          '<tr><td>${_esc(r['role']!)}</td><td><b>${_esc(r['name']!)}</b></td>'
          '<td>${bits.map(_esc).join('<br>')}</td><td>${_esc(r['contract']!)}</td></tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'team',
      title: 'vendor team sheet',
      fileName: 'Vendor team.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Vendor team',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>['planner', 'venue'],
      note:
          'Here\u2019s everyone we\u2019ve booked so far, with contact details, so you know who to expect that day.',
      preview:
          '${rows.length} vendor${rows.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} with roles, contact details and contract status.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 2: day-of timeline ----
  Future<void> _sendTimeline(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs,
      List<List<String>> team,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (evs.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Add a moment or two first.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln('DAY-OF TIMELINE${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    t.writeln('');
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer('<table>');
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
      final String clock = _tlRange(ev);
      final String label = (ev['label'] ?? '').toString();
      final String note = (ev['note'] ?? '').toString();
      t.writeln('$clock  $label${note.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $note'}');
      h.write(
          '<tr><td class="time">${_esc(clock)}</td><td><b>${_esc(label)}</b>'
          '${note.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#6B5F72">${_esc(note)}</span>'}</td></tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    if (team.isNotEmpty) {
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('THE TEAM');
      h.write('<h2>The team</h2><table>');
      for (final List<String> x in team) {
        t.writeln('${x[0]}: ${x[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : x[1]}');
        h.write(
            '<tr><td>${_esc(x[0])}</td><td><b>${_esc(x[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : x[1])}</b></td></tr>');
      }
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'timeline',
      title: 'day-of timeline',
      fileName: 'Day-of timeline.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Day-of timeline',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>[],
      // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: each vendor's page opens with their moments.
      pageFor: (Map<String, dynamic> v) => _tlVendorHtml(
          evs, team, couple, (v['tag'] ?? '').toString(), v['name'].toString()),
      textFor: (Map<String, dynamic> v) =>
          _tlVendorText(evs, couple, (v['tag'] ?? '').toString()),
      note:
          'Here\u2019s our day-of timeline as it stands - your moments are at the top. Tell us if any of your times need to shift.',
      preview:
          '${evs.length} moment${evs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} from ${_fmtClock((evs.first.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())} to ${_fmtClock((evs.last.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())}. Goes to every booked vendor by default.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 3: guest list + meals (the caterer sheet) ----
  Future<void> _sendGuestSheet(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (docs.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Add guests first.');
      return;
    }
    final String text = _guestListText(docs);
    int heads = 0;
    int yes = 0;
    int pend = 0;
    final Map<String, int> meals = <String, int>{};
    final List<List<String>> people = <List<String>>[];
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
      final String r = (g['rsvp'] ?? 'pending').toString();
      if (r == 'no') continue;
      final int plus = ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
      heads += 1 + plus;
      if (r == 'yes') {
        yes += 1 + plus;
      } else {
        pend += 1 + plus;
      }
      final String m = (g['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (m.isNotEmpty) meals[m] = (meals[m] ?? 0) + 1;
      people.add(<String>[
        (g['name'] ?? '').toString(),
        r == 'yes' ? 'Attending' : 'Pending',
        plus > 0 ? '+$plus' : '',
        m,
        (g['allergies'] ?? '').toString(),
        (g['tableName'] ?? '').toString(),
      ]);
    }
    people.sort((List<String> a, List<String> b) =>
        a[0].toLowerCase().compareTo(b[0].toLowerCase()));
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    h.write(
        '<p><b>Headcount: $heads</b> &middot; $yes confirmed &middot; $pend pending</p>');
    if (meals.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write('<h2>Meals</h2><table>');
      meals.forEach((String m, int n) =>
          h.write('<tr><td>${_esc(m)}</td><td><b>$n</b></td></tr>'));
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    h.write(
        '<h2>Guests</h2><table><tr><th>Name</th><th>RSVP</th><th>+1s</th><th>Meal</th><th>Allergies / dietary</th><th>Table</th></tr>');
    for (final List<String> p in people) {
      h.write('<tr>${p.map((String x) => '<td>${_esc(x)}</td>').join()}</tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'guests',
      title: 'guest list & meals',
      fileName: 'Guest list.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Guest list & meals',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: text,
      tags: <String>['caterer', 'venue', 'planner'],
      note:
          'Here\u2019s our guest list with meal choices and dietary notes. Counts will move a little until RSVPs close.',
      preview:
          'Headcount $heads ($yes confirmed, $pend pending), meal counts, allergies, and table assignments where set.',
    );
  }

  Future<void> _editDetails(String kind) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> cur = <String, dynamic>{};
    try {
      cur = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    } catch (_) {}
    final List<List<String>> fields = _detailFields[kind]!;
    final Map<String, List<String>> items = <String, List<String>>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields)
        f[0]: (cur[f[0]] ?? '')
            .toString()
            .split('\n')
            .map((String l) => l.trim())
            .where((String l) => l.isNotEmpty)
            .toList(),
    };
    final Map<String, TextEditingController> adders =
        <String, TextEditingController>{
      for (final List<String> f in fields) f[0]: TextEditingController(),
    };
    final Map<String, List<String>> starters =
        _detailStarters[kind] ?? <String, List<String>>{};
    final String title =
        kind == 'photos' ? 'Photo groups & shot list' : 'Ceremony order';
    final String blurb = kind == 'photos'
        ? 'Your photographer plans the day around this. Names help - "Aunt May" beats "an aunt".'
        : 'Your officiant, planner and DJ all read this. Add things in order; the arrows move one up.';
    if (!mounted) return;
    bool saving = false;
    String err = '';
    Future<void> save() async {
      await _detailsRef.doc(kind).set(<String, dynamic>{
        for (final List<String> f in fields) f[0]: items[f[0]]!.join('\n'),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    }

    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSheet) {
        int total = 0;
        for (final List<String> l in items.values) total += l.length;

        Future<void> run(bool send) async {
          setSheet(() {
            saving = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            await save();
          } catch (e) {
            if (sc.mounted) {
              setSheet(() {
                saving = false;
                err = 'Couldn\u2019t save just now. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
            return;
          }
          if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
          if (!send) {
            _toast('Saved.');
            return;
          }
          try {
            final Map<String, dynamic> couple =
                _liveD['couple:$_cid']?.latest?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
            await _sendDetails(kind, couple);
          } catch (e) {
            _toast('Could not send: $e');
          }
        }

        Future<void> editItem(List<String> f, List<String> list, int index, bool multiline) async {
          final TextEditingController ec = TextEditingController(text: list[index]);
          final String? v = await _lzSheet<String>(
            context: sc,
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
            builder: (BuildContext dctx) => _lzFrame(dctx,
                icon: Icons.edit_rounded,
                title: f[1],
                subtitle: 'Clear it to remove this one.',
                children: <Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  TextField(
                      controller: ec,
                      autofocus: true,
                      minLines: 1,
                      maxLines: multiline ? 4 : 2,
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                      textInputAction: multiline ? TextInputAction.newline : TextInputAction.done,
                      onSubmitted: multiline ? null : (String t) => Navigator.pop(dctx, t.trim()),
                      style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                      decoration: _lightDeco('Item')),
                ],
                footer: _lzActions(
                    secondary: 'Cancel',
                    onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(dctx),
                    primary: 'Save',
                    icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                    onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(dctx, ec.text.trim()))),
          );
          if (v != null) {
            setSheet(() {
              if (v.isEmpty) {
                list.removeAt(index);
              } else {
                list[index] = v;
              }
            });
          }
        }

        Widget section(List<String> f) {
          final String key = f[0];
          final List<String> list = items[key]!;
          final bool multiline = key == 'notes' || key == 'readings';
          return Container(
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 12),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(Colors.white.withOpacity(.8)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(f[1].toUpperCase(),
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(plum),
                              fontSize: 10.5,
                              letterSpacing: 1.6,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                    if (list.isEmpty &&
                        (starters[key] ?? const <String>[]).isNotEmpty)
                      _Press(
                        tick: _Tick.select,
                        onTap: () =>
                            setSheet(() => list.addAll(starters[key]!)),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 9, vertical: 4),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: gold.withOpacity(.18),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6))),
                          child: Text('Use a typical list',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plumDeep),
                                  fontSize: 10.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ]),
                  if (list.isEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8, bottom: 4),
                      child: Text(f[2].replaceAll('\n', ' \u00b7 '),
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12,
                              color: _lzFg(ink.withOpacity(.4)),
                              height: 1.4)),
                    ),
                  ...list.asMap().entries.map((MapEntry<int, String> e) =>
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
                        child: Row(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Container(
                                  width: 22,
                                  height: 22,
                                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
                                  alignment: Alignment.center,
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                      color: gold.withOpacity(.2),
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
                                  child: Text('${e.key + 1}',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(plum),
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800))),
                              const SizedBox(width: 9),
                              Expanded(
                                child: _Press(
                                  tick: _Tick.select,
                                  onTap: () => editItem(f, list, e.key, multiline),
                                  child: Text(e.value,
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                                          fontSize: 14,
                                          height: 1.35)),
                                ),
                              ),
                              if (e.key > 0)
                                _Press(
                                  tick: _Tick.select,
                                  onTap: () => setSheet(() {
                                    final String x = list.removeAt(e.key);
                                    list.insert(e.key - 1, x);
                                  }),
                                  child: Tooltip(
                                    message: 'Move up',
                                    child: Padding(
                                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                                        child: Icon(Icons.arrow_upward_rounded,
                                            size: 15, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              _Press(
                                tick: _Tick.select,
                                onTap: () =>
                                    setSheet(() => list.removeAt(e.key)),
                                child: Tooltip(
                                  message: 'Remove',
                                  child: Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(3),
                                      child: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                          size: 15, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ]),
                      )),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: TextField(
                        controller: adders[key],
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                        textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                        onSubmitted: (String v) {
                          if (v.trim().isEmpty) return;
                          setSheet(() {
                            list.add(v.trim());
                            adders[key]!.clear();
                          });
                        },
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5),
                        decoration:
                            _lightDeco(multiline ? 'Add a note' : 'Add one'),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    IconButton(
                      tooltip: 'Add',
                      onPressed: _h(() {
                        final String v = adders[key]!.text.trim();
                        if (v.isEmpty) return;
                        setSheet(() {
                          list.add(v);
                          adders[key]!.clear();
                        });
                      }),
                      icon: Icon(Icons.add_circle_rounded,
                          color: _lzFg(plum), size: 26),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ]),
          );
        }

        return ConstrainedBox(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(sc).size.height * .9),
          child: _lzFrame(sc,
              icon: kind == 'photos' ? Icons.photo_camera_rounded : Icons.menu_book_rounded,
              title: title,
              subtitle: blurb,
              bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 14),
              children: <Widget>[
                for (final List<String> f in fields) section(f),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
              ],
              footer: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 4, right: 8),
                  child: Text('$total item${total == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(muted),
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: _lzActions(
                      secondary: 'Save',
                      onSecondary: () => run(false),
                      primary: 'Save & send',
                      icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                      busy: saving,
                      onPrimary: total == 0 ? null : () => run(true)),
                ),
              ])),
        );
      }),
    );
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Future<void> _sendDetails(String kind, Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    Map<String, dynamic> d = <String, dynamic>{};
    try {
      d = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    } catch (_) {}
    final List<List<String>> fields = _detailFields[kind]!;
    final bool empty = fields
        .every((List<String> f) => (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty);
    if (empty) {
      await _editDetails(kind);
      try {
        d = (await _detailsRef.doc(kind).get()).data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      } catch (_) {}
      if (fields
          .every((List<String> f) => (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty))
        return;
    }
    final String title =
        kind == 'photos' ? 'photo groups & shot list' : 'ceremony order';
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    for (final List<String> f in fields) {
      final String v = (d[f[0]] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (v.isEmpty) continue;
      final List<String> lines = v
          .split('\n')
          .map((String s) => s.trim())
          .where((String s) => s.isNotEmpty)
          .toList();
      t.writeln(f[1].toUpperCase());
      lines.forEach(t.writeln);
      t.writeln('');
      h.write(
          '<h2>${_esc(f[1])}</h2>${f[0] == 'notes' ? '<p>${lines.map(_esc).join('<br>')}</p>' : '<ol>${lines.map((String l) => '<li>${_esc(l)}</li>').join()}</ol>'}');
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: kind,
      title: title,
      fileName: '${_tc(title)}.html',
      page: _printShell(
          _tc(title),
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' \u00b7 '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: kind == 'photos'
          ? <String>['photo', 'video', 'planner']
          : <String>['officiant', 'planner', 'dj', 'video', 'photo'],
      note: kind == 'photos'
          ? 'Here are our photo groups and the shots that matter most to us.'
          : 'Here\u2019s the ceremony order so everyone is on the same page.',
    );
  }

  // ---- artifact 6: website + registry link (no file) ----
  Future<void> _sendSiteLinks(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    String slug = '';
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('weddingSites')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(1)
          .get();
      if (q.docs.isNotEmpty) slug = q.docs.first.id;
    } catch (_) {}
    if (slug.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Make your wedding website first.');
      return;
    }
    final String site = 'https://meetlazo.com/w/$slug/';
    final String text = 'Our wedding website: $site\nRegistry: $site#registry';
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'site',
      title: 'website link',
      fileName: 'Wedding website.html',
      page: _printShell('Our wedding website', _coupleLabel(couple),
          '<p><a href="$site">$site</a></p><p>Registry: <a href="$site#registry">$site#registry</a></p>'),
      text: text,
      tags: <String>['planner'],
      note:
          'Our website has the schedule, travel details and registry - handy if guests ask you.',
    );
  }

  // The hub on the Day-Of screen: every artifact, who has it, one tap to send.
  Widget _shareHubCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, List<List<String>> team) {
    final int bookedCount = plan.values
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> p) => (p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')
        .length;
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 18, 20, 14),
      radius: 22,
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text('Share with your vendors', style: _serif(size: 24)),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
             Text(
                'Each one lands in the vendor\u2019s thread with a printable copy, so nobody has to ask twice. Build it here, send it when it\u2019s ready.',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            _shareRow(
              kind: 'team',
              icon: Icons.badge_rounded,
              title: 'Vendor team sheet',
              sub: 'Who\u2019s booked, contact details, contract status',
              state: bookedCount == 0
                  ? const _ShareState('Nobody booked yet', false)
                  : _ShareState('$bookedCount booked', true),
              onPrimary: bookedCount == 0
                  ? () => setState(() => _view = _View.vendors)
                  : () => _sendTeamSheet(couple, plan),
              primary: bookedCount == 0 ? 'Book a vendor' : 'Send',
            ),
            StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
              stream:
                  _liveQuery('dayof:$_cid', () => _dayofRef.orderBy('time')),
              initialData: _liveQ['dayof:$_cid']?.latest,
              builder: (BuildContext c,
                  AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
                final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs =
                    sn.data?.docs ??
                        <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
                return _shareRow(
                  kind: 'timeline',
                  icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
                  title: 'Day-of timeline',
                  sub: 'The schedule every vendor asks for',
                  state: evs.isEmpty
                      ? const _ShareState('Nothing planned yet', false)
                      : _ShareState(
                          '${evs.length} moment${evs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} \u00b7 ${_fmtClock((evs.first.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())} to ${_fmtClock((evs.last.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())}',
                          true),
                  onPrimary: () => _timelineBuilderSheet(couple, team),
                  primary: evs.isEmpty ? 'Build it' : 'Open',
                  onSend: evs.isEmpty
                      ? null
                      : () => _sendTimeline(evs, team, couple),
                );
              },
            ),
            StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
              stream: _liveQuery('guests:$_cid', () => _guestsRef),
              initialData: _liveQ['guests:$_cid']?.latest,
              builder: (BuildContext c,
                  AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
                final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> gs =
                    sn.data?.docs ??
                        <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
                return _shareRow(
                  kind: 'guests',
                  icon: Icons.restaurant_rounded,
                  title: 'Guest list & meals',
                  sub: 'Headcount, meals, allergies, tables',
                  state: gs.isEmpty
                      ? const _ShareState('No guests yet', false)
                      : _ShareState(
                          '${gs.length} guest${gs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                          true),
                  onPrimary: gs.isEmpty
                      ? () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests)
                      : () => _sendGuestSheet(gs, couple),
                  primary: gs.isEmpty ? 'Add guests' : 'Send',
                  onEdit: gs.isEmpty
                      ? null
                      : () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests),
                );
              },
            ),
            _shareRow(
              kind: 'music',
              icon: Icons.music_note_rounded,
              title: 'Music',
              sub: 'Must-plays, do-not-plays, the first dance',
              state: const _ShareState('Sent from the Music page', true),
              onPrimary: _openMusic,
              primary: 'Open',
            ),
            for (final List<dynamic> k in <List<dynamic>>[
              <dynamic>[
                'photos',
                Icons.photo_camera_rounded,
                'Photo groups & shot list',
                'Wedding party, family groupings, must-haves'
              ],
              <dynamic>[
                'ceremony',
                Icons.church_rounded,
                'Ceremony order',
                'Processional, readings, recessional'
              ],
            ])
              StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                stream: _liveDoc('details:${k[0]}:$_cid',
                    () => _detailsRef.doc(k[0] as String)),
                initialData: _liveD['details:${k[0]}:$_cid']?.latest,
                builder: (BuildContext c,
                    AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> d =
                      sn.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
                  int items = 0;
                  for (final List<String> f in _detailFields[k[0] as String]!) {
                    items += (d[f[0]] ?? '')
                        .toString()
                        .split('\n')
                        .where((String l) => l.trim().isNotEmpty)
                        .length;
                  }
                  return _shareRow(
                    kind: k[0] as String,
                    icon: k[1] as IconData,
                    title: k[2] as String,
                    sub: k[3] as String,
                    state: items == 0
                        ? const _ShareState('Not filled in yet', false)
                        : _ShareState(
                            '$items item${items == 1 ? '' : 's'}', true),
                    onPrimary: items == 0
                        ? () => _editDetails(k[0] as String)
                        : () => _sendDetails(k[0] as String, couple),
                    primary: items == 0 ? 'Fill in' : 'Send',
                    onEdit:
                        items == 0 ? null : () => _editDetails(k[0] as String),
                  );
                },
              ),
            StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
              stream: _liveQuery(
                  'site:$_cid',
                  () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('weddingSites')
                      .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
                      .limit(1)),
              initialData: _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest,
              builder: (BuildContext c,
                  AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
                final bool has = (sn.data?.docs ??
                        const <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                    .isNotEmpty;
                return _shareRow(
                  kind: 'site',
                  icon: Icons.language_rounded,
                  title: 'Website & registry',
                  sub: 'The link, for when guests ask them',
                  state: has
                      ? const _ShareState('Your site is live', true)
                      : const _ShareState('No website yet', false),
                  onPrimary: has
                      ? () => _sendSiteLinks(couple)
                      : () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
                  primary: has ? 'Send' : 'Build your site',
                );
              },
            ),
          ]),
    );
  }

  // ---- the timeline builder: the whole day, in order, then Send ----
  Future<void> _timelineBuilderSheet(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, List<List<String>> team) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .88),
        child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
          stream: _liveQuery('dayof:$_cid', () => _dayofRef.orderBy('time')),
          initialData: _liveQ['dayof:$_cid']?.latest,
          builder: (BuildContext c,
              AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
            final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs =
                <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
              ...(sn.data?.docs ??
                  <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
            ];
            _tlSortDocs(evs);

            Widget moment(int i) {
              final Map<String, dynamic> ev = evs[i].data();
              final bool last = i == evs.length - 1;
              final String hint = i == 0 ? '' : _tlHint(evs[i - 1].data(), ev);
              final bool clash = hint.startsWith('Overlaps');
              return _Press(
                onTap: () => _editTimelineEvent(evs[i]),
                child: IntrinsicHeight(
                  child: Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        SizedBox(
                          width: 74,
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                            child: Text(_tlRange(ev),
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(clash ? rose : plum),
                                    fontSize: 12,
                                    height: 1.25,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                          ),
                        ),
                        Column(children: <Widget>[
                          Container(
                              width: 10,
                              height: 10,
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: gold,
                                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                  border: Border.all(color: plum, width: 1.5))),
                          if (!last)
                            Expanded(
                                child: Container(
                                    width: 2, color: gold.withOpacity(.5))),
                        ]),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(0, 8, 0, 16),
                            child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Text((ev['label'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                                          fontSize: 14.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                  if ((ev['note'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
                                    Text((ev['note'] ?? '').toString(),
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 12.5,
                                            color: _lzFg(muted),
                                            height: 1.35)),
                                  _tlOwnerRow(ev),
                                  if (hint.isNotEmpty)
                                    Padding(
                                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                                      child: Text(hint,
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                              fontSize: 11,
                                              color: _lzFg(clash
                                                  ? rose
                                                  : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                    ),
                                ]),
                          ),
                        ),
                        IconButton(
                          // 44x44 is the floor on both platforms; compact density was 40.
                          constraints:
                              const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44),
                          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                          tooltip: 'Remove this moment',
                          onPressed: _h(() async {
                            // Snapshot first: after the delete
                            // there is nothing left to read.
                            final Map<String, dynamic> gone = Map<String, dynamic>.from(evs[i].data());
                            final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref =
                                evs[i].reference;
                            await ref.delete();
                            _toastUndo('Moment removed.', () => ref.set(gone));
                          }),
                          icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                              color: _lzFg(muted), size: 16),
                        ),
                      ]),
                ),
              );
            }

            return _lzFrame(ctx,
                icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
                title: 'Day-of timeline',
                subtitle: evs.isEmpty
                    ? 'The whole day, hour by hour. Every vendor plans around it.'
                    : '${evs.length} moment${evs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} \u00b7 tap one to change it',
                headerExtra: evs.isEmpty
                    ? null
                    : Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        child: _tlChip(
                            _tlAnchor(evs) == null
                                ? 'Mark the ceremony to shift the whole day'
                                : 'Ceremony at ${_fmtClock((_tlAnchor(evs)!.data()['time'] ?? '').toString())} \u00b7 change',
                            _tlAnchor(evs) != null,
                            () => _tlReanchor(ctx, evs)),
                      ),
                bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 12, 18, 12),
                children: <Widget>[
                  if (evs.isEmpty)
                    _pcB_empty(Icons.schedule_rounded,
                        'Getting ready, first look, ceremony, cocktails, dinner, dances, send-off. Start from a classic day built around your ceremony time, then adjust.')
                  else
                    for (int i = 0; i < evs.length; i++) moment(i),
                ],
                footer: evs.isEmpty
                    ? _lzActions(
                        secondary: 'Add one moment',
                        onSecondary: () => _editTimelineEvent(null),
                        primary: 'Start from a classic day',
                        icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                        onPrimary: () => _seedClassicDay(ctx))
                    : _lzActions(
                        secondary: 'Add a moment',
                        onSecondary: () => _editTimelineEvent(null),
                        primary: 'Send to vendors',
                        icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                        onPrimary: () {
                          Navigator.pop(ctx);
                          _sendTimeline(evs, team, couple);
                        }));
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _logOut() async {
    await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
    if (!mounted) return;
    context.goNamed(pageWelcome);

  Future<void> _deleteAccount() async {
    final User? u0 = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u0 == null) return;
    final User u = u0;

    // Deletion runs server-side now. The old code here deleted couples/{cid} and
    // its 'plan' subcollection, swallowed every error, then deleted the login
    // regardless - leaving the wedding website, every message thread, the other
    // seven subcollections and all uploaded photos behind, and unreachable once
    // the login was gone. deleteMyAccount removes all of it and deletes the
    // login LAST, so a partial failure is retryable rather than permanent.
    // See functions-dashboard/deleteAccount.js.
    // cB (JC-LAZO-POPUP-1014): one popup asks, works, asks for the password
    // when Firebase wants a recent login, and shows any failure in place.
    final String email = u.email ?? '';
    final TextEditingController passC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    bool needPass = false;
    bool gone = false;
    String err = '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 480),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setS) {
          void upd(VoidCallback f) {
            if (sc.mounted) setS(f);
          }

          Future<void> go() async {
            upd(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              if (needPass) {
                await u.reauthenticateWithCredential(
                    EmailAuthProvider.credential(email: email, password: passC.text));
              }
              await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                  .httpsCallable('deleteMyAccount')
                  .call(<String, dynamic>{});
              gone = true;
              if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
            } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
              upd(() {
                busy = false;
                err = _lzFnMsg(e, 'We could not delete your account just now. Check your connection and try again.');
              });
            } on FirebaseAuthException catch (e) {
              if (!needPass && e.code == 'requires-recent-login') {
                upd(() {
                  busy = false;
                  needPass = true;
                });
              } else {
                upd(() {
                  busy = false;
                  err = needPass
                      ? 'Password didn\u2019t match - account not deleted.'
                      : _lzFnMsg(e, 'We could not delete your account just now. Check your connection and try again.');
                });
              }
            } catch (_) {
              upd(() {
                busy = false;
                err = needPass
                    ? 'Password didn\u2019t match - account not deleted.'
                    : 'We could not delete your account just now.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(sc,
              icon: needPass ? Icons.lock_outline_rounded : Icons.warning_amber_rounded,
              title: needPass ? 'Confirm it\u2019s you' : 'Delete your account?',
              subtitle: needPass
                  ? 'Enter your password to finish deleting your account.'
                  : 'This can\u2019t be undone.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 10),
                if (!needPass)
                  Text(
                      'Your account and wedding plan are deleted for good, with your website, message threads and photos.',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14.5, color: _lzFg(ink), height: 1.5))
                else
                  TextField(
                    controller: passC,
                    autofocus: true,
                    obscureText: true,
                    enabled: !busy,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
                    onChanged: (String _) => upd(() {}),
                    onSubmitted: (String _) {
                      if (!busy && passC.text.isNotEmpty) go();
                    },
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Password'),
                  ),
                if (busy) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _lzBusy('Deleting your account\u2026'),
                ],
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Keep my account',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(sc),
                  primary: needPass ? 'Delete' : 'Delete my account',
                  danger: true,
                  icon: Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: needPass && passC.text.isEmpty ? null : go));
        },
      ),
    );
    if (!gone) return;
    await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();
    if (!mounted) return;
    context.goNamed(pageWelcome);
  }

  // v91: flat ivory on the plum canvas. The blur under every card was a

  Widget _glass({
    required Widget child,
    EdgeInsetsGeometry padding = const EdgeInsets.all(18),

    Color? borderColor,
    double tint = .55,

            : <BoxShadow>[

    );
  }

              };

          );

      ),
    );
  }

  // v145: hand the signed-in couple to the June hub with a one-hour custom token
  // JC-LAZO-JUNE-EMBED-1008-001: the hub URL, signed in through the juneToken callable (one hour), plain URL as the fallback
  Future<String> _juneUrl({bool embed = false}) async {
    String url = kJuneHubUrl + (embed ? '?embed=1' : '');
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'juneToken',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 15)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> r =
          await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{});
      final String t = ((r.data as Map)['token'] ?? '').toString();
      if (t.isNotEmpty) {
        url = '$kJuneHubUrl?${embed ? 'embed=1&' : ''}t=${Uri.encodeComponent(t)}';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO juneToken: ' + e.toString());
    }
    return url;
  }

  Future<void> _talkToJune() async {
    final String url = await _juneUrl();
    try {
      await launchUrl(Uri.parse(url),
          mode: kIsWeb ? LaunchMode.externalApplication : LaunchMode.inAppWebView);
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO june hub: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  void _askJune(String q) {
    final String t = q.trim();
    _askC.clear();
    setState(() => _view = _View.june);
    if (t.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    _juneC.text = t;
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      if (mounted) {
        _juneSend();
      }
    });
  }

  Widget _activeScreen(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    if (_view == _View.vendors) return _vendorScreen(couple, plan);
    if (_view == _View.registry) return _registryScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.shopping) return _shoppingScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.board) return _boardScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.guests) return _guestScreen();
    if (_view == _View.website) return _websiteScreen(couple);
    if (_view == _View.june) return _juneScreen();
    if (_view == _View.messages) return _messagesScreen();
    if (_view == _View.dayof) return _dayOfScreen(couple, plan);
    if (_view == _View.browse) return _browseScreen();
    if (_view == _View.account) return _accountScreen(couple);
    return _hub(couple, plan);
  }

  Widget _shell(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    return LayoutBuilder(
      builder: (BuildContext context, BoxConstraints box) {
        final bool wide = box.maxWidth >= 1080;
        _hasRail =
            wide; // v108: the home shows the wordmark itself when there's no rail
        // v130: screens slide in over the hub instead of hard-cutting.
        final Widget screen =
            _viewSwitch(_screenKeyed(_activeScreen(couple, plan)));
        final Widget content = !wide
            ? Center(
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 860),
                  child: screen,
                ),
              )
            : Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  SizedBox(width: 330, child: _deskRail(couple, plan)),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(child: screen),
                ],
              );
        return Stack(
          children: <Widget>[
            content,
            Positioned(
              top: 22,
              left: 18,
              right: 18,
              child: Center(
                child: ConstrainedBox(
                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 540),
                  child: _contractReadyBanner(couple),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  String _railMoney(double v) {
    final String s = v.round().toString();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      if (i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 == 0) {
        b.write(',');
      }
      b.write(s[i]);
    }
    return '\u0024' + b.toString();
  }

  Widget _hub(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _inqStream(),
      initialData: _inqLatest(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs =
            _inqList(s);
        DateTime? weddingDate;
        final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
        if (ts is Timestamp) weddingDate = ts.toDate();
        final int? daysOut = weddingDate == null
            ? null
            : DateTime(weddingDate.year, weddingDate.month, weddingDate.day)
                .difference(DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month,
                    DateTime.now().day))
                .inDays;
        final String firstName =
            (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '')
                .split(' ')
                .first;
        final String? photoUrl = (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
            ? null
            : couple['photoUrl'].toString();
        final bool needsSetup = weddingDate == null ||
            (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ||
            (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty;
        final List<List<dynamic>> steps =
            _juneSteps(couple, plan, inqs, weddingDate, daysOut);
        _syncFolds(couple);
        _maybeStartCoupleTour(couple, needsSetup);
        _cwWatch(couple);
        return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
          final bool twoUp = cons.maxWidth >= 720;
          // v156: widgets on the right when there is room, else at the end
          final bool railSide = cons.maxWidth >= 1040;
          final Widget railStack = _crStack(couple, plan, inqs, weddingDate, daysOut);
          final Widget mainList = ListView(
            cacheExtent: 4000,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 18, 96),
            children: <Widget>[
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: !_hasRail
                        ? Align(
                            alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                            child: _lazoMark(height: 22, color: gold))
                        : Text(
                            'Your wedding',
                            style: _serif(
                                size: 30,
                                weight: FontWeight.w500,
                                color: ivory)),
                  ),
                  // JC-LAZO-VIEWSWITCH-0917-002: labelled so a store reviewer
                  // can find it without guessing, and shown only to the review
                  // account. Pure navigation - role is untouched; _markViewSwitch()
                  // is what stops VendorHome's own role guard from bouncing a
                  // couple-role account straight back here.
                  if (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.email ==
                      'demo@meetlazo.com') ...<Widget>[
                    _Press(
                      scale: .96,
                      onTap: () async {
                        await _markViewSwitch();
                        if (mounted) {
                          context.goNamed('VendorHome');
                        }
                      },
                      child: Container(
                        height: 44,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: gold,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            const Icon(Icons.storefront_rounded,
                                color: plumDeep, size: 17),
                            const SizedBox(width: 7),
                            Text('Vendor view',
                                style: GoogleFonts.inter(
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                                    color: plumDeep)),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  ],
                  _roundBtn(Icons.ios_share_rounded, () => _shareLazo()),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _cFeedBell(),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),
                  _msgHeaderButton(),
                  const SizedBox(width: 10),

                    onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.account),
                    child: Container(
                      width: 44,
                      height: 44,
