  // ---------------- v91: JUNE'S READ + THREE STEPS ----------------
  // Rule-based until her function lands: what is actually waiting on them,
  // in order. [title, why, cta, action]
  List<List<dynamic>> _juneSteps(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut) {
    final List<List<dynamic>> out = <List<dynamic>>[];
    // v139: after the wedding, June stops saying "talk to three venues"
    if (daysOut != null && daysOut < 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Send the thank-you notes',
        'Tick each one off on the guest list as it goes out - the count at the top keeps you honest.',
        'Open guests',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.guests),
      ]);
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Add a chapter to your site',
        'The honeymoon, the first anniversary, the news - your site keeps telling the story after the day.',
        'Open website',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
      ]);
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Gather the photos',
        'Approve what guests shared, download the wall, and link the photographer\u2019s gallery when it lands.',
        'Open website',
        () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
      ]);
      return out;
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String vn = (m['vendorName'] ?? 'your vendor').toString();
      if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent') {
        out.add(<dynamic>[
          'Sign $vn\u2019s contract',
          'It\u2019s in your thread. Signing is what locks your date - everything else hangs on it.',
          'Open thread',
          () => _openCoupleThread(d.id, m),
        ]);
      }
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String isx = (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '').toString();
      if (isx == 'sent' || isx == 'due') {
        final String vn = (m['vendorName'] ?? 'your vendor').toString();
        out.add(<dynamic>[
          'Settle $vn\u2019s invoice',
          'Paying it keeps the booking real on their side. Card or your own way - it\u2019s in the thread.',
          'Open thread',
          () => _openCoupleThread(d.id, m),
        ]);
      }
    }
    if (wedding == null) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Pick your date',
        'Even a month is enough. Every vendor conversation starts with it, and June plans backwards from it.',
        'Set the date',
        () => _setWeddingDate(null),
      ]);
    }
    if ((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Tell June where',
        'The city sets who she can show you, what things cost there, and when vendors book out.',
        'Set the place',
        () => _setupSheet(couple),
      ]);
    }
    // next vendor by booking lead
    final List<List<dynamic>> due = <List<dynamic>>[];
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final Map<String, dynamic> p = plan[slug] ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      due.add(<dynamic>[by ?? DateTime(now.year + 5), slug, st]);
    }
    due.sort((List<dynamic> a, List<dynamic> b) =>
        (a[0] as DateTime).compareTo(b[0] as DateTime));
    if (due.isNotEmpty) {
      final String slug = due.first[1] as String;
      final DateTime by = due.first[0] as DateTime;
      final String label = _catLabel(slug).toLowerCase();
      final bool late =
          wedding != null && by.isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1));
      final String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Talk to three ${label.endsWith('s') ? label : (label.contains('&') ? '$label pros' : '${label}s')}',
        wedding == null
            ? 'Once your date is set, June can tell you when this one usually needs booking.'
            : late
                ? 'Couples usually have this one booked by ${_kMoLong[by.month - 1]} for a ${_kMoLong[wedding.month - 1]} wedding - so it\u2019s the one to start today.'
                : 'Couples usually book this by ${_kMoLong[by.month - 1]} ${by.year} for your date. Three conversations is enough to know.',
        'See verified ${label}s',
        () => _openBrowse(
            metro: metro.isEmpty ? _browseMetro : metro, category: slug),
      ]);
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double planned = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') != 'skipped') planned += ((p['budgetPlanned'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
    }
    if (budgetTotal <= 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Set a budget - even a rough one',
        'June uses it to say what\u2019s realistic here, and to flag when a proposal is out of range before you fall for it.',
        'Set the budget',
        () => _setBudgetSheet(null),
      ]);
    }
    // v110: while the gold setup banner is showing, the steps don't repeat
    // it line by line - one step opens the same sheet, the rest are real
    // next moves.
    final bool bannerUp = wedding == null ||
        (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty ||
        (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty;
    if (bannerUp) {
      out.removeWhere((List<dynamic> st) =>
          st[0] == 'Pick your date' ||
          st[0] == 'Tell June where' ||
          st[0] == 'Set a budget - even a rough one');
      out.insert(0, <dynamic>[
        'Finish the one-minute setup',
        'Still missing: ${_setupMissing(couple).join(', ')}. Everything June says about cost and timing gets sharper once these are in.',
        'Finish setup',
        () => _setupSheet(couple),
      ]);
    }
    if (budgetTotal > 0 && planned <= 0) {
      out.add(<dynamic>[
        'Split the ${_railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble())} into what it\u2019s for',
        'Right now it\u2019s one number. Give it a few lines and June can tell you what\u2019s realistic for each.',
        'Split the budget',
        () => _budgetSheet(couple, plan),
      ]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  String _juneRead(int? daysOut, int booked, int active, DateTime? wedding,
      [List<String> late = const <String>[]]) {
    if (daysOut == null) {
      return 'Pick a date and June plans backwards from it - what to book when, and what\u2019s realistic where you are.';
    }
    if (daysOut < 0)
      return 'Congratulations. Your day is behind you - the memories aren\u2019t.';
    if (daysOut == 0) return 'It\u2019s today. Put the phone down.';
    final int months = (daysOut / 30.4).round();
    final String monthsOut = months < 1 ? 'under a month' : '$months months';
    if (booked == 0) {
      return months >= 10
          ? 'You have room. Most couples at $monthsOut out haven\u2019t booked anyone yet either - the venue and photographer are the two to start with.'
          : months >= 6
              ? 'You\u2019re not behind - but the venue and photographer book out first, so those two are this month\u2019s job.'
              : 'Short runway, which is fine - it just means fewer conversations and faster decisions. June will keep the list short.';
    }
    final bool ahead =
        booked >= (active * (1 - (months / 14).clamp(0, 1))).round();
    if (late.isEmpty) {
      return ahead
          ? 'You\u2019re ahead of most couples at $monthsOut out - $booked of $active booked. Nothing is overdue.'
          : '$booked of $active booked at $monthsOut out. Nothing is overdue yet - the next one to book is below.';
    }
    final String who = late.length == 1
        ? late.first
        : late.length == 2
            ? '${late[0]} and ${late[1]}'
            : '${late.take(late.length - 1).join(', ')} and ${late.last}';
    final String verb = late.length == 1 ? 'is' : 'are';
    return '$booked of $active booked at $monthsOut out. $who $verb usually booked by now - ${late.length == 1 ? 'it\u2019s' : 'they\u2019re'} first on the list below.';
  }

  // ---------------- v91: HERO - their photo, their names, the day ----------------
  Widget _heroToday(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding,
      int? daysOut,
      List<List<dynamic>> steps) {
    int booked = 0, skipped = 0;
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') booked++;
      if (st == 'skipped') skipped++;
      if (st != 'booked' && st != 'skipped') {
        final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
        if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
            (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
          nextSlug = slug;
          nextBy = by;
        }
      }
    }
    final int active = kCategories.length - skipped;
    int waiting = 0;
    String waitingWho = '';
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final bool fromVendor = (m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') == 'vendor';
      final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
      final dynamic read = m['coupleLastReadAt'];
      final bool unread = fromVendor &&
          last is Timestamp &&
          (read is! Timestamp || last.compareTo(read) > 0);
      final bool contract = (m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent';
      if (unread || contract) {
        waiting++;
        if (waitingWho.isEmpty) {
          waitingWho = contract
              ? '${m['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor'} sent the contract'
              : '${m['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor'} replied';
        }
      }
    }
    final num budgetTotal =
        couple['budgetTotal'] is num ? couple['budgetTotal'] as num : 0;
    double committed = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked')
        committed += _spentOf(p).toDouble(); // v140
    }
    // v110: which categories are past their usual booking month?
    final DateTime monthStart =
        DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month, 1);
    final List<String> late = <String>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'skipped') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (by != null && by.isBefore(monthStart)) late.add(c['label']!);
    }
    final bool nextLate = nextBy != null && nextBy.isBefore(monthStart);
    final String names = (couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final String metro = _metroLabel((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString());
    final String greetFirst =
        (FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.displayName ?? '').split(' ').first;
    // v128: each segment is glued with no-break spaces and a non-breaking
    // hyphen, so a wrap can only happen at a dot - never "DALLAS-FORT /
    // WORTH".
    String glue(String t) => t
        .toUpperCase()
        .replaceAll(' ', '\u00a0')
        .replaceAll('-', '\u2011')
        .replaceAll('\u2013', '\u2011');
    final String eyeTop = <String>[
      if (names.isNotEmpty) glue(names),
      if (names.isEmpty && !_hasRail && greetFirst.isNotEmpty)
        glue('HI, $greetFirst'),
    ].join(' \u00b7 ');
    final String eyeBottom = <String>[
      if (wedding != null) glue(_longDate(wedding)),
      if (metro.isNotEmpty) glue(metro),
    ].join(' \u00b7 ');
    final String eyebrow = <String>[
      if (eyeTop.isNotEmpty) eyeTop,
      if (eyeBottom.isNotEmpty) eyeBottom,
    ].join('\n');
    final String photo = (couple['photoUrl'] ?? '').toString();
    final String nextLabel = nextSlug.isEmpty ? '' : _catLabel(nextSlug);

    final List<Widget> tiles = <Widget>[
      // JC-LAZO-JUNE-HERO-1013-001: the countdown, now the first tile
      _heroTile(
          daysOut == null ? 'Your day' : (daysOut < 0 ? 'Married' : 'Countdown'),
          daysOut == null ? 'Set' : (daysOut == 0 ? 'Today' : '${daysOut.abs()}'),
          daysOut == null || daysOut == 0 ? '' : (daysOut < 0 ? 'days since' : 'days to go'),
          wedding == null ? 'Tap your names above to add it' : _longDate(wedding),
          accent: gold),
      if (!_cr.contains('team'))
      _heroTile(
          'Vendor team',
          '$booked',
          'of $active',
          booked == 0
              ? 'Nobody booked yet - that\u2019s normal'
              : _bookedLine(plan)),
      _heroTile(
          'Next up',
          nextLabel.isEmpty ? '\u2014' : nextLabel,
          '',
          nextLabel.isEmpty
              ? 'Your list is complete'
              : (nextBy == null
                  ? 'Set a date to see when'
                  : nextLate
                      ? 'Usually booked by now - start this week'
                      : 'Usually booked by ${_kMo[nextBy.month - 1]} ${nextBy.year}'),
          small: nextLabel.isNotEmpty,
          accent: nextLate ? const Color(0xFFF2B8B8) : null),
      if (!_cr.contains('budget'))
      _heroTile(
          'Budget',
          budgetTotal <= 0 ? '\u2014' : _railMoney(budgetTotal.toDouble()),
          budgetTotal <= 0 ? '' : 'set',
          budgetTotal <= 0
              ? 'Not set yet'
              : (committed <= 0
                  ? 'Nothing committed yet'
                  : '${_railMoney(committed)} committed')),
      if (!_cr.contains('replies'))
      _heroTile(
          'Vendor replies',
          '$waiting',
          waiting == 0 ? '' : 'to read',
          waiting == 0 ? 'Inbox is clear' : waitingWho),
    ];
    final Widget nameBlock = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        if (eyebrow.isNotEmpty)
          // v126: tap the eyebrow to edit names / date / city.
          _Press(
            onTap: () => _setupSheet(couple),
            child: Padding(
              // v128: right inset keeps the text out from under the camera pill
              padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8, right: photo.isEmpty && MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600 ? 148 : 52),
              // v125: ivory, not gold - gold vanished into the cover photo at
              // the top of the hero where the scrim is lightest; a soft dark
              // shadow keeps it legible over a bright photo too.
              child: Text(eyebrow,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      color: ivory,
                      fontSize: 11.5,
                      letterSpacing: 2,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      shadows: <Shadow>[
                        Shadow(
                            color: Color(0x99000000),
                            blurRadius: 6,
                            offset: Offset(0, 1)),
                      ])),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
    // JC-LAZO-JUNE-HERO-1013-001: this week's step, under the tiles
    final Widget stepBlock = Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: <Widget>[
        if (steps.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 14),
          _Press(
            onTap: steps.first[3] as VoidCallback,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 11),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: gold, borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Flexible(
                  child: Text(
                      'This week: ${(steps.first[0] as String)[0].toLowerCase()}${(steps.first[0] as String).substring(1)}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: plumDeep,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                const Icon(Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                    color: plumDeep, size: 16),
              ]),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ],
    );
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
      final bool wide = cons.maxWidth >= 760;
      final Widget grid = wide
          ? IntrinsicHeight(
              child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 2)
                      Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: i == 0 ? 0 : 10),
                        child: SizedBox(
                          width: 168,
                          // a column with one tile lets it fill the height: no empty slot
                          child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                            Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
                            if (i + 1 < tiles.length) ...<Widget>[
                              const SizedBox(height: 10),
                              Expanded(child: tiles[i + 1]),
                            ],
                          ]),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ]),
            )
          : Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: <Widget>[
                  if (tiles.length.isOdd) ...<Widget>[
                    tiles.first,
                    if (tiles.length > 1) const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  ],
                  _twoUp(tiles.length.isOdd ? tiles.sublist(1) : tiles),
                ],
              );
      return Container(
        // v117: gradient + photo are clipped by the rounded shape; the gold
        // border is painted on top as a foreground so the corners stay clean.
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(22)), color: plum),
        foregroundDecoration: BoxDecoration(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
            border: Border.all(color: gold)),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: Stack(children: <Widget>[
          const Positioned.fill(
            child: DecoratedBox(
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                    colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF6A3A66), plum, plumDeep]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned.fill(
            child: photo.isEmpty
                ? const SizedBox.shrink()
                : Image(
                    image: ResizeImage(NetworkImage(photo), width: 1400),
                    fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    alignment: _photoAlign(couple), // v127
                    errorBuilder: (BuildContext c2, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                        Container(color: plumDeep),
                  ),
          ),
          Positioned.fill(
            child: Container(
              decoration: const BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                  end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                  colors: <Color>[
                    Color(0x663D1C3B),
                    Color(0xE63D1C3B),
                    Color(0xF9241022)
                  ],
                  stops: <double>[0, .4, 1],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            top: 10,
            right: 10,
            child: Tooltip(
              message: photo.isEmpty
                  ? 'Add a photo of the two of you'
                  : 'Move or change the photo',
              child: _Press(
                onTap: photo.isEmpty
                    ? _changePhoto
                    : () => _adjustPhotoSheet(couple), // v127
                child: Container(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: photo.isEmpty && MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600 ? 12 : 8, vertical: 7),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.55),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.35)))),
                  child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(Icons.photo_camera_rounded,
                        color: ivory, size: 15),
                    if (photo.isEmpty && MediaQuery.of(context).size.width >= 600) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(width: 6),
                      const Text('Add your photo',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: ivory,
                              fontSize: 11.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ],
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                wide ? 28 : 18, wide ? 28 : 20, wide ? 28 : 18, wide ? 24 : 18),
            // JC-LAZO-JUNE-HERO-1013-001/002: June is the top of the dashboard - the day as
            // the eyebrow, her hero, then the numbers (beside her when the card has room for both, >= 1100;
            // a narrower wide card - beside the sidebar - stacks them under her in one even row) and this week's step.
            child: wide && cons.maxWidth >= 1100
                ? Row(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            nameBlock,
                            KeyedSubtree(
                                key: _kTourJune,
                                child: const JuneNative(
                                    role: 'couple', layout: 'hero')),
                            stepBlock,
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 28),
                      grid,
                    ],
                  )
                : Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      nameBlock,
                      KeyedSubtree(
                          key: _kTourJune,
                          child: const JuneNative(role: 'couple', layout: 'hero')),
                      const SizedBox(height: 18),
                      wide
                          ? IntrinsicHeight(
                              child: Row(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                                    if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
                                  ],
                                ],
                              ),
                            )
                          : grid,
                      stepBlock,
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
        ]),
      );
    });
  }

  String _bookedLine(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' &&
          (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) {
        return '${p['vendorName']} booked';
      }
    }
    return 'Off to a start';
  }

  Widget _heroTile(String label, String value, String unit, String sub,
      {bool small = false, Color? accent}) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 11, 14, 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.10)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.22))),
      ),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(label,
                maxLines: 1,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: ivory.withOpacity(.72))),
            const SizedBox(height: 3),
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Flexible(
                      child: Text(value,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: _serif(
                              size: small ? 20 : 28, color: ivory, height: 1))),
                  if (unit.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Text(unit,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12,
                            color: gold,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  ],
                ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(sub,
                maxLines: 2,
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    height: 1.3,
                    fontWeight:
                        accent == null ? FontWeight.w400 : FontWeight.w700,
                    color: _lzFg(accent ?? ivory.withOpacity(.78)))),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _twoUp(List<Widget> tiles) {
    final List<Widget> rows = <Widget>[];
    for (int i = 0; i < tiles.length; i += 2) {
      rows.add(IntrinsicHeight(
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(child: tiles[i]),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                  child: i + 1 < tiles.length
                      ? tiles[i + 1]
                      : const SizedBox.shrink()),
            ]),
      ));
      if (i + 2 < tiles.length) rows.add(const SizedBox(height: 10));
    }
    return Column(children: rows);
  }

  // The "confirmed your booking" moment: a vendor marked them booked and it
  // isn't on their list yet. One tap links it. Kept from v90, restyled.
  Widget _linkBookingBanner(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs) {
    final List<String> linked = List<String>.from(
        (couple['linkedInquiries'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]);
    QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? fresh;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      if ((d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' && !linked.contains(d.id)) {
        fresh = d;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (fresh == null) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d = fresh;
    final String vn = (d.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'A vendor').toString();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 14),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _linkBooking(d.data(), d.id),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            gradient: LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[
              vGreen.withOpacity(.95),
              const Color(0xFF3AA37E)
            ]),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
          ),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            const Text('\uD83C\uDF89', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text('$vn confirmed your booking',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const Text('Tap to add them to your vendor team',
                        style: TextStyle(color: ivory, fontSize: 12)),
                  ]),
            ),
            const Icon(Icons.chevron_right_rounded, color: ivory),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: THIS WEEK, WITH JUNE ----------------
  Widget _juneWeekCard(List<List<dynamic>> steps,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs) {
    String lastWeek = '';
    Timestamp? newest;
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      if ((m['status'] ?? '') != 'booked') continue;
      final dynamic b = m['bookedAt'];
      if (b is Timestamp &&
          DateTime.now().difference(b.toDate()).inDays <= 14) {
        if (newest == null || b.compareTo(newest) > 0) {
          newest = b;
          lastWeek =
              'You booked ${m['vendorName'] ?? 'a vendor'} ${_ago(b) == 'now' ? 'just now' : '${_ago(b)} ago'}. That was the right move.';
        }
      }
    }
    final List<List<dynamic>> show = steps.take(3).toList();
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 14),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text('This week, with June', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                              show.isEmpty
                                  ? 'Nothing is waiting on you. That is the whole point.'
                                  : '${show.length == 1 ? 'One thing' : show.length == 2 ? 'Two things' : 'Three things'}, in order - from your date, your list and your budget.',
                              style:
                                   TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                    onPressed: _h(() => _askJune('')),
                    child: const Text('Ask June',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  // v145: the full June, in her own voice, at june.meetlazo.com
                  FilledButton(
                    style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: gold,
                        foregroundColor: plum,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                    onPressed: _h(() => _talkToJune()),
                    child: const Text('Talk to June',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  _foldBtn('week'),
                ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            for (int i = 0; i < show.length; i++)
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    border: Border(
                        top: BorderSide(
                            color: _lzLine(i == 0
                                ? Colors.transparent
                                : const Color(0xFFF0E8DD))))),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Container(
                    width: 22,
                    height: 22,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        border: Border.all(color: gold, width: 1.5)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text(show[i][0] as String,
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 14.5,
                                  color: _lzFg(ink),
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 1),
                          Text(show[i][1] as String,
                              style:  TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  i == 0
                      ? FilledButton(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold,
                              foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                              elevation: 0,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 13, vertical: 9),
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                          onPressed: _h(show[i][3] as VoidCallback),
                          child: Text(show[i][2] as String,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        )
                      : OutlinedButton(
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                              foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                              side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 13, vertical: 9),
                              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),

  // ---------------- v91: VENDOR TEAM - their list, and the road to the date ----------------
  Widget _teamCard(
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> inqs,
      DateTime? wedding) {
    final List<Map<String, String>> mine = <Map<String, String>>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st != 'skipped') mine.add(c);
    }
    // conversations per category, from the inquiries themselves
    final Map<String, int> talking = <String, int>{};
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in inqs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final String st = (m['status'] ?? '').toString();
      if (st == 'booked' || st == 'lost' || st == 'closed') continue;
      final dynamic cat = m['vendorCategory'] ??
          m['category'] ??
          (m['structuredIntent'] is Map
              ? (m['structuredIntent'] as Map)['category']
              : null);
      if (cat != null)
        talking[cat.toString()] = (talking[cat.toString()] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    String nextSlug = '';
    DateTime? nextBy;
    for (final Map<String, String> c in mine) {
      final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
      final String st = (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') continue;
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
      if (nextSlug.isEmpty ||
          (by != null && (nextBy == null || by.isBefore(nextBy)))) {
        nextSlug = slug;
        nextBy = by;
      }
    }
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    return _glass(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 16),
      child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          Text('Your vendor team', style: _serif(size: 24)),
                          const SizedBox(height: 2),
                          Text(
                              'The ${mine.length} you said you need. Not our ${kCategories.length} - yours.',
                              style:
                                   TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                        ]),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                        side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10))),
                    onPressed: _h(() => _editWantedSheet(plan)),
                    child: const Text('Edit the list',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ]),
            if (wedding != null) ...<Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 14),
              _roadStrip(mine, plan, wedding, nextSlug),
            ],
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext lc, BoxConstraints cons) {
              final int cols =
                  cons.maxWidth >= 860 ? 6 : (cons.maxWidth >= 560 ? 3 : 2);
              final double w = (cons.maxWidth - (cols - 1) * 8) / cols;
              // v117: phones fold the list - booked and next-up first, then
              // the rest behind "Show all".
              final bool phone = cols == 2;
              final List<Map<String, String>> ordered =
                  List<Map<String, String>>.from(mine);
              if (phone && !_teamExpanded) {
                int rank(Map<String, String> c) {
                  final String st =
                      (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
                  if (c['slug'] == nextSlug) return 0;
                  if (st == 'booked') return 1;
                  if ((talking[c['slug']] ?? 0) > 0) return 2;
                  return 3;
                }

                ordered.sort((Map<String, String> a, Map<String, String> b) =>
                    rank(a).compareTo(rank(b)));
              }
              final List<Map<String, String>> shown =
                  phone && !_teamExpanded ? ordered.take(4).toList() : ordered;
              return Column(children: <Widget>[
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final Map<String, String> c in shown)
                      SizedBox(
                          width: w,
                          child: _teamTile(
                              c,
                              plan[c['slug']] ?? <String, dynamic>{},
                              talking[c['slug']] ?? 0,
                              c['slug'] == nextSlug,
                              wedding,
                              couple)),
                  ],
                ),
                if (phone && mine.length > 4)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
                    child: SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                            side:  BorderSide(color: _lzLine(goldLine)),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11)),
                        onPressed: _h(() =>
                            setState(() => _teamExpanded = !_teamExpanded)),
                        icon: Icon(
                            _teamExpanded
                                ? Icons.expand_less_rounded
                                : Icons.expand_more_rounded,
                            size: 18),
                        label: Text(
                            _teamExpanded
                                ? 'Show fewer'
                                : 'Show all ${mine.length}',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ]);
            }),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                    wedding == null
                        ? 'Set your date and each one shows when couples here usually book it.'
                        : 'Grey months are when couples usually book each one - nothing here is late unless it says so.',
                    style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() => _openBrowse(
                    metro: (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                        ? _browseMetro
                        : couple['metroId'].toString())),
                child:  Text('Browse verified vendors \u2192',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ]),
          ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _teamTile(Map<String, String> c, Map<String, dynamic> p, int talking,
      bool isNext, DateTime? wedding, Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
    final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
    final bool booked = st == 'booked';
    final String vn = (p['vendorName'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    final DateTime? by = _dueFor(slug, wedding);
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final bool late =
        !booked && by != null && by.isBefore(DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1));
    String sub;
    Widget pill;
    if (booked) {
      sub = vn.isEmpty ? 'Booked' : vn;
      pill = (p['contractUrl'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
          ? Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
              _pill('Booked', vGreen),
              const SizedBox(width: 6),
              _Press(
                  scale: .985,
                  dim: .92,
                  onTap: () => _openLink(p['contractUrl'].toString()),
                  child: _pill('Contract', plum)),
            ])
          : _pill('Booked', vGreen);
    } else if (talking > 0) {
      sub = '$talking in conversation';
      pill = _pill(isNext ? 'Next up' : 'Talking', isNext ? gold : plum);
    } else if (_recFor(slug) != null) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = _recFor(slug)!;
      sub = '${r['fromVendorName']} recommends ${r['name']}';
      pill = _pill('Recommended', plum);
    } else if (isNext) {
      sub = 'Start here';
      pill = _pill('Next up', gold);
    } else {
      sub = 'Not started';
      pill = by == null
          ? _pill('Anytime', muted)
          : _pill(late ? 'Running late' : 'From ${_kMo[by.month - 1]}',
              late ? const Color(0xFFB04343) : muted);
    }
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () {
        if (booked) {
          setState(() => _view = _View.vendors);
        } else if (talking == 0 && _recFor(slug) != null) {
          _checkDateWithRec(_recFor(slug)!);
        } else {
          _openBrowse(
              metro: (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty
                  ? _browseMetro
                  : couple['metroId'].toString(),
              category: slug);
        }
      },
      child: Container(
        constraints: const BoxConstraints(minHeight: 100),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 11, 12, 10),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(booked
              ? const Color(0xFFF1F8F4)
              : (isNext ? const Color(0xFFFBF4E4) : ivory)),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border:
              Border.all(color: _lzLine(booked ? vGreen : (isNext ? gold : goldLine))),
        ),
        child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              const SizedBox(height: 3),
              Text(sub,
                  maxLines: 2,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  style:  TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13.5,
                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      height: 1.25)),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              pill,
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // The road: one strip from this month to the wedding, each vendor placed
  // on the month couples usually book it. Their whole plan, in a glance.
  Widget _roadStrip(
      List<Map<String, String>> mine,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan,
      DateTime wedding,
      String nextSlug) {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime start = DateTime(now.year, now.month, 1);
    final DateTime end = DateTime(wedding.year, wedding.month, 1);
    int months = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month) + 1;
    if (months < 1) months = 1;
    if (months > 16) months = 16;
    final DateTime first =
        months == 16 ? DateTime(end.year, end.month - 15, 1) : start;
    final Map<String, List<Map<String, String>>> byMonth =
        <String, List<Map<String, String>>>{};
    final List<Map<String, String>> earlier = <Map<String, String>>[];
    for (final Map<String, String> c in mine) {
      final DateTime? by = _dueFor(c['slug'] ?? '', wedding);
      if (by == null) continue;
      if (by.isBefore(first)) {
        earlier.add(c);
        continue;
      }
      final String k = '${by.year}-${by.month}';
      byMonth.putIfAbsent(k, () => <Map<String, String>>[]).add(c);
    }
    Color dotColor(Map<String, String> c) {
      final String st = (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
      if (st == 'booked') return vGreen;
      if (c['slug'] == nextSlug) return gold;
      return muted.withOpacity(.45);
    }

    return SizedBox(
      height: 92,
      child: ListView(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        children: <Widget>[
          if (earlier.isNotEmpty)
            _roadCol('Overdue', earlier, (Map<String, String> c) {
              final String st =
                  (plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
              return st == 'booked' ? vGreen : const Color(0xFFB04343);
            }, false, false, overdue: true),
          for (int i = 0; i < months; i++)
            Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
              final DateTime m = DateTime(first.year, first.month + i, 1);
              final bool isNow = m.year == now.year && m.month == now.month;
              final bool isWedding = m.year == end.year && m.month == end.month;
              return _roadCol(
                  '${_kMo[m.month - 1]}${m.month == 1 || i == 0 ? ' ${m.year.toString().substring(2)}' : ''}',
                  byMonth['${m.year}-${m.month}'] ??
                      const <Map<String, String>>[],
                  dotColor,
                  isNow,
                  isWedding);
            }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  static const Map<String, String> _kShortLabel = <String, String>{
    'Photographer': 'Photo',
    'Videographer': 'Video',
    'Cake & Desserts': 'Cake',
    'Hair & Makeup': 'Hair & makeup',
    'Transportation': 'Transport',
    'Live Band': 'Band',
    'Invitations': 'Invites',
    'Day-Of Coordinator': 'Day-of coord.',
  };

  // Which vendors do they actually need? Their list, saved as plan status.
  Future<void> _editWantedSheet(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    final Set<String> wanted = <String>{
      for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
        if ((plan[c['slug']]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString() != 'skipped')
          c['slug'] ?? ''
    };
    if (!mounted) return;
    bool saving = false;
    String err = '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          Future<void> save() async {
            setD(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
              for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
                final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                final String cur =
                    (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? 'needed').toString();
                if (cur == 'booked') continue;
                final String next = wanted.contains(slug)
                    ? (cur == 'skipped' ? 'needed' : cur)
                    : 'skipped';
                if (next != cur) {
                  b.set(
                      _planRef.doc(slug),
                      <String, dynamic>{
                        'status': next,
                        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                      },
                      SetOptions(merge: true));
                }
              }
              await b.commit();
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
            } catch (_) {
              if (ctx2.mounted) {
                setD(() {
                  saving = false;
                  err = 'Couldn\u2019t save just now. Check your connection and try again.';
                });
              }
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.checklist_rounded,
              title: 'Which vendors do you need?',
              subtitle: 'Tap to add or remove. Booked vendors stay either way.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
                      Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                        final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                        final bool booked =
                            (plan[slug]?['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
                        final bool on = wanted.contains(slug) || booked;
                        return FilterChip(
                          label: Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5,
                                  color: _lzFg(on ? ivory : plum),
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                          selected: on,
                          selectedColor: plum,
                          checkmarkColor: gold,
                          backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                          side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                          tooltip: booked ? 'Booked' : null,
                          onSelected: _hb(booked || saving
                              ? null
                              : (bool v) => setD(() {
                                    if (v) {
                                      wanted.add(slug);
                                    } else {
                                      wanted.remove(slug);
                                    }
                                  })),
                        );
                      }),
                  ],
                ),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary:
                      'Save my ${wanted.length} vendor${wanted.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: save));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: WEBSITE + BUDGET, AT A GLANCE ----------------
  Widget _websiteMini(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery(
          'site:$_cid',
          () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('weddingSites')
              .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
              .limit(1)),
      initialData: _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? doc =
            (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                    .isEmpty
                ? null
                : s.data!.docs.first;
        final Map<String, dynamic> w = doc?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final List<String> fields = <String>[
          'names',
          'story',
          'venueName',
          'receptionTime',
          'travelNotes',
          'siteGallery',
          'template'
        ];
        int done = 0;
        for (final String f in fields) {
          final dynamic v = w[f];
          if (v is List ? v.isNotEmpty : (v ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
            done++;
        }
        final int pct =
            doc == null ? 0 : ((done / fields.length) * 100).round();
        final String slug = doc?.id ?? '';
        return _Press(
          scale: .985,
          dim: .92,
          onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.website),
          child: _glass(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 16, 20, 16),
            child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Text('Your website', style: _serif(size: 22)),
                  Text(
                      slug.isEmpty
                          ? 'Free, live in minutes, no ads'
                          : 'meetlazo.com/w/$slug',
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                    child: SizedBox(
                        height: 8,
                        child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                            value: pct / 100,
                            backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFEFE6D8),
                            valueColor:
                                const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(gold))),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                      textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                      children: <Widget>[
                        Text('$pct%', style: _serif(size: 22, height: 1)),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                         Text('complete',
                            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                        if (doc != null) ...<Widget>[
                          const SizedBox(width: 16),
                          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                            stream: _liveQuery(
                                'rsvp:$slug',
                                () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                                    .collection('weddingSites')
                                    .doc(slug)
                                    .collection('rsvps')),
                            initialData: _liveQ['rsvp:$slug']?.latest,
                            builder: (BuildContext c2,
                                AsyncSnapshot<
                                        QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                                    r) {
                              final int n = r.data?.docs.length ?? 0;
                              return Row(
                                  crossAxisAlignment:
                                      CrossAxisAlignment.baseline,
                                  textBaseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                    Text('$n',
                                        style: _serif(size: 22, height: 1)),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                    Text('RSVP${n == 1 ? '' : 's'} in',
                                        style:  TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                  ]);
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                      doc == null
                          ? 'Type your names and watch it come alive. Guests RSVP right on it.'
                          : pct >= 100
                              ? 'Done. Share it, and every RSVP lands here.'
                              : 'Add your story and where to stay, then share it.',
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
                ]),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // Budget as a plan: each vendor line against what it really costs in
  // their metro (metroStats.priceFrom, written nightly from Lazo listings).
  Widget _budgetLine(
      Map<String, String> c, Map<String, dynamic> p, String metro) {
    final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
    final num plannedN =
        p['budgetPlanned'] is num ? p['budgetPlanned'] as num : 0;
    final num actualN = p['budgetActual'] is num ? p['budgetActual'] as num : 0;
    final bool booked = (p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
    final String key = '${metro}__$slug';
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: metro.isEmpty
          ? const Stream<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>.empty()
          : _liveDoc(
              'ms:$key',
              () =>
                  FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('metroStats').doc(key)),
      initialData: metro.isEmpty ? null : _liveD['ms:$key']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c2,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> ms = s.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final Map<String, dynamic> pf = ms['priceFrom'] is Map
            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(ms['priceFrom'] as Map)
            : <String, dynamic>{};
        String range = '';
        if (pf['p25'] is num && pf['p75'] is num) {
          range =
              'here: from ${_railMoney((pf['p25'] as num).toDouble())}\u2013${_railMoney((pf['p75'] as num).toDouble())}';
        }
        return Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 7),
          decoration:  BoxDecoration(
              border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(Color(0xFFF0E8DD))))),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 13.5,
                            color: _lzFg(ink),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                    if (range.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(range,
                          style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ]),
            ),
            Text(
                booked && actualN > 0
                    ? _railMoney(actualN.toDouble())
                    : (plannedN > 0
                        ? _railMoney(plannedN.toDouble())
                        : '\u2014'),
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13.5,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                    color: _lzFg(booked ? vGreen : plum))),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Text(booked ? 'paid' : (plannedN > 0 ? 'planned' : ''),
                style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
          ]),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // The old budget card, in a sheet - it already edits every line.
  Future<void> _budgetSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 720),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * .88),
        child: _lzFrame(ctx,
            icon: Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
            title: 'Budget',
            subtitle: 'What you planned and what\u2019s committed, line by line.',
            bodyPadding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 24),
            children: <Widget>[
              StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                stream: _liveQuery('plan:$_cid', () => _planRef),
                initialData: _liveQ['plan:$_cid']?.latest,
                builder: (BuildContext c2,
                    AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ps) {
                  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> livePlan =
                      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{
                    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                        in ps.data?.docs ??
                            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                      d.id: d.data()
                  };
                  return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                    stream: _liveDoc('couple:$_cid', () => _coupleRef),
                    builder: (BuildContext c3,
                        AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> cs) {
                      final Map<String, dynamic> liveCouple =
                          cs.data?.data() ?? couple;
                      return _budgetCard(liveCouple, livePlan);
                    },
                  );
                },
              ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- v91: SETUP, THE WAY JUNE WOULD ASK ----------------
  // v110: the pieces of setup still empty, in the order the sheet asks.
  List<String> _setupMissing(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return <String>[
      if ((couple['names'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty) 'your names',
      if (couple['weddingDate'] is! Timestamp) 'the date',
      if ((couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString().isEmpty) 'the city',
      if (!(couple['budgetTotal'] is num && (couple['budgetTotal'] as num) > 0))
        'a rough budget',
    ];
  }

                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plumDeep, fontSize: 12.5, height: 1.4)),

          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _setupSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final TextEditingController namesC =
        TextEditingController(text: (couple['names'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController budgetC = TextEditingController(
        text: couple['budgetTotal'] is num && (couple['budgetTotal'] as num) > 0
            ? (couple['budgetTotal'] as num).round().toString()
            : '');
    String metro = (couple['metroId'] ?? '').toString();
    String town = (couple['town'] ?? '').toString(); // v159
    DateTime? date = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp
        ? (couple['weddingDate'] as Timestamp).toDate()
        : null;
    final Set<String> wanted = <String>{
      'wedding-venues',
      'wedding-photographers',
      'wedding-djs',
      'wedding-florists',
      'hair-and-makeup',
      'day-of-coordination'
    };
    int step = 0;
    bool saving = false;
    String err = '';
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pq0 = await _planRef.get();
      final Set<String> fromPlan = <String>{
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pd in pq0.docs)
          if ((pd.data()['status'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty &&
              (pd.data()['status'] ?? '').toString() != 'skipped')
            pd.id
      };
      if (pq0.docs.isNotEmpty) {
        wanted
          ..clear()
          ..addAll(fromPlan);
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          // Title, then the one line that says why June asks.
          const List<List<String>> asks = <List<String>>[
            <String>['Who\u2019s getting married?', 'Your names, the way you\u2019d like them shown.'],
            <String>['When\u2019s the day?', 'A month is enough for now.'],
            <String>['Where?', 'The city sets who June can show you and what things cost.'],
            <String>['A rough budget', 'June uses it to keep proposals honest, not to judge.'],
            <String>['Which vendors do you need?', 'Tap to add or remove. You can change this any time.'],
          ];
          const List<IconData> stepIcons = <IconData>[
            Icons.favorite_rounded,
            Icons.event_rounded,
            Icons.place_rounded,
            Icons.account_balance_wallet_rounded,
            Icons.checklist_rounded,
          ];

          Future<void> next() async {
            if (step < asks.length - 1) {
              setD(() => step++);
              return;
            }
            setD(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              final double? b = double.tryParse(
                  budgetC.text.trim().replaceAll(',', ''));
              await _coupleRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
                if (namesC.text.trim().isNotEmpty) 'names': namesC.text.trim(),
                if (metro.isNotEmpty) 'metroId': metro,
                if (metro.isNotEmpty) 'town': town, // v159
                if (date != null) 'weddingDate': Timestamp.fromDate(date!),
                if (b != null && b > 0) 'budgetTotal': b,
                'setupDoneAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              }, SetOptions(merge: true));
              // v139: only categories with no plan
              // doc yet - reopening setup used to flip
              // a booked vendor back to "needed"
              final Set<String> hasPlan = <String>{};
              try {
                final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pq =
                    await _planRef.get();
                for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pd
                    in pq.docs) {
                  if (const <String>['booked', 'researching']
                      .contains((pd.data()['status'] ?? '').toString())) {
                    hasPlan.add(pd.id);
                  }
                }
              } catch (_) {}
              final WriteBatch wb = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
              for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
                final String slug = c['slug'] ?? '';
                if (hasPlan.contains(slug)) {
                  continue;
                }
                wb.set(
                    _planRef.doc(slug),
                    <String, dynamic>{
                      'status': wanted.contains(slug) ? 'needed' : 'skipped'
                    },
                    SetOptions(merge: true));
              }
              await wb.commit();
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
            } catch (e) {
              if (ctx2.mounted) {
                setD(() {
                  saving = false;
                  err = 'Couldn\u2019t save just now. Check your connection and try again.';
                });
              }
            }
          }

          Widget body;
          if (step == 0) {
            body = TextField(
                controller: namesC,
                autofocus: true,
                textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                onSubmitted: (String _) => next(),
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Your names', hint: 'Mindy and John'));
          } else if (step == 1) {
            body = OutlinedButton.icon(
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                  side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 16),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14))),
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
                    context: ctx2,
                    initialDate:
                        date ?? DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 300)),
                    firstDate: (date != null && date!.isBefore(DateTime.now()))
                        ? date!
                        : DateTime.now(),
                    lastDate:
                        DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 365 * 4)));
                if (picked != null) setD(() => date = picked);
              }),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.event_rounded, size: 18),
              label: Text(date == null ? 'Pick the date' : _longDate(date!),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            );
          } else if (step == 2) {
            // v159: a search over every town and city, not a 45-row dropdown
            body = OutlinedButton.icon(
              style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                  side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                  alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 16),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14))),
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final Map<String, String>? p = await _pickPlace();
                if (p != null && (p['metro'] ?? '').isNotEmpty) {
                  setD(() {
                    metro = p['metro']!;
                    town = p['town'] ?? '';
                  });
                }
              }),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.place_rounded, size: 18),
              label: Text(
                  metro.isEmpty
                      ? 'Your town or city'
                      : (town.isNotEmpty
                          ? '$town · ${_metroLabel(metro)} area'
                          : _metroLabel(metro)),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            );
          } else if (step == 3) {
            body = TextField(
                controller: budgetC,
                autofocus: true,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                onSubmitted: (String _) => next(),
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 16),
                decoration: _lightDeco('Total budget',
                    hint: '25000', prefix: '\u0024 '));
          } else {
            body = Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
              for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories)
                FilterChip(
                  label: Text(c['label'] ?? '',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          color: _lzFg(wanted.contains(c['slug']) ? ivory : plum),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  selected: wanted.contains(c['slug']),
                  selectedColor: plum,
                  checkmarkColor: gold,
                  backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                  side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                  onSelected: _hb((bool v) => setD(() {
                        if (v) {
                          wanted.add(c['slug'] ?? '');
                        } else {
                          wanted.remove(c['slug']);
                        }
                      })),
                ),
            ]);
          }
          final bool lastStep = step == asks.length - 1;
          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: stepIcons[step],
              title: asks[step][0],
              subtitle: asks[step][1],
              headerExtra: Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(99),
                    child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                        value: (step + 1) / asks.length,
                        minHeight: 5,
                        backgroundColor: _lzLine(goldLine).withOpacity(.5),
                        valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(gold)),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Text('June \u00b7 ${step + 1} of ${asks.length}',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: _lzFg(muted),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
              ]),
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                KeyedSubtree(key: ValueKey<int>(step), child: body),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 14),
                  _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: step > 0 ? 'Back' : 'Not now',
                  onSecondary: step > 0
                      ? () => setD(() => step--)
                      : () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: lastStep ? 'Done' : 'Next',
                  icon: lastStep ? Icons.check_rounded : Icons.arrow_forward_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: next));
        },
      ),
    );
  }
