  Future<void> _partnerSheet(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final TextEditingController emailC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController codeC = TextEditingController();
    bool inviting = false, joining = false;
    String inviteErr = '', joinErr = '';
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 620),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setS) {
          void upd(VoidCallback f) {
            if (sc.mounted) setS(f);
          }

          final String em = emailC.text.trim().toLowerCase();
          final bool emailOk = em.contains('@');
          final String code =
              codeC.text.trim().toUpperCase().replaceAll(' ', '');

          Future<void> invite() async {
            if (!emailOk || inviting) return;
            upd(() {
              inviting = true;
              inviteErr = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('coupleInvites')
                  .add(<String, dynamic>{
                'coupleUid': _cid,
                'email': em,
                'code': _randomCode(6),
                'status': 'pending',
                'createdBy': _uid,
                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              });
              emailC.clear();
              upd(() => inviting = false);
              _toast('Invite created - send them the code.');
            } catch (e) {
              upd(() {
                inviting = false;
                inviteErr = 'Couldn\u2019t create the invite. Try again in a moment.';
              });
            }
          }

          Future<void> join() async {
            if (code.length < 4 || joining) return;
            upd(() {
              joining = true;
              joinErr = '';
            });
            try {
              final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
                  'redeemCoupleInvite',
                  options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                      timeout: const Duration(seconds: 30)));
              final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
                  await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{'code': code});
              final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                  Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
              final String cu = (r['coupleUid'] ?? '').toString();
              if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
              if (cu.isNotEmpty && mounted) {
                setState(() => _coupleIdCache = cu);
              }
              _toast('You\u2019re in - one plan, both of you.');
            } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
              upd(() {
                joining = false;
                joinErr = _lzFnMsg(e, 'That code did not work. Check it and try again.');
              });
            } catch (_) {
              upd(() {
                joining = false;
                joinErr = 'That code did not work.';
              });
            }
          }

          return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: _liveQuery(
                'cinv:$_cid',
                () => FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('coupleInvites')
                    .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)),
            initialData: _liveQ['cinv:$_cid']?.latest,
            builder: (BuildContext c2,
                AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
              final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
                  s.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
              return _lzFrame(sc,
                  icon: Icons.favorite_rounded,
                  title: 'Plan together',
                  subtitle: 'One plan and one inbox, for both of you.',
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _lzSection('Invite your partner'),
                    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                        in docs)
                      Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 6, 8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Icon(
                              (d.data()['status'] ?? 'pending') == 'accepted'
                                  ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                                  : Icons.hourglass_top_rounded,
                              size: 18,
                              color: (d.data()['status'] ?? 'pending') ==
                                      'accepted'
                                  ? vGreen
                                  : gold),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Text((d.data()['email'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                                          fontSize: 13.5,
                                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                                  Text(
                                      (d.data()['status'] ?? 'pending') ==
                                              'accepted'
                                          ? 'Joined'
                                          : 'Code ${(d.data()['code'] ?? '').toString()} - waiting for them',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                ]),
                          ),
                          if ((d.data()['status'] ?? 'pending') != 'accepted')
                            IconButton(
                              tooltip: 'Copy code',
                              icon: Icon(Icons.copy_rounded,
                                  color: _lzFg(plum), size: 18),
                              onPressed: _h(() async {
                                final String code = (d.data()['code'] ?? '').toString();
                                try {
                                  await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: code));
                                  _toast('Code copied');
                                } catch (_) {
                                  _toast('Couldn\u2019t copy it here. The code is $code - send it to your partner.');
                                }
                              }),
                            ),
                        ]),
                      ),
                    TextField(
                        controller: emailC,
                        enabled: !inviting,
                        keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                        textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                        onChanged: (String _) => upd(() {}),
                        onSubmitted: (String _) => invite(),
                        style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5),
                        decoration: _lightDeco('Their email',
                            hint: 'name@example.com')),
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    FilledButton.icon(
                      style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: gold,
                          foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                          disabledBackgroundColor: gold.withOpacity(.45),
                          disabledForegroundColor: plumDeep.withOpacity(.7),
                          elevation: 0,
                          minimumSize: const Size(0, 46),
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13))),
                      onPressed: _h(emailOk && !inviting ? invite : null,
                          _Tick.medium),
                      icon: inviting
                          ? const SizedBox(
                              width: 16,
                              height: 16,
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  strokeWidth: 2, color: plumDeep))
                          : const Icon(Icons.favorite_rounded, size: 17),
                      label: const Text('Invite my partner',
                          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                    if (inviteErr.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, inviteErr),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    _lzNote(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                        'They sign up at app.meetlazo.com with this email, then enter the code under Plan together.'),
                    _lzSection('Were you invited?'),
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: TextField(
                            controller: codeC,
                            enabled: !joining,
                            textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
                            textInputAction: TextInputAction.go,
                            onChanged: (String _) => upd(() {}),
                            onSubmitted: (String _) => join(),
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(ink),
                                fontSize: 16,
                                letterSpacing: 3,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
                            decoration: _lightDeco('Invite code')),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 10),
                      OutlinedButton(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: _lzFg(plum),
                            side: const BorderSide(color: gold),
                            minimumSize: const Size(0, 50),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13))),
                        onPressed: _h(code.length >= 4 && !joining ? join : null),
                        child: joining
                            ? SizedBox(
                                width: 16,
                                height: 16,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    strokeWidth: 2, color: _lzFg(plum)))
                            : const Text('Join',
                                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                    if (joinErr.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                      const SizedBox(height: 10),
                      _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, joinErr),
                    ],
                  ]);
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  String _randomCode(int n) {
    const String alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
    final math.Random r = math.Random.secure();
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      b.write(alphabet[r.nextInt(alphabet.length)]);
    }
    return b.toString();
  }

  Widget _msgHeaderButton() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _uid == null
          ? null
          : FirebaseFirestore.instance
              .collection('inquiries')
              .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
              .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        int attention = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
            in snap.data?.docs ??
                <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
          if ((m['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent' ||
              (m['questionnaireStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent' ||
              (m['invoiceStatus'] ?? '') == 'sent') {
            attention++;
          }
        }
        return _Press(
          scale: .92,
          onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.messages),
          child: Stack(
            clipBehavior: Clip.none,
            children: <Widget>[
              Container(
                width: 46,
                height: 46,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.14)),
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.8), width: 1.4),
                ),
                child: _Wiggle(
                    active: attention > 0,
                    child: const Icon(Icons.forum_rounded,
                        color: ivory, size: 21)),
              ),
              if (attention > 0)
                Positioned(
                  top: -3,
                  right: -3,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 6, vertical: 2.5),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      gradient: const LinearGradient(
                          colors: <Color>[gold, Color(0xFFC9A45C)]),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory), width: 1.5),
                    ),
                    child: Text('$attention',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: plum,
                            fontSize: 10.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  bool _planComplete(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, int booked) {
    bool bookedCat(String slug) =>
        ((plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['status'] ?? '') == 'booked';
    final bool hasDate = couple['weddingDate'] is Timestamp;
    final bool hasPhoto =
        couple['photoUrl'] != null && couple['photoUrl'].toString().isNotEmpty;
    final bool hasBudget = plan.values.any((Map<String, dynamic> p) =>
        p['budgetPlanned'] != null && ((p['budgetPlanned'] ?? 0) as num) > 0);
    final bool hasRegistry = couple['registryLinks'] is List &&
        (couple['registryLinks'] as List).isNotEmpty;
    return hasDate &&
        hasPhoto &&
        hasBudget &&
        hasRegistry &&
        bookedCat('wedding-venues') &&
        bookedCat('wedding-photographers') &&
        bookedCat('wedding-videographers') &&
        booked >= 5;
  }

  Future<void> _openSupportSheet() async {
    final User? u0 = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    if (u0 == null) return;
    final User u = u0;
    String cat = 'Report a vendor';
    final TextEditingController vendC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController subjC = TextEditingController();
    final TextEditingController msgC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    String err = '';
    const List<List<dynamic>> cats = <List<dynamic>>[
      <dynamic>['Report a vendor', Icons.flag_outlined],
      <dynamic>['Report a bug', Icons.bug_report_outlined],
      <dynamic>['Billing question', Icons.receipt_long_outlined],
      <dynamic>['Something else', Icons.help_outline_rounded],
    ];
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setD) {
          void upd(VoidCallback f) {
            if (sc.mounted) setD(f);
          }

          final bool ready =
              subjC.text.trim().isNotEmpty && msgC.text.trim().isNotEmpty;

          Future<void> send() async {
            upd(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('supportTickets')
                  .add(<String, dynamic>{
                'role': 'couple',
                'uid': u.uid,
                'email': u.email ?? '',
                'category': cat,
                'subject': subjC.text.trim(),
                'message': msgC.text.trim(),
                'vendorName': vendC.text.trim(),
                'status': 'open',
                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'context': <String, dynamic>{
                  'source': 'couple_dashboard',
                  'build': 'v158',
                },
              });
              if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
              _toastC('Ticket sent \u2713 We\u2019ll get back to you by email.');
            } catch (_) {
              upd(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'Couldn\u2019t send the ticket. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(sc,
              icon: Icons.support_agent_rounded,
              title: 'Support',
              subtitle: 'Tell us what happened. We\u2019ll reply by email.',
              children: <Widget>[
                _lzSection('What is this about?'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<dynamic> c in cats)
                    ChoiceChip(
                      avatar: Icon(c[1] as IconData,
                          size: 16, color: _lzFg(cat == c[0] ? ivory : plum)),
                      label: Text(c[0] as String,
                          style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              color: _lzFg(cat == c[0] ? ivory : plum),
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      selected: cat == c[0],
                      showCheckmark: false,
                      selectedColor: plum,
                      backgroundColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                      side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                      onSelected: busy
                          ? null
                          : _hb((bool _) => upd(() => cat = c[0] as String)),
                    ),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (cat == 'Report a vendor') ...<Widget>[
                  TextField(
                    controller: vendC,
                    enabled: !busy,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.words,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    cursorColor: _lzFg(plum),
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Which vendor?'),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ],
                TextField(
                  controller: subjC,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                  onChanged: (String _) => upd(() {}),
                  cursorColor: _lzFg(plum),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Subject'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                  controller: msgC,
                  enabled: !busy,
                  minLines: 4,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  onChanged: (String _) => upd(() {}),
                  cursorColor: _lzFg(plum),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Tell us what happened'),
                ),
                if (err.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  _lzNote(Icons.error_outline_rounded, err),
                ],
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(sc),
                  primary: busy ? 'Sending\u2026' : 'Send',
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: ready ? send : null));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  // Hellos: one writer for the switch and the row alike. Firestore's local
  // write lands before the round trip, so the switch slides the moment it is
  // tapped and the couple doc stays the single source of truth.
  Future<void> _setHellos(bool on) async {
    await _coupleRef
        .set(<String, dynamic>{'hellosOk': on}, SetOptions(merge: true));
    _toastC(on
        ? 'Hellos are on.'
        : 'Hellos are off - vendors only reply when you write first.');
  }

  // Every on/off control in this widget. Green track when on, grey when off -
  // the one thing that reads as 'on' from across the room. Defined once so the
  // four switches cannot drift into three different looks again.
  Widget _lazoSwitch({
    required bool value,
    required ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged,
  }) {
    return Switch(
      value: value,
      activeColor: Colors.white,
      activeTrackColor: vGreen,
      inactiveThumbColor: Colors.white,
      inactiveTrackColor: muted.withOpacity(.4),
      onChanged: onChanged,
    );
  }

  // The photo, framed: a gold ring, a hairline of plum between ring and
  // picture the way a real frame has a mat, a warm halo underneath, and a
  // camera badge in the corner. The badge is the affordance everyone already

                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  colors: <Color>[_lzBg(Color(0xFFF7E3B4)), gold, Color(0xFFA9843F)],
                ),
                boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: gold.withOpacity(.30),
                      blurRadius: 36,
                      spreadRadius: -4,

  // One group: a small caps label and a single card holding its rows, split
  // by hairlines inset past the icon column. Three of these replace eight
  // free-floating cards, and three shadows replace eight.
  Widget _accountGroup({required String label, required List<Widget> rows}) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 18),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: <Widget>[
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 14, bottom: 8),
            child: Text(label,
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: gold.withOpacity(.85),
                    fontSize: 10,
                    letterSpacing: 2,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          ),
          Container(
            clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(.96)),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.30),
                    blurRadius: 26,
                    spreadRadius: -6,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 12)),
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.16),
                    blurRadius: 6,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 2)),
              ],
            ),
            child: Column(children: <Widget>[
              for (int i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
                if (i > 0)
                   Padding(
                    // 14 padding + 40 tile + 12 gap: the line starts where
                    // the text does, not under the icon.
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 66),
                    child: Divider(height: 1, thickness: 1, color: _lzLine(goldLine)),
                  ),
                rows[i],
              ],
            ]),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // The icon tile: same build as the gold disc - a lit rim, a face that falls
  // away from the light, a soft specular - so it reads as enamel set into the
  // card rather than a printed square.
  Widget _accountIconTile(IconData icon) {
    return Container(
      width: 40,
      height: 40,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
          colors: <Color>[gold.withOpacity(.75), plumDeep.withOpacity(.35)],
        ),
        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
          BoxShadow(
              color: plumDeep.withOpacity(.30),
              blurRadius: 9,
              spreadRadius: -1,
              offset: const Offset(0, 3)),
        ],
      ),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(1), // the rim
      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topLeft,
            end: Alignment.bottomRight,
            colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF63325F), plumDeep],
            stops: <double>[0, .85],
          ),
        ),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.center,
          children: <Widget>[
            Positioned.fill(
              child: DecoratedBox(
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  gradient: RadialGradient(
                    center: const Alignment(-.55, -.65),
                    radius: 1,
                    colors: <Color>[
                      _lzBg(Colors.white).withOpacity(.16),
                      _lzBg(Colors.white).withOpacity(0),
                    ],
                    stops: const <double>[0, .75],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            Icon(icon, color: gold, size: 19),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // One row inside a group. No card of its own any more - the group is the
  // card. Title leads (14 bold plum); the detail line sits under it, smaller
  // and quieter, which is the hierarchy the old row had upside down.

  // JC-LAZO-THEME-1009-001: light / dark / auto, remembered on this device
  void _lzLoadTheme() {
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((SharedPreferences p) {
      final String? v = p.getString('lazo_theme');
      if (v != null && v != _lzThemePref && mounted) {
        setState(() => _lzThemePref = v);
      }
    }).catchError((_) {});
  }

  void _lzSetTheme(String v) {
    if (v == _lzThemePref) return;
    HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
    setState(() => _lzThemePref = v);
    SharedPreferences.getInstance()
        .then((SharedPreferences p) => p.setString('lazo_theme', v))
        .catchError((_) => true);
  }

          _accountIconTile(icon),

                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

      ),

  }

              width: 44,
              height: 44,

                  width: 40,
                  height: 40,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    // Light from above: near-white at the top edge, falling to
                    // a warmer ivory at the bottom. A flat 70% white disc had
                    // no direction to it at all.
                    gradient:  LinearGradient(

                      end: Alignment.bottomCenter,

                        _lzBg(Color(0xFFFFFFFF)),

                          color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.16),
                          blurRadius: 3,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 1)),
                    ],
                  ),
                  child:  Icon(Icons.arrow_back_rounded,
                      color: _lzFg(plum), size: 20),
                ),
              ),
            ),

          Expanded(

                style: const TextStyle(
                    color: ivory, fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),

  // v140: the top of the ranking for the current metro + category, fetched
  // once per pair and merged into the unordered page so the best vendors
  // are never the ones the 60-limit dropped. Needs the composite index
  // vendors(metroId, categories contains, score desc); without it the
  // query fails quietly and Browse behaves as before.
  final Map<String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>
      _topScored = <String, List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>>{};
  final Set<String> _topScoredBusy = <String>{};

  void _ensureTopScored(String metro, String cat) {
    final String key = '$metro|$cat';
    if (metro.isEmpty ||
        cat.isEmpty ||
        _topScored.containsKey(key) ||
        _topScoredBusy.contains(key)) {
      return;
    }
    _topScoredBusy.add(key);
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('vendors')
        .where('metroId', isEqualTo: metro)
        .where('categories', arrayContains: cat)
        .orderBy('score', descending: true)
        .limit(24)
        .get()
        .then((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> q) {
      _topScored[key] = q.docs;
      _topScoredBusy.remove(key);
      if (mounted) setState(() {});
    }).catchError((Object e) {
      _topScored[key] = <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
      _topScoredBusy.remove(key);
      debugPrint('LAZO top-scored: ' + e.toString());
    });
  }

  StreamSubscription<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>? _inqSub;
  List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> _inqDocs =
      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
  Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _lastPlanForSync =
      <String, Map<String, dynamic>>{};

  void _ensureInquiryListener() {
    if (_inqSub != null || _uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    _inqSub = FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
        .snapshots()
        .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      _inqDocs = snap.docs;
      // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-1011-V151: the cache's first answer is not the truth
      if (!snap.metadata.isFromCache) _maybeCelebrateBooking(snap.docs);
      _runBookedSync(_lastPlanForSync);
    });
  }

  // ---------------- v60: NEW BOOKING CELEBRATION ----------------

  // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-1011-V151: once per booking, ever. Keyed by inquiry id on
  // the couple's doc; the first run baselines silently; the set only grows.
  Future<void> _maybeCelebrateBooking(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) async {
    if (_uid == null || _bookingCelebrateBusy) {
      return;
    }
    final List<String> booked = <String>[];
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> inq = d.data();
      final bool isBooked = (inq['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' ||
          inq['bookedAt'] != null ||
          (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'signed';
      if (isBooked) booked.add(d.id);
    }
    _bookingCelebrateBusy = true;
    try {
      final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> cRef =
          FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('couples').doc(_cid);
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cSnap = await cRef.get();
      final Map<String, dynamic> cd = cSnap.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
      final dynamic raw = cd['celebratedBookingIds'];
      if (raw is! List) {
        // First run (or a plan from before ids): baseline silently - no
        // confetti for history. Keeps the old count in step for older builds.
        await cRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
          'celebratedBookingIds': booked,
          'celebratedBookings': booked.length,
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
        return;
      }
      final Set<String> seen = raw.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()).toSet();
      final List<String> fresh =
          booked.where((String id) => !seen.contains(id)).toList();
      if (fresh.isEmpty) return;
      await cRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
        'celebratedBookingIds': FieldValue.arrayUnion(fresh),
        'celebratedBookings': seen.length + fresh.length,
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      if (mounted) {
        _fireBookingCelebration();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO booking celebrate: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      _bookingCelebrateBusy = false;
    }
  }

  void _fireBookingCelebration() {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    setState(() => _bookingBannerUp = true);
    _celebrate();
    _bookingBannerT?.cancel();
    _bookingBannerT = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 7), () {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _bookingBannerUp = false);
      }
    });
  }

  void _syncBookedFromInquiries(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    _lastPlanForSync = plan;
    _ensureInquiryListener();
    _runBookedSync(plan);
  }

  void _runBookedSync(Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan) {
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in _inqDocs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> inq = d.data();
      final bool isBooked = (inq['status'] ?? '') == 'booked' ||
          inq['bookedAt'] != null ||
          (inq['contractStatus'] ?? '') == 'signed';
      if (!isBooked) {
        continue;
      }
      final Map<String, dynamic> intent = inq['structuredIntent'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(inq['structuredIntent'] as Map)
          : <String, dynamic>{};
      final String slug = (intent['category'] ?? '').toString();
      if (slug.isEmpty) {
        continue;
      }
      final String planStatus =
          ((plan[slug] ?? const <String, dynamic>{})['status'] ?? '')
              .toString();
      if (planStatus == 'booked' || _autoSyncInFlight.contains(slug)) {
        continue;
      }
      final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? '').toString();
      _autoSyncInFlight.add(slug);
      _planRef.doc(slug).set(<String, dynamic>{
        'status': 'booked',
        'vendorName': vn,
        'vendorId': inq['vendorId'],
        'autoBookedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true)).then((_) {
        _autoSyncInFlight.remove(slug);
        String label = slug;
        for (final Map<String, String> c in kCategories) {
          if (c['slug'] == slug) {
            label = c['label']!;
          }
        }
        _bookedShareSnack('$vn is booked \u2713',
            'Just booked our $label \u2014 $vn! \u{1F389}');
      }).catchError((Object e) {
        _autoSyncInFlight.remove(slug);
      });
    }
  }

  Widget _categoryRow({
    required String slug,
    required String label,
    required Map<String, dynamic> data,
    required String metroId,
  }) {
    final status = (data['status'] as String?) ?? 'needed';
    final vendorName = (data['vendorName'] as String?) ?? '';
    final planned = data['budgetPlanned'] as num?;
    final Map<String, List<dynamic>> chip = {
      'needed': [const Color(0xFFEDE4EE), plum, 'Needed'],
      'researching': [
        gold.withOpacity(.25),
        const Color(0xFF8A6A2F),
        'Researching'
      ],
      'booked': [vGreen.withOpacity(.15), vGreen, 'Booked \u2713'],
      'skipped': [const Color(0xFFE8E4EA), const Color(0xFF8A7D90), 'Skipped'],
    };
    final c = chip[status] ?? chip['needed']!;
    final isBooked = status == 'booked';
    final isSkipped = status == 'skipped';

    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 13),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(isSkipped ? .55 : .93)),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        border: Border.all(
            color: _lzLine(isBooked ? vGreen.withOpacity(.5) : gold.withOpacity(.5))),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: _Press(
              tick: _Tick.select,
              onTap: () => _editVendor(slug, label, data),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(label,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(isSkipped ? const Color(0xFF8A7D90) : plum),
                          fontSize: 15.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                          decoration:
                              isSkipped ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null)),
                  if (vendorName.isNotEmpty || planned != null)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: Text(
                        [
                          if (vendorName.isNotEmpty) vendorName,
                          if (planned != null)
                            '\$${planned.toStringAsFixed(0)}',
                        ].join(' \u00b7 '),
                        style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          if (!isBooked && !isSkipped)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: _h(() => _openBrowse(category: slug, metro: metroId)),
              child:  Text('Find one \u2192',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(plum),
                      fontSize: 12.5,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          _Press(
            tick: _Tick.select,
            onTap: () => _cycleStatus(slug, status),
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 7),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(c[0] as Color),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
              ),
              child: Text(c[2] as String,
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(c[1] as Color),
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---------------- IN-APP BROWSE ----------------

  // v132: the whole page scrolls.
  //
  // This was a Column ending in Expanded(child: ListView), so the filters were
  // fixed furniture and only the results moved. Twelve category chips plus
  // seven refine chips is six or seven rows on a phone, which left the vendor
  // list a sliver at the bottom behind the June bar - and nothing above it
  // could be scrolled out of the way. The page reads as frozen because the one
  // part that can scroll has no room to.
  Widget _browseScreen() {
    return ListView(
      // Clears the Ask June bar and the desk button, both of which float over
      // this screen.
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 104),
      children: <Widget>[
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),
          child: _subHeader('Find vendors'),
        ),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _browseField(
            // v159: every Lazo city and town, as a search
            child: InkWell(
              onTap: _h(() async {
                final Map<String, String>? p =
                    await _pickPlace(title: 'Find vendors near…');
                if (p != null && (p['metro'] ?? '').isNotEmpty) {
                  setState(() => _browseMetro = p['metro']!);
                }
              }),
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                        _metroLabel(_browseMetro).isEmpty
                            ? _browseMetro
                            : _metroLabel(_browseMetro),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 15,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  ),
                  const Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: gold, size: 20),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: TextField(
            controller: _vSearchC,
            cursorColor: _lzFg(plum),
            onChanged: (s) {
              _bDebounce?.cancel();
              _bDebounce = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 350), () {
                _runBrowseSearch();
              });
            },
            style: TextStyle(color: ivory.withOpacity(.95), fontSize: 14.5),
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              hintText:
                  'Search by name \u2014 find anyone, even someone you\u2019ve hired',
              hintStyle: TextStyle(color: ivory.withOpacity(.55), fontSize: 13),
              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search_rounded,
                  color: ivory.withOpacity(.8), size: 20),
              suffixIcon: _bQuery.isEmpty
                  ? null
                  : IconButton(
                      icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.8), size: 18),
                      onPressed: _h(() {
                        _bDebounce?.cancel();
                        _vSearchC.clear();
                        setState(() {
                          _bQuery = '';
                          _bResults = [];
                          _bSearching = false;
                        });
                      }),
                    ),
              isDense: true,
              filled: true,
              fillColor: const Color(0xFF2E1530).withOpacity(.55),
              contentPadding:
                  const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
              border: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              ),
              enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
              ),
              focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                borderSide: const BorderSide(color: plum, width: 1.3),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        // Was twelve category chips over five rows.
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _browseField(
            child: DropdownButtonHideUnderline(
              child: DropdownButton<String>(
                value: _browseCat,
                isExpanded: true,
                dropdownColor: _lzBg(ivory),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded, color: gold),
                selectedItemBuilder: (BuildContext c) => kCategories
                    .map((Map<String, String> m) => Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        child: Text(m['label']!,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                                color: ivory,
                                fontSize: 15,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600))))
                    .toList(),
                style:  TextStyle(
                    color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 15, fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                items: kCategories
                    .map((Map<String, String> m) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                        value: m['slug'], child: Text(m['label']!)))
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: (String? v) =>
                    setState(() => _browseCat = v ?? _browseCat),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 10),
        // Was seven refine chips over three rows. Not a DropdownButton,
        // because four of these are independent toggles and a dropdown cannot
        // show a multiple selection honestly - so the field opens a sheet and
        // reads back whatever is on.
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 18),
          child: _refineField(),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        Builder(
          builder: (BuildContext _) => _bQuery.length >= 2
              ? _browseSearchResults()
              : StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                  stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('vendors')
                      .where('metroId', isEqualTo: _browseMetro)
                      .where('categories', arrayContains: _browseCat)
                      .limit(60)
                      .snapshots(),
                  builder: (context, snap) {
                    if (snap.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                      return const Center(
                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: gold));
                    }
                    if (snap.hasError) {
                      return  Center(
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: EdgeInsets.all(24),
                          child: Text(
                              'Could not load vendors - try again shortly.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13)),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    _ensureTopScored(_browseMetro, _browseCat);
                    final Set<String> seenIds = <String>{};
                    final docs = <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
                      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                          in <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
                        ...(_topScored['$_browseMetro|$_browseCat'] ??
                            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]),
                        ...(snap.data?.docs ??
                            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[]),
                      ])
                        if (seenIds.add(d.id)) d
                    ];
                    docs.sort((a, b) {
                      final sa = ((a.data()['score'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
                      final sb = ((b.data()['score'] ?? 0) as num).toDouble();
                      return sb.compareTo(sa);
                    });
                    final String priceLine = _priceTransparency(docs);
                    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                        shown = docs
                            .where((d) => _passesBrowseFilters(d.data()))
                            .toList();
                    if (shown.isEmpty) {
                      return Center(
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                          child: Text(
                              docs.isEmpty
                                  ? 'No vendors here yet \u2014 more metros soon.'
                                  : 'No matches for those filters \u2014 loosen one and more appear.',
                              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Color(0xFFD9C7D6), fontSize: 13.5)),
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                    return Column(children: <Widget>[
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),
                        child: Text(_browseHeadline(shown.length),
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12,
                                color: ivory.withOpacity(.72),
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                      ),
                      if (priceLine.isNotEmpty)
                        Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 6, 18, 2),
                          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                            const Icon(Icons.payments_rounded,
                                color: gold, size: 13),
                            const SizedBox(width: 5),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(priceLine,
                                  style: const TextStyle(
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      color: gold,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                            ),
                          ]),
                        ),
                      // Plain children, not a nested ListView: this whole
                      // screen is the scrollable now, and a scroll view inside
                      // a scroll view is what stops either one working.
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 0),
                        child: Column(
                            children: shown
                                .map(
                                    (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>
                                            d) =>
                                        _vendorBrowseCard(d.data()))
                                .toList()),
                      ),
                    ]);
                  },
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // The metro dropdown's shell, lifted out so the category and refine fields
  // are the same object and the three line up down the screen.
  Widget _browseField({required Widget child}) => Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF2E1530).withOpacity(.55),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.45)),
        ),
        child: child,
      );

  // What the refine field says when it is shut. Naming the one or two active
  // filters beats a count - 'Under $2k - Deals' tells you what you did, '2
  // filters' makes you open it to find out.
  List<String> get _activeRefinements => <String>[
        if (_fPrice == 1) 'Under \u00242k',
        if (_fPrice == 2) '\u00242\u20135k',
        if (_fPrice == 3) '\u00245k+',
        if (_fWoman) 'Woman-led',
        if (_fLgbtq) 'LGBTQ+ owned',
        if (_fDeals) 'Deals',
        if (_fTop) 'Top rated',
      ];

  Widget _refineField() {
    final List<String> on = _activeRefinements;
    final String label = on.isEmpty
        ? 'All vendors'
        : (on.length <= 2 ? on.join('  \u00b7  ') : '${on.length} filters');
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: 1,
      tick: _Tick.select,
      tickOnDown: true,
      onTap: _refineSheet,
      child: _browseField(
        child: SizedBox(
          height: 48,

                      fontSize: 15,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
            ),

              _Press(
                scale: .85,
                onTap: () => setState(() {
                  _fPrice = 0;
                  _fWoman = false;
                  _fLgbtq = false;
                  _fDeals = false;

            const Icon(Icons.expand_more_rounded, color: gold),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
