  // Blocking is reversible on purpose - someone who blocks in anger should be
  // able to undo it. The conversation is kept either way; it is not ours to
  // delete, and if they later report, it is the evidence.
  Future<void> _confirmBlock(BuildContext threadCtx, String inquiryId,
      Map<String, dynamic> inq, bool currentlyBlocked) async {
    final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? 'this vendor').toString();
    final bool unblocking = currentlyBlocked;
    final bool sure = await _lzConfirm(
        unblocking ? 'Unblock $vn?' : 'Block $vn?',
        unblocking
            ? 'They can reply in this conversation again, and they show up in your search.'
            : 'They can\u2019t message you again. The conversation leaves your inbox and they leave your search. You can undo this any time.',
        confirm: unblocking ? 'Unblock' : 'Block vendor',
        cancel: 'Cancel',
        danger: !unblocking,
        icon: unblocking ? Icons.lock_open_rounded : Icons.block_rounded);
    if (!sure) return;

    try {
      await FirebaseFunctions.instance
          .httpsCallable('blockVendor')
          .call(<String, dynamic>{
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'blocked': !unblocking,
      });
    } on FirebaseFunctionsException catch (e) {
      _toast(_lzFnMsg(e, 'Could not update that just now. Try again in a moment.'));
      return;
    } catch (_) {
      _toast('Could not update that just now.');
      return;
    }

    if (!mounted) return;
    if (unblocking) {
      _toast('$vn is unblocked.');
      return;
    }
    // Close the thread: it has just left the inbox, so leaving it open would
    // show a conversation that is no longer in the list behind it.
    if (Navigator.of(threadCtx).canPop()) Navigator.pop(threadCtx);
    _toast('$vn is blocked. They cannot message you again.');
  }

  // Reporting queues the case for the Lazo team AND blocks immediately -
  // nobody should have to wait on a human before the messages stop.
  Future<void> _reportSheet(BuildContext threadCtx, String inquiryId,
      Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? 'this vendor').toString();
    String reason = '';
    final TextEditingController detailC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';

    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> send() async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFunctions.instance
                  .httpsCallable('reportVendor')
                  .call(<String, dynamic>{
                'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                'reason': reason,
                'detail': detailC.text.trim(),
              });
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err =
                    'Could not send that just now. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
              return;
            }
            if (!mounted) return;
            if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
            if (Navigator.of(threadCtx).canPop()) {
              Navigator.pop(threadCtx);
            }
            _toast(
                'Thank you. We have blocked them and our team is looking into it.');
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.flag_rounded,
              title: 'Report $vn',
              subtitle: 'A real person on the Lazo team reads every report.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                _lzNote(Icons.shield_outlined,
                    'They are blocked straight away. The conversation is kept so we can see what happened.'),
                _lzSection('What happened'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<String> o in const <List<String>>[
                    <String>['harassment', 'Harassment'],
                    <String>['inappropriate', 'Inappropriate'],
                    <String>['spam', 'Spam or pressure'],
                    <String>['scam', 'Scam or fraud'],
                    <String>['noshow', 'Took money and vanished'],
                    <String>['other', 'Something else'],
                  ])
                    _pcC_reason(o[1], reason == o[0], _pcC_red,
                        () => up(() => reason = o[0])),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: detailC,
                  minLines: 3,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Details (optional)',
                      hint: 'Anything that helps us act faster'),
                ),
                _pcC_err(err),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Text(
                    'If you are in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first.',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.4)),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Send report',
                  icon: Icons.flag_rounded,
                  danger: true,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: reason.isEmpty ? null : send));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  // Blocked conversations are kept, never deleted - if the couple later reports,
  // the conversation is the case. They live here, collapsed and out of the way,
  // which is also the only place blocking can be undone.
  Widget _blockedSection(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> blockedDocs) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 6),
      child: _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2, vertical: 2),
        radius: 18,
        tint: .5,
        borderColor: muted.withOpacity(.35),
        child: Theme(
          data: Theme.of(context).copyWith(dividerColor: Colors.transparent),
          child: ExpansionTile(
            tilePadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
            iconColor: _lzFg(muted),
            collapsedIconColor: muted,
            leading:  Icon(Icons.block_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 20),
            title: Text(
                blockedDocs.length == 1
                    ? '1 blocked conversation'
                    : '${blockedDocs.length} blocked conversations',
                style:  TextStyle(
                    color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
            subtitle:  Text('Kept, but they cannot message you',
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
            children: <Widget>[
              for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                  in blockedDocs)
                ListTile(
                  dense: true,
                  contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
                  title: Text((d.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'Vendor').toString(),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                          fontSize: 13.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  subtitle: Text(
                      (d.data()['reportId'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
                          ? 'Blocked and reported'
                          : 'Blocked',
                      style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 11.5)),
                  trailing: TextButton(
                    onPressed:
                        _h(() => _confirmBlock(context, d.id, d.data(), true)),
                    child:  Text('Unblock',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _wentElsewhereSheet(BuildContext threadCtx, String inquiryId,
      Map<String, dynamic> inq) async {
    final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? 'this vendor').toString();
    String reason = '';
    final TextEditingController noteC = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> send() async {
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('inquiries')
                  .doc(inquiryId)
                  .set(<String, dynamic>{
                'status': 'lost',
                'lostReason': reason,
                'lostNote': noteC.text.trim(),
                'lostAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              }, SetOptions(merge: true));
              final String note = noteC.text.trim();
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('inquiries')
                  .doc(inquiryId)
                  .collection('messages')
                  .add(<String, dynamic>{
                'senderRole': 'couple',
                'text': note.isEmpty
                    ? 'Thank you so much for your time - we\u2019ve decided to go another direction. We really appreciated talking with you.'
                    : note,
                'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'system': 'lost',
              });
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
              if (threadCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(threadCtx);
              _toast('Told $vn. That was kind.');
            } catch (e) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err = 'Could not send that just now. Try again in a moment.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.waving_hand_rounded,
              title: 'Going another direction?',
              subtitle:
                  'Tell $vn why, in one tap. They\u2019d rather know than wonder.',
              children: <Widget>[
                _lzSection('The main reason'),
                Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
                  for (final List<String> o in const <List<String>>[
                    <String>['price', 'Price'],
                    <String>['date', 'Date didn\u2019t work'],
                    <String>['style', 'Not our style'],
                    <String>['booked elsewhere', 'Booked someone else'],
                    <String>['changed plans', 'Plans changed'],
                    <String>['other', 'Something else'],
                  ])
                    _pcC_reason(o[1], reason == o[0], plum,
                        () => up(() => reason = o[0])),
                ]),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: noteC,
                  minLines: 2,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('A line for them (optional)'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _lzNote(Icons.favorite_border_rounded,
                    'Leave it blank and we send a short, kind thank-you for you.'),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Let them know',
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: reason.isEmpty ? null : send));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  void _openCoupleThread(String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq) {
    _openThreadId = inquiryId;
    _stampPresence(inquiryId, 'coupleActiveAt');
    _presenceTimer?.cancel();
    _presenceTimer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 45),
        (_) => _stampPresence(inquiryId, 'coupleActiveAt'));
    // Read receipt: she has seen everything up to now
    FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .doc(inquiryId)
        .set(<String, dynamic>{
      'coupleLastReadAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    final String vn = (inq['vendorName'] ?? 'Vendor') as String;
    bool sending = false;
    _lzSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 760),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setSheet) {
          // v112: on a desktop the thread is a card over the dashboard, not a
          // sheet that paints the whole screen ivory. Phones keep the sheet.
          final Size scr = MediaQuery.of(ctx2).size;
          final double kb = MediaQuery.of(ctx2).viewInsets.bottom;
          final bool wideT = scr.width >= _lzWideAt;
          final double sheetH =
              wideT ? (scr.height - kb) * .84 : scr.height * .92;
          final Widget card = Container(
            constraints:
                BoxConstraints(maxWidth: wideT ? 760 : double.infinity),
            height: sheetH,
            clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _lzBg(ivory),
              borderRadius: wideT
                  ? BorderRadius.circular(24)
                  : const BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26)),
              border: wideT ? Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine)) : null,
              boxShadow: wideT
                  ? <BoxShadow>[
                      BoxShadow(
                          color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.35),
                          blurRadius: 40,
                          offset: const Offset(0, 16))
                    ]
                  : null,
            ),
            child: _threadBody(ctx2, setSheet, inquiryId, inq, vn, c,
                () => sending, (bool v) => sending = v),
          );
          if (wideT) return card;
          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: kb),
            child: card,
          );
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() {
      _presenceTimer?.cancel();
      _presenceTimer = null;
      _openThreadId = '';
    });
  }

  // The thread itself: header, messages, contract/invoice strips, composer.
  Widget _threadBody(
      BuildContext ctx2,
      StateSetter setSheet,
      String inquiryId,
      Map<String, dynamic> inq,
      String vn,
      TextEditingController c,
      bool Function() isSending,
      void Function(bool) setSending) {
    return Column(
      children: <Widget>[
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(22, 18, 22, 6),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(vn,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    _presenceLine(inquiryId, 'vendor'),
                  ]),
            ),
            IconButton(
                tooltip: 'More',
                icon:  Icon(Icons.more_horiz_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                onPressed: _h(() => _threadMenu(ctx2, inquiryId, inq))),
            IconButton(
                icon:  Icon(Icons.close_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                onPressed: _h(() => Navigator.pop(ctx2))),
          ]),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('inquiries')
                .doc(inquiryId)
                .collection('messages')
                .orderBy('at')
                .snapshots(),
            builder: (BuildContext c3,
                AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ms) {
              final List<Widget> bubbles = <Widget>[];
              final String orig = (inq['message'] ?? '') as String;
              if (orig.isNotEmpty) {
                bubbles.add(_coupleBubble(orig, true, 'You'));
              }
              final String legacyReply = (inq['vendorReply'] ?? '') as String;
              bool legacyShown = false;
              final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> mdocs =
                  ms.data?.docs ??
                      <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
              return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
                stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('inquiries')
                    .doc(inquiryId)
                    .snapshots(),
                builder: (BuildContext c4,
                    AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>
                        liveSnap) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> liveInq =
                      liveSnap.data?.data() ?? inq;
                  final Timestamp? otherRead =
                      liveInq['vendorLastReadAt'] as Timestamp?;
                  int lastMineIdx = -1;
                  for (int i = 0; i < mdocs.length; i++) {
                    if (mdocs[i].data()['senderRole'] == 'couple') {
                      lastMineIdx = i;
                    }
                  }
                  for (int i = 0; i < mdocs.length; i++) {
                    final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d =
                        mdocs[i];
                    final Map<String, dynamic> mm = d.data();
                    final bool mine = mm['senderRole'] == 'couple';
                    if (!mine && mm['text'] == legacyReply) {
                      legacyShown = true;
                    }
                    final Timestamp? at = mm['at'] as Timestamp?;
                    String? receipt;
                    if (mine && i == lastMineIdx) {
                      receipt = (otherRead != null &&
                              at != null &&
                              otherRead.compareTo(at) >= 0)
                          ? 'Read'
                          : 'Delivered';
                    }
                    bubbles.add(_coupleBubble(
                        (mm['text'] ?? '') as String, mine, mine ? 'You' : vn,
                        at: at?.toDate(),
                        edited: mm['editedAt'] != null,
                        receipt: receipt,
                        attachment: mm['attachment'] is Map
                            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(mm['attachment'] as Map)
                            : null,
                        sneakPeek: mm['sneakPeek'] is List
                            ? mm['sneakPeek'] as List<dynamic>
                            : null,
                        teaser: mm['teaser'] is Map
                            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(mm['teaser'] as Map)
                            : null,
                        teamRec: mm['teamRec'] is Map
                            ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(mm['teamRec'] as Map)
                            : null,
                        onLongPress: mine
                            ? () => _editCoupleMessage(
                                inquiryId, d.id, (mm['text'] ?? '') as String)
                            : null));
                  }
                  if (legacyReply.isNotEmpty && !legacyShown) {
                    bubbles.insert(orig.isEmpty ? 0 : 1,
                        _coupleBubble(legacyReply, false, vn));
                  }
                  return ListView(
                    padding:
                        const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20, vertical: 8),
                    children: bubbles,
                  );
                },
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        _coupleProposals(inquiryId, vn),
        _coupleContracts(inquiryId, vn),
        _coupleQuestionnaires(inquiryId, vn),
        _coupleReviewCard(inquiryId, inq, vn),
        _coupleInvoices(inquiryId, vn),
        _uploadStrip(),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 6, 18, 18),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Attach a file \u2014 $kAttachHint',
              // 44x44 is the floor on both platforms; compact density was 40.
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44),
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              icon:
                   Icon(Icons.attach_file_rounded, color: _lzFg(plum), size: 21),
              onPressed: _h(
                  () => _pickAndSendAttachment(inquiryId, refresh: setSheet)),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Emoji',
              // 44x44 is the floor on both platforms; compact density was 40.
              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44),
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              icon:  Icon(Icons.emoji_emotions_outlined,
                  color: _lzFg(plum), size: 21),
              onPressed: _h(() => _emojiSheet(c, after: () {
                    setSheet(() {});
                  })),
            ),
            Expanded(
              // v91: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks a line.
              child: Focus(
                onKeyEvent: (FocusNode node, KeyEvent ev) {
                  if (ev is KeyDownEvent &&
                      (ev.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter ||
                          ev.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.numpadEnter) &&
                      !HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed) {
                    _coupleSend(inquiryId, c, setSheet, isSending, setSending);
                    return KeyEventResult.handled;
                  }
                  return KeyEventResult.ignored;
                },
                child: TextField(
                  onChanged: (_) => _stampTyping(inquiryId, 'coupleTypingAt'),
                  controller: c,
                  minLines: 1,
                  maxLines: 4,
                  style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Message $vn\u2026 (Enter sends)',
                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                        horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                    ),
                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 10),
            _Press(
              tick: _Tick.medium,
              onTap: isSending()
                  ? null
                  : () => _coupleSend(
                      inquiryId, c, setSheet, isSending, setSending),
              child: Container(
                width: 46,
                height: 46,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient:
                      const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                ),
                child: isSending()
                    ? const Padding(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.all(13),
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2, color: gold),
                      )
                    : const Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: gold, size: 20),
              ),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // ---------------- STUDIO: CONTRACT SIGNING (v25) ----------------

  Widget _coupleQuestionnaires(String inquiryId, String vendorName) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('questionnaires')
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> qs) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            qs.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> qn = d.data();
            final bool done = (qn['status'] ?? '') == 'completed';
            final String title = (qn['title'] ?? 'Questionnaire') as String;
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(done
                    ? vGreen.withOpacity(.1)
                    : Colors.white.withOpacity(.75)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border:
                    Border.all(color: _lzLine((done ? vGreen : gold).withOpacity(.6))),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(
                        done
                            ? Icons.check_circle_rounded
                            : Icons.fact_check_outlined,
                        color: _lzFg(done ? vGreen : plum),
                        size: 18),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            Text(
                                ((qn['vendorName'] ?? vendorName) as String)
                                    .toUpperCase(),
                                maxLines: 1,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                style:  TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                                    fontSize: 8.5,
                                    letterSpacing: 1.4,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            Text(title,
                                style:  TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(plum),
                                    fontSize: 14.5,
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                          ]),
                    ),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                      done
                          ? 'Completed - $vendorName has your answers. \u2728'
                          : '$vendorName sent a few questions to plan your day perfectly.',
                      style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  if (!done) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 10),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: plum,
                            foregroundColor: ivory,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11)),
                        onPressed:
                            _h(() => _fillQuestionnaire(inquiryId, d.id, qn)),
                        child: const Text('Fill it out',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _fillQuestionnaire(
      String inquiryId, String qId, Map<String, dynamic> qn) {
    final List<dynamic> questions = qn['questions'] is List
        ? qn['questions'] as List<dynamic>
        : <dynamic>[];
    final Map<String, dynamic> prior = qn['answers'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(qn['answers'] as Map)
        : <String, dynamic>{};
    final List<TextEditingController> cs = List<TextEditingController>.generate(
        questions.length,
        (int i) => TextEditingController(text: (prior['$i'] ?? '').toString()));
    final String from = (qn['vendorName'] ?? '').toString();
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    _lzSheet(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setQ) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setQ(f);
          }

          final int answered = cs
              .where((TextEditingController t) => t.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
              .length;

          Future<void> send() async {
            up(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            final Map<String, String> ans = <String, String>{};
            for (int i = 0; i < cs.length; i++) {
              if (cs[i].text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
                ans['$i'] = cs[i].text.trim();
              }
            }
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('inquiries')
                  .doc(inquiryId)
                  .collection('questionnaires')
                  .doc(qId)
                  .update(<String, dynamic>{
                'answers': ans,
                'status': 'completed',
                'completedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              });
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('inquiries')
                  .doc(inquiryId)
                  .set(<String, dynamic>{
                'questionnaireStatus': 'completed',
                'questionnaireUpdatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              }, SetOptions(merge: true));
              if (ctx2.mounted) {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
              }
              _toastC('Sent. Your vendor has your answers.');
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                saving = false;
                err =
                    'Could not send your answers. Check your connection and try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.fact_check_outlined,
              title: (qn['title'] ?? 'Questionnaire').toString(),
              subtitle: from.isEmpty
                  ? 'Answer what you can - you can message about the rest.'
                  : 'From $from. Answer what you can - you can message about the rest.',
              headerExtra: questions.isEmpty
                  ? null
                  : _pcC_progress(answered, questions.length),
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                if (questions.isEmpty)
                  _pcC_empty(Icons.fact_check_outlined,
                      'There are no questions in this one yet.')
                else
                  for (int i = 0; i < questions.length; i++)
                    _pcC_question(i, questions[i].toString(), cs[i],
                        autofocus: i == 0 && cs[0].text.isEmpty,
                        onChanged: (_) => up(() {})),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Later',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Send answers',
                  icon: Icons.send_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: send));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  Widget _coupleContracts(String inquiryId, String vendorName) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('contracts')
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> cs) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            cs.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        // Couples only see contracts that were actually sent (or signed)
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> visible =
            docs.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          final String st = (d.data()['status'] ?? 'draft') as String;
          return st == 'sent' || st == 'signed' || st == 'declined';
        }).toList();
        if (visible.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children:
              visible.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> ct = d.data();
            final String st = (ct['status'] ?? 'sent') as String;
            final bool signed = st == 'signed';
            if (st == 'sent' && !_syncChecked.contains(d.id)) {
              _syncChecked.add(d.id);
              _syncContractNow(inquiryId, d.id, silent: true);
            }
            final String tName =
                (ct['templateName'] ?? 'Your contract') as String;
            final String signingUrl = (ct['signingUrl'] ?? '') as String;
            if (signed) {
              return Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 8),
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  border: Border.all(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.55)),
                ),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                   Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 17),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text('$tName \u00b7 Signed',
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(ink),
                            fontSize: 12.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  ),
                  _Press(
                    onTap: () => _openContractPdf(ct),
                    child:  Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                      child: Text('View',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(plum),
                              fontSize: 12,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    ),
                  ),
                ]),
              );
            }
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                    colors: signed
                        ? <Color>[vGreen, const Color(0xFF3AA37E)]
                        : <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(
                        signed
                            ? Icons.verified_rounded
                            : Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                        color: gold,
                        size: 18),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(signed ? 'CONTRACT SIGNED' : 'YOUR CONTRACT',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: gold,
                            fontSize: 10,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(tName,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: ivory,
                          fontSize: 15.5,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                      signed
                          ? 'All set - your signed copy was emailed to you. \u{1F389}'
                          : st == 'declined'
                              ? 'You declined this contract. Message $vendorName to sort out changes.'
                              : '$vendorName sent your agreement. Review and sign - it takes about a minute.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                          fontSize: 12.5,
                          height: 1.35)),
                  if (!signed &&
                      st == 'sent' &&
                      signingUrl.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: FilledButton.icon(
                        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                            backgroundColor: gold,
                            foregroundColor: plum,
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _openSigning(signingUrl)),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.draw_rounded, size: 18),
                        label: const Text('Review & sign',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: gold,
                            side: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.8)),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 11)),
                        onPressed: _h(
                            () => _juneReviewContract(inquiryId, d.id, tName)),
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, size: 16),
                        label: const Text('Have June read it first',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 13, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    Center(
                      child: StatefulBuilder(
                          builder: (BuildContext sc, StateSetter setSync) {
                        final bool busy = _syncBusy.contains(d.id);
                        final String verdict = _syncVerdict[d.id] ?? '';
                        if (busy) {
                          return Row(
                              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                SizedBox(
                                    width: 12,
                                    height: 12,
                                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                        color: gold, strokeWidth: 2)),
                                const SizedBox(width: 7),
                                Text('Checking with SignWell\u2026',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.85),
                                        fontSize: 11.5)),
                              ]);
                        }
                        if (verdict.isNotEmpty) {
                          return _Press(
                            onTap: () {
                              setSync(() => _syncVerdict.remove(d.id));
                            },
                            child: Container(
                              width: double.infinity,
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: const Color(0xFF8A6A2F).withOpacity(.25),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.7)),
                              ),
                              child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                                Text(verdict,
                                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.95),
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                Text('Tap to check again',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.6),
                                        fontSize: 10)),
                              ]),
                            ),
                          );
                        }
                        return _Press(
                          onTap: () async {
                            setSync(() => _syncBusy.add(d.id));
                            String v;
                            try {
                              final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions
                                  .instance
                                  .httpsCallable('syncContractNow',
                                      options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                                          timeout:
                                              const Duration(seconds: 60)));
                              final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out =
                                  await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
                                'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                                'contractId': d.id,
                              });
                              final Map<String, dynamic> r =
                                  Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
                              final String sw =
                                  (r['signwell'] ?? '').toString();
                              v = (r['status'] ?? '') == 'signed'
                                  ? 'Signed and sealed \u2713'
                                  : sw.isEmpty
                                      ? 'Not signed on SignWell\u2019s side yet \u2014 this updates the moment it is.'
                                      : 'SignWell status: $sw \u2014 the last step may still be waiting in that tab.';
                            } catch (err) {
                              v = 'Could not check: $err';
                            }
                            setSync(() {
                              _syncBusy.remove(d.id);
                              _syncVerdict[d.id] = v;
                            });
                          },
                          child: Padding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
                            child: Text('Already signed? Tap to update',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: ivory.withOpacity(.85),
                                    fontSize: 11.5,
                                    decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                                    decorationColor: ivory.withOpacity(.5))),
                          ),
                        );
                      }),
                    ),
                  ],
                  if (signed) ...<Widget>[
                    const SizedBox(height: 6),
                    _Press(
                      onTap: () => _juneReviewContract(inquiryId, d.id, tName),
                      child: Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 3),
                        child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                                  color: gold, size: 13),
                              const SizedBox(width: 5),
                              Text('June\u2019s plain-English summary',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      decoration: TextDecoration.underline,
                                      decorationColor: ivory.withOpacity(.5))),
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _syncContractNow(String inquiryId, String contractId,
      {required bool silent}) async {
    try {
      final HttpsCallable fn = FirebaseFunctions.instance.httpsCallable(
          'syncContractNow',
          options: HttpsCallableOptions(timeout: const Duration(seconds: 60)));
      final HttpsCallableResult<dynamic> out = await fn.call(<String, dynamic>{
        'inquiryId': inquiryId,
        'contractId': contractId,
      });
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out.data as Map);
      final String status = (r['status'] ?? '') as String;
      if (!silent) {
        _toastC(status == 'signed'
            ? 'Signed and sealed \u2713'
            : 'Not signed yet on SignWell\u2019s side - the card updates the moment it is.');
      }
    } catch (_) {
      if (!silent) {
        _toastC('Could not check right now - try again.');
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _juneReviewContract(
      String inquiryId, String contractId, String tName) async {
    Future<HttpsCallableResult<dynamic>> read() => FirebaseFunctions.instance
            .httpsCallable('reviewContractForCouple',
                options: HttpsCallableOptions(
                    timeout: const Duration(seconds: 120)))
            .call(<String, dynamic>{
          'inquiryId': inquiryId,
          'contractId': contractId,
        });
    Future<HttpsCallableResult<dynamic>> fut = read();
    _lzSheet(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setR) =>
            FutureBuilder<HttpsCallableResult<dynamic>>(
          future: fut,
          builder: (BuildContext c2,
              AsyncSnapshot<HttpsCallableResult<dynamic>> snap) {
            final bool loading = snap.connectionState != ConnectionState.done;
            bool bad = !loading && (snap.hasError || snap.data == null);
            Map<String, dynamic> r = <String, dynamic>{};
            if (!loading && !bad) {
              try {
                final Map<String, dynamic> out =
                    Map<String, dynamic>.from(snap.data!.data as Map);
                r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(out['review'] as Map);
              } catch (_) {
                bad = true;
              }
            }
            final List<dynamic> terms = (r['keyTerms'] as List?) ?? <dynamic>[];
            final List<dynamic> flags = (r['flags'] as List?) ?? <dynamic>[];
            final List<dynamic> qs = (r['questions'] as List?) ?? <dynamic>[];
            final List<Widget> body = <Widget>[const SizedBox(height: 16)];
            if (loading) {
              body.add(_lzBusy(
                  'June is reading every clause. It takes about fifteen seconds.'));
            } else if (bad) {
              body.add(_pcC_err(
                  'June couldn\u2019t finish the read. Give it another try in a moment.'));
            } else {
              final String summary = (r['summary'] ?? '').toString();
              if (summary.isNotEmpty) {
                body.add(Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: _lzBg(cardBg),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                  child: Text(summary,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14.5, height: 1.55)),
                ));
              }
              if (terms.isNotEmpty) {
                body.add(_lzSection('Key terms'));
                body.add(Container(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
                  child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                    for (int i = 0; i < terms.length; i++)
                      Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 11),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            border: i == 0
                                ? null
                                : Border(
                                    top: BorderSide(
                                        color: _lzLine(goldLine)
                                            .withOpacity(.6)))),
                        child: Row(
                            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              SizedBox(
                                width: 130,
                                child: Text(
                                    (terms[i] is Map
                                            ? (terms[i] as Map)['label'] ?? ''
                                            : '')
                                        .toString(),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(muted), fontSize: 13)),
                              ),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Text(
                                    (terms[i] is Map
                                            ? (terms[i] as Map)['value'] ?? ''
                                            : terms[i])
                                        .toString(),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        color: _lzFg(ink),
                                        fontSize: 13,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                                        height: 1.4)),
                              ),
                            ]),
                      ),
                  ]),
                ));
              }
              if (flags.isNotEmpty) {
                body.add(_lzSection('Worth knowing'));
                for (final dynamic f in flags) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> m = f is Map
                      ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(f)
                      : <String, dynamic>{'text': f.toString()};
                  final bool caution = (m['severity'] ?? 'note') == 'caution';
                  final Color tone =
                      caution ? _pcC_red : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
                  body.add(Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    child: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 11, 14, 11),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: tone.withOpacity(.07),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(13),
                          border: Border.all(color: tone.withOpacity(.3))),
                      child: Row(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            Icon(
                                caution
                                    ? Icons.error_outline_rounded
                                    : Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                size: 18,
                                color: _lzFg(tone)),
                            const SizedBox(width: 10),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text((m['text'] ?? '').toString(),
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _lzFg(ink),
                                      fontSize: 13.5,
                                      height: 1.45)),
                            ),
                          ]),
                    ),
                  ));
                }
              }
              if (qs.isNotEmpty) {
                body.add(_lzSection('Questions you could ask',
                    trailing: 'Tap one to send it'));
                for (int qi = 0; qi < qs.length; qi++) {
                  final String q = qs[qi].toString();
                  final bool sent = _juneQSent.contains('$inquiryId-$qi');
                  body.add(Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                    child: _Press(
                      onTap: sent
                          ? null
                          : () async {
                              try {
                                if (!await _safeCoupleSend(inquiryId, q)) return; // v160
                                _juneQSent.add('$inquiryId-$qi');
                                if (ctx2.mounted) setR(() {});
                              } catch (err) {
                                _toastC(
                                    'Could not send that question. Try again.');
                              }
                            },
                      child: Container(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(13),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _lzBg(
                              sent ? vGreen.withOpacity(.10) : Colors.white),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                          border: Border.all(
                              color: _lzLine(sent
                                  ? vGreen.withOpacity(.6)
                                  : gold.withOpacity(.55))),
                        ),
                        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(q,
                                style: TextStyle(
                                    color: _lzFg(sent
                                        ? const Color(0xFF2E6B52)
                                        : ink),
                                    fontSize: 13.5,
                                    height: 1.4)),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          sent
                              ? Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: <Widget>[
                                      Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                          color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 16),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                      Text('Sent',
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                              color: _lzFg(vGreen),
                                              fontSize: 12,
                                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                    ])
                              : Icon(Icons.send_rounded,
                                  color: _lzFg(plum), size: 17),
                        ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ));
                }
              }
              body.add(const SizedBox(height: 14));
              body.add(_lzNote(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                  'June helps you understand what you\u2019re signing. She\u2019s not a lawyer, and this isn\u2019t legal advice.'));
            }
            return _lzFrame(ctx2,
                icon: Icons.auto_awesome_rounded,
                title: loading ? 'June is reading' : 'June read it',
                subtitle: tName,
                children: body,
                footer: loading
                    ? null
                    : bad
                        ? _lzActions(
                            secondary: 'Close',
                            onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                            primary: 'Try again',
                            icon: Icons.refresh_rounded,
                            onPrimary: () => setR(() => fut = read()))
                        : _lzActions(
                            primary: 'Done',
                            icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                            onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2)));
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static const String _kInvoicePdfBase =
      'https://us-central1-lazo-513ec.cloudfunctions.net/invoicePdf';

  // v66: how this couple can actually settle the invoice. Card first when the
  // vendor has connected Stripe; their own links otherwise; never a dead end.
  Widget _payBlock(String inquiryId, String invoiceId, Map<String, dynamic> inv,
      String vendorName) {
    final String vendorId = (inv['vendorId'] ?? '').toString();
    if (vendorId.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('vendors')
          .doc(vendorId)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> vs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> vd = vs.data?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
        final Map<String, dynamic> pay = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
            (vd['payments'] as Map?) ?? <String, dynamic>{});
        final bool whop = (pay['processor'] ?? '') == 'whop' &&
            (pay['whopCompanyId'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty;
        final bool cards = whop ||
            vd['stripeChargesEnabled'] == true ||
            vd['squareConnected'] == true;
        final List<dynamic> links =
            (vd['paymentLinks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[];
        final bool busy = _payingInvoiceId == invoiceId;
        final bool tips = inv['tipAllowed'] == true;
        final num tip = _tipFor[invoiceId] ?? 0;
        final num invTotal = (inv['total'] is num) ? inv['total'] as num : 0;
        final bool claimed = (inv['status'] ?? '') == 'paid_pending';
        if (claimed) {
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
            child: Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 13, vertical: 11),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.16)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.45))),
              ),
              child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                const Icon(Icons.schedule_rounded, color: ivory, size: 15),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                      'You marked this as paid \u2014 $vendorName will confirm shortly.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.92),
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          height: 1.35)),
                ),
              ]),
            ),
          );
        }
        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: <Widget>[
            if (cards) ...<Widget>[
              if (tips) ...<Widget>[
                Text('Add a tip for $vendorName?',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.85),
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                // v139: the chips sit in a modal sheet, so the page's
                // setState never redrew them - a local builder does
                StatefulBuilder(builder: (BuildContext tc, StateSetter setT) {
                  final num tipNow = _tipFor[invoiceId] ?? 0;
                  return Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                    for (final num t in <num>[0, 25, 50, 100, 200])
                      _Press(
                        tick: _Tick.select,
                        onTap: () {
                          setT(() => _tipFor[invoiceId] = t);
                          if (mounted) setState(() {});
                        },
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 11, vertical: 6),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: _lzBg(tipNow == t ? gold : Colors.transparent),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                              border: Border.all(
                                  color: _lzLine(tipNow == t
                                      ? gold
                                      : ivory.withOpacity(.5)))),
                          child: Text(t == 0 ? 'No tip' : _money(t),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(tipNow == t ? plumDeep : ivory),
                                  fontSize: 11.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ]);
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
              ],
              FilledButton.icon(
                style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: gold,
                    foregroundColor: plumDeep,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 13)),
                onPressed: _h(busy
                    ? null
                    : () => _payInvoiceByCard(inquiryId, invoiceId,
                        tip: tips ? tip : 0)),
                icon: busy
                    ? const SizedBox(
                        width: 15,
                        height: 15,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                            strokeWidth: 2, color: plumDeep))
                    : const Icon(Icons.credit_card_rounded, size: 17),
                label: Text(
                    busy
                        ? 'Opening\u2026'
                        : tips && tip > 0
                            ? 'Pay ${_money(invTotal + tip)} by card'
                            : 'Pay by card',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 6),
              Text('Secure checkout \u2014 paid straight to $vendorName.',
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style:
                      TextStyle(color: ivory.withOpacity(.75), fontSize: 10.5)),
              const SizedBox(height: 10),
            ],
            if (links.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
              if (cards)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6),
                  child: Text('Or pay another way',
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.7),
                          fontSize: 10,
                          letterSpacing: 1.2,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              Wrap(
                spacing: 7,
                runSpacing: 7,
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                children: List<Widget>.generate(links.length, (int i) {
                  final Map<String, dynamic> l =
                      Map<String, dynamic>.from(links[i] as Map);
                  final String label = (l['label'] ?? 'Pay').toString();
                  String url = (l['url'] ?? '').toString();
                  if (url.isNotEmpty &&
                      !url.startsWith('http') &&
                      !url.startsWith('mailto')) {
                    url = 'https://' + url.replaceFirst('@', '');
                  }
                  return OutlinedButton(
                    style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        foregroundColor: ivory,
                        side: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.5))),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                            horizontal: 14, vertical: 9)),
                    onPressed: _h(() => _openSigning(url)),
                    child: Text(label,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 12, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  );
                }),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ],
            if (!cards && links.isEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                child: Text(
                    '$vendorName will let you know how to send payment.',
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.8),
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        height: 1.35)),
              ),
            if (!cards)
              TextButton(
                onPressed: _h(() async {
                  await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                      .collection('inquiries')
                      .doc(inquiryId)
                      .collection('invoices')
                      .doc(invoiceId)
                      .set(<String, dynamic>{
                    'status': 'paid_pending',
                    'paidClaimedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                  }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                  _toastC('Thanks \u2014 we let $vendorName know.');
                }),
                child: Text("I've already paid",
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: ivory.withOpacity(.85),
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  static const String _kChimeUrl =
      'https://meetlazo.com/assets/chime-couple.mp3';
  // v116: payCheckout routes to Whop, Stripe or Square by the vendor's rail.
  static const String _kCheckoutFn =
      'https://us-central1-lazo-513ec.cloudfunctions.net/payCheckout';
  final Map<String, num> _tipFor = <String, num>{};

  void _playChime() {
    if (_chimeMuted) return;
    if (_cwVoice && _cwFor.isNotEmpty && _tourIdx < 0) return; // v157: June says it instead
    final int now = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
    if (now - _chimeLastMs < 3000) return;
    _chimeLastMs = now;
    if (!kIsWeb) return; // phones get the push notification instead
    try {
      final html.AudioElement a = html.AudioElement()
        ..src = _kChimeUrl
        ..volume = 0.42
        ..autoplay = true;
      a.play().catchError((Object _) {});
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  void _setTabBadge(int n) {
    if (!kIsWeb) return;
    try {
      html.document.title = n > 0 ? '($n) Lazo' : 'Lazo';
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  // A vendor wrote back: chime once, badge the tab. Never on first load,
  // never for our own messages, never for a thread we have open.
  void _ensureCoupleChime(String uid) {
    if (_chimeForUid == uid || uid.isEmpty) return;
    _chimeForUid = uid;
    _chimeArmed = false;
    _chimeSub?.cancel();
    _chimeSub = FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('inquiries')
        .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: uid)
        .snapshots()
        .listen((QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snap) {
      int unread = 0;
      bool fresh = false;
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in snap.docs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
        if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') != 'vendor') continue;
        final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
        final dynamic read = m['coupleLastReadAt'];
        if (last is! Timestamp) continue;
        if (read is! Timestamp || last.compareTo(read) > 0) unread++;
      }
      if (_chimeArmed) {
        for (final DocumentChange<Map<String, dynamic>> ch in snap.docChanges) {
          if (ch.type == DocumentChangeType.removed) continue;
          final Map<String, dynamic> m = ch.doc.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
          if ((m['lastMessageRole'] ?? '') != 'vendor') continue;
          if (ch.doc.id == _openThreadId) continue;
          final dynamic last = m['lastMessageAt'];
          if (last is! Timestamp) continue;
          if (DateTime.now().difference(last.toDate()).inSeconds > 25) continue;
          fresh = true;
        }
      }
      if (fresh) _playChime();
      _chimeArmed = true;
      if (unread != _cUnread) {
        _setTabBadge(unread);
        if (mounted) setState(() => _cUnread = unread);
      }
    });
  }

  // Card payment: a Stripe Checkout session on the VENDOR's own account.
  Future<void> _payInvoiceByCard(String inquiryId, String invoiceId,
      {num tip = 0}) async {
    setState(() => _payingInvoiceId = invoiceId);
    try {
      final httpc.Response res = await httpc.get(
        Uri.parse(
            '$_kCheckoutFn?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=$invoiceId&tip=${tip.round()}'),
        headers: <String, String>{'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      );
      final Map<String, dynamic> r = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
          jsonDecode(res.body.isEmpty ? '{}' : res.body));
      final String url = (r['url'] ?? '').toString();
      if (url.isEmpty) {
        _toastC('Could not open checkout - try again.');
      } else {
        await _openSigning(url);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _toastC('Could not open checkout - try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO pay: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _payingInvoiceId = '');
    }
  }
