  Future<void> _leaveReviewSheet(
      String inquiryId, Map<String, dynamic> inq, String vendorName) async {
    int rating = 5;
    final TextEditingController txt = TextEditingController();
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    const List<String> words = <String>[
      '',
      'Poor',
      'Not great',
      'Good',
      'Great',
      'Wonderful'
    ];
    if (!mounted) return;
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setR) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setR(f);
          }

          Future<void> post() async {
            up(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('reviews')
                  .add(<String, dynamic>{
                'vendorId': inq['vendorId'],
                'inquiryId': inquiryId,
                'coupleUid': inq['coupleUid'],
                'coupleName': inq['coupleName'] ?? '',
                'rating': rating,
                'text': txt.text.trim(),
                'status': 'published',
                'source': 'lazo',
                'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              });
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
              _toastC('Thank you - that means a lot to them.');
            } catch (e) {
              up(() {
                saving = false;
                err = 'Could not post your review. Try again in a moment.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.star_rounded,
              title: 'Review $vendorName',
              subtitle:
                  'Honest is more useful than glowing. Other couples are counting on you.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: List<Widget>.generate(5, (int i) {
                      return IconButton(
                        tooltip: '${i + 1} star${i == 0 ? '' : 's'}',
                        onPressed: _h(() => up(() => rating = i + 1)),
                        icon: Icon(
                            i < rating
                                ? Icons.star_rounded
                                : Icons.star_outline_rounded,
                            color: gold,
                            size: 36),
                      );
                    })),
                Text(words[rating],
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: txt,
                  minLines: 4,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  maxLength: 900,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Your review',
                      hint:
                          'What were they like to work with? What should the next couple know?'),
                ),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Later',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Post review',
                  icon: Icons.star_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: post));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  // v140: money flows into the plan. spent = max(what the couple typed,
  // what was paid on Lazo) - a typed figure still wins, nothing double
  // counts, and a paid invoice shows up without anyone retyping it.
  static num _spentOf(Map<String, dynamic> p) {
    final num typed = (p['budgetActual'] as num?) ?? 0;
    num paid = 0;
    if (p['paid'] is Map) {
      for (final dynamic v in (p['paid'] as Map).values) {
        if (v is num) paid += v;
      }
    }
    return typed > paid ? typed : paid;
  }

  String _inqCategory(String inquiryId) {
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in _inqDocs) {
      if (d.id != inquiryId) continue;
      final Map<String, dynamic> m = d.data();
      final dynamic si = m['structuredIntent'];
      final String c = (m['vendorCategory'] ??
              m['category'] ??
              (si is Map ? si['category'] : null) ??
              '')
          .toString();
      return c;
    }
    return '';
  }

  final Map<String, num> _paidNoted = <String, num>{};
  void _notePaid(String inquiryId, num paidSum) {
    if (_paidNoted[inquiryId] == paidSum) return;
    _paidNoted[inquiryId] = paidSum;
    final String cat = _inqCategory(inquiryId);
    if (cat.isEmpty) return;
    _planRef.doc(cat).set(<String, dynamic>{
      'paid': <String, dynamic>{inquiryId: paidSum},
      'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    }, SetOptions(merge: true)).catchError((Object e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO paid note: ' + e.toString());
    });
  }

  Future<void> _noteQuoted(String inquiryId, num price) async {
    final String cat = _inqCategory(inquiryId);
    if (cat.isEmpty || price <= 0) return;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> pd =
          await _planRef.doc(cat).get();
      final num planned = (pd.data()?['budgetPlanned'] as num?) ?? 0;
      await _planRef.doc(cat).set(<String, dynamic>{
        'quoted': <String, dynamic>{inquiryId: price},
        if (planned <= 0) 'budgetPlanned': price,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      }, SetOptions(merge: true));
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO quoted note: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _coupleInvoices(String inquiryId, String vendorName) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('invoices')
          .orderBy('createdAt', descending: true)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            (s.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
                .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                    (d.data()['status'] ?? '') != 'void')
                .toList();
        if (s.hasData) {
          // v140: what has been paid here lands on the plan
          num paidSum = 0;
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
            if ((d.data()['status'] ?? '') == 'paid') {
              paidSum += (d.data()['total'] as num?) ?? 0;
            }
          }
          _notePaid(inquiryId, paidSum);
        }
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> inv = d.data();
            final bool paid = (inv['status'] ?? '') == 'paid';
            final num total = (inv['total'] ?? 0) as num;
            // v76: a settled invoice is a receipt, not an announcement. After
            // the first day it collapses to a quiet row like the signed
            // contract above it - still there, still downloadable, no longer
            // shouting every time she opens the thread.
            if (paid) {
              final dynamic pAt = inv['paidAt'];
              final bool fresh = pAt is Timestamp &&
                  DateTime.now().difference(pAt.toDate()).inHours < 24;
              if (!fresh) {
                return Container(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 8),
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 11),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _lzBg(ivory),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                    border: Border.all(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.45)),
                  ),
                  child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                     Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 16),
                    const SizedBox(width: 9),
                    Expanded(
                      child: Text(
                          '${(inv['title'] ?? 'Invoice')} \u00b7 Paid ${_money(total)}',
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(ink),
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                    ),
                    _Press(
                      onTap: () => _openSigning(
                          '$_kInvoicePdfBase?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=${d.id}'),
                      child:  Padding(
                        padding:
                            EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                        child: Text('Receipt',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: _lzFg(plum),
                                fontSize: 12,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
                );
              }
            }
            final List<dynamic> lines =
                (inv['lineItems'] as List?) ?? <dynamic>[];
            final dynamic dd = inv['dueDate'];
            DateTime? dueOn;
            if (dd is Timestamp) {
              dueOn = dd.toDate();
            }
            final bool dueNow = inv['dueNow'] == true;
            final bool overdue = !paid &&
                dueOn != null &&
                DateTime.now().isAfter(
                    DateTime(dueOn.year, dueOn.month, dueOn.day)
                        .add(const Duration(days: 1)));
            // gold asks; red only once the date has actually passed.
            const Color red = Color(0xFFB3413A);
            const Color redDeep = Color(0xFF7C2B2B);
            final List<Color> band = paid
                ? <Color>[vGreen, const Color(0xFF3AA37E)]
                : overdue
                    ? <Color>[redDeep, red]
                    : <Color>[plumDeep, plum];
            final Color accent = paid
                ? gold
                : overdue
                    ? const Color(0xFFFFD9D4)
                    : gold;
            final String label = paid
                ? 'INVOICE PAID'
                : overdue
                    ? 'PAYMENT OVERDUE'
                    : dueNow
                        ? 'PAYMENT DUE NOW'
                        : 'PAYMENT DUE';
            String dueLine;
            if (paid) {
              dueLine = 'All settled \u2014 thank you! \u{1F942}';
            } else if (overdue) {
              final int days = DateTime.now().difference(dueOn!).inDays;
              dueLine = days <= 1
                  ? 'Due yesterday \u2014 a quick payment keeps everything on track.'
                  : 'Due $days days ago \u2014 a quick payment keeps everything on track.';
            } else if (dueNow) {
              dueLine =
                  'Due now that your contract is signed \u2014 this secures your date with $vendorName.';
            } else if (dueOn != null) {
              dueLine =
                  'Due ${dueOn.month}/${dueOn.day}/${dueOn.year} \u2014 pay however you have arranged with $vendorName.';
            } else {
              dueLine = 'Pay however you have arranged with $vendorName.';
            }
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(colors: band),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(
                    color: _lzLine(overdue && !paid
                        ? const Color(0xFFFFD9D4)
                        : gold.withOpacity(.75)),
                    width: overdue && !paid ? 1.6 : 1),
                boxShadow: (!paid)
                    ? <BoxShadow>[
                        BoxShadow(
                            color: (overdue ? red : gold).withOpacity(.30),
                            blurRadius: 18,
                            offset: const Offset(0, 6)),
                      ]
                    : null,
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Icon(
                        paid
                            ? Icons.verified_rounded
                            : overdue
                                ? Icons.error_outline_rounded
                                : Icons.receipt_long_rounded,
                        color: _lzFg(accent),
                        size: 18),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(label,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(accent),
                            fontSize: 10,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text(_money(total),
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(paid ? ivory : accent),
                            fontSize: 19,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text((inv['title'] ?? 'Invoice') as String,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: ivory,
                          fontSize: 15,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  if (inv['installmentCount'] is num)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 2),
                      child: Text(
                          'Payment ${((inv['installmentIndex'] ?? 0) as num).toInt() + 1} of ${(inv['installmentCount'] as num).toInt()} on your plan'

                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(accent),
                              fontSize: 11,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  ...lines.map((dynamic l) {
                    final Map<String, dynamic> m =
                        Map<String, dynamic>.from(l as Map);
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text((m['label'] ?? '').toString(),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), fontSize: 12)),
                        ),
                        Text(_money((m['amount'] ?? 0) as num),
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), fontSize: 12)),
                      ]),
                    );
                  }),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(dueLine,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                          fontSize: 11.5,
                          height: 1.4)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  if (!paid) _payBlock(inquiryId, d.id, inv, vendorName),
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    Expanded(
                      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            foregroundColor: ivory,
                            side: BorderSide(color: _lzLine(ivory.withOpacity(.55))),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 10)),
                        onPressed: _h(() => _openSigning(
                            '$_kInvoicePdfBase?inquiry=$inquiryId&invoice=${d.id}')),
                        icon:
                            const Icon(Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded, size: 16),
                        label: const Text('Download invoice',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ---------------- WEDDING-DAY COMMAND CENTER ----------------

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _dayofRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('dayof');

  Widget _dayOfCard(Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> plan, int? daysOut) {
    final bool hasDate = daysOut != null;
    final bool isDay = daysOut == 0;
    int team = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> p in plan.values) {
      if ((p['status'] ?? '') == 'booked') {
        team++;
      }
    }
    return _Press(
      scale: .985,
      dim: .92,
      onTap: () => setState(() => _view = _View.dayof),
      child: _glass(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        radius: 22,
        borderColor: _lzLine(isDay ? gold : gold.withOpacity(.5)),
        child: Row(children: <Widget>[
          Container(
            width: 44,
            height: 44,

  String _fmtClock(String hhmm) {
    final List<String> parts = hhmm.split(':');
    int h = int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? 12;
    final String m = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1].padLeft(2, '0') : '00';
    final String ap = h >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    h = h % 12 == 0 ? 12 : h % 12;
    return '$h:$m $ap';
  }

  Future<void> _editTimelineEvent(
      QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? d) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController labelC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ev['label'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ev['note'] ?? '').toString());
    final List<String> t0 = ((ev['time'] ?? '16:00').toString()).split(':');
    TimeOfDay time = TimeOfDay(
        hour: int.tryParse(t0[0]) ?? 16,
        minute: t0.length > 1 ? int.tryParse(t0[1]) ?? 0 : 0);
    // JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: how long it runs, whose moment it is, and
    // whether it is the ceremony - the anchor the whole day shifts around.
    int dur = ev['dur'] is num ? (ev['dur'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final Set<String> owners = <String>{
      if (ev['owners'] is List)
        for (final dynamic o in ev['owners'] as List) o.toString()
    };
    bool anchor = ev['anchor'] == true;
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';

    Future<void> save() async {
      final String hh =
          '${time.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${time.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
      final Map<String, dynamic> payload = <String, dynamic>{
        'time': hh,
        'label': labelC.text.trim(),
        'note': noteC.text.trim(),
        'dur': dur,
        'owners': owners.toList()..sort(),
        'anchor': anchor,
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      if (d == null) {
        await _dayofRef.add(payload);
      } else {
        await d.reference.set(payload, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
      if (anchor) {
        // One anchor only: the ceremony.
        try {
          final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> others =
              await _dayofRef.where('anchor', isEqualTo: true).get();
          final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
          bool any = false;
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> o
              in others.docs) {
            if (d != null && o.id == d.id) continue;
            if (d == null &&
                (o.data()['label'] ?? '') == labelC.text.trim() &&
                (o.data()['time'] ?? '') == hh) continue;
            b.set(o.reference, <String, dynamic>{'anchor': false},
                SetOptions(merge: true));
            any = true;
          }
          if (any) await b.commit();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    }

    await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
        void up(VoidCallback f) {
          if (open) setD(f);
        }

        Future<void> go() async {
          up(() {
            saving = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            await save();
            if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
          } catch (_) {
            up(() {
              saving = false;
              err =
                  'Could not save this moment. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        return _lzFrame(ctx2,
            icon: Icons.schedule_rounded,
            title: d == null ? 'Add a moment' : 'Edit moment',
            subtitle: 'One line on your day-of timeline.',
            children: <Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextField(
                  controller: labelC,
                  autofocus: d == null,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                  onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('What happens', hint: 'Ceremony')),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _pcC_pickRow(Icons.schedule_rounded, 'Starts at',
                  time.format(ctx2), () async {
                final TimeOfDay? p =
                    await showTimePicker(context: ctx2, initialTime: time);
                if (p != null) {
                  up(() => time = p);
                }
              }),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                  controller: noteC,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Note (optional)',
                      hint: 'Where, who, what to bring')),
              _lzSection('How long'),
              Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                for (final int m in const <int>[
                  0,
                  15,
                  30,
                  45,
                  60,
                  90,
                  120,
                  180
                ])
                  _tlChip(m == 0 ? 'A moment' : _tlDur(m), dur == m,
                      () => up(() => dur = m)),
              ]),
              _lzSection('Whose moment'),
              Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                for (final List<String> o in kTlOwners)
                  _tlChip(
                      o[1],
                      owners.contains(o[0]),
                      () => up(() {
                            if (!owners.remove(o[0])) owners.add(o[0]);
                          })),
              ]),
              _lzSection('The anchor'),
              Align(
                alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                child: _tlChip(
                    'This is the ceremony \u00b7 the day is built around it',
                    anchor,
                    () => up(() => anchor = !anchor)),
              ),
              _pcC_err(err),
            ],
            footer: _lzActions(
                secondary: 'Cancel',
                onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                primary: d == null ? 'Add moment' : 'Save',
                icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                busy: saving,
                onPrimary: labelC.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : go));
      }),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  // ---- JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-TL-001: the anchored timeline ----

  // Owner tags match _catTag on booked vendors, plus the wedding party.
  static const List<List<String>> kTlOwners = <List<String>>[
    <String>['planner', 'Planner'],
    <String>['photo', 'Photographer'],
    <String>['video', 'Videographer'],
    <String>['dj', 'DJ / band'],
    <String>['caterer', 'Caterer'],
    <String>['venue', 'Venue'],
    <String>['florist', 'Florist'],
    <String>['officiant', 'Officiant'],
    <String>['cake', 'Cake'],
    <String>['party', 'Wedding party'],
  ];

  static String _tlOwnerLabel(String tag) {
    for (final List<String> o in kTlOwners) {
      if (o[0] == tag) return o[1];
    }
    return tag;
  }

  static String _tlDur(int m) {
    if (m <= 0) return '';
    if (m < 60) return '$m min';
    final int h = m ~/ 60;
    final int r = m % 60;
    return r == 0 ? '$h hr' : '$h hr $r min';
  }

  static int _tlMin(String hhmm) {
    final List<String> p = hhmm.split(':');
    return (int.tryParse(p[0]) ?? 0) * 60 +
        (p.length > 1 ? int.tryParse(p[1]) ?? 0 : 0);
  }

  // v139: a moment before 4 am belongs to the night before, so the send-off
  // at 01:10 sorts after the dancing, not before the ceremony
  static int _tlSortKey(dynamic hhmm) {
    final List<String> p = hhmm.toString().split(':');
    final int m = p.length == 2
        ? (int.tryParse(p[0]) ?? 0) * 60 + (int.tryParse(p[1]) ?? 0)
        : 0;
    return m < 240 ? m + 1440 : m;
  }

  static void _tlSortDocs(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs) {
    evs.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
            QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) =>
        _tlSortKey(a.data()['time'] ?? '')
            .compareTo(_tlSortKey(b.data()['time'] ?? '')));
  }

  static String _tlHm(int m) {
    final int x = ((m % 1440) + 1440) % 1440;
    return '${(x ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${(x % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  // "4:00 - 4:30 PM" when the moment has a length, "4:00 PM" when not.
  String _tlRange(Map<String, dynamic> ev) {
    final String t = (ev['time'] ?? '').toString();
    final int dur = ev['dur'] is num ? (ev['dur'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    if (dur <= 0) return _fmtClock(t);
    final String a = _fmtClock(t);
    final String b = _fmtClock(_tlHm(_tlMin(t) + dur));
    final String apA = a.substring(a.length - 2);
    final String apB = b.substring(b.length - 2);
    return apA == apB
        ? '${a.substring(0, a.length - 3)} \u2013 $b'
        : '$a \u2013 $b';
  }

  List<String> _tlOwners(Map<String, dynamic> ev) => <String>[
        if (ev['owners'] is List)
          for (final dynamic o in ev['owners'] as List) o.toString()
      ];

  // The hint that sits between two moments: an overlap, or a long gap.
  String _tlHint(Map<String, dynamic> prev, Map<String, dynamic> next) {
    final int pd = prev['dur'] is num ? (prev['dur'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    if (pd <= 0) return '';
    final int end = _tlMin((prev['time'] ?? '').toString()) + pd;
    final int start = _tlMin((next['time'] ?? '').toString());
    if (start < end) {
      return 'Overlaps ${(prev['label'] ?? 'the last one').toString().toLowerCase()} by ${_tlDur(end - start)}';
    }
    if (start - end >= 60) return '${_tlDur(start - end)} open';
    return '';
  }

  Widget _tlChip(String label, bool on, VoidCallback go) {
    return _Press(
      tick: _Tick.select,
      onTap: go,
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 7),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: _lzBg(on ? plum : Colors.white),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(on ? plum : goldLine)),
        ),
        child: Text(label,
            style: TextStyle(
                color: _lzFg(on ? gold : plum),
                fontSize: 12,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _tlOwnerRow(Map<String, dynamic> ev, {double size = 10}) {
    final List<String> os = _tlOwners(ev);
    if (os.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
      child: Wrap(spacing: 4, runSpacing: 4, children: <Widget>[
        for (final String o in os)
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 2),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: gold.withOpacity(.18),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999)),
            child: Text(_tlOwnerLabel(o),
                style: TextStyle(
                    color: _lzFg(const Color(0xFF8A6A2F)),
                    fontSize: size,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
          ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  // The anchor: the moment flagged as the ceremony, else the first one
  // called Ceremony.
  QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? _tlAnchor(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs) {
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      if (d.data()['anchor'] == true) return d;
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      if ((d.data()['label'] ?? '').toString().trim().toLowerCase() ==
          'ceremony') {
        return d;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // The website's ceremony time ("4:00 pm", "16:00", "4pm") as a TimeOfDay.
  TimeOfDay? _tlSiteCeremony() {
    try {
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? q =
          _liveQ['site:$_cid']?.latest;
      if (q == null || q.docs.isEmpty) return null;
      final String raw = (q.docs.first.data()['ceremonyTime'] ?? '')
          .toString()
          .trim()
          .toLowerCase();
      final RegExpMatch? m =
          RegExp(r'(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm)?').firstMatch(raw);
      if (m == null) return null;
      int h = int.parse(m.group(1)!);
      final int mi = int.tryParse(m.group(2) ?? '') ?? 0;
      final String? ap = m.group(3);
      if (ap == 'pm' && h < 12) h += 12;
      if (ap == 'am' && h == 12) h = 0;
      if (ap == null && h < 8)
        h += 12; // "4:00" on a wedding site means afternoon
      if (h > 23 || mi > 59) return null;
      return TimeOfDay(hour: h, minute: mi);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Move the ceremony and everything moves with it.
  Future<void> _tlReanchor(BuildContext ctx,
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs) async {
    final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? a = _tlAnchor(evs);
    if (a == null) {
      _toast(
          'Mark the ceremony first - open it and tap \u201cThis is the ceremony\u201d.');
      return;
    }
    final int was = _tlMin((a.data()['time'] ?? '16:00').toString());
    final TimeOfDay? p = await showTimePicker(
        context: ctx,
        initialTime: TimeOfDay(hour: was ~/ 60, minute: was % 60),
        helpText: 'CEREMONY TIME - EVERYTHING SHIFTS WITH IT');
    if (p == null) return;
    final int delta = p.hour * 60 + p.minute - was;
    if (delta == 0) return;
    final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    final Map<DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>>, String> before =
        <DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>>, String>{};
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final String t = (d.data()['time'] ?? '').toString();
      before[d.reference] = t;
      b.set(
          d.reference,
          <String, dynamic>{
            'time': _tlHm(_tlMin(t) + delta),
            'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          },
          SetOptions(merge: true));
    }
    await b.commit();
    _toastUndo(
        'Ceremony at ${_fmtClock(_tlHm(p.hour * 60 + p.minute))} - ${evs.length} moments moved ${delta > 0 ? 'later' : 'earlier'} by ${_tlDur(delta.abs())}.',
        () async {
      final WriteBatch u = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
      before.forEach((DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> r, String t) {
        u.set(r, <String, dynamic>{'time': t}, SetOptions(merge: true));
      });
      await u.commit();
    });
  }

  // One vendor's page: their moments first, then the whole day with theirs
  // marked. The planner (and anyone with no tag) gets the whole day plain.
  String _tlVendorHtml(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs,
      List<List<String>> team,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple,
      String tag,
      String vendorName) {
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final bool scoped = tag.isNotEmpty && tag != 'planner';
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    if (scoped) {
      final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> mine = evs
          .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
              _tlOwners(d.data()).contains(tag))
          .toList();
      h.write('<h2>Your moments</h2>');
      if (mine.isEmpty) {
        h.write(
            '<p style="color:#6B5F72">Nothing is marked as yours yet - the whole day is below. Tell us where you need to be and when.</p>');
      } else {
        h.write('<table>');
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in mine) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
          final String note = (ev['note'] ?? '').toString();
          h.write(
              '<tr><td class="time">${_esc(_tlRange(ev))}</td><td><b>${_esc((ev['label'] ?? '').toString())}</b>'
              '${note.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#6B5F72">${_esc(note)}</span>'}</td></tr>');
        }
        h.write('</table>');
      }
      h.write('<h2>The whole day</h2>');
    }
    h.write('<table>');
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
      final String note = (ev['note'] ?? '').toString();
      final List<String> os = _tlOwners(ev);
      final bool mine = scoped && os.contains(tag);
      h.write(
          '<tr${mine ? ' style="background:#FBF3E4"' : ''}><td class="time">${_esc(_tlRange(ev))}</td><td><b>${_esc((ev['label'] ?? '').toString())}</b>'
          '${mine ? ' <span style="color:#8A6A2F;font-size:11px;font-weight:700">YOURS</span>' : ''}'
          '${note.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#6B5F72">${_esc(note)}</span>'}'
          '${os.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#8A6A2F;font-size:11px">${_esc(os.map(_tlOwnerLabel).join(' \u00b7 '))}</span>'}'
          '</td></tr>');
    }
    h.write('</table>');
    if (team.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write('<h2>The team</h2><table>');
      for (final List<String> x in team) {
        h.write(
            '<tr><td>${_esc(x[0])}</td><td><b>${_esc(x[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : x[1])}</b></td></tr>');
      }
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    return _printShell(
        scoped ? 'Day-of timeline for $vendorName' : 'Day-of timeline',
        <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
            .join(' \u00b7 '),
        h.toString());
  }

  String _tlVendorText(List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple, String tag) {
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final bool scoped = tag.isNotEmpty && tag != 'planner';
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln('DAY-OF TIMELINE${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    if (scoped) {
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('YOUR MOMENTS');
      bool any = false;
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
        if (!_tlOwners(ev).contains(tag)) continue;
        any = true;
        t.writeln('${_tlRange(ev)}  ${ev['label'] ?? ''}');
      }
      if (!any) t.writeln('(nothing marked yet - see the whole day)');
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('THE WHOLE DAY');
    } else {
      t.writeln('');
    }
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
      final String note = (ev['note'] ?? '').toString();
      final bool mine = scoped && _tlOwners(ev).contains(tag);
      t.writeln(
          '${_tlRange(ev)}  ${ev['label'] ?? ''}${mine ? '  [yours]' : ''}${note.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $note'}');
    }
    return t.toString();
  }

  void _shareDayOf(List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> evs,
      List<List<String>> team, Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    b.writeln('OUR WEDDING DAY \u2014 the plan \u{1F942}');
    final dynamic ts = couple['weddingDate'];
    if (ts is Timestamp) {
      final DateTime dt = ts.toDate();
      b.writeln('${dt.month}/${dt.day}/${dt.year}');
    }
    b.writeln('');
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in evs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> ev = d.data();
      b.writeln(
          '${_fmtClock((ev['time'] ?? '').toString())}  ${ev['label'] ?? ''}');
      if (((ev['note'] ?? '').toString()).isNotEmpty) {
        b.writeln('        ${ev['note']}');
      }
    }
    if (team.isNotEmpty) {
      b.writeln('');
      b.writeln('THE TEAM');
      for (final List<String> t in team) {
        b.writeln('${t[0]}: ${t[1].isEmpty ? 'Booked' : t[1]}');
      }
    }
    b.writeln('');
    b.writeln('Planned on Lazo \u00b7 meetlazo.com');
    Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: b.toString()));
    _toastC('Copied \u2014 paste it to your wedding party \u2713');
  }

  Future<void> _shareLazo({String? bookedLine}) async {
    int? daysOut;
    try {
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cs = await _coupleRef.get();
      final dynamic ts = cs.data()?['weddingDate'];
      if (ts is Timestamp) {
        daysOut = ts.toDate().difference(DateTime.now()).inDays;
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    if (bookedLine != null && bookedLine.isNotEmpty) {
      b.writeln(bookedLine);
    } else if (daysOut != null && daysOut > 0) {
      b.writeln('$daysOut days until we say \u201cI do\u201d \u{1F48D}');
    } else {
      b.writeln('Planning our wedding \u{1F48D}');
    }
    b.writeln(
        'We\u2019re planning it all on Lazo \u2014 real prices, verified vendors, zero spam.');
    b.writeln('meetlazo.com');
    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: b.toString()));
    _toastC(
        'Copied \u2014 paste it on Instagram, TikTok, the group chat\u2026 \u2713');
  }

  // v139: chapters can be listed, edited and deleted, not only added
  Future<void> _chaptersSheet(String slug) async {
    if (!mounted) {
      return;
    }
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 640),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) =>
          StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('weddingSites')
            .doc(slug)
            .collection('chapters')
            .orderBy('dateIso', descending: true)
            .snapshots(),
        builder: (BuildContext c,
            AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
          final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
              sn.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
          final bool loading = !sn.hasData && !sn.hasError;
          return _lzFrame(ctx,
              icon: Icons.auto_stories_rounded,
              title: 'Chapters',
              subtitle: docs.isEmpty
                  ? 'The story keeps going on your site after the big day.'
                  : '${docs.length} on your site - tap one to edit',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (loading)
                  _lzBusy('Loading your chapters')
                else if (docs.isEmpty)
                  _pcC_empty(Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
                      'No chapters yet. Add the honeymoon, big news or an anniversary.')
                else
                  for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d
                      in docs)
                    _pcC_chapterRow(slug, d),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Done',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                  primary: 'Add a chapter',
                  icon: Icons.add_rounded,
                  onPrimary: () => _addChapterDialog(slug)));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _pcC_chapterRow(
      String slug, QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> ch = d.data();
    final List<String> ph = List<String>.from(
        (ch['photos'] as List?)?.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()) ??
            const <String>[]);
    final String title = (ch['title'] ?? '').toString();
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _addChapterDialog(slug, d),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 12, 4, 12),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _lzBg(cardBg),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
              border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(goldLine))),
          child: Row(children: <Widget>[
            ClipRRect(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              child: ph.isNotEmpty
                  ? Image.network(ph.first,
                      width: 54,
                      height: 54,
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                      errorBuilder:
                          (BuildContext c5, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                              Container(
                                  width: 54,
                                  height: 54,
                                  color: gold.withOpacity(.12)))
                  : Container(
                      width: 54,
                      height: 54,
                      color: gold.withOpacity(.12),
                      child: Icon(Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
                          color: _lzFg(plum), size: 22)),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text(title.isEmpty ? 'Untitled chapter' : title,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                            fontSize: 14.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                        '${ch['dateIso'] ?? ''}${ph.isNotEmpty ? ' \u00b7 ${ph.length} photo${ph.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}' : ''}',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ]),
            ),
            IconButton(
              tooltip: 'Delete chapter',
              onPressed: _h(() async {
                final bool sure = await _lzConfirm('Delete this chapter?',
                    'It comes off your site right away.',
                    confirm: 'Delete chapter', cancel: 'Keep', danger: true);
                if (sure) {
                  await d.reference.delete();
                }
              }),
              icon: Icon(Icons.delete_outline_rounded,
                  color: _lzFg(muted), size: 20),
            ),
          ]),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _addChapterDialog(String slug,
      [QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? existing]) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> ex = existing?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController titleC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ex['title'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController textC =
        TextEditingController(text: (ex['text'] ?? '').toString());
    DateTime chDate =
        DateTime.tryParse((ex['dateIso'] ?? '').toString()) ?? DateTime.now();
    final List<String> photos = List<String>.from(
        (ex['photos'] as List?)?.map((dynamic e) => e.toString()) ??
            const <String>[]);
    bool busy = false;
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    const List<String> months = <String>[
      'January',
      'February',
      'March',
      'April',
      'May',
      'June',
      'July',
      'August',
      'September',
      'October',
      'November',
      'December'
    ];

    Future<void> pickPhotos(StateSetter setD) async {
      void up(VoidCallback f) {
        if (open) setD(f);
      }

      try {
        final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
            type: FileType.image, allowMultiple: true, withData: true);
        if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) {
          return;
        }
        up(() {
          busy = true;
          err = '';
        });
        for (final PlatformFile f in res.files) {
          if (photos.length >= 4) {
            break;
          }
          final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
          if (bytes == null) {
            continue;
          }
          final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
              ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.')).toLowerCase()
              : '.jpg';
          final String ctype = ext == '.png'
              ? 'image/png'
              : ext == '.webp'
                  ? 'image/webp'
                  : 'image/jpeg';
          final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(
              'couples/$_uid/site/ch${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext');
          await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
          photos.add(await ref.getDownloadURL());
          up(() {});
        }
        up(() => busy = false);
      } catch (e) {
        up(() {
          busy = false;
          err = 'A photo didn\u2019t upload. Try a JPG or PNG, or try again.';
        });
      }
    }

    await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setD(f);
          }

          Future<void> publish() async {
            up(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              final Map<String, dynamic> chData = <String, dynamic>{
                'title': titleC.text.trim(),
                'text': textC.text.trim(),
                'dateIso':
                    '${chDate.year}-${chDate.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-${chDate.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}',
                'photos': photos,
                if (existing == null) 'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              };
              if (existing != null) {
                await existing.reference.set(chData, SetOptions(merge: true));
              } else {
                await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                    .collection('weddingSites')
                    .doc(slug)
                    .collection('chapters')
                    .add(chData);
              }
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
              _toastC(existing != null
                  ? 'Chapter updated.'
                  : 'Chapter published. It\u2019s live on your site.');
            } catch (e) {
              up(() {
                saving = false;
                err = 'Couldn\u2019t publish just now. Try again in a moment.';
              });
            }
          }

          Widget thumb(Widget child) => ClipRRect(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                child: SizedBox(width: 74, height: 74, child: child),
              );

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.auto_stories_rounded,
              title: existing == null ? 'Add a chapter' : 'Edit chapter',
              subtitle: 'Honeymoon photos, big news, anniversaries.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                    controller: titleC,
                    autofocus: existing == null,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                    onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Title',
                        hint: 'The honeymoon \u00b7 Big news \u00b7 One year in')),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                _pcC_pickRow(
                    Icons.event_rounded,
                    'Date',
                    '${months[chDate.month - 1]} ${chDate.day}, ${chDate.year}',
                    () async {
                  final DateTime? d = await showDatePicker(
                      context: ctx2,
                      initialDate: chDate,
                      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                      lastDate: DateTime(2100));
                  if (d != null) {
                    up(() => chDate = d);
                  }
                }),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                TextField(
                    controller: textC,
                    minLines: 3,
                    maxLines: 6,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('The story')),
                _lzSection('Photos', trailing: '${photos.length} of 4'),
                Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    ...photos.map((String u) => thumb(Image.network(u,
                        fit: BoxFit.cover,
                        errorBuilder:
                            (BuildContext c5, Object e, StackTrace? st) =>
                                Container(color: gold.withOpacity(.12))))),
                    if (busy)
                      thumb(Container(
                        color: gold.withOpacity(.1),
                        child: const Center(
                            child: SizedBox(
                                width: 18,
                                height: 18,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                    color: gold, strokeWidth: 2))),
                      )),
                    if (!busy && photos.length < 4)
                      _Press(
                        onTap: () => pickPhotos(setD),
                        child: Container(
                          width: 74,
                          height: 74,
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                            border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(gold)),
                          ),
                          child: Column(
                              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                              children: <Widget>[
                                Icon(Icons.add_photo_alternate_outlined,
                                    color: _lzFg(plum), size: 22),
                                const SizedBox(height: 3),
                                Text('Add',
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11.5,
                                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                              ]),
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                  primary:
                      existing == null ? 'Publish chapter' : 'Save chapter',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: titleC.text.trim().isEmpty || busy
                      ? null
                      : publish));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

                Row(children: <Widget>[
                  btn(Icons.facebook_rounded, 'Facebook', 'Post the link', () {
                    _openLink(
                        'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=${Uri.encodeComponent(url)}&quote=${Uri.encodeComponent(msg)}');
                  }),
                  btn(Icons.photo_camera_rounded, 'Instagram',
                      'We copy a caption', () async {
                    await Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: msg));
                    _toastC('Caption copied. Paste it into a Story or post.');
                    _openLink('https://www.instagram.com/');
                  }),
                ]),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Done',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: copied ? 'Link copied' : 'Copy link',
                  icon: copied ? Icons.check_rounded : Icons.copy_rounded,
                  onPrimary: copyLink));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openContractPdf(Map<String, dynamic> ct) async {
    final String path =
        ((ct['signedPdfPath'] ?? ct['pdfPath'] ?? '') as String? ?? '');
    if (path.isEmpty) {
      _toastC('Your signed copy was emailed to you by SignWell.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      final String url =
          await FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path).getDownloadURL();
      await _openLink(url);
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Your signed copy was emailed to you by SignWell.');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _contractsVaultSheet() async {
    if (_uid == null) {
      return;
    }
    final Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> load = () async {
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
      final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> iq = await FirebaseFirestore
          .instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .where('coupleUid', isEqualTo: _cid)
          .limit(40)
          .get();
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> inq in iq.docs) {
        try {
          final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> cs = await inq.reference
              .collection('contracts')
              .where('status', isEqualTo: 'signed')
              .get();
          for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> c
              in cs.docs) {
            rows.add(<String, dynamic>{
              ...c.data(),
              'vendorName': inq.data()['vendorName'] ?? 'Vendor',
            });
          }
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      rows.sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) {
        final Timestamp ta = (a['signedAt'] is Timestamp)
            ? a['signedAt'] as Timestamp
            : Timestamp(0, 0);
        final Timestamp tb = (b['signedAt'] is Timestamp)
            ? b['signedAt'] as Timestamp
            : Timestamp(0, 0);
        return tb.compareTo(ta);
      });
      return rows;
    }();
    _lzSheet(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 680),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => FutureBuilder<List<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        future: load,
        builder:
            (BuildContext c2, AsyncSnapshot<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> s) {
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> rows =
              s.data ?? <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
          final bool loading = s.connectionState != ConnectionState.done;
          return _lzFrame(ctx,
              icon: Icons.history_edu_rounded,
              title: 'Your contracts',
              subtitle: loading || rows.isEmpty
                  ? 'Every signed agreement, kept for you.'
                  : '${rows.length} signed \u00b7 kept for you',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                if (loading)
                  _lzBusy('Gathering your signed contracts')
                else if (s.hasError)
                  _pcC_err(
                      'Could not load your contracts. Close this and try again.')
                else if (rows.isEmpty)
                  _pcC_empty(Icons.history_edu_rounded,
                      'Nothing signed yet. When you sign a vendor\u2019s agreement, it lives here.')
                else
                  for (final Map<String, dynamic> ct in rows)
                    _pcC_contractRow(ct),
              ]);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _pcC_contractRow(Map<String, dynamic> ct) {
    String when = '';
    if (ct['signedAt'] is Timestamp) {
      final DateTime dt = (ct['signedAt'] as Timestamp).toDate();
      when = 'Signed ${dt.month}/${dt.day}/${dt.year}';
    }
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 6, 12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _lzBg(Colors.white),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(color: vGreen.withOpacity(.5)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        Container(
            width: 36,
            height: 36,
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: vGreen.withOpacity(.12),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(11)),
            child: Icon(Icons.verified_rounded, color: _lzFg(vGreen), size: 19)),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text((ct['templateName'] ?? 'Agreement').toString(),
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(ink),
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 2),
                Text('${ct['vendorName']}${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' \u00b7 $when'}',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: _lzFg(muted))),
              ]),
        ),
        TextButton(
          onPressed: _h(() => _openContractPdf(ct)),
          child: Text('View',
              style: TextStyle(
                  color: _lzFg(plum),
                  fontSize: 13,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
        ),
      ]),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openSigning(String url) async {
    try {
      final Uri uri = Uri.parse(url);
      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
        await launchUrl(uri,
            mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication, webOnlyWindowName: '_blank');
      } else {
        _toastC('Could not open the signing page.');
      }
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Could not open the signing page.');
    }
  }

  Widget _coupleProposals(String inquiryId, String vendorName) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('proposals')
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> ps) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            ps.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        if (docs.isEmpty) {
          return const SizedBox.shrink();
        }
        return Column(
          children: docs.map((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
            final Map<String, dynamic> p = d.data();
            final String st = (p['status'] ?? 'sent') as String;
            final bool accepted = st == 'accepted';
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 0, 20, 10),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                    colors: accepted
                        ? <Color>[vGreen, const Color(0xFF3AA37E)]
                        : <Color>[plumDeep, plum]),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.75)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(Icons.description_rounded,
                        color: gold, size: 18),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    const Text('PROPOSAL',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: gold,
                            fontSize: 10,
                            letterSpacing: 2,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ]),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text((p['title'] ?? '') as String,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: ivory,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                  Text('\$${((p['price'] ?? 0) as num).toStringAsFixed(0)}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: gold,
                          fontSize: 22,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  if (((p['note'] ?? '') as String).isNotEmpty)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                      child: Text((p['note'] ?? '') as String,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                              color: Color(0xFFEBDDEC),
                              fontSize: 12.5,
                              height: 1.4)),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  if (accepted)
                    const Text(
                        'Accepted \u00b7 you\u2019re booked',
                        style: TextStyle(
                            color: ivory,
                            fontSize: 13,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700))
                  else if (st == 'declined')
                    const Text('Declined',
                        style:
                            TextStyle(color: Color(0xFFEBDDEC), fontSize: 12.5))
                  else
                    Row(children: <Widget>[
                      Expanded(
                        child: FilledButton(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plumDeep),
                          onPressed: _h(() async {
                            // v140: ask first, then let the price reach the plan
                            final num price = (p['price'] as num?) ?? 0;
                            final bool sure = await _lzConfirm(
                                'Accept this proposal?',
                                price > 0
                                    ? '${_money(price)} from $vendorName. It becomes this category\u2019s planned figure if you haven\u2019t set one.'
                                    : 'You\u2019re telling $vendorName yes.',
                                confirm: 'Accept proposal',
                                cancel: 'Not yet',
                                icon: Icons.description_rounded);
                            if (!sure) {
                              return;
                            }
                            await d.reference.update(<String, dynamic>{
                              'status': 'accepted',
                              'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                            });
                            await _noteQuoted(inquiryId, price);
                          }, _Tick.medium),
                          child: const Text('Accept proposal',
                              style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: _h(() async {
                          await d.reference.update(<String, dynamic>{
                            'status': 'declined',
                            'respondedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp()
                          });
                        }),
                        child: const Text('Decline',
                            style: TextStyle(
                                color: Color(0xFFEBDDEC), fontSize: 12.5)),
                      ),
                    ]),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }).toList(),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  String _fmtMsgTime(DateTime t) {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime local = t.toLocal();
    final int h12 = local.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : local.hour % 12;
    final String hm =
        '$h12:${local.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${local.hour >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM'}';
    final DateTime today = DateTime(now.year, now.month, now.day);
    final DateTime day = DateTime(local.year, local.month, local.day);
    if (day == today) {
      return hm;
    }
    if (day == today.subtract(const Duration(days: 1))) {
      return 'Yesterday $hm';
    }
    const List<String> mo = <String>[
      'Jan',
      'Feb',
      'Mar',
      'Apr',
      'May',
      'Jun',
      'Jul',
      'Aug',
      'Sep',
      'Oct',
      'Nov',
      'Dec'
    ];
    return '${mo[local.month - 1]} ${local.day}, $hm';
  }

  Future<void> _editCoupleMessage(
      String inquiryId, String messageId, String current) async {
    final TextEditingController ec = TextEditingController(text: current);
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setE) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setE(f);
          }

          final String t = ec.text.trim();
          final bool can = t.isNotEmpty && t != current;

          Future<void> save() async {
            up(() {
              saving = true;
              err = '';
            });
            try {
              await FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('inquiries')
                  .doc(inquiryId)
                  .collection('messages')
                  .doc(messageId)
                  .update(<String, dynamic>{
                'text': ec.text.trim(),
                'editedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
              });
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
            } catch (_) {
              up(() {
                saving = false;
                err = 'Could not save your edit. Try again.';
              });
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.edit_rounded,
              title: 'Edit message',
              subtitle: 'It shows as edited in the conversation.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                  controller: ec,
                  autofocus: true,
                  minLines: 2,
                  maxLines: 6,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Your message'),
                ),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Save',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  busy: saving,
                  onPrimary: can ? save : null));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  void _emojiSheet(TextEditingController target, {VoidCallback? after}) {
    String tab = kEmoji.keys.first;
    _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: _lzBg(ivory),
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(26))),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setE) => SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 14, 18, 18),
            child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: <Widget>[
                  Row(
                      children: kEmoji.keys.map((String k) {
                    final bool sel = tab == k;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
                      child: _Press(
                        tick: _Tick.select,
                        onTap: () => setE(() => tab = k),
                        child: Container(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 13, vertical: 7),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: _lzBg(sel ? plum : Colors.white),
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                            border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                          ),
                          child: Text(k,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(sel ? ivory : plum),
                                  fontSize: 12,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  }).toList()),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 6,
                    runSpacing: 6,
                    children: (kEmoji[tab] ?? const <String>[])
                        .map((String e) => _Press(
                              tick: _Tick.select,
                              onTap: () {
                                final TextEditingValue v = target.value;
                                final int pos = v.selection.baseOffset < 0
                                    ? v.text.length
                                    : v.selection.baseOffset;
                                final String next = v.text.substring(0, pos) +
                                    e +
                                    v.text.substring(pos);
                                target.value = TextEditingValue(
                                  text: next,
                                  selection: TextSelection.collapsed(
                                      offset: pos + e.length),
                                );
                                if (after != null) after();
                              },
                              child: Container(
                                width: 44,
                                height: 44,
                                alignment: Alignment.center,
                                child: Text(e,
                                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 23)),
                              ),
                            ))
                        .toList(),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                   Center(
                    child: Text('Tap to add - keep going, then close.',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ),
                ]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _attachmentTile(Map<String, dynamic> a, bool mine) {
    final String url = (a['url'] ?? '').toString();
    final String name = (a['name'] ?? 'Attachment').toString();
    final String type = (a['type'] ?? '').toString();
    final dynamic rawSize = a['size'];
    final int size =
        rawSize is int ? rawSize : (rawSize is num ? rawSize.toInt() : 0);
    final bool isImage = type.startsWith('image/');
    String sizeLabel = '';
    if (size > 0) {
      sizeLabel = size > 1024 * 1024
          ? '${(size / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)} MB'
          : '${(size / 1024).round()} KB';
    }
    if (isImage) {
      return Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          child: _Press(
            onTap: () => _openSigning(url),
            child: Image.network(url,
                width: 250,
                fit: BoxFit.cover,
                errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? s) =>
                    const SizedBox.shrink()),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }
    final IconData ic = type.contains('pdf')
        ? Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded
        : type.startsWith('video/')
            ? Icons.movie_rounded
            : Icons.insert_drive_file_rounded;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: _Press(
        onTap: () => _openSigning(url),
        child: Container(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 9),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _lzBg(mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.16) : plum.withOpacity(.06)),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            border: Border.all(
                color: _lzLine(mine ? ivory.withOpacity(.4) : gold.withOpacity(.6))),
          ),
          child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
            Icon(ic, size: 17, color: _lzFg(mine ? ivory : plum)),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Flexible(
              child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
