  // v67: attachments. Pricing sheets, inspiration photos, timelines -
  // the things that used to force everyone back into email.
  static const List<String> kAttachExt = <String>[
    'jpg',
    'jpeg',
    'png',
    'webp',
    'heic',
    'pdf',
    'doc',
    'docx',
    'mp4',
    'mov'
  ];
  static const String kAttachHint =
      'PDF, Word, JPG, PNG, HEIC, MP4 or MOV \u2014 up to 20MB';

  // v71: tell them what fits, then show it going.
  Future<void> _pickAndSendAttachment(String inquiryId,
      {StateSetter? refresh}) async {
    void bump() {
      if (refresh != null) {
        refresh(() {});
      } else if (mounted) {
        setState(() {});
      }
    }

    FilePickerResult? res;
    try {
      res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: kAttachExt,
        withData: true,
      );
    } catch (_) {
      _toastC('Could not open files.');
      return;
    }
    if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) return;
    final PlatformFile f = res.files.first;
    final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
    if (bytes == null) {
      _toastC('Could not read that file.');
      return;
    }
    if (bytes.length > 20 * 1024 * 1024) {
      _toastC(
          'That file is ${(bytes.length / (1024 * 1024)).toStringAsFixed(1)}MB \u2014 the limit is 20MB.');
      return;
    }
    final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
        ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase()
        : '';
    if (!kAttachExt.contains(ext)) {
      _toastC('$kAttachHint.');
      return;
    }
    _attaching = true;
    _attachName = f.name;
    _attachPct = 0;
    bump();
    try {
      String ctype = 'application/octet-stream';
      if (<String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'heic'].contains(ext)) {
        ctype = 'image/jpeg';
      } else if (ext == 'png') {
        ctype = 'image/png';
      } else if (ext == 'webp') {
        ctype = 'image/webp';
      } else if (ext == 'pdf') {
        ctype = 'application/pdf';
      } else if (ext == 'mp4') {
        ctype = 'video/mp4';
      } else if (ext == 'mov') {
        ctype = 'video/quicktime';
      } else if (ext == 'doc' || ext == 'docx') {
        ctype = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument'
            '.wordprocessingml.document';
      }
      final String safe = f.name.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]'), '_');
      final String path = 'inquiries/$inquiryId/attachments/'
          '${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}_$safe';
      final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(path);
      final UploadTask task =
          ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
      task.snapshotEvents.listen((TaskSnapshot s) {
        if (s.totalBytes <= 0) return;
        _attachPct = s.bytesTransferred / s.totalBytes;
        bump();
      });
      await task;
      final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
      await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('inquiries')
          .doc(inquiryId)
          .collection('messages')
          .add(<String, dynamic>{
        'senderRole': 'couple',
        'text': '',
        'at': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'attachment': <String, dynamic>{
          'url': url,
          'name': f.name,
          'type': ctype,
          'size': bytes.length,
          'path': path,
        },
      });
      _attaching = false;
      _attachPct = 1;
      bump();
      _toastC('${f.name} attached \u2713');
    } catch (e) {
      _attaching = false;
      bump();
      _toastC('Could not send that file \u2014 try again.');
      debugPrint('LAZO attach: ' + e.toString());
    }
  }

  Widget _uploadStrip() {
    if (!_attaching) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    final int pct = (_attachPct * 100).clamp(0, 100).round();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 0, 18, 6),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: gold.withOpacity(.14),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
      ),
      child: Row(children: <Widget>[
        const SizedBox(
          width: 14,
          height: 14,
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: plum),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 10),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: <Widget>[
                Text('Attaching $_attachName\u2026',
                    maxLines: 1,
                    overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    style:  TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(plum),
                        fontSize: 11.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  child: SizedBox(

                      value: _attachPct <= 0 ? null : _attachPct,

                      valueColor: const AlwaysStoppedAnimation<Color>(gold),

                  ),
                ),

        ),

            style:  TextStyle(

      ]),
    );
  }

  Widget _guestScreen() {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _guestsRef.snapshots(),
      builder: (BuildContext context,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> snap) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[
          ...(snap.data?.docs ??
              <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[])
        ];
        docs.sort((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> a,
                QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> b) =>
            ((a.data()['name'] ?? '') as String)
                .toLowerCase()
                .compareTo(((b.data()['name'] ?? '') as String).toLowerCase()));
        int yes = 0, no = 0, pend = 0, heads = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
          final String r = (g['rsvp'] ?? 'pending') as String;
          final int plus = ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
          if (r == 'yes') {
            yes++;
            heads += 1 + plus;
          } else if (r == 'no') {
            no++;
          } else {
            pend++;
          }
        }
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> shown =
            docs.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          if (_guestFilter == 'all') {
            return true;
          }
          final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
          if (_guestFilter == 'yes' ||
              _guestFilter == 'no' ||
              _guestFilter == 'pending') {
            return (g['rsvp'] ?? 'pending') == _guestFilter;
          }
          return (g['group'] ?? '') == _guestFilter;
        }).where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          final String q = _guestSearchC.text.trim().toLowerCase();
          if (q.isEmpty) {
            return true;
          }
          final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
          // v139: email, table and meal too
          return ('${g['name'] ?? ''} ${g['party'] ?? ''} ${g['email'] ?? ''} ${g['tableName'] ?? ''} ${g['meal'] ?? ''}')
              .toLowerCase()
              .contains(q);
        }).toList();

        return ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 32),
          children: <Widget>[
            // The two caterer pills used to share this row with the header.
            // They size to their content, so on a phone they took ~260 of the
            // ~324 available and left the title about 5px to live in - which
            // is why 'Guest list' came out one letter per line. They get their
            // own row now, and Wrap drops them to a second line rather than
            // squeezing anything.
            _subHeader('Guest list'),
            _thankYouLine(docs),
            if (docs.isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 14),
                child: Wrap(
                  spacing: 8,
                  runSpacing: 8,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _Press(
                      onTap: () => _sendGuestSheet(
                          docs,
                          _liveD['couple:$_cid']?.latest?.data() ??
                              <String, dynamic>{}),
                      child: Container(
                        height: 34,
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: gold,
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                        ),
                        child: const Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: plum, size: 14),
                              SizedBox(width: 5),
                              Text('Send to caterer',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: plum,
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                    _Press(
                      onTap: () => _shareGuestList(docs),
                      child: Container(
                        height: 34,
                        alignment: Alignment.center,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _lzBg(ivory.withOpacity(.12)),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                          border: Border.all(color: gold.withOpacity(.6)),
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              const Icon(Icons.ios_share_rounded,
                                  color: ivory, size: 14),
                              const SizedBox(width: 5),
                              Text('For your caterer',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                                      fontSize: 11.5,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                            ]),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            _glass(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              radius: 20,
              tint: .6,
              borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.5),
              child: Column(children: <Widget>[
                Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    _gStat('$heads', 'HEADCOUNT'),
                    _gStat('$yes', 'ATTENDING'),
                    _gStat('$pend', 'PENDING'),
                    _gStat('$no', 'DECLINED'),
                  ],
                ),
                Builder(builder: (BuildContext bc) {
                  final Map<String, int> meals = <String, int>{};
                  int allergies = 0;
                  for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d

                    final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
                    if ((g['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'no') {
                      continue;
                    }
                    final String m = (g['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim();
                    if (m.isNotEmpty) {
                      meals[m] = (meals[m] ?? 0) + 1;
                    }
                    if ((g['allergies'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty) {
                      allergies++;
                    }
                  }
                  if (meals.isEmpty && allergies == 0) {
                    return const SizedBox.shrink();
                  }
                  final String line = <String>[
                    ...meals.entries.map(
                        (MapEntry<String, int> e) => '${e.value} ${e.key}'),
                    if (allergies > 0) '$allergies with allergies',
                  ].join(' \u00b7 ');
                  return Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 10),
                    child: Text(line,
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11.5,
                            color: _lzFg(muted),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
                  );
                }),
              ]),

            _seatingCard(docs),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: _guestSearchC,
              onChanged: (String _) => setState(() {}),
              style:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 13.5),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                isDense: true,
                hintText: 'Search guests\u2026',
                hintStyle:  TextStyle(color: _lzFg(muted)),
                prefixIcon:
                     Icon(Icons.search_rounded, color: _lzFg(muted), size: 19),
                filled: true,
                fillColor: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(.94)),
                contentPadding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 10),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                ),
                enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                  borderSide: BorderSide(color: gold.withOpacity(.5)),
                ),

  void _shareGuestList(List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) {

    _toastC('Copied \u2014 paste it to your caterer \u2713');

  String _guestListText(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs) {
    final StringBuffer b = StringBuffer();
    b.writeln('GUEST LIST \u2014 for the caterer & planner');
    int heads = 0;
    final Map<String, int> meals = <String, int>{};
    final List<String> allergyLines = <String>[];
    final Map<String, List<String>> tables = <String, List<String>>{};
    for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
      final Map<String, dynamic> g = d.data();
      if ((g['rsvp'] ?? '') == 'no') {
        continue;
      }
      final String name = (g['name'] ?? '').toString();
      final int plus = ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
      heads += 1 + plus;
      final String m = (g['meal'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (m.isNotEmpty) {
        meals[m] = (meals[m] ?? 0) + 1;
      }
      final String al = (g['allergies'] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (al.isNotEmpty) {
        allergyLines.add('$name: $al');
      }
      final String tn = (g['tableName'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty
          ? g['tableName'].toString().trim()
          : (g['table'] is num ? 'Table ${g['table']}' : '');
      if (tn.isNotEmpty) {
        tables.putIfAbsent(tn, () => <String>[]).add(name);
      }
    }
    b.writeln('Headcount (attending + pending): $heads');
    if (meals.isNotEmpty) {
      b.writeln('');
      b.writeln('MEALS');
      meals.forEach((String m, int n) => b.writeln('$m: $n'));
    }
    if (allergyLines.isNotEmpty) {
      b.writeln('');
      b.writeln('ALLERGIES & DIETARY');
      allergyLines.forEach(b.writeln);
    }
    if (tables.isNotEmpty) {
      b.writeln('');
      b.writeln('TABLES');
      final List<String> keys = tables.keys.toList()..sort();
      for (final String t in keys) {
        b.writeln('$t: ${tables[t]!.join(', ')}');
      }
    }
    b.writeln('');
    b.writeln('Planned on Lazo \u00b7 meetlazo.com');
    return b.toString();
  }

  Widget _gStat(String v, String label) {
    return Column(children: <Widget>[
      Text(v,
          style:  TextStyle(
              color: _lzFg(plum), fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

              letterSpacing: 1.2,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
    ]);
  }

  Widget _guestRow(String id, Map<String, dynamic> g) {
    final String rsvp = (g['rsvp'] ?? 'pending') as String;
    final Color rc = rsvp == 'yes'
        ? vGreen
        : rsvp == 'no'
            ? const Color(0xFF8A7D90)
            : const Color(0xFF8A6A2F);
    final int plus = ((g['plusOnes'] ?? 0) as num).toInt();
    final List<String> bits = <String>[
      if ((g['party'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) (g['party'] as String),
      if (plus > 0) '+$plus',
      if ((g['meal'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty) (g['meal'] as String),
      if ((g['allergies'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty)
        '\u26a0 ${g['allergies']}',
      if ((g['tableName'] ?? '').toString().trim().isNotEmpty)
        '${g['tableName']}${g['seat'] is num && (g['seat'] as num) >= 0 ? ' \u00b7 seat ${(g['seat'] as num).toInt() + 1}' : ''}',
      if (g['thankYouAt'] != null) '\u2709 thanked',
      if (g['events'] is List && (g['events'] as List).isNotEmpty)
        (g['events'] as List).join(', '),
    ];
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: _Press(
        scale: .985,
        dim: .92,
        onTap: () => _editGuest(id, g),
        child: _glass(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 11),
          radius: 16,
          tint: .6,
          borderColor: gold.withOpacity(.4),
          child: Row(
            children: <Widget>[
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: <Widget>[
                    Text((g['name'] ?? '') as String,
                        style:  TextStyle(
                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                            fontSize: 14.5,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                    if (bits.isNotEmpty)
                      Text(bits.join(' \u00b7 '),
                          style:  TextStyle(fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Container(
                padding:
                    const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 5),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: _lzBg(rc.withOpacity(.14)),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                ),
                child: Text(
                    rsvp == 'yes'
                        ? 'Attending'
                        : rsvp == 'no'
                            ? 'Declined'
                            : 'Pending',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(rc), fontSize: 11, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _bdItems = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  bool _bdLoaded = false;
  String _bdSel = '';
  bool _bdDragging = false;
  bool _bdBusy = false;
  Timer? _bdSaveT;
  final TransformationController _bdTc = TransformationController();
  int _bdLocalRev =
      0; // bumps on every local change; remote snapshots older than our last save are ignored
  // v139: while a local change is waiting for its save, the cached remote
  // snapshot must not be re-applied - it reverted new pins and comments
  bool _bdDirty = false;

  void _bdApplyRemote(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    if (_bdDragging || _bdDirty) return;
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> next = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    if (d['items'] is List) {
      for (final dynamic it in d['items'] as List) {
        if (it is Map) next.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(it));
      }
    }
    _bdItems = next;
    _bdLoaded = true;
  }

  void _bdSave() {
    _bdDirty = true;
    _bdLocalRev++;
    _bdSaveT?.cancel();
    _bdSaveT = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 500), () async {
      try {
        await _boardRef.set(<String, dynamic>{
          'items': _bdItems,
          'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        }, SetOptions(merge: true));
      } catch (e) {
        _toast('Could not save the board: ' + e.toString());
      } finally {
        _bdDirty = false;
      }
    });
  }

  double _bdScale() => _bdTc.value.getMaxScaleOnAxis();

  String _bdId() =>
      'b${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}${_bdItems.length}';

  int _bdTopZ() {
    int z = 0;
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> it in _bdItems) {
      final int iz = it['z'] is num ? (it['z'] as num).toInt() : 0;
      if (iz > z) z = iz;
    }
    return z;
  }

  // Somewhere free-ish in the current view: the centre, nudged for each item.
  Offset _bdSpot() {
    final int n = _bdItems.length;
    return Offset(200 + (n % 6) * 90.0, 160 + ((n ~/ 6) % 5) * 80.0);
  }

  void _bdAdd(Map<String, dynamic> it) {
    final Offset o = _bdSpot();
    it['id'] = _bdId();
    it['x'] = o.dx;
    it['y'] = o.dy;
    it['z'] = _bdTopZ() + 1;
    setState(() {
      _bdItems.add(it);
      _bdSel = it['id'].toString();
    });
    _bdSave();
  }

  Map<String, dynamic>? _bdById(String id) {
    for (final Map<String, dynamic> it in _bdItems) {
      if (it['id'] == id) return it;
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _bdAddLink() async {
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    bool busy = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setL) {
          void up(VoidCallback f) {
            if (open) setL(f);
          }

          Future<void> pin() async {
            String u = c.text.trim();
            if (u.isEmpty || busy) return;
            if (!u.startsWith('http')) u = 'https://' + u;
            up(() {
              busy = true;
              err = '';
            });
            if (mounted) setState(() => _bdBusy = true);
            try {
              final httpc.Response r = await httpc
                  .get(Uri.parse('https://meetlazo.com/api/unfurl?u=' +
                      Uri.encodeComponent(u)))
                  .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
              final Map<String, dynamic> j = r.statusCode == 200
                  ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(jsonDecode(r.body) as Map)
                  : <String, dynamic>{};
              final String img = (j['image'] ?? '').toString();
              if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2);
              if (img.isEmpty) {
                _bdAdd(<String, dynamic>{
                  'kind': 'note',
                  'text': (j['title'] ?? '').toString().isNotEmpty
                      ? j['title'].toString()
                      : u,
                  'src': u,
                  'color': 'F3EBDD',
                  'w': 220.0,
                  'ar': 1.4,
                });
                _toast(
                    'No picture on that page - pinned it as a note with the link.');
              } else {
                _bdAdd(<String, dynamic>{
                  'kind': 'image',
                  'url': img,
                  'src': (j['url'] ?? u).toString(),
                  'title': (j['title'] ?? '').toString(),
                  'site': (j['site'] ?? '').toString(),
                  'w': 260.0,
                  'ar': 1.0,
                });
              }
            } catch (e) {
              up(() {
                busy = false;
                err =
                    'Could not read that link. Check it opens in your browser, then try again.';
              });
            } finally {
              if (mounted) setState(() => _bdBusy = false);
            }
          }

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.link_rounded,
              title: 'Pin from a link',
              subtitle: 'We pull the picture and a caption from the page.',
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextField(
                    controller: c,
                    autofocus: true,
                    enabled: !busy,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.go,
                    onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                    onSubmitted: (_) => pin(),
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('Paste the link',
                        hint:
                            'A Pinterest pin, an Etsy listing, any page or picture')),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (busy)
                  _lzBusy('Reading the page\u2026')
                else
                  _lzNote(Icons.push_pin_outlined,
                      'On Pinterest, copy the link from the share button.'),
                _pcC_err(err),
              ],
              footer: _lzActions(
                  secondary: 'Cancel',
                  onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2),
                  primary: 'Pin it',
                  icon: Icons.push_pin_rounded,
                  busy: busy,
                  onPrimary: c.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : pin));
        },
      ),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  Future<void> _bdAddPhoto() async {
    try {
      final FilePickerResult? res = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowedExtensions: <String>['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
        withData: true,
        allowMultiple: true,
      );
      if (res == null || res.files.isEmpty) return;
      setState(() => _bdBusy = true);
      for (final PlatformFile f in res.files.take(6)) {
        final Uint8List? bytes = f.bytes;
        if (bytes == null || bytes.length > 8 * 1024 * 1024) continue;
        final String ext = f.name.contains('.')
            ? f.name.substring(f.name.lastIndexOf('.')).toLowerCase()
            : '.jpg';
        final String ctype = ext == '.png'
            ? 'image/png'
            : (ext == '.webp' ? 'image/webp' : 'image/jpeg');
        // The website gallery path: the storage rules already allow it.
        final Reference ref = FirebaseStorage.instance.ref(
            'couples/$_uid/site/board${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}$ext');
        await ref.putData(bytes, SettableMetadata(contentType: ctype));
        final String url = await ref.getDownloadURL();
        _bdAdd(<String, dynamic>{
          'kind': 'image',
          'url': url,
          'src': '',
          'title': '',
          'site': '',
          'w': 260.0,
          'ar': 1.0
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _toast(e.toString().contains('permission') ||
              e.toString().contains('unauthorized')
          ? 'Photo upload isn’t permitted yet - storage rules need the couples/site path.'
          : 'Upload failed: ' + e.toString());
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _bdBusy = false);
    }
  }

                  secondary: 'Cancel',

                  primary: existing == null ? 'Add color' : 'Save',
                  icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                  onPrimary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, true)));
        },
      ),
    );
    if (ok != true) return;
    if (existing != null) {
      setState(() {
        existing['color'] = color;
        existing['text'] = labelC.text.trim();
      });
      _bdSave();
      return;
    }
    _bdAdd(<String, dynamic>{
      'kind': 'swatch',
      'color': color,
      'text': labelC.text.trim(),
      'src': '',
      'w': 120.0,
      'ar': 1.0
    });

  // v135: who is typing - initials and first name of the signed-in partner.
  List<String> _bdMe() {
    final User? u = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;
    String name = (u?.displayName ?? '').trim();
    if (name.isEmpty) name = (u?.email ?? '').split('@').first;
    if (name.isEmpty) name = 'You';
    final List<String> parts = name
        .split(RegExp(r'[\s._-]+'))
        .where((String w) => w.isNotEmpty)
        .toList();
    final String ini =
        parts.take(2).map((String w) => w[0].toUpperCase()).join();
    return <String>[
      ini.isEmpty ? 'Y' : ini,
      parts.isEmpty ? 'You' : parts.first
    ];
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _bdComments(Map<String, dynamic> it) =>
      <Map<String, dynamic>>[
        if (it['comments'] is List)
          for (final dynamic c in it['comments'] as List)
            if (c is Map) Map<String, dynamic>.from(c)
      ];

  Future<void> _bdCommentSheet(Map<String, dynamic> it) async {
    final TextEditingController c = TextEditingController();
    final List<String> me = _bdMe();
    final String myUid = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid ?? '';
    await _lzSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 520),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setS) {
          final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cs = _bdComments(it);
          final String caption = (it['title'] ?? it['text'] ?? '').toString();

          void post() {
            final String v = c.text.trim();
            if (v.isEmpty) return;
            setState(() {
              final List<Map<String, dynamic>> all = _bdComments(it);
              all.add(<String, dynamic>{
                'by': FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser?.uid ?? '',
                'ini': me[0],
                'name': me[1],
                'text': v,
                'at': DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
              });
              it['comments'] = all;
            });
            c.clear();
            setS(() {});
            _bdSave();
          }

          Widget avatar(String ini, bool mine) => Container(
                width: 30,
                height: 30,
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: mine ? plum : gold, shape: BoxShape.circle),
                child: Text(ini,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: mine ? gold : plumDeep,
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              );

          return _lzFrame(ctx2,
              icon: Icons.forum_outlined,
              title: 'Talk about this one',
              subtitle: cs.isEmpty
                  ? 'Your partner sees it here too.'
                  : '${cs.length} comment${cs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
              headerExtra: Row(children: <Widget>[
                ClipRRect(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                  child: it['kind'] == 'image'
                      ? Image.network((it['url'] ?? '').toString(),
                          width: 48,
                          height: 48,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          errorBuilder:
                              (BuildContext a, Object b, StackTrace? d) =>
                                  const SizedBox(width: 48, height: 48))
                      : Container(
                          width: 48,
                          height: 48,
                          color: _lzBg(Color(int.tryParse(
                                  'FF${(it['color'] ?? 'F3EBDD').toString()}',
                                  radix: 16) ??
                              0xFFF3EBDD))),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(caption.isEmpty ? 'From your dream board' : caption,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13, color: _lzFg(ink), height: 1.35)),
                ),
              ]),
              children: <Widget>[
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                if (cs.isEmpty)
                  _pcC_empty(Icons.chat_bubble_outline_rounded,
                      'Say what you like about it, or what you\u2019d change.'),
                for (final Map<String, dynamic> cm in cs)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                    child: Row(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: <Widget>[
                          avatar((cm['ini'] ?? '?').toString(),
                              (cm['by'] ?? '') == myUid),
                          const SizedBox(width: 10),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: <Widget>[
                                  Row(children: <Widget>[
                                    Text((cm['name'] ?? '').toString(),
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                            color: _lzFg(plum),
                                            fontSize: 12.5,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                    Text(
                                        cm['at'] is num
                                            ? _ago(Timestamp
                                                .fromMillisecondsSinceEpoch(
                                                    (cm['at'] as num).toInt()))
                                            : '',
                                        style: TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted))),
                                  ]),
                                  const SizedBox(height: 2),
                                  Text((cm['text'] ?? '').toString(),
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                          color: _lzFg(ink),
                                          fontSize: 14,
                                          height: 1.4)),
                                ]),
                          ),
                          if ((cm['by'] ?? '') == myUid)
                            IconButton(
                              tooltip: 'Delete comment',
                              icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                                  size: 15, color: _lzFg(muted)),
                              onPressed: () {
                                setState(() {
                                  final List<Map<String, dynamic>> all =
                                      _bdComments(it);
                                  all.removeWhere((Map<String, dynamic> x) =>
                                      x['at'] == cm['at'] &&
                                      x['by'] == cm['by']);
                                  it['comments'] = all;
                                });
                                setS(() {});
                                _bdSave();
                              },
                            ),
                        ]),
                  ),
              ],
              footer: Row(children: <Widget>[
                avatar(me[0], true),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    controller: c,
                    autofocus: cs.isEmpty,
                    minLines: 1,
                    maxLines: 3,
                    textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                    textInputAction: TextInputAction.send,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink), fontSize: 14),
                    decoration: _lightDeco('',
                        hint: 'Candles instead of taper lights?'),
                    onSubmitted: (String v) => post(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                IconButton(
                  tooltip: 'Send',
                  icon: Icon(Icons.send_rounded, color: _lzFg(plum)),
                  onPressed: post,
                ),
              ]));
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _bdShare(Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    if (_bdItems.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Pin a few things first.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln('DREAM BOARD${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> imgs = _bdItems
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> i) => i['kind'] == 'image')
        .toList();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> notes = _bdItems
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> i) => i['kind'] == 'note')
        .toList();
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> sw = _bdItems
        .where((Map<String, dynamic> i) => i['kind'] == 'swatch')
        .toList();
    if (sw.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write(
          '<h2>Colors</h2><div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px">');
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('COLORS');
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in sw) {
        final String c = (i['color'] ?? 'D9B77C').toString();
        final String l = (i['text'] ?? '').toString();
        h.write(
            '<div style="text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#6B5F72"><div style="width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:12px;background:#$c;border:1px solid #E6D6B8"></div>#$c${l.isEmpty ? '' : '<br>' + _esc(l)}</div>');
        t.writeln('#$c${l.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $l'}');
      }
      h.write('</div>');
    }
    if (notes.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write('<h2>Notes</h2><ul>');
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('NOTES');
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in notes) {
        final String src = (i['src'] ?? '').toString();
        h.write(
            '<li>${_esc((i['text'] ?? '').toString())}${src.isEmpty ? '' : ' <a href="${_esc(src)}">link</a>'}</li>');
        t.writeln('- ${i['text'] ?? ''}${src.isEmpty ? '' : ' ($src)'}');
      }
      h.write('</ul>');
    }
    if (imgs.isNotEmpty) {
      h.write(
          '<h2>Pictures</h2><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px">');
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln('PICTURES');
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> i in imgs) {
        final String u = (i['url'] ?? '').toString();
        final String src = (i['src'] ?? '').toString();
        final String cap = (i['title'] ?? '').toString();
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> cms = _bdComments(i);
        h.write(
            '<div><a href="${_esc(src.isEmpty ? u : src)}"><img src="${_esc(u)}" style="width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block" alt=""></a>${cap.isEmpty ? '' : '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#6B5F72;margin-top:4px">' + _esc(cap) + '</div>'}'
            '${cms.isEmpty ? '' : '<div style="font-size:11.5px;color:#52284F;margin-top:4px">' + cms.map((Map<String, dynamic> x) => '<b>' + _esc((x['name'] ?? '').toString()) + ':</b> ' + _esc((x['text'] ?? '').toString())).join('<br>') + '</div>'}</div>');
        t.writeln('${cap.isEmpty ? '' : cap + ' - '}${src.isEmpty ? u : src}');
      }
      h.write('</div>');
    }
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'board',
      title: 'dream board',
      fileName: 'Dream board.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Dream board',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' · '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>['florist', 'planner', 'photo'],
      note:
          'Here’s our dream board - the look we’re going for. Tell us what’s realistic and what you’d change.',
      preview:
          '${imgs.length} picture${imgs.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}, ${notes.length} note${notes.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}, ${sw.length} color${sw.length == 1 ? '' : 's'}',
    );
  }

  Widget _boardScreen(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveDoc('board:$_cid', () => _boardRef),
      initialData: _liveD['board:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
        if (sn.hasData) _bdApplyRemote(sn.data!.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{});
        final Map<String, dynamic>? sel =
            _bdSel.isEmpty ? null : _bdById(_bdSel);
        final bool empty = _bdItems.isEmpty;
        Widget tool(IconData ic, String label, VoidCallback go,
            {bool solid = false}) {
          return _Press(
            tick: _Tick.light,
            onTap: _bdBusy ? null : go,

                color: _lzBg(solid ? gold : Colors.white.withOpacity(.12)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                border:
                    Border.all(color: _lzLine(solid ? gold : ivory.withOpacity(.35))),
              ),
              child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Icon(ic, size: 15, color: _lzFg(solid ? plumDeep : ivory)),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(label,
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(solid ? plumDeep : ivory),
                        fontSize: 12.5,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ]),
            ),
          );
        }

        final List<Widget> sorted = <Widget>[];
        final List<Map<String, dynamic>> byZ =
            List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(_bdItems)
              ..sort((Map<String, dynamic> a, Map<String, dynamic> b) =>
                  ((a['z'] is num ? (a['z'] as num) : 0))
                      .compareTo(b['z'] is num ? (b['z'] as num) : 0));
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> it in byZ) {

        }

        return Column(children: <Widget>[

                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),

                      )),
          ),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 0, 18, 10),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,

                tool(Icons.link_rounded, 'Pin a link', _bdAddLink, solid: true),
                tool(Icons.add_photo_alternate_rounded, 'Photo', _bdAddPhoto),
                tool(Icons.sticky_note_2_rounded, 'Note', () => _bdAddNote()),
                tool(Icons.palette_rounded, 'Color', () => _bdAddSwatch()),
                if (_bdBusy)
                  const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 4),
                    child: SizedBox(

          if (sel != null)
            Padding(

                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,

                    tool(Icons.open_in_new_rounded, 'Open source', () async {
                      final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(sel['src'].toString());

  Widget _boardItem(Map<String, dynamic> it) {
    final String id = it['id'].toString();
    final String kind = (it['kind'] ?? 'note').toString();
    final double w = (it['w'] is num ? (it['w'] as num).toDouble() : 220)
        .clamp(60, 900)
        .toDouble();
    final double ar = (it['ar'] is num ? (it['ar'] as num).toDouble() : 1)
        .clamp(.2, 5)
        .toDouble();
    final double hgt = kind == 'note'
        ? (it['h'] is num ? (it['h'] as num).toDouble() : w / ar)
        : w / ar;
    final double x = it['x'] is num ? (it['x'] as num).toDouble() : 100;
    final double y = it['y'] is num ? (it['y'] as num).toDouble() : 100;
    final bool sel = _bdSel == id;
    Widget body;
    if (kind == 'image') {
      body = ClipRRect(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        child: Image.network(
          (it['url'] ?? '').toString(),
          width: w,
          height: hgt,
          fit: BoxFit.cover,
          frameBuilder: (BuildContext c, Widget child, int? frame, bool sync) {
            if (frame != null && it['arReal'] != true) {
              // First paint: read the real aspect once, so the pin keeps its shape.
              WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                final ImageStream st =
                    Image.network((it['url'] ?? '').toString())
                        .image
                        .resolve(const ImageConfiguration());
                late final ImageStreamListener l;
                l = ImageStreamListener((ImageInfo info, bool _) {
                  st.removeListener(l);
                  final double real = info.image.width / info.image.height;
                  if (mounted && (it['arReal'] != true)) {
                    setState(() {
                      it['ar'] = real;
                      it['arReal'] = true;
                    });
                    _bdSave();
                  }
                });
                st.addListener(l);
              });
            }
            return child;
          },
          errorBuilder: (BuildContext c, Object e, StackTrace? st) => Container(
            width: w,
            height: hgt,
            color: _lzBg(const Color(0xFFEFE4D2)),
            alignment: Alignment.center,
            child:  Icon(Icons.broken_image_outlined, color: _lzFg(muted)),
          ),
        ),
      );
      final String cap = (it['title'] ?? '').toString();
      if (cap.isNotEmpty) {
        body = Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              body,
              SizedBox(
                width: w,
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(2, 4, 2, 0),
                  child: Text(cap,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style:  TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.3)),
                ),
              ),
            ]);
      }
    } else if (kind == 'swatch') {
      final String c = (it['color'] ?? 'D9B77C').toString();
      final String l = (it['text'] ?? '').toString();
      body = Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
        Container(
          width: w,
          height: w,
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: _lzBg(Color(int.tryParse('FF$c', radix: 16) ?? 0xFFD9B77C)),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
              border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(Colors.white), width: 3),
              boxShadow: const <BoxShadow>[
                BoxShadow(
                    color: Color(0x22000000),
                    blurRadius: 8,
                    offset: Offset(0, 3))
              ]),
        ),
        SizedBox(
          width: w,
          child: Text(l.isEmpty ? '#$c' : '$l · #$c',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              maxLines: 2,
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              style:  TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 11, color: _lzFg(muted), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
        ),
      ]);
    } else {
      final String c = (it['color'] ?? 'F3EBDD').toString();
      body = Container(
        width: w,
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: hgt * .6),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(14, 12, 14, 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _lzBg(Color(int.tryParse('FF$c', radix: 16) ?? 0xFFF3EBDD)),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
            boxShadow: const <BoxShadow>[
              BoxShadow(
                  color: Color(0x22000000), blurRadius: 8, offset: Offset(0, 3))
            ]),
        child: Text((it['text'] ?? '').toString(),
            style: TextStyle(
                color: _lzFg(ink),
                fontSize: (w / 14).clamp(12, 20).toDouble(),
                height: 1.35,
                fontFamily: GoogleFonts.cormorantGaramond().fontFamily,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600)),
      );
    }
    return Positioned(
      left: x,
      top: y,
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTap: () => setState(() => _bdSel = sel ? '' : id),
        onPanStart: (DragStartDetails d) {
          _bdDragging = true;
          setState(() {
            _bdSel = id;
            it['z'] = _bdTopZ() + 1;
          });
        },
        onPanUpdate: (DragUpdateDetails d) {
          final double sc = _bdScale();
          setState(() {
            it['x'] = ((it['x'] as num).toDouble() + d.delta.dx / sc)
                .clamp(-200, kBoardW - 40)
                .toDouble();
            it['y'] = ((it['y'] as num).toDouble() + d.delta.dy / sc)
                .clamp(-200, kBoardH - 40)
                .toDouble();
          });
        },
        onPanEnd: (DragEndDetails d) {
          _bdDragging = false;
          _bdSave();
        },
        onPanCancel: () {
          _bdDragging = false;
          _bdSave();
        },
        child: Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none, children: <Widget>[
          AnimatedContainer(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 140),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                border: Border.all(
                    color: _lzLine(sel ? plum : Colors.transparent), width: 2)),
            child: body,
          ),
          if (_bdComments(it).isNotEmpty)
            Positioned(
              left: -6,
              top: -6,
              child: GestureDetector(
                onTap: () => _bdCommentSheet(it),
                child: Container(
                  padding:
                      const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 7, vertical: 3),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: plum,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory), width: 1.5)),
                  child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                    const Icon(Icons.mode_comment_rounded,
                        size: 10, color: gold),
                    const SizedBox(width: 3),
                    Text('${_bdComments(it).length}',
                        style: const TextStyle(
                            color: gold,
                            fontSize: 10,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          if (sel)
            Positioned(
              right: -8,
              bottom: -8,
              child: GestureDetector(
                behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
                onPanStart: (DragStartDetails d) => _bdDragging = true,
                onPanUpdate: (DragUpdateDetails d) {
                  final double sc = _bdScale();
                  setState(() {
                    it['w'] = ((it['w'] as num).toDouble() + d.delta.dx / sc)
                        .clamp(60, 900)
                        .toDouble();
                    if (kind == 'note') {
                      it['h'] = (((it['h'] is num ? (it['h'] as num) : w / ar)
                                  .toDouble()) +
                              d.delta.dy / sc)
                          .clamp(60, 900)
                          .toDouble();
                    }
                  });
                },
                onPanEnd: (DragEndDetails d) {
                  _bdDragging = false;
                  _bdSave();
                },
                child: Container(
                  width: 26,
                  height: 26,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: plum,
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(ivory), width: 2)),
                  child: const Icon(Icons.open_in_full_rounded,
                      size: 13, color: gold),
                ),
              ),
            ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ---- JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-SHOP-001: the shopping list ----

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _shopRef =>
      _coupleRef.collection('shopping');

  static const List<List<String>> kShopCats = <List<String>>[
    <String>['ceremony', 'Ceremony'],

  ];

  static String _shopCatLabel(String c) {
    for (final List<String> k in kShopCats) {
      if (k[0] == c) return k[1];
    }
    return 'Everything else';
  }

  Future<void> _seedShopping() async {
    final WriteBatch b = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();
    int i = 0;
    for (final List<dynamic> r in kShopClassic) {
      b.set(_shopRef.doc(), <String, dynamic>{
        'name': r[0],
        'cat': r[1],
        'qty': r[2],
        'est': r[3],
        'bought': false,
        'note': '',
        'link': '',
        'order': i++,
        'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    }
    await b.commit();
    _toast('The classic list - cross off what you don’t need.');
  }

  Future<void> _editShopItem(
      QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>? d) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> it = d?.data() ?? <String, dynamic>{};
    final TextEditingController nameC =
        TextEditingController(text: (it['name'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController qtyC = TextEditingController(
        text: it['qty'] == null ? '1' : it['qty'].toString());
    final TextEditingController estC = TextEditingController(
        text: it['est'] == null ? '' : it['est'].toString());
    final TextEditingController linkC =
        TextEditingController(text: (it['link'] ?? '').toString());
    final TextEditingController noteC =
        TextEditingController(text: (it['note'] ?? '').toString());
    String cat = (it['cat'] ??
            (_shopFilter.length > 5 &&
                    kShopCats.any((List<String> k) => k[0] == _shopFilter)
                ? _shopFilter
                : 'reception'))
        .toString();
    bool saving = false;
    bool open = true;
    String err = '';

    Future<void> save() async {
      String link = linkC.text.trim();
      if (link.isNotEmpty && !link.startsWith('http')) link = 'https://' + link;
      final Map<String, dynamic> payload = <String, dynamic>{
        'name': nameC.text.trim(),
        'cat': cat,
        'qty': int.tryParse(qtyC.text.trim()) ?? 1,
        'est':
            (double.tryParse(estC.text.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^0-9.]'), '')) ??
                    0)
                .round(),
        'link': link,
        'note': noteC.text.trim(),
        'updatedAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      };
      if (d == null) {
        payload['bought'] = false;
        payload['order'] = DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch;
        payload['createdAt'] = FieldValue.serverTimestamp();
        await _shopRef.add(payload);
      } else {
        await d.reference.set(payload, SetOptions(merge: true));
      }
    }

    await _lzSheet<bool>(
      context: context,
      constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 560),
      builder: (BuildContext ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
          builder: (BuildContext ctx2, StateSetter setD) {
        void up(VoidCallback f) {
          if (open) setD(f);
        }

        Future<void> go() async {
          up(() {
            saving = true;
            err = '';
          });
          try {
            await save();
            if (ctx2.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx2, true);
          } catch (_) {
            up(() {
              saving = false;
              err = 'Could not save that. Check your connection and try again.';
            });
          }
        }

        return _lzFrame(ctx2,
            icon: Icons.shopping_bag_outlined,
            title: d == null ? 'Add to the list' : 'Edit item',
            subtitle: 'What you need, how many, and roughly what it costs.',
            children: <Widget>[
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextField(
                  controller: nameC,
                  autofocus: d == null,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                  onChanged: (_) => up(() {}),
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('What', hint: 'Card box')),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              Row(children: <Widget>[
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                      controller: qtyC,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                      style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                      decoration: _lightDeco('How many')),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                      controller: estC,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                      style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                      decoration: _lightDeco('About, in total',
                          hint: '0', prefix: '\$ ')),
                ),
              ]),
              _lzSection('Where it\u2019s for'),
              Wrap(spacing: 6, runSpacing: 6, children: <Widget>[
                for (final List<String> k in kShopCats)
                  _tlChip(k[1], cat == k[0], () => up(() => cat = k[0])),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              TextField(
                  controller: linkC,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.url,
                  textInputAction: TextInputAction.next,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Link (optional)',
                      hint: 'Where you found it')),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              TextField(
                  controller: noteC,
                  textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.sentences,
                  style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(ink)),
                  decoration: _lightDeco('Note (optional)',
                      hint: 'Colour, size, who\u2019s buying it')),
              _pcC_err(err),
            ],
            footer: _lzActions(
                secondary: 'Cancel',
                onSecondary: () => Navigator.pop(ctx2, false),
                primary: d == null ? 'Add to list' : 'Save',
                icon: Icons.check_rounded,
                busy: saving,
                onPrimary: nameC.text.trim().isEmpty ? null : go));
      }),
    ).whenComplete(() => open = false);
  }

  Future<void> _sendShopping(
      List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs,
      Map<String, dynamic> couple) async {
    final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> open = docs
        .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
            d.data()['bought'] != true)
        .toList();
    if (open.isEmpty) {
      _toast('Everything is bought - nothing to send.');
      return;
    }
    final String who = _coupleLabel(couple);
    final String when = _weddingDateLine(couple);
    final StringBuffer t = StringBuffer();
    final StringBuffer h = StringBuffer();
    t.writeln('SHOPPING LIST - still to buy${when.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $when'}');
    for (final List<String> k in kShopCats) {
      final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> rows = open
          .where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
              (d.data()['cat'] ?? 'other') == k[0])
          .toList();
      if (rows.isEmpty) continue;
      t.writeln('');
      t.writeln(k[1].toUpperCase());
      h.write('<h2>${_esc(k[1])}</h2><table>');
      for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in rows) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> it = d.data();
        final int qty = it['qty'] is num ? (it['qty'] as num).toInt() : 1;
        final int est = it['est'] is num ? (it['est'] as num).toInt() : 0;
        final String note = (it['note'] ?? '').toString();
        final String link = (it['link'] ?? '').toString();
        t.writeln(
            '${qty > 1 ? '$qty x ' : ''}${it['name'] ?? ''}${est > 0 ? ' - about \$$est' : ''}${note.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $note'}${link.isEmpty ? '' : ' - $link'}');
        h.write(
            '<tr><td class="time">${qty > 1 ? '$qty ×' : ''}</td><td><b>${_esc((it['name'] ?? '').toString())}</b>'
            '${est > 0 ? ' <span style="color:#8A6A2F">about \$$est</span>' : ''}'
            '${note.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><span style="color:#6B5F72">${_esc(note)}</span>'}'
            '${link.isEmpty ? '' : '<br><a href="${_esc(link)}">${_esc(link)}</a>'}</td></tr>');
      }
      h.write('</table>');
    }
    await _sendToVendors(
      kind: 'shopping',
      title: 'shopping list',
      fileName: 'Shopping list.html',
      page: _printShell(
          'Shopping list - still to buy',
          <String>[if (who.isNotEmpty) who, if (when.isNotEmpty) when]
              .join(' · '),
          h.toString()),
      text: t.toString(),
      tags: <String>['planner'],
      note:
          'Here’s what we still need to buy. Tell us if you’d rather source any of it, or if we’re missing something.',
      preview: '${open.length} item${open.length == 1 ? '' : 's'} still to buy',
    );
  }

  Widget _shoppingScreen(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: _liveQuery('shop:$_cid', () => _shopRef.orderBy('order')),
      initialData: _liveQ['shop:$_cid']?.latest,
      builder: (BuildContext c,
          AsyncSnapshot<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> sn) {
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> docs =
            sn.data?.docs ?? <QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>[];
        final int total = docs.length;
        int bought = 0;
        int toGo = 0;
        int spent = 0;
        for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d in docs) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> it = d.data();
          final int est = it['est'] is num ? (it['est'] as num).toInt() : 0;
          if (it['bought'] == true) {
            bought++;
            spent += est;
          } else {
            toGo += est;
          }
        }
        final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> shown =
            docs.where((QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
          final Map<String, dynamic> it = d.data();
          if (_shopFilter == 'tobuy') return it['bought'] != true;
          if (_shopFilter == 'bought') return it['bought'] == true;
          if (_shopFilter == 'all') return true;
          return (it['cat'] ?? 'other') == _shopFilter;
        }).toList();
        Widget chip(String key, String label, [int? n]) {
          final bool on = _shopFilter == key;
          return _Press(
            tick: _Tick.select,
            onTap: () => setState(() => _shopFilter = key),
            child: Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 11, vertical: 7),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: _lzBg(on ? gold : Colors.white.withOpacity(.12)),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999),
                border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(on ? gold : ivory.withOpacity(.35))),
              ),
              child: Text(n == null ? label : '$label · $n',
                  style: TextStyle(
                      color: _lzFg(on ? plumDeep : ivory),
                      fontSize: 12,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
            ),
          );
        }

        return ListView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 96),
          children: <Widget>[
            _subHeader('Shopping list',
                trailing: total == 0
                    ? null
                    : _Press(
                        onTap: () => _sendShopping(docs, couple),
                        child: Row(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: <Widget>[
                              Icon(Icons.send_rounded,
                                  color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), size: 15),
                              const SizedBox(width: 4),
                              Text('Send',
                                  style: TextStyle(
                                      color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                                      fontSize: 12,
                                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                            ]),
                      )),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 14),
              child: Text(
                total == 0
                    ? 'The things you buy yourselves - signs, the card box, favors, the day-of kit. Your registry is what guests buy; this is the rest.'
                    : '$bought of $total bought${toGo > 0 ? ' · about \$$toGo still to spend' : ''}${spent > 0 ? ' · \$$spent spent' : ''}',
                style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13, color: ivory.withOpacity(.72), height: 1.45),
              ),
            ),
            if (total == 0)
              _glass(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                radius: 22,
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                       Text('Start with the classic list',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(plum),
                              fontSize: 16,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 6),
                      Text(
                          '${kShopClassic.length} things most weddings end up buying, in the right categories with rough prices. Cross off what you don’t need, add what we missed.',
                          style:  TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 12.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.45)),
                      const SizedBox(height: 12),
                      Row(children: <Widget>[
                        FilledButton.icon(
                          style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                              backgroundColor: gold, foregroundColor: plum),
                          onPressed: _h(_seedShopping, _Tick.medium),
                          icon:
                              const Icon(Icons.auto_awesome_rounded, size: 16),
                          label: const Text('Use the classic list',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 10),
                        TextButton(
                          onPressed: _h(() => _editShopItem(null)),
                          child:  Text('Add one thing',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  color: _lzFg(plum), fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                        ),
                      ]),
                    ]),
              )
            else ...<Widget>[
              SingleChildScrollView(
                scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                child: Row(children: <Widget>[
                  chip('tobuy', 'To buy', total - bought),
                  chip('bought', 'Bought', bought),
                  chip('all', 'All'),
                  for (final List<String> k in kShopCats)
                    if (docs.any(
                        (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                            (d.data()['cat'] ?? 'other') == k[0]))
                      chip(k[0], k[1]),
                ]),
              ),
              if (shown.isEmpty)
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
                  child: Text(
                      _shopFilter == 'tobuy'
                          ? 'Everything is bought.'
                          : 'Nothing here yet.',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.72), fontSize: 13)),
                )
              else
                for (final List<String> k in kShopCats)
                  if (shown.any(
                      (QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) =>
                          (d.data()['cat'] ?? 'other') == k[0]))
                    _glass(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 14, 16, 8),
                      radius: 22,
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
                      child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: <Widget>[
                            Text(k[1].toUpperCase(),
                                style:  TextStyle(
                                    fontSize: 10.5,
                                    letterSpacing: 2,
                                    color: _lzFg(plum),
                                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            for (final QueryDocumentSnapshot<
                                Map<String, dynamic>> d in shown)
                              if ((d.data()['cat'] ?? 'other') == k[0])
                                _shopRow(d),
                          ]),
                    ),
              Center(
                child: TextButton.icon(
                  onPressed: _h(() => _editShopItem(null)),
                  icon: Icon(Icons.add_rounded,
                      color: ivory.withOpacity(.9), size: 18),
                  label: Text('Add something',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          color: ivory.withOpacity(.9),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
                ),
              ),
              Center(
                child: Text(
                    'Tap the circle when it’s bought · tap the name to edit · hold to remove',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10.5, color: ivory.withOpacity(.6))),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _shopRow(QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> d) {
    final Map<String, dynamic> it = d.data();
    final bool bought = it['bought'] == true;
    final int qty = it['qty'] is num ? (it['qty'] as num).toInt() : 1;
    final int est = it['est'] is num ? (it['est'] as num).toInt() : 0;
    final String note = (it['note'] ?? '').toString();
    final String link = (it['link'] ?? '').toString();
    return _Press(
      onTap: () => _editShopItem(d),
      onLongPress: () async {
        final Map<String, dynamic> gone = Map<String, dynamic>.from(d.data());
        final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> ref = d.reference;
        await ref.delete();
        _toastUndo('Removed.', () => ref.set(gone));
      },
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 6),
        child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: <Widget>[
              _Press(
                tick: _Tick.select,
                onTap: () async {
                  await d.reference.set(<String, dynamic>{
                    'bought': !bought,
                    'boughtAt': bought
                        ? FieldValue.delete()
                        : FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
                  }, SetOptions(merge: true));
                },
                child: Container(
                  width: 26,
                  height: 26,
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 1),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: _lzBg(bought ? vGreen : Colors.white),
                    shape: BoxShape.circle,
                    border: Border.all(
                        color: _lzLine(bought ? vGreen : goldLine), width: 1.6),
                  ),
                  child: bought
                      ? const Icon(Icons.check_rounded,
                          size: 16, color: Colors.white)
                      : null,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: <Widget>[
                      Text('${qty > 1 ? '$qty × ' : ''}${it['name'] ?? ''}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                              color: _lzFg(bought ? muted : ink),
                              fontSize: 13.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                              decoration:
                                  bought ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null)),
                      if (est > 0 || note.isNotEmpty)
                        Text(
                            <String>[
                              if (est > 0) 'about \$$est',
                              if (note.isNotEmpty) note,
                            ].join(' · '),
                            style:  TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 11.5, color: _lzFg(muted), height: 1.35)),
                    ]),
              ),
              if (link.isNotEmpty)
                _Press(
                  onTap: () async {
                    final Uri? u = Uri.tryParse(link);
                    if (u != null && await canLaunchUrl(u)) {
                      await launchUrl(u, mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication);
                    }
                  },
                  child:  Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(4),
                    child:
                        Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded, size: 16, color: _lzFg(plum)),
                  ),
                ),
            ]),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _registryScreen(Map<String, dynamic> couple) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> links = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final dynamic l
        in (couple['registryLinks'] as List?) ?? const <dynamic>[]) {
      if (l is Map) links.add(Map<String, dynamic>.from(l));
    }
    final String note = (couple['registryNote'] ?? '').toString();
    return ListView(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 8, 18, 96),
      children: <Widget>[
        _subHeader('Registry'),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 6, bottom: 14),
          child: Text(
            'Link registries from anywhere - a store, a honeymoon fund, a charity. They show on your wedding website exactly like this. Lazo never hosts or marks up a registry.',
            // muted is built for the ivory cards. On the plum canvas it is
            // 2.8:1, under the 4.5:1 floor for body text; ivory at 72% is 9:1.
            style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 13, color: ivory.withOpacity(.72), height: 1.45),
          ),
        ),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
          child: Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: <Widget>[
            for (final List<String> st in const <List<String>>[
              <String>['zola.com', 'Zola'],
              <String>['amazon.com', 'Amazon'],
              <String>['target.com', 'Target'],
              <String>['crateandbarrel.com', 'Crate & Barrel'],
