// v91: one Firestore listener per query, replayed to late subscribers, the
// same Stream object every build. Retries a dead source after 30s.
class _Live<T> {
  _Live(Stream<T> Function() source,
      {Duration retryAfter = const Duration(seconds: 30)})
      : _source = source,
        _retryAfter = retryAfter {
    stream = Stream<T>.multi((MultiStreamController<T> c) {
      if (_hasLatest) {
        c.add(_latest as T);
      } else if (_err != null) {
        c.addError(_err!, _errSt);
      }
      final StreamSubscription<T> s = _shared.stream.listen(
        (T v) => c.add(v),
        onError: (Object e, StackTrace st) => c.addError(e, st),
      );
      c.onCancel = () => s.cancel();
    }, isBroadcast: true);
    _listen();
  }

  final Stream<T> Function() _source;
  final Duration _retryAfter;
  late final Stream<T> stream;
  T? get latest => _latest;
  final StreamController<T> _shared = StreamController<T>.broadcast();
  StreamSubscription<T>? _sub;
  Timer? _retry;
  bool _disposed = false;
  T? _latest;
  bool _hasLatest = false;
  Object? _err;
  StackTrace? _errSt;

  void _listen() {
    _sub?.cancel();
    _sub = _source().listen((T v) {
      _latest = v;
      _hasLatest = true;
      _err = null;
      _errSt = null;
      _shared.add(v);
    }, onError: (Object e, StackTrace st) {
      _err = e;
      _errSt = st;
      _shared.addError(e, st);
      _retry?.cancel();
      _retry = Timer(_retryAfter, () {
        if (!_disposed) {
          _listen();
        }
      });
    });
  }

  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _retry?.cancel();
    _sub?.cancel();
    _sub = null;
    _shared.close();
  }
}

// ---------------- v130: MOTION ----------------
// Three rules, from the WWDC "Designing Fluid Interfaces" talk:
//  1. Answer the finger on pointer-DOWN, never only on release.
//  2. Critically damped by default. Overshoot only when something arrives
//     with momentum (a banner dropping in).
//  3. Reduced-motion users get a cross-fade - never a slide, never a bounce.

bool _reducedMotion(BuildContext c) =>
    MediaQuery.maybeOf(c)?.disableAnimations ?? false;

// Haptics, in tiers. Fired on the COMMIT so the pulse and the visual change
// hit on the same frame. On web these are no-ops; on Android and iOS they
// need no extra permission.
//   select - a choice among peers: tabs, filter chips, toggles.
//   light  - an ordinary button.
//   medium - something left your hands: a send.
// JC-LAZO-COUPLE-0920-BOARD-001: the dream board's faint dot grid.
class _BoardGridPainter extends CustomPainter {
  const _BoardGridPainter(this.color);
  final Color color;
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint p = Paint()..color = color;
    for (double x = 0; x < size.width; x += 40) {
      for (double y = 0; y < size.height; y += 40) {
        canvas.drawCircle(Offset(x, y), 1.2, p);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_BoardGridPainter old) => old.color != color;
}

enum _Tick { none, select, light, medium }

void _tick(_Tick t) {
  switch (t) {
    case _Tick.none:
      return;
    case _Tick.select:
      HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
      return;
    case _Tick.light:
      HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
      return;
    case _Tick.medium:
      HapticFeedback.mediumImpact();
      return;
  }
}

/// Wrap any Material button's onPressed: `onPressed: _h(() => save())`.
/// Null stays null, so `busy ? null : () {...}` keeps its disabled state.
VoidCallback? _h(VoidCallback? f, [_Tick t = _Tick.light]) => f == null
    ? null
    : () {
        _tick(t);
        f();
      };

/// Same for bool callbacks: a chip's onSelected, a Switch's onChanged.
ValueChanged<bool>? _hb(ValueChanged<bool>? f, [_Tick t = _Tick.select]) =>
    f == null
        ? null
        : (bool v) {
            _tick(t);
            f(v);
          };

/// A tappable that answers the instant the finger lands. Use it instead of
/// InkWell wherever the child paints its own opaque background - the ink
/// splash lands on the Material *under* that background and is invisible.
class _Press extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Press({
    super.key,
    required this.child,
    this.onTap,
    this.onLongPress,
    this.scale = .97,
    this.dim = .88,
    this.enabled = true,
    this.tick = _Tick.light,
    this.tickOnDown = false,
  });
  final Widget child;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;
  final VoidCallback? onLongPress;
  final double scale;
  final double dim;
  final bool enabled;
  final _Tick tick;
  // Harmony (Designing Audio-Haptic Experiences): the visual, the sound and
  // the haptic have to land on the same frame or the illusion comes apart.
  // The scale already fires on touch-down; this lets a control put its haptic
  // there too. Off by default - flipping it app-wide is a separate decision.
  final bool tickOnDown;
  @override
  State<_Press> createState() => _PressState();
}

class _PressState extends State<_Press> {
  bool _down = false;
  void _set(bool v) {
    if (_down != v && mounted) setState(() => _down = v);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bool on = _down && widget.enabled && !_reducedMotion(context);
    final VoidCallback? tap = widget.enabled ? widget.onTap : null;
    return MouseRegion(
      cursor: widget.enabled && widget.onTap != null
          ? SystemMouseCursors.click
          : MouseCursor.defer,
      child: GestureDetector(
        behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque,
        onTapDown: widget.enabled
            ? (_) {
                if (widget.tickOnDown) _tick(widget.tick);
                _set(true);
              }
            : null,
        onTapUp: (_) => _set(false),
        onTapCancel: () => _set(false),
        onTap: tap == null
            ? null
            : () {
                if (!widget.tickOnDown) _tick(widget.tick);
                tap();
              },
        onLongPress: widget.enabled ? widget.onLongPress : null,
        child: AnimatedScale(
          // Down is fast (the finger is already there); up is the settle.
          scale: on ? widget.scale : 1,
          duration: Duration(milliseconds: on ? 90 : 240),
          curve: on ? Curves.easeOut : Curves.easeOutCubic,
          child: AnimatedOpacity(
            opacity: on ? widget.dim : 1,
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: on ? 60 : 200),
            child: widget.child,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Wiggle extends StatefulWidget {
  const _Wiggle({required this.child, this.active = true});
  final Widget child;
  final bool active;
  @override
  State<_Wiggle> createState() => _WiggleState();
}

class _WiggleState extends State<_Wiggle> with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _c = AnimationController(
      vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 3200))
    ..repeat();
  @override
  void dispose() {
    _c.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!widget.active || _reducedMotion(context)) {
      return widget.child;
    }
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _c,
      builder: (BuildContext ctx, Widget? ch) {
        final double t = _c.value;
        double angle = 0;
        if (t > .82) {
          final double p = (t - .82) / .18;
          angle = math.sin(p * math.pi * 5) * .085 * (1 - p);
        }
        return Transform.rotate(angle: angle, child: ch);
      },
      child: widget.child,
    );
  }
}

class _CordPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _CordPainter({required this.progress});
  final double progress;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final center = Offset(size.width / 2, size.height / 2);
    final radius = math.min(size.width, size.height) / 2 - 5;
    final track = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 6
      ..color = const Color(0xFFFAF6F0).withOpacity(.22);
    final cord = Paint()
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeWidth = 6
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round
      ..color = const Color(0xFFD9B77C);
    canvas.drawCircle(center, radius, track);
    canvas.drawArc(
      Rect.fromCircle(center: center, radius: radius),
      -math.pi / 2,
      2 * math.pi * progress.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
      false,
      cord,
    );
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_CordPainter old) => old.progress != progress;
}

class _ConfettiPiece {
  _ConfettiPiece({
    required this.x,
    required this.startY,
    required this.speed,
    required this.size,
    required this.swayAmp,
    required this.swayFreq,
    required this.phase,
    required this.rotSpeed,
    required this.color,
    required this.delay,
    required this.span,
    required this.ribbon,
  });
  final double x;
  final double startY;
  final double speed;
  final double size;
  final double swayAmp;
  final double swayFreq;
  final double phase;
  final double rotSpeed;
  final Color color;
  final double delay;
  final double span;
  final bool ribbon;
}

class _ConfettiPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _ConfettiPainter(this.pieces, this.t);
  final List<_ConfettiPiece> pieces;
  final double t;

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint paint = Paint()..isAntiAlias = true;
    for (final p in pieces) {
      // Every piece lives its own life: it enters late, falls at its own
      // pace, and fades on its own clock. Nothing moves in lockstep.
      double lt = (t - p.delay) / p.span;
      if (lt <= 0 || lt >= 1.3) continue;
      if (lt > 1) lt = 1;

      // Gravity with a little air resistance.
      final double fall = lt * lt * (1.06 - 0.2 * lt);
      final double y = p.startY + fall * p.speed * 1.7;
      if (y < -0.4 || y > 1.15) continue;

      final double x =
          p.x + math.sin(lt * p.swayFreq * math.pi + p.phase) * p.swayAmp;
      final Offset c = Offset(x * size.width, y * size.height);

      double alpha = 1.0;
      if (lt < 0.07) {
        alpha = lt / 0.07;
      } else if (lt > 0.70) {
        alpha = 1 - (lt - 0.70) / 0.30;
      }
      alpha = alpha.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
      if (alpha <= 0.02) continue;

      paint.color = p.color.withOpacity(alpha);
      canvas.save();
      canvas.translate(c.dx, c.dy);
      canvas.rotate(p.phase + lt * p.rotSpeed);
      // Foreshortening as it tumbles - floored so it never flickers away.
      final double squash =
          0.42 + 0.58 * math.sin(lt * (p.swayFreq * 1.3) + p.phase * 2).abs();
      canvas.drawRRect(
        RRect.fromRectAndRadius(
          Rect.fromCenter(
              center: Offset.zero,
              width: p.size * squash,
              height: p.ribbon ? p.size * 2.1 : p.size * 0.78),
          Radius.circular(p.ribbon ? 1.5 : 2.5),
        ),
        paint,
      );
      canvas.restore();
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_ConfettiPainter old) => old.t != t;
}

class _SpotlightPainter extends CustomPainter {
  _SpotlightPainter(this.rect, this.tint);
  final Rect? rect;
  final Color tint;
  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Path full = Path()..addRect(Offset.zero & size);
    final Path hole = rect == null
        ? Path()
        : (Path()
          ..addRRect(
              RRect.fromRectAndRadius(rect!, const Radius.circular(20))));
    final Path dim = Path.combine(PathOperation.difference, full, hole);
    canvas.drawPath(
        dim, Paint()..color = const Color(0xFF120A14).withOpacity(.72));
    if (rect != null) {
      canvas.drawRRect(
          RRect.fromRectAndRadius(rect!, const Radius.circular(20)),
          Paint()
            ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
            ..strokeWidth = 2
            ..color = const Color(0xFFD9B77C));
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(_SpotlightPainter old) => old.rect != rect;
}

// JC-LAZO-JUNE-EMBED-1008-001: June inside the dashboard.
// On the web app the June hub (june.meetlazo.com) is a real <iframe> laid over
// the Flutter canvas exactly where this widget sits (position re-synced every
// frame tick, hidden whenever a sheet or dialog is on top), signed in through
// the juneToken hand-off, with the mic and autoplay allowed. On the phone apps
// the same URL opens in the in-app browser from a card. Nothing in Firestore
// changes; the hub is one codebase for couples and vendors.
class _JuneEmbed extends StatefulWidget {
  const _JuneEmbed({
    super.key,
    required this.urlFuture,
    this.height,
    required this.openExternal,
    this.blurb = '',
  });
  final Future<String> urlFuture; // the signed-in hub URL (with ?embed=1)
  final double? height; // null = fill the parent
  final Future<void> Function() openExternal; // phone: open in the in-app browser
  final String blurb;
  @override
  State<_JuneEmbed> createState() => _JuneEmbedState();
}

class _JuneEmbedState extends State<_JuneEmbed> {
  static const Color _plum = Color(0xFF52284F);
  static const Color _plumDeep = Color(0xFF3D1C3B);
  static const Color _gold = Color(0xFFD9B77C);
  static const Color _ivory = Color(0xFFFAF6F0);
  final GlobalKey _anchor = GlobalKey();
  html.IFrameElement? _frame;
  Timer? _sync;
  String _url = '';
  bool _failed = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.urlFuture.then((String u) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _url = u);
      if (kIsWeb) _mount();
    }).catchError((Object e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    });
  }

  void _mount() {
    try {
      final html.IFrameElement f = html.IFrameElement();
      f.src = _url;
      f.setAttribute('allow', 'microphone; autoplay; clipboard-write');
      f.setAttribute('allowtransparency', 'true');
      f.style
        ..position = 'fixed'
        ..border = '0'
        ..zIndex = '30'
        ..display = 'none'
        ..borderRadius = '22px'
        ..background = '#24101F'
        ..boxShadow = '0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.6)';
      html.document.body?.append(f);
      _frame = f;
      _sync = Timer.periodic(const Duration(milliseconds: 60), (_) => _place());
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('LAZO june embed: ' + e.toString());
      if (mounted) setState(() => _failed = true);
    }
  }

  void _place() {
    final html.IFrameElement? f = _frame;
    if (f == null) return;
    final BuildContext? c = _anchor.currentContext;
    final RenderObject? ro = c?.findRenderObject();
    final bool onTop = c != null && (ModalRoute.of(c)?.isCurrent ?? true);
    if (ro is! RenderBox || !ro.attached || !ro.hasSize || !onTop) {
      if (f.style.display != 'none') f.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    final Offset o = ro.localToGlobal(Offset.zero);
    final Size s = ro.size;
    if (s.width < 40 || s.height < 40) {
      if (f.style.display != 'none') f.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    f.style
      ..left = '${o.dx.round()}px'
      ..top = '${o.dy.round()}px'
      ..width = '${s.width.round()}px'
      ..height = '${s.height.round()}px';
    if (f.style.display != 'block') f.style.display = 'block';
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _sync?.cancel();
    _frame?.remove();
    _frame = null;
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget _mark(double size) => Container(
        width: size,
        height: size,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
              colors: <Color>[_plumDeep, Color(0xFF6A3A66)]),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(size * .34),
          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(_gold.withOpacity(.85)), width: 1.4),
          boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[
            BoxShadow(color: _gold.withOpacity(.3), blurRadius: 40, spreadRadius: 2)
          ],
        ),
        child: Icon(Icons.graphic_eq_rounded,
            color: const Color(0xFFE8CFA0), size: size * .46),
      );

  Widget _card({required Widget child}) => Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(20, 22, 20, 20),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          gradient: const LinearGradient(
              begin: Alignment.topLeft,
              end: Alignment.bottomRight,
              colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF241022), Color(0xFF3D1C3B)]),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(_gold.withOpacity(.55))),
        ),
        child: child,
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Widget body;
    if (!kIsWeb) {
      // phones: the hub opens in the in-app browser (voice, brief, radio all work there)
      body = _card(
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: <Widget>[
            Row(children: <Widget>[
              _mark(54),
              const SizedBox(width: 14),
               Expanded(
                child: Text('June',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        color: _lzFg(_ivory), fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              ),
            ]),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Text(
                widget.blurb.isEmpty
                    ? 'Talk to her out loud, hear your brief, and let her act for you. One tap, already signed in.'
                    : widget.blurb,
                style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(_ivory.withOpacity(.82)), fontSize: 13.5, height: 1.4)),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            FilledButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => widget.openExternal(),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.graphic_eq_rounded, size: 18),
              label: const Text('Open June',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w800)),
              style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: _lzBg(_gold),
                  foregroundColor: _lzFg(_plumDeep),
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 22, vertical: 14),
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(999))),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    } else if (_failed) {
      body = _card(
        child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
           Text('June couldn’t load here.',
              style: TextStyle(color: _lzFg(_ivory), fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => widget.openExternal(),
            style: TextButton.styleFrom(foregroundColor: _lzFg(_gold)),
            child: const Text('Open June in a new tab'),
          ),
        ]),
      );
    } else {
      // the iframe is laid over this box; the box itself just reserves the space (and shows a soft loading frame)
      body = Container(
        key: _anchor,
        width: double.infinity,
        height: widget.height,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFF24101F),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(22),
          border: Border.all(color: _lzLine(_gold.withOpacity(.35))),
        ),
        child: _url.isEmpty
            ? const Center(
                child: SizedBox(
                    width: 22,
                    height: 22,
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2, color: _gold)))
            : const SizedBox.expand(),
      );
      if (widget.height == null) return body;
    }
    return SizedBox(height: widget.height, child: body);
  }
}

// END OF FILE - JC-LAZO-COUPLE-1011-V152

// JC-LAZO-FAB-1014-001: the desk button, movable. Drag it anywhere; it settles against the nearer side edge
// at the height it was dropped and remembers the spot on this device. Left alone for a few seconds it tucks
// partly behind the edge and dims (AssistiveTouch style), so it covers almost nothing until it is touched.
class _MovableFab extends StatefulWidget {
  const _MovableFab({required this.prefKey, required this.child, this.size = 56, this.defaultBottom = 18});
  final String prefKey;
  final Widget child;
  final double size;
  final double defaultBottom;
  @override
  State<_MovableFab> createState() => _MovableFabState();
}

class _MovableFabState extends State<_MovableFab> {
  bool _left = false;
  double? _yFrac;
  Offset? _drag;
  bool _awake = true;
  Timer? _sleep;
  Offset _grab = Offset.zero; // where on the disc the finger went down
  final GlobalKey _area = GlobalKey();

  // the finger's real position in the button's area, so a fast flick lands exactly where it is let go
  Offset _at(Offset global) {
    final RenderObject? ro = _area.currentContext?.findRenderObject();
    if (ro is! RenderBox) return global - _grab;
    return ro.globalToLocal(global) - _grab;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((SharedPreferences p) {
      final String? s = p.getString(widget.prefKey);
      if (s == null || !mounted) return;
      final List<String> parts = s.split('|');
      setState(() {
        _left = parts[0] == 'L';
        _yFrac = parts.length > 1 ? double.tryParse(parts[1]) : null;
      });
    }).catchError((Object _) {});
    _wake();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _sleep?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _wake() {
    _sleep?.cancel();
    if (!_awake && mounted) setState(() => _awake = true);
    _sleep = Timer(const Duration(seconds: 4), () {
      if (mounted && _drag == null) setState(() => _awake = false);
    });
  }

  void _save() {
    final String v = '${_left ? 'L' : 'R'}|${(_yFrac ?? -1).toStringAsFixed(4)}';
    SharedPreferences.getInstance().then((SharedPreferences p) => p.setString(widget.prefKey, v)).catchError((Object _) => false);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bool reduce = MediaQuery.maybeOf(context)?.disableAnimations ?? false;
    return LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext c, BoxConstraints box) {
      final double s = widget.size;
      const double edge = 14;
      const double minY = 12;
      final double maxY = math.max(minY, box.maxHeight - s - widget.defaultBottom);
      final double span = math.max(1, box.maxHeight - s);
      double y = (_yFrac == null || _yFrac! < 0) ? maxY : (_yFrac! * span).clamp(minY, maxY).toDouble();
      // tucked: 40% of the disc behind the edge
      final double tuck = _awake ? 0 : s * .4;
      double x = _left ? edge - tuck : box.maxWidth - s - edge + tuck;
      final Offset? d = _drag;
      if (d != null) {
        x = d.dx.clamp(0, math.max(0, box.maxWidth - s)).toDouble();
        y = d.dy.clamp(minY, maxY).toDouble();
      }
      return Stack(key: _area, children: <Widget>[
        AnimatedPositioned(
          duration: Duration(milliseconds: d != null || reduce ? 0 : 340),
          curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
          left: x,
          top: y,
          child: Listener(
            onPointerDown: (PointerDownEvent e) {
              _grab = e.localPosition;
              _wake();
            },
            child: GestureDetector(
              onPanStart: (DragStartDetails st) {
                HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                _sleep?.cancel();
                setState(() {
                  _awake = true;
                  _drag = _at(st.globalPosition);
                });
              },
              onPanUpdate: (DragUpdateDetails u) => setState(() => _drag = _at(u.globalPosition)),
              onPanEnd: (DragEndDetails _) {
                final Offset p = _drag ?? Offset(x, y);
                HapticFeedback.lightImpact();
                setState(() {
                  _left = p.dx + s / 2 < box.maxWidth / 2;
                  _yFrac = p.dy.clamp(minY, maxY).toDouble() / span;
                  _drag = null;
                });
                _save();
                _wake();
              },
              child: AnimatedOpacity(
                duration: Duration(milliseconds: reduce ? 0 : 260),
                opacity: _awake ? 1 : .55,
                child: AnimatedScale(
                  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 150),
                  scale: d != null ? 1.08 : 1,
                  child: Semantics(
                    hint: 'Drag to move it',
                    child: widget.child,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ]);
    });
  }
}

// JC-LAZO-WX-1014-001: the weather card, drawn the way Apple draws its weather widget. The sky is the card
// (a gradient picked by the condition and by day or night), type is white, the temperature large and thin,
// the condition and H / L on the right, and underneath either the hours of the day or, further out, this
// date in each of the last five years as range bars on one scale.
class _SkyCard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SkyCard({
    required this.place,
    required this.when,
    required this.w,
    required this.status,
    required this.fold,
    this.who = '',
    this.note = '',
    this.action = '',
    this.radius = 22,
    this.stats = const <List<String>>[],
  });
  final String place;
  final String when;
  final String who;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? w;
  final String status;
  final Widget fold;
  final String note;
  final String action;
  final double radius;
  final List<List<String>> stats; // [label, value] tiles under the card

  static String label(int c) {
    if (c == 0) return 'Clear';
    if (c == 1) return 'Mostly Clear';
    if (c == 2) return 'Partly Cloudy';
    if (c == 3) return 'Cloudy';
    if (c == 45 || c == 48) return 'Foggy';
    if (c >= 51 && c <= 57) return 'Drizzle';
    if (c >= 61 && c <= 67) return c >= 65 ? 'Heavy Rain' : 'Rain';
    if (c >= 71 && c <= 77) return 'Snow';
    if (c >= 80 && c <= 82) return 'Showers';
    if (c == 85 || c == 86) return 'Snow Showers';
    if (c >= 95) return 'Thunderstorms';
    return 'Cloudy';
  }

  static IconData icon(int c, bool day) {
    if (c <= 1) return day ? Icons.wb_sunny_rounded : Icons.nightlight_round;
    if (c == 2) return day ? Icons.wb_cloudy_rounded : Icons.cloud_rounded;
    if (c == 3 || c == 45 || c == 48) return Icons.cloud_rounded;
    if (c >= 95) return Icons.thunderstorm_rounded;
    if ((c >= 71 && c <= 77) || c == 85 || c == 86) return Icons.ac_unit_rounded;
    return Icons.water_drop_rounded;
  }

  // Apple colours its glyphs: a yellow sun, white moon and cloud, blue rain, a yellow bolt
  static Color iconColor(int c, bool day) {
    if (c <= 1) return day ? const Color(0xFFFFD60A) : Colors.white;
    if (c >= 95) return const Color(0xFFFFD60A);
    if ((c >= 51 && c <= 67) || (c >= 80 && c <= 82)) return const Color(0xFF64D2FF);
    return Colors.white;
  }

  static List<Color> sky(int c, bool day) {
    if (c < 0) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF3B4A63), Color(0xFF1F2A3D)];
    if (!day) {
      if (c <= 2) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF0B1230), Color(0xFF1E2C57), Color(0xFF34477A)];
      return const <Color>[Color(0xFF1B2232), Color(0xFF2E3850), Color(0xFF45506A)];
    }
    if (c <= 1) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF2A6FDB), Color(0xFF4C93EE), Color(0xFF7DB8F5)];
    if (c == 2) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF3C74C4), Color(0xFF6B97CF), Color(0xFF9DB9DB)];
    if (c >= 95) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF2B2745), Color(0xFF443D6B), Color(0xFF615A8A)];
    if ((c >= 71 && c <= 77) || c == 85 || c == 86) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF6E86A8), Color(0xFF97ABC6), Color(0xFFC3D0E1)];
    if ((c >= 51 && c <= 67) || (c >= 80 && c <= 82)) return const <Color>[Color(0xFF3E4D61), Color(0xFF5A6A80), Color(0xFF7C8B9E)];
    return const <Color>[Color(0xFF55667F), Color(0xFF75859B), Color(0xFF97A4B6)];
  }

  // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-002: the archive's daily weather_code is the worst hour of the day, so a single
  // overcast hour made a sunny day 'Cloudy'. A past day is judged by what it was: rain or snow when
  // a millimetre or more fell, otherwise the share of daylight that was sunshine.
  static int dayCode(Map<String, dynamic> d) {
    num first(String k) {
      final dynamic v = d[k];
      return v is List && v.isNotEmpty && v.first is num ? v.first as num : -1;
    }

    final int raw = first('weather_code').toInt();
    final num precip = first('precipitation_sum');
    if (precip >= 1.0) return raw >= 51 ? raw : 61;
    final num sun = first('sunshine_duration');
    final num light = first('daylight_duration');
    if (sun < 0 || light <= 0) return raw < 0 ? 1 : (raw >= 51 ? 3 : raw);
    final double r = sun / light;
    if (r >= .85) return 0;
    if (r >= .7) return 1;
    if (r >= .45) return 2;
    if (raw == 45 || raw == 48) return 45;
    return 3;
  }

  // the hours of one day from an Open-Meteo forecast: the next six today, 2 PM to 7 PM on another day
  static List<Map<String, dynamic>> hoursFrom(Map<String, dynamic> j, int daysOut) {
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> out = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> h = Map<String, dynamic>.from(j['hourly'] as Map);
      final List<dynamic> t = h['time'] as List<dynamic>;
      final List<dynamic> temp = h['temperature_2m'] as List<dynamic>;
      final List<dynamic> code = h['weather_code'] as List<dynamic>;
      final List<dynamic> pop = (h['precipitation_probability'] as List<dynamic>?) ?? <dynamic>[];
      final List<dynamic> isDay = (h['is_day'] as List<dynamic>?) ?? <dynamic>[];
      final int startHour = daysOut == 0 ? DateTime.now().hour : 14;
      int start = 0;
      for (int i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
        final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(t[i].toString());
        if (d != null && d.hour >= startHour) {
          start = i;
          break;
        }
      }
      for (int i = start; i < t.length && out.length < 6; i++) {
        final DateTime? d = DateTime.tryParse(t[i].toString());
        if (d == null || temp[i] is! num) continue;
        final int h12 = d.hour % 12 == 0 ? 12 : d.hour % 12;
        out.add(<String, dynamic>{
          'label': daysOut == 0 && out.isEmpty ? 'Now' : '$h12${d.hour < 12 ? 'AM' : 'PM'}',
          't': (temp[i] as num).round(),
          'code': code[i] is num ? (code[i] as num).toInt() : 1,
          'pop': i < pop.length && pop[i] is num ? (pop[i] as num).round() : 0,
          'day': i < isDay.length ? isDay[i] == 1 : (d.hour >= 7 && d.hour < 19),
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return out;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Map<String, dynamic>? w = this.w;
    final bool loaded = w != null;
    final int code = loaded ? (w['code'] as int) : -1;
    final int daysOut = loaded && w['daysOut'] is int ? w['daysOut'] as int : 1;
    // night only matters for today: after sunset or before seven
    bool day = true;
    if (loaded && daysOut == 0) {
      final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
      final DateTime? ss = DateTime.tryParse((w['sunset'] ?? '').toString());
      day = now.hour >= 7 && (ss == null || now.isBefore(ss));
    }
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> hours = loaded && w['hours'] is List
        ? (w['hours'] as List).whereType<Map>().map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m)).toList()
        : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    final List<Map<String, dynamic>> years = loaded && w['yearsRows'] is List
        ? (w['yearsRows'] as List).whereType<Map>().map((Map m) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(m)).toList()
        : <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    const Color fg = Colors.white;
    final Color fg2 = Colors.white.withOpacity(.78);
    TextStyle t(double size, {FontWeight wt = FontWeight.w500, Color color = fg, double h = 1.2, double ls = 0}) =>
        TextStyle(color: color, fontSize: size, fontWeight: wt, height: h, letterSpacing: ls,
            shadows: const <Shadow>[Shadow(color: Color(0x33000000), blurRadius: 6, offset: Offset(0, 1))]);
    final Widget divider = Container(height: .6, color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.22));

    Widget hourStrip() => Row(children: <Widget>[
          for (final Map<String, dynamic> hr in hours)
            Expanded(
              child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Text(hr['label'].toString(), style: t(12, wt: FontWeight.w600, color: fg2)),
                const SizedBox(height: 7),
                Icon(icon(hr['code'] as int, hr['day'] == true), size: 20, color: iconColor(hr['code'] as int, hr['day'] == true)),
                SizedBox(
                  height: 14,
                  child: (hr['pop'] as int) >= 20
                      ? Text('${hr['pop']}%', style: t(10.5, wt: FontWeight.w700, color: const Color(0xFF8FDBFF)))
                      : const SizedBox.shrink(),
                ),
                Text('${hr['t']}°', style: t(15, wt: FontWeight.w600)),
              ]),
            ),
        ]);

    Widget yearRows() {
      int lo = 999, hi = -999;
      for (final Map<String, dynamic> y in years) {
        lo = math.min(lo, y['lo'] as int);
        hi = math.max(hi, y['hi'] as int);
      }
      final double span = math.max(1, hi - lo).toDouble();
      return Column(children: <Widget>[
        for (final Map<String, dynamic> y in years)
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
            child: Row(children: <Widget>[
              SizedBox(width: 44, child: Text(y['y'].toString(), style: t(14, wt: FontWeight.w600))),
              SizedBox(
                width: 30,
                child: Icon(y['rain'] == true ? Icons.water_drop_rounded : icon(y['code'] as int, true),
                    size: 18, color: y['rain'] == true ? const Color(0xFF64D2FF) : iconColor(y['code'] as int, true)),
              ),
              SizedBox(width: 38, child: Text('${y['lo']}°', textAlign: TextAlign.right, style: t(14, wt: FontWeight.w600, color: fg2))),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              Expanded(
                child: LayoutBuilder(builder: (BuildContext c, BoxConstraints b) {
                  final double a = ((y['lo'] as int) - lo) / span * b.maxWidth;
                  final double z = ((y['hi'] as int) - lo) / span * b.maxWidth;
                  return SizedBox(
                    height: 5,
                    child: Stack(children: <Widget>[
                      Positioned.fill(child: DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.16), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3)))),
                      Positioned(
                        left: a,
                        width: math.max(5, z - a),
                        top: 0,
                        bottom: 0,
                        child: DecoratedBox(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(3),
                            gradient: const LinearGradient(colors: <Color>[Color(0xFF5AC8FA), Color(0xFFFFD60A), Color(0xFFFF9F0A)]),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ]),
                  );
                }),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 10),
              SizedBox(width: 34, child: Text('${y['hi']}°', style: t(14, wt: FontWeight.w600))),
            ]),
          ),
      ]);
    }

    // JC-LAZO-WX-1014-002: small frosted tiles, the way Apple lays out sunset and rain
    Widget statTiles() => Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
          for (int i = 0; i < stats.length; i++) ...<Widget>[
            if (i > 0) const SizedBox(width: 8),
            Expanded(
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(10, 8, 10, 9),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.13),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.16), width: .6),
                ),
                child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                  Text(stats[i][0].toUpperCase(),
                      maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(9.5, wt: FontWeight.w700, color: fg2, ls: .8)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 3),
                  Text(stats[i][1], maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(14.5, wt: FontWeight.w600)),
                ]),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ]);

    final List<Color> bg = sky(code, day);
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        gradient: LinearGradient(begin: Alignment.topCenter, end: Alignment.bottomCenter, colors: bg),
        boxShadow: <BoxShadow>[BoxShadow(color: Colors.black.withOpacity(.22), blurRadius: 18, offset: const Offset(0, 8))],
      ),
      foregroundDecoration: BoxDecoration(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(radius),
        border: Border.all(color: Colors.white.withOpacity(.14), width: .8),
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          colors: <Color>[Colors.white.withOpacity(.12), Colors.white.withOpacity(0)],
          stops: const <double>[0, .35],
        ),
      ),
      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 16, 14, 16),
      child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch, children: <Widget>[
        Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
          Expanded(
            child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: <Widget>[
              Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: <Widget>[
                Flexible(child: Text(place, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(17, wt: FontWeight.w600))),
              ]),
              const SizedBox(height: 1),
              Text(when, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(12.5, wt: FontWeight.w500, color: fg2)),
              if (who.isNotEmpty) Text(who, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(12.5, wt: FontWeight.w600)),
            ]),
          ),
          fold,
        ]),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        if (!loaded)
          Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14), child: Text(status, style: t(15, color: fg2)))
        else
          Row(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: <Widget>[
            // today the big number is the temperature now, as Apple's is; another day shows that day's high
            Text('${daysOut == 0 && hours.isNotEmpty ? hours.first['t'] : w['hi']}°', style: t(64, wt: FontWeight.w200, h: 1, ls: -2.5)),
            const Spacer(),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8, right: 4),
              child: Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end, children: <Widget>[
                Icon(icon(code, day), size: 24, color: iconColor(code, day)),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(label(code), style: t(14, wt: FontWeight.w600)),
                Text('${w['mode'] == 'typical' ? 'Avg ' : ''}H:${w['hi']}°  L:${w['lo']}°', style: t(14, wt: FontWeight.w600)),
              ]),
            ),
          ]),
        if (loaded && (hours.isNotEmpty || years.isNotEmpty)) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          divider,
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          if (hours.isNotEmpty) hourStrip() else ...<Widget>[
            Text('THIS DATE, THE LAST ${years.length} YEARS', style: t(10.5, wt: FontWeight.w700, color: fg2, ls: 1.2)),
            const SizedBox(height: 6),
            yearRows(),
          ],
        ],
        if (loaded && stats.isNotEmpty) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          statTiles(),
        ],
        if (loaded && (note.isNotEmpty || action.isNotEmpty)) ...<Widget>[
          const SizedBox(height: 10),
          divider,
          const SizedBox(height: 9),
          Row(children: <Widget>[
            Expanded(child: Text(note, maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, style: t(12.5, wt: FontWeight.w500, color: fg2))),
            if (action.isNotEmpty) Text('$action ›', style: t(12.5, wt: FontWeight.w700)),
          ]),
        ],
      ]),
    );
  }
}
